    # WeBox 接口与交互契约
    
    **日期**：2026-10-16。全部 Tier 1–3 必须交付；本目录定义实施边界，不表示服务已经运行。
    
    - [openapi.yaml](openapi.yaml)：OpenAPI 3.1.0，32 个 HTTP 操作、请求/响应字段、权限和校验。
    - [streaming.md](streaming.md)：库存 SSE、AI POST SSE、事件顺序、重连与模型错误。
    - [data-model.md](../data-model.md)：约束、版本、状态机、事务锁序与统计口径。
    - [quickstart.md](../quickstart.md)：后续实现完成后的启动与验收入口。
    
    ## 1. 公共约定
    
    API 基址 `/api/v1`，与 SPA 同源。唯一例外是公开菜品图片 `/media/{mediaId}`，该操作在 OpenAPI 内显式覆盖 server 为 `/`。请求和响应使用 UTF-8 JSON，上传为 multipart，流为 text/event-stream；系统提供的展示文案和错误 message 是英文；用户地址等自由文本原样安全保留，不强制翻译。
    
    业务 ID 是 UUID 字符串。日期是 `YYYY-MM-DD`，时区为 Asia/Shanghai；时间戳为 UTC、带 `Z`。金额为非负整数分，所有计算和传输不得超过 9,007,199,254,740,991；单位字段名以 Cents 结尾。版本也是 JSON 安全整数，不绕回、不重置。供应数量受存储整数上限约束。
    
    全部必填文本 trim 后非空，密码不 trim；长度按 Unicode 码点统一校验。未声明请求字段拒绝，不能通过添加 role、userId、status、price 等字段改变业务权限或成交内容。文本作为文本而非 HTML/SQL/指令处理，参数化查询；LIKE 关键词中的通配符按普通字符处理。公共字符串枚举见 OpenAPI，不在代码中另建中文枚举。
    
    列表采用 page 从 0 开始、size 默认 24/最多 100；菜单按英文名称、ID 稳定排序，订单按 createdAt 降序、ID 稳定排序。类别数组使用重复参数，例如 `?categories=Chinese&categories=Japanese`。空列表返回 200 与空数组。金额和历史展示字段不得从前端输入直接信任。
    
    ## 2. 身份与安全
    
    1. SPA 先 `GET /auth/csrf` 获取 `{token,headerName}`，保存浏览器接受的匿名 session Cookie；headerName 固定 `X-XSRF-TOKEN`。
    2. 注册和登录同样带 CSRF header；注册只创建 Employee，不自动登录。登录成功设置/轮换 HttpOnly `WEBOXSESSION`。
    3. 除 health、csrf、注册/登录和公开媒体外，接口要求登录；所有 `/admin/**` 另要求 Admin。用户身份从服务端会话取得，个人查询按 owner 限制。
    4. 登录/退出后重新读取 CSRF。写请求缺失/错误 token 返回 403；不能用 SameSite 代替 CSRF。退出使服务器会话失效，关闭流、清除个人请求缓存与页面购物车状态，保留按账号隔离的 localStorage 草稿；验证登录身份后才恢复本人草稿并重新校验，不存凭据或地址。
    5. 生产 Cookie 使用 Secure、HttpOnly、SameSite=Lax。仅本地 localhost HTTP 配置允许非 Secure，开发通过代理维持同源。会话默认空闲有效期 8 小时，可配置；SSE 心跳本身不延长空闲期，显式用户操作才续期。
    6. health 仅公开 UP 或失败；媒体仅公开已验证的菜品图片。身份、地址、偏好、订单、报价与流使用 no-store。无权限的个人实体读取返回 404，避免暴露其存在；Console 角色不足返回 403。
    
    ## 3. 接口分组
    
    | 用途 | 入口 | 关键行为 |
    | --- | --- | --- |
    | 账号 | `/auth/csrf`、`/auth/register`、`/auth/login`、`/auth/logout`、`/auth/me` | 唯一邮箱、角色、session、CSRF |
    | 个人设置 | `/me/preferences`、`/me/addresses` | 偏好全量替换带 expectedVersion；地址在订单成功时保存 |
    | 员工菜单 | `/menus/{date}`、`/menus/{date}/dishes/{dishId}` | 仅已上架且安排菜品，售罄仍展示；搜索与偏好排序组合 |
    | 实时供应 | `/menus/{date}/inventory`、`/menus/{date}/events` | 当前快照与流式绝对量，按版本合并 |
    | 结算 | `/checkout/quotes`、`/orders` | 权威报价、不预留库存、一次消费、订单幂等 |
    | 个人订单 | `/orders`、`/orders/{orderId}`、`/orders/{orderId}/cancel` | 本人历史与快照、仅 Pending 可取消 |
    | AI | `/recommendations/stream` | 真实 LLM、硬过滤、逐卡验证、部分失败明确 |
    | 菜品后台 | `/admin/dishes`、`/admin/dishes/{dishId}`、`/admin/dishes/{dishId}/publication` | 版本检查、配置维护、上/下架 |
    | 菜单后台 | `/admin/menus/{date}` | 日期默认由 UI 选次日；允许当日；总量不低于已占用 |
    | 订单后台 | `/admin/orders`、`/admin/orders/{orderId}`、`/admin/orders/{orderId}/status` | Pending→Confirmed→Completed 或 Pending→Cancelled；重复取消返回当前状态 |
    | 看板 | `/admin/dashboard` | 配送日口径、一致性快照、七日趋势与真实库存 |
    | 图片 | `/admin/media`、`/media/{mediaId}` | 管理员上传，安全转换后以不可变URL展示 |
    
    配置、分页等具体字段以 OpenAPI 为准。新建菜品默认 unpublished，显式发布并安排日期后进入员工菜单。配置组至少一个选项；Single 最多一项、Multiple 每项最多一次，required 至少选择一项。保存现有 groupId/optionId 时必须属于该菜品；省略 ID 由服务端生成，旧 ID 的历史快照保留。
    
    ## 4. 结算协议与恢复顺序
    
    购物车没有服务器增减接口。每项提交 `dishId, dishVersion, optionIds, quantity`，总份数 1–5；相同菜品和排序后的相同选项集合归并。客户端金额只用于展示。
    
    草稿使用 `webox.cart.v1:<userId>` 的 localStorage，退出保留，恢复时重取当前菜单，变化须确认、不可用项须调整；不会自动提交。菜品 allergens 仅代表基础标签，所有选项读写和快照携带 allergens。报价的 FLAGGED_ALLERGEN 按每条实际配置计算，以 itemIndex 指向最终 Quote.items 的零基序号；AI 使用基础及全部当前选项标签的并集保守排除。
    
    1. 调用 `POST /checkout/quotes`，服务器检查目标日期、餐次、当前菜单与版本、配置、份数、库存和本人有效订单。成功返回 201 Quote，五分钟有效、不预留库存。总价超预算仅产生 warning。
    2. SLOT_EXPIRED 返回建议日期/餐次，UI 自动调整选择并提示，再请求报价；不能静默替员工创建另一餐次订单。过去日期返回 INVALID_DELIVERY_DATE，不重写成今日。
    3. DISH_CHANGED/DISH_UNAVAILABLE 返回 itemIssues；保留购物车并展示变化，用户调整/确认后才用新的版本请求新报价。ACTIVE_ORDER_EXISTS 将按钮变为 `View Existing Order` 并打开 existingOrderId。
    4. 员工确认新报价和地址后冻结这次提交快照，生成 UUID Idempotency-Key。请求仅含 quoteId 与 addressId/addressText 二选一；地址 text trim 后保存，历史 ID 必须属于本人。
    5. `POST /orders` 首次成功返回 201；同 key、同 canonical payload 重放返回 200 原订单和其当前状态。重放判断先于 quote 是否还存在、到期、被消费、截止时间、当前价格、当前地址或库存核验。
    6. 请求 hash 基于协议版本、规范化 quoteId、地址选择方式与规范化 ID/trim 文本；不直接哈希原始 JSON，也不把可变地址内容重新读入旧 hash。相同 key 改任何有效请求内容都返回 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED。
    7. 一个 quote 最多创建一单。同 key 优先重放；不同 key 使用已消费 quote 返回 QUOTE_CONSUMED。新订单意图必须使用新 quote 和新 key；取消/完成不使旧 quote 可复用。
    8. 写事务锁后再核验时间及当前数据，原子更新订单、快照、历史地址、供应、报价消费和 outbox。失败无部分成功。瞬间截单返回 SLOT_EXPIRED，显示新安排并让用户确认后重新报价。
    9. 网络结果未知时保留 quote/key/请求，重试解析结果；不能因超时生成新 key。成功后仅移除这次实际提交的购物车数量；期间新增内容保留。明确拒绝且用户修正内容后，开启新报价/新 key。
    
    最小订单请求示例（示例 UUID 必须替换为实际报价）：
    
    ```http
    POST /api/v1/orders
    Content-Type: application/json
    Idempotency-Key: 3e6a517e-f9b1-42c2-bc16-3c3df1995506
    X-XSRF-TOKEN: <token from the current session>
    
    {"quoteId":"c3c7bac8-15da-4a2c-8b6f-2105bb594a30","addressText":"Building A, Floor 3"}
    ```
    
    ## 5. 错误与交互恢复
    
    错误共通为 `{code,message,requestId,retryable,...context}`。fieldErrors 解释输入错误，itemIssues 逐菜品解释不足/变化；只有当前用户可访问的已有订单才能返回 existingOrderId。以下是必需业务码，不能仅返回笼统 HTTP 500。
    
    | HTTP / code | 触发与恢复 |
    | --- | --- |
    | 400 VALIDATION_ERROR | 字段、长度、枚举、数量格式或必选配置无效；保持已填内容并就地提示 |
    | 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS / UNAUTHENTICATED | 登录错误或会话失效；前者明确英文反馈，后者进入登录 |
    | 403 FORBIDDEN / CSRF_INVALID | 权限不足或 token 不匹配；不可通过改客户端身份恢复权限 |
    | 404 NOT_FOUND | 不存在或无权查看的个人资源，不泄露 owner |
    | 409 EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED | 规范化邮箱已存在；改邮箱或登录 |
    | 422 INVALID_DELIVERY_DATE / ORDER_LIMIT_EXCEEDED | 过去日期或总份数超限；调整选择 |
    | 409 SLOT_EXPIRED | 附 suggestedDeliveryDate/suggestedMeal；明确切换并重新确认 |
    | 409 ACTIVE_ORDER_EXISTS | 附 existingOrderId；打开已有有效订单，不跳到更晚餐次绕过 |
    | 409 DISH_CHANGED / DISH_UNAVAILABLE | 附 itemIssues；展示变化并重新确认，不静默改价/替换 |
    | 409 INSUFFICIENT_STOCK | 附具体 dishId 与 availableQuantity；整单失败、保留购物车 |
    | 409 QUOTE_EXPIRED / QUOTE_CONSUMED | 重新报价；已成功的同 key 必须仍重放，不返回该错误 |
    | 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED | 同成功 key 不同内容；不自动覆盖或返回另一笔新单 |
    | 409 VERSION_CONFLICT | 运营/偏好资料被并发修改；重读最新内容再确认保存 |
    | 409 ORDER_NOT_CANCELLABLE / INVALID_ORDER_TRANSITION | 状态不允许，展示最新状态；不回退、不恢复不该恢复的库存 |
    | 409 SUPPLY_BELOW_ALLOCATED | 新总量低于现有占用；保留当前总量并提示限制 |
    | 413 IMAGE_TOO_LARGE / 415 IMAGE_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED / 422 IMAGE_INVALID | 文件大小、类型或真实解码失败；允许重新选图 |
    | 429 RATE_LIMITED / 503 TEMPORARY_UNAVAILABLE | 有界限流或锁等待/依赖暂不可用；遵循 Retry-After，重试写订单复用原 key |
    | 503 AI_BUSY / AI_UNAVAILABLE | 流建立前模型队列满或不可用；普通菜单继续可用 |
    
    流建立后的 AI 错误以 [streaming.md](streaming.md) 的 error 事件结束，不将 HTTP 200 误认为完成；INTENT_CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED 是产品内对用户诉求的反馈，不是本计划仍有未决需求。
    
    ## 6. 前端页面契约
    
    | 路由 | 布局/访问 | 必需状态和操作 |
    | --- | --- | --- |
    | `/register`、`/login` | 访客 | 英文校验、错误、成功引导，无角色选择 |
    | `/menu` | 员工布局/登录 | 日期菜单、搜索、多分类、推荐开关、配置对话框、库存/重连、AI入口 |
    | `/cart`、`/checkout` | 员工布局/登录 | 配置、总份数、金额、预算提醒、日期餐次地址、报价变化、现有订单入口 |
    | `/orders`、`/orders/:orderId` | 员工布局/登录 | 分页历史、成功订单配送信息、不可变明细、状态与合法取消 |
    | `/settings` | 员工布局/登录 | 偏好读取/清除/保存、并发冲突、地址选用关联 |
    | `/console/dishes`、`/console/menus` | Console/Admin | 表格、编辑、图片、发布、指定日期供应和冲突反馈 |
    | `/console/orders` | Console/Admin | 筛选、订单详情、确认、完成、Pending 取消 |
    | `/console/dashboard` | Console/Admin | 真实概览、Top10、餐次、七日、预警、Refresh、generatedAt 与英文口径 |
    
    注册/登录后的默认入口：Employee 到 `/menu`，Admin 到 `/console/dishes`。管理员可保留员工功能入口，但 Console 操作只能由服务端验证 Admin。过敏原警告与预算警告都不硬过滤普通菜单；AI 则必须过滤已标记过敏原。关键操作需要键盘可用、焦点明确和可读错误，375/768/1440 宽度无页面级横向滚动。
    
    菜单与购物车的加号在总份数达到5或菜品售罄时不可增加，并解释原因；同一菜品不同配置消耗同一剩余量。AI 结果走同一配置和加购入口。新增/编辑/上传失败保留可安全保留的输入；图片加载失败显示替代说明。所有图表附可核对的表格或文字，不仅依靠颜色。
    
    ## 7. 修订后的业务边界
    
    - 管理员沿用 `PATCH /admin/orders/{orderId}/status`，body 为 `{status,expectedVersion}`，status 允许 Confirmed、Completed、Cancelled。身份/CSRF 与锁定后，当前/目标均为 Cancelled 则先于版本比较返回 200 当前 AdminOrder；不写版本、时间或事件。其余请求先验版本，合法转换仅 Pending→Confirmed、Confirmed→Completed、Pending→Cancelled；版本过时为 VERSION_CONFLICT，非法转换为 INVALID_ORDER_TRANSITION。员工取消接口及本人归属限制不变。
    - 看板可选查询参数 `date` 定义 D，省略时取 Asia/Shanghai 运营今天；概览、Top 10、餐次和库存预警统一取 D，趋势为 D-6 至 D 并补零，响应 `date` 回显 D，`generatedAt` 为本次生成的 UTC 时间。仅 Completed 订单贡献收入和销量，收入含加料且显示 Completed Order Amount；按配送日统计，Top 10 按份数降序、dishId 升序。所有状态计订单总数/餐次，Pending+Confirmed 计待处理；预警读取 D 的已安排上架供应行当前剩余量，不回放历史库存。
    - 图片上传与转换产物均最多 5 MiB（5,242,880 字节），大小合规仍须真实解码及像素校验；失败不替换旧图。Media.byteLength 是实际转换产物大小。
    - 用户自由地址允许中文等 Unicode，保留去首尾空白后的原值；所有系统错误和菜单资料仍为英文。
    - 菜单资料缓存只用于版本匹配的读取加速；当前可售范围、库存、报价和下单以数据库为准，见数据模型缓存章节。规格来源与执行状态见 [修订决策](../decisions.md) 和 [验收台账](../acceptance.md)。
    openapi: 3.1.0
    info:
      title: WeBox API
      version: 1.0.0-design
      description: Design contract; all Tier 1–3 features mandatory. API messages and persisted menu copy are English.
        No implementation is asserted. Read README.md and streaming.md for concurrency, recovery and event framing.
    servers:
    - url: /api/v1
      description: Same origin through Vite proxy or production reverse proxy
    tags:
    - name: Auth
    - name: Employee
    - name: Console
    security:
    - sessionCookie: []
    paths:
      /health:
        get:
          operationId: health
          summary: Application and MySQL readiness
          description: No credentials or infrastructure details. AI availability is checked separately and does
            not disable normal ordering.
          tags:
          - Employee
          security: []
          responses:
            '200':
              description: Success
              content:
                application/json:
                  schema:
                    type: object
                    additionalProperties: false
                    properties:
                      status:
                        type: string
                        const: UP
                    required:
                    - status
            '503':
              description: English error with stable business code. See README.md for recovery rules.
              content:
                application/json:
                  schema:
                    $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
            '500':
              description: English error with stable business code. See README.md for recovery rules.
              content:
                application/json:
                  schema:
                    $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
      /auth/csrf:
        get:
          operationId: getCsrf
          summary: Get a session-bound CSRF token
          description: 'May create an anonymous session. Cache-Control: no-store. Re-fetch after login/logout.
            A session cookie must accompany the token on subsequent requests.'
          tags:
          - Auth
          security: []
          responses:
            '200':
              description: Success
              content:
                application/json:
                  schema:
                    $ref: '#/components/schemas/Csrf'
            '500':
              description: English error with stable business code. See README.md for recovery rules.
              content:
                application/json:
                  schema:
                    $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
      /auth/register:
        post:
          operationId: register
          summary: Register an employee
          description: EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED for a normalized duplicate. Does not log in. Client cannot set
            role.
          tags:
          - Auth
          security:
          - csrfToken: []
          responses:
            '201':
              description: Success
              content:
                application/json:
                  schema:
                    $ref: '#/components/schemas/User'
            '409':
              description: English error with stable business code. See README.md for recovery rules.
              content:
                application/json:
                  schema:
                    $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
            '400':
              description: English error with stable business code. See README.md for recovery rules.
              content:
                application/json:
                  schema:
                    $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
            '429':
              description: English error with stable business code. See README.md for recovery rules.
              content:
                application/json:
                  schema:
                    $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
            '403':
              description: English error with stable business code. See README.md for recovery rules.
              content:
                application/json:
                  schema:
                    $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
            '500':
              description: English error with stable business code. See README.md for recovery rules.
              content:
                application/json:
                  schema:
                    $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
          requestBody:
            required: true
            content:
              application/json:
                schema:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Registration'
      /auth/login:
        post:
          operationId: login
          summary: Log in and rotate the session
          description: Sets WEBOXSESSION HttpOnly cookie. Invalid credentials return INVALID_CREDENTIALS; do not
            disclose password details.
          tags:
          - Auth
          security:
          - csrfToken: []
          responses:
            '200':
              description: Success
              content:
                application/json:
                  schema:
                    $ref: '#/components/schemas/User'
            '400':
              description: English error with stable business code. See README.md for recovery rules.
              content:
                application/json:
                  schema:
                    $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
            '403':
              description: English error with stable business code. See README.md for recovery rules.
              content:
                application/json:
                  schema:
                    $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
            '429':
              description: English error with stable business code. See README.md for recovery rules.
              content:
                application/json:
                  schema:
                    $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
            '401':
              description: English error with stable business code. See README.md for recovery rules.
              content:
                application/json:
                  schema:
                    $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
            '500':
              description: English error with stable business code. See README.md for recovery rules.
              content:
                application/json:
                  schema:
                    $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
          requestBody:
            required: true
            content:
              application/json:
                schema:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Login'
      /auth/logout:
    # WeBox 数据模型与事务设计
    
    **日期**：2026-10-16
    **依据**：[spec.md](spec.md)、[research.md](research.md)、[delivery-constraints.md](delivery-constraints.md)。全部 Tier 1–3 均在本模型范围内。本文定义实现约束，不表示迁移、代码或测试已经完成。
    
    ## 1. 通用约定
    
    | 项目 | 约定 |
    | --- | --- |
    | 数据库 | 独立 MySQL 8.4 LTS，业务表使用 InnoDB，字符集 utf8mb4；迁移由 Flyway 管理 |
    | 标识 | 业务实体 ID 为服务端生成的 UUID 字符串；持久化 `CHAR(36)`、ASCII 二进制比较；API 使用字符串，不暴露自增序号 |
    | 金额 | 人民币整数分；Java `long` / SQL `BIGINT` / JSON 安全整数；合法范围为 0–9,007,199,254,740,991，计算必须检查乘加溢出与 JSON 上界；展示固定两位小数 |
    | 配送日 | Java `LocalDate` / SQL `DATE`，接口 `YYYY-MM-DD`；它不是 UTC 时间戳 |
    | 事件时间 | Java `Instant`，持久化 `DATETIME(6)` 且 JDBC、数据库会话统一 UTC；接口为带 `Z` 的 ISO 8601 |
    | 运营时区 | `Asia/Shanghai`；服务端注入 `Clock`，以运营时间计算今天、截止时间、最近七个自然日 |
    | 版本 | 可变业务记录使用非负整数 `version`；每次成功修改递增，API 保持 JSON 安全整数范围；日期菜单使用同义的 `revision` |
    | 文本 | 必填文本 trim 后非空；密码不 trim、不截断；系统英文业务内容在服务端校验/初始化和界面验收中共同保证；用户自由地址保留原文，不翻译 |
    | 字符长度 | 校验统一按 Unicode 码点计数；不得一端按 UTF-16 单元、一端按字符而形成不同边界 |
    | 删除 | 不实现业务实体任意硬删除；菜品下架、供应取消安排使用状态；订单与快照不级联删除 |
    | 空值 | 未设置的可选标量使用 NULL；未标记过敏原、无偏好菜系、无配置使用空集合，不创建 `None` 伪记录 |
    | 权威来源 | MySQL 是权威来源；单实例使用版本化 Caffeine 菜单资料缓存，库存、报价、订单、权限、日期可售范围和经营汇总不缓存 |
    
    `created_at`、`updated_at` 适用于可变根实体。未另行说明时，外键使用 `RESTRICT`；外键关系不能代替当前用户的所有权检查。API 字段采用 camelCase，本文列名采用 snake_case。
    
    ### 业务枚举
    
    | 字段 | 允许值 |
    | --- | --- |
    | 用户角色 | `Employee`、`Admin`；公开注册固定为 Employee |
    | Category | `Chinese`、`Western`、`Japanese`、`Light Meal`、`Korean`、`Southeast Asian` |
    | Spice | `None`、`Mild`、`Medium`、`Hot` |
    | Allergen | `Peanuts`、`Dairy`、`Egg`、`Gluten`、`Soy`、`Fish`、`Shellfish` |
    | Flavor | `Light`、`Moderate`、`Strong` |
    | Meal | `Lunch`、`Dinner` |
    | Order status | `Pending`、`Confirmed`、`Completed`、`Cancelled` |
    | 配置选择方式 | `Single`、`Multiple`；单选组最多一项，多选组每选项每份最多一次 |
    
    存储采用受 CHECK 限制的字符串，而非允许任意文本的字段；前后端从同一契约生成/维护允许值。SQL CHECK 验证单行不变量，跨行约束由事务服务与有针对性的集成测试保证。
    
    ## 2. 账号、偏好与地址
    
    ### users
    
    | 字段 | 类型与规则 |
    | --- | --- |
    | id | UUID 主键 |
    | email | VARCHAR(200)，trim 后的展示邮箱 |
    | normalized_email | VARCHAR(200)，trim + `Locale.ROOT` 小写；使用二进制排序规则精确唯一，避免重音折叠 |
    | password_hash | VARCHAR(255)，包含算法标识、参数及盐的 Argon2id 编码；不保存原始密码 |
    | role | Employee / Admin；管理员由受控初始化过程创建 |
    | version | 非负整数 |
    | created_at, updated_at | UTC 时间 |
    
    唯一索引：`normalized_email`。注册与登录密码为 8–128 个字符且包含字母与数字；验证原输入，不采用 bcrypt 的 72 字节截断。密码哈希、CSRF token、会话内容不得进入业务日志、AI 提示或 API 用户响应。
    
    用户行也是同一员工订单写操作的串行锁：创建订单、取消和管理员确认/完成/取消均先锁订单所属用户，而不是锁操作者管理员。管理员操作前可只读定位订单的不可变 owner，再按规定锁序重新读取与校验。
    
    ### dietary_preferences / preference_cuisines / preference_allergens
    
    | 实体 | 字段与约束 |
    | --- | --- |
    | dietary_preferences | `user_id` 同时为主键及 users 外键；`spice`、`flavor` 可为 NULL；`budget_min_cents`、`budget_max_cents` 可为 NULL；`version`；UTC `updated_at` |
    | preference_cuisines | 复合主键 `(user_id, category)`；user_id 关联偏好根记录；category 受枚举约束 |
    | preference_allergens | 复合主键 `(user_id, allergen)`；user_id 关联偏好根记录；allergen 受枚举约束 |
    
    预算上下限必须同时为 NULL 或同时为非负整数，设置时下限不大于上限。不存在偏好记录等价于全部未设置；第一次保存创建根记录。清除偏好保留根记录并清空集合/可选字段、递增 version，避免丢失并发版本。
    
    更新按 user → preference 根记录加锁，以客户端 expected version 防止覆盖其他页面刚保存的内容；子集合替换与版本递增在同一事务中完成。过敏原是普通加购提醒的依据，也是 AI 候选的硬过滤条件，两种使用方式不能混淆。
    
    ### delivery_addresses
    
    | 字段 | 类型与规则 |
    | --- | --- |
    | id | UUID 主键 |
    | user_id | users 外键；每次按当前用户过滤读取 |
    | address_text | VARCHAR(200)，trim 后非空，不擅自合并内部空格或改变大小写 |
    | created_at, last_used_at | UTC 时间 |
    
    索引：`(user_id,last_used_at,id)`；唯一约束 `(user_id,address_text)`，地址文本采用精确比较，仅复用完全相同的 trim 后地址。输入新地址只在下单成功事务中持久化；订单失败不能留下被宣称成功使用的地址。订单保存独立 `delivery_address_snapshot`，后续地址变化不影响历史。
    
    ## 3. 菜品、配置与媒体
    
    ### dishes / dish_allergens
    
    | 字段 | 类型与规则 |
    | --- | --- |
    | dishes.id | UUID 主键 |
    | name | VARCHAR(100)，非空英文名称 |
    | description | VARCHAR(2000)，非空英文描述 |
    | base_price_cents | BIGINT，非负且不超过安全整数上界 |
    | category | Category 枚举 |
    | protein_source | VARCHAR(200)，非空英文内容 |
    | spice | Spice 枚举 |
    | media_id | media_assets 外键；必须指向已验证、可展示的图片 |
    | is_listed | BOOLEAN；只有上架且按目标日期安排的菜品进入员工菜单 |
    | version | 整数；资料、图片、过敏原、配置或价格变化均递增 |
    | created_at, updated_at | UTC 时间 |
    | dish_allergens | `(dish_id,allergen)` 复合主键，dish_id 外键；空集合表示无已声明过敏原 |
    
    索引：`(is_listed,category,name,id)`、`(name,id)`；名称不是唯一身份。关键词按名称/描述进行不区分大小写的包含查询，转义 LIKE 的 `%`、`_`、反斜线等字符，输入是文字，不是查询语法；500 菜品规模先测量现有索引和分页，无需引入搜索服务。
    
    菜品基础标签存于 dish_allergens；选项标签存于 option_allergens，不能将所有加料混写为菜品基础标签。下架不删除菜品、历史条目或供应；再次上架也不会改变已成交快照。管理员编辑按 dish 根行锁串行化，并校验 expected version，子表修改与 dish version 递增原子完成。
    
    ### customization_groups / customization_options
    
    | 实体 | 字段与约束 |
    | --- | --- |
    | customization_groups | `id` UUID；`dish_id` FK；`name` VARCHAR(100) 非空；`selection_mode` Single/Multiple；`required` BOOLEAN；`display_order` 非负整数 |
    | customization_options | `id` UUID；`group_id` FK；`name` VARCHAR(100) 非空；`extra_price_cents` 非负 BIGINT；`display_order` 非负整数 |
    | option_allergens | `(option_id,allergen)` 复合主键；option_id 外键，allergen 使用统一枚举；空集合表示未标记 |
    
    索引：groups `(dish_id,display_order,id)`，options `(group_id,display_order,id)`。配置组和选项由所属 dish version 覆盖，不单独建立与菜品不一致的报价版本。
    
    普通配置有效过敏原 = dish_allergens ∪ 已选 option_allergens；报价逐条计算告警，不混入同菜其他配置；FLAGGED_ALLERGEN 的 itemIndex 指向归并后 Quote.items 的零基序号，allergens 为该条目与个人标记的非空交集。加购和编辑配置出现新的个人匹配时重新提醒，拒绝则保留原条目。AI 过滤使用基础标签与所有当前选项标签的并集。选项标签变动递增 dish version、使旧报价需重新确认；不根据菜名猜测标签，空标签不代表安全承诺。
    
    跨行校验：有配置组时每组至少一个选项；required 组必须选择；Single 组只能选一个；Multiple 组不得重复 option；选项必须属于所提交菜品的有效组。当前配置可在锁 dish 后整体维护；报价与订单保留 option/group ID 及名称/价格/选项过敏原快照，不对这些当前可变子记录建立会破坏历史的级联依赖。
    
    ### media_assets
    
    | 字段 | 类型与规则 |
    | --- | --- |
    | id | UUID 主键 |
    | uploaded_by | users 外键，创建者必须为管理员 |
    | original_filename | VARCHAR(255)，仅审计文本，不参与路径拼接，不作为下载响应的可信文件名 |
    | source_mime, source_bytes | 真实检测的 JPEG/PNG/WebP 类型；输入大小 1–5,242,880 字节 |
    | content_sha256 | 固定长度摘要，便于内容核对；不作为业务权限标识 |
    | width, height | 正整数；解码前/过程中执行像素和内存上限，实施默认每边不超过 8192、总像素不超过 16,777,216 |
    | storage_key | 服务端随机生成的相对资源键，唯一；解析后的路径必须位于受控持久媒体目录内 |

    specs/001-webox-meal-ordering/data-model.md:248:Completed/Cancelled 都是该订单的终态。Completed 不阻止在截止前使用新报价、新 key 重新下单；库存仍受限制。管理员操作先验证身份并锁 owner/order。目标与当前均为 Cancelled 时先于版本比较返回 200 当前订单，不写时间、版本、库存或事件；除此之外先校验 expectedVersion，旧版本返回 VERSION_CONFLICT。其余相同状态返回 INVALID_ORDER_TRANSITION；不能把 Completed 上的确认请求当作允许回退，也不允许跳过 Confirmed。

    import org.springframework.boot.test.context.TestConfiguration;

    import org.springframework.context.annotation.Primary;
    import org.springframework.test.context.ActiveProfiles;

    import org.testcontainers.DockerClientFactory;
    import org.testcontainers.mysql.MySQLContainer;
    
    /** A disposable real database; never connects to the development Compose volume. */
    @ActiveProfiles("test")
    @Import(MySqlTestSupport.TimeConfiguration.class)
    public abstract class MySqlTestSupport {
        // Digest identifies MySQL 8.4.11. Testcontainers expects repository@digest without a tag.
        public static final String MYSQL_IMAGE = "mysql@sha256:24989179f58856db763f418010c1169fecc944e3ec1ea7e921572d83eb070f70";
        public static final Instant INITIAL_TIME = Instant.parse("2026-10-16T01:00:00Z");
        protected static final MutableClock TEST_CLOCK = new MutableClock(INITIAL_TIME, ZoneOffset.UTC);
        protected static final Path MEDIA_ROOT = temporaryMedia();
        protected static final MySQLContainer MYSQL = database();
    
        static {
            Runtime.getRuntime().addShutdownHook(new Thread(() -> {
                MYSQL.stop();
                try (var paths = Files.walk(MEDIA_ROOT)) {
                    paths.sorted(Comparator.reverseOrder()).forEach(path -> {
                        try { Files.deleteIfExists(path); } catch (IOException ignored) { /* Temporary files only. */ }
                    });
                } catch (IOException ignored) { /* The OS may already have removed the temporary directory. */ }
            }, "webox-test-cleanup"));
        }
    
        private static Path temporaryMedia() {
            try { return Files.createTempDirectory("webox-test-media-"); }
            catch (IOException e) { throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot create isolated test media directory", e); }
        }
    
        private static MySQLContainer database() {
            if (!DockerClientFactory.instance().isDockerAvailable()) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("Docker is required for core MySQL integration tests; tests cannot be skipped.");
            }
            var mysql = new MySQLContainer(MYSQL_IMAGE)
                    .withDatabaseName("webox_test")
                    .withUsername("webox_test")
                    .withPassword(UUID.randomUUID().toString())
                    .withCommand("--character-set-server=utf8mb4", "--collation-server=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci", "--default-time-zone=+00:00");
            mysql.start();
            return mysql;
        }
    
        @DynamicPropertySource
        static void databaseProperties(DynamicPropertyRegistry properties) {
            properties.add("spring.datasource.url", () -> MYSQL.getJdbcUrl() + "&connectionTimeZone=UTC&forceConnectionTimeZoneToSession=true");
            properties.add("spring.datasource.username", MYSQL::getUsername);
            properties.add("spring.datasource.password", MYSQL::getPassword);
            properties.add("webox.media-root", () -> MEDIA_ROOT.toString());
        }
    
        @TestConfiguration(proxyBeanMethods = false)
        public static class TimeConfiguration {
            @Bean @Primary Clock testClock() { return TEST_CLOCK; }
        }
    
        public static final class MutableClock extends Clock {
            private final AtomicReference<Instant> current;
            private final ZoneId zone;
            public MutableClock(Instant instant, ZoneId zone) { this(new AtomicReference<>(instant), zone); }
            private MutableClock(AtomicReference<Instant> current, ZoneId zone) { this.current = current; this.zone = zone; }
            public void set(Instant instant) { current.set(instant); }
            @Override public ZoneId getZone() { return zone; }
            @Override public Clock withZone(ZoneId zone) { return new MutableClock(current, zone); }
            @Override public Instant instant() { return current.get(); }
        }
    }

        package com.webox.shared;
        import java.nio.file.Path;
        import java.time.*;
        import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
        import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;
        import com.webox.shared.DomainTypes.*;
        import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
        class ValueRulesTest {
            @Test void sharedSamplesMatchMoneyAndUnicodeContract() throws Exception {
                var json=JsonMapper.builder().build().readTree(Path.of("../shared/fixtures/values.json"));
                for (var row:json.path("money")) assertEquals(row.path("display").asText(), ValueRules.money(row.path("cents").asLong()));
                for (var row:json.path("texts")) {
                    String normalized=ValueRules.requiredText(row.path("input").asText(), 200);
                    assertEquals(row.path("normalized").asText(), normalized);
                    assertEquals(row.path("codePoints").asInt(), ValueRules.codePoints(normalized));
                }
                assertEquals(json.path("password").asText(), ValueRules.password(json.path("password").asText()));
            }
            @Test void arithmeticNeverRoundsOverflowsOrWraps() {
                assertEquals(ValueRules.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, ValueRules.add(ValueRules.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,0));
                assertEquals(5900, ValueRules.multiply(2950,2));
                assertEquals(1,ValueRules.nextVersion(0));
                assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->ValueRules.safeInteger(-1));
                assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->ValueRules.add(ValueRules.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,1));
                assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->ValueRules.multiply(ValueRules.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,Long.MAX_VALUE));
                assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->ValueRules.nextVersion(ValueRules.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER));
            }
            @Test void textAndPasswordBoundariesUseCodePointsWithoutTruncation() {
                assertEquals("🍜".repeat(200),ValueRules.requiredText("🍜".repeat(200),200));
                assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->ValueRules.requiredText("🍜".repeat(201),200));
                assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->ValueRules.requiredText(" \n\u3000",200));
                assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->ValueRules.requiredText("\uD800",200));
                assertEquals("A1"+"🍜".repeat(126),ValueRules.password("A1"+"🍜".repeat(126)));
                for (String invalid:new String[]{"A123456", "abcdefgh", "12345678", "A1"+"x".repeat(127)})
                    assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->ValueRules.password(invalid));
            }
            @Test void operatingDatesAndCutoffsDoNotDependOnMachineTimezone() {
                var clock=new BusinessClock(Clock.fixed(Instant.parse("2026-10-16T16:00:00Z"),ZoneOffset.ofHours(-5)));
                assertEquals(LocalDate.of(2026,10,17),clock.today());
                assertEquals(Instant.parse("2026-10-17T02:00:00Z"),clock.cutoff(clock.today(),Meal.Lunch));
                assertEquals(Instant.parse("2026-10-17T07:00:00Z"),clock.cutoff(clock.today(),Meal.Dinner));
                assertEquals(Instant.parse("2026-10-16T16:00:00Z"),clock.now());
            }
            @Test void enumWireValuesAreExact() {
                var mapper=JsonMapper.builder().build();
                assertEquals("\"Light Meal\"",mapper.writeValueAsString(Category.LightMeal));
                assertEquals(Category.SoutheastAsian,mapper.readValue("\"Southeast Asian\"",Category.class));
                assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->Category.parse("LightMeal"));
            }
        }

              expect(parseMoney(row.display)).toBe(row.cents);

        package com.webox.shared;
        
        import java.util.Locale;
        import java.util.regex.Pattern;
        
        /** Shared scalar rules. No floating point is used for money. */
        public final class ValueRules {
            public static final long MAX_SAFE_INTEGER = 9007199254740991L;
            private static final Pattern EDGE_SPACE = Pattern.compile("^[\\x09-\\x0D\\x20\\u00A0\\u1680\\u2000-\\u200A\\u2028\\u2029\\u202F\\u205F\\u3000\\uFEFF]+|[\\x09-\\x0D\\x20\\u00A0\\u1680\\u2000-\\u200A\\u2028\\u2029\\u202F\\u205F\\u3000\\uFEFF]+$");
            private ValueRules() {}
            public static long safeInteger(long value) {
                if (value < 0 || value > MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Value must be a non-negative safe integer.");
                return value;
            }
            public static long add(long a, long b) {
                safeInteger(a); safeInteger(b);
                if (a > MAX_SAFE_INTEGER - b) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Total exceeds the supported amount.");
                return a + b;
            }
            public static long multiply(long a, long b) {
                safeInteger(a); safeInteger(b);
                if (b != 0 && a > MAX_SAFE_INTEGER / b) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Total exceeds the supported amount.");
                return a * b;
            }
            public static long nextVersion(long value) { return add(value, 1); }
            public static String money(long cents) {
                safeInteger(cents);
                return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%d.%02d", cents / 100, cents % 100);
            }
            public static String requiredText(String text, int max) {
                if (text == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("This field is required.");
                String normalized = EDGE_SPACE.matcher(text).replaceAll("");
                int length = codePoints(normalized);
                if (length == 0 || length > max) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Text must contain 1 to " + max + " characters.");
                return normalized;
            }
            public static String password(String text) {
                int length = codePoints(text);
                if (length < 8 || length > 128 || !Pattern.compile("[A-Za-z]").matcher(text).find() || !Pattern.compile("[0-9]").matcher(text).find())
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Password must contain 8 to 128 characters, including a letter and a number.");
                return text;
            }
            public static int codePoints(String text) {
                if (text == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("This field is required.");
                for (int i=0; i<text.length(); i++) {
                    char c=text.charAt(i);
                    if (Character.isHighSurrogate(c)) {
                        if (++i >= text.length() || !Character.isLowSurrogate(text.charAt(i))) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Text contains invalid Unicode.");
                    } else if (Character.isLowSurrogate(c)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Text contains invalid Unicode.");
                }
                return text.codePointCount(0,text.length());
            }
        }

        export const MAX_SAFE_INTEGER = Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
        export function safeInteger(value: number): number {
          if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value < 0) throw new Error('Value must be a non-negative safe integer.');
          return value;
        }
        export function money(cents: number): string {
          const exact = BigInt(safeInteger(cents));
          return `${exact / 100n}.${String(exact % 100n).padStart(2, '0')}`;
        }
        export function parseMoney(input: string): number {
          if (!/^\d{1,14}(\.\d{1,2})?$/.test(input)) throw new Error('Enter a valid amount with at most two decimal places.');
          const [whole, fraction = ''] = input.split('.');
          const cents = BigInt(whole) * 100n + BigInt(fraction.padEnd(2, '0'));
          if (cents > BigInt(MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)) throw new Error('Amount exceeds the supported limit.');
          return Number(cents);
        }
        export function codePoints(text: string): number {
          // A lone surrogate cannot be stored faithfully in utf8mb4.
          for (const point of text) {
            const code = point.codePointAt(0)!;
            if (code >= 0xd800 && code <= 0xdfff) throw new Error('Text contains invalid Unicode.');
          }
          return Array.from(text).length;
        }
        export function requiredText(text: string, max: number): string {
          const normalized = text.trim();
          const length = codePoints(normalized);
          if (!length || length > max) throw new Error(`Text must contain 1 to ${max} characters.`);
          return normalized;
        }
        export function password(text: string): string {
          const length = codePoints(text);
          if (length < 8 || length > 128 || !/[A-Za-z]/.test(text) || !/[0-9]/.test(text)) {
            throw new Error('Password must contain 8 to 128 characters, including a letter and a number.');
          }
          return text;
        }
        EOF

        package com.webox.shared;
        import java.util.List;
        import java.util.Map;
        import java.util.Set;
        /** Only server-authored messages and authorized context belong in public errors. */
        public final class ApiException extends RuntimeException {
            private static final Set<String> CONTEXT_KEYS = Set.of("fieldErrors", "itemIssues", "existingOrderId", "suggestedDeliveryDate", "suggestedMeal");
            private final int status;
            private final String code;
            private final boolean retryable;
            private final Map<String,Object> context;
            public ApiException(int status, String code, String message) { this(status,code,message,false,Map.of()); }
            public ApiException(int status, String code, String message, boolean retryable, Map<String,Object> context) {
                super(message);
                if (!CONTEXT_KEYS.containsAll(context.keySet())) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported error context.");
                this.status=status; this.code=code; this.retryable=retryable; this.context=Map.copyOf(context);
            }
            public int status() { return status; }
            public String code() { return code; }
            public boolean retryable() { return retryable; }
            public Map<String,Object> context() { return context; }
            public static ApiException validation(String field, String message) {
                return new ApiException(400,"VALIDATION_ERROR","Please check the highlighted fields.",false,
                        Map.of("fieldErrors",List.of(Map.of("field",field,"message",message))));
            }
        }

        package com.webox.shared;
        import java.io.IOException;
        import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
        import java.util.Map;
        import java.util.UUID;
        import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
        import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
        import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;
        public final class ApiErrors {
            public static final String REQUEST_ID = ApiErrors.class.getName()+".requestId";
            private ApiErrors() {}
            public static String requestId(HttpServletRequest request) {
                var value=request.getAttribute(REQUEST_ID);
                if (value instanceof String s) return s;
                String id=UUID.randomUUID().toString(); request.setAttribute(REQUEST_ID,id); return id;
            }
            public static Map<String,Object> body(HttpServletRequest request, ApiException error) {
                var result=new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();
                result.put("code",error.code()); result.put("message",error.getMessage());
                result.put("requestId",requestId(request)); result.put("retryable",error.retryable()); result.putAll(error.context());
                return result;
            }
            public static void write(JsonMapper mapper,HttpServletRequest request,HttpServletResponse response,ApiException error) throws IOException {
                response.setStatus(error.status()); response.setContentType("application/json"); response.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");
                response.setHeader("Cache-Control","no-store");response.setHeader("X-Request-Id",requestId(request));
                response.getWriter().write(mapper.writeValueAsString(body(request,error)));
            }
        }

        package com.webox.shared;
        import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
        import org.slf4j.Logger;
        import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
        import org.springframework.dao.DataAccessException;
        import org.springframework.dao.TransientDataAccessException;
        import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
        import org.springframework.http.converter.HttpMessageNotReadableException;
        import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
        import org.springframework.web.bind.MethodArgumentNotValidException;
        import org.springframework.web.method.annotation.MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException;
        import org.springframework.web.servlet.resource.NoResourceFoundException;
        import org.springframework.web.multipart.MaxUploadSizeExceededException;
        import org.springframework.web.HttpRequestMethodNotSupportedException;
        import org.springframework.web.HttpMediaTypeNotSupportedException;
        import java.util.Map;
        @RestControllerAdvice
        public class ApiExceptionHandler {
            private static final Logger LOG=LoggerFactory.getLogger(ApiExceptionHandler.class);
            @ExceptionHandler(ApiException.class)
            public ResponseEntity<Map<String,Object>> business(ApiException e,HttpServletRequest request) {
                return ResponseEntity.status(e.status()).header("Cache-Control","no-store").body(ApiErrors.body(request,e));
            }
            @ExceptionHandler({HttpMessageNotReadableException.class,MethodArgumentNotValidException.class,MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException.class,IllegalArgumentException.class,HttpRequestMethodNotSupportedException.class,HttpMediaTypeNotSupportedException.class})
            public ResponseEntity<Map<String,Object>> invalid(Exception e,HttpServletRequest request) {
                return business(new ApiException(400,"VALIDATION_ERROR","The request contains invalid or unsupported fields."),request);
            }
            @ExceptionHandler(NoResourceFoundException.class)
            public ResponseEntity<Map<String,Object>> missing(Exception e,HttpServletRequest request) {
                return business(new ApiException(404,"NOT_FOUND","The requested resource was not found."),request);
            }
            @ExceptionHandler(MaxUploadSizeExceededException.class)
            public ResponseEntity<Map<String,Object>> upload(Exception e,HttpServletRequest request) {
                return business(new ApiException(413,"IMAGE_TOO_LARGE","The image exceeds the 5 MiB limit."),request);
            }
            @ExceptionHandler(TransientDataAccessException.class)
            public ResponseEntity<Map<String,Object>> temporary(Exception e,HttpServletRequest request) {
                LOG.warn("requestId={} code=TEMPORARY_UNAVAILABLE type={}",ApiErrors.requestId(request),e.getClass().getSimpleName());
                return business(new ApiException(503,"TEMPORARY_UNAVAILABLE","The service is temporarily unavailable. Please retry.",true,Map.of()),request);
            }
            @ExceptionHandler({DataAccessException.class,Exception.class})
            public ResponseEntity<Map<String,Object>> unexpected(Exception e,HttpServletRequest request) {
                // Exception messages and stacks can contain SQL parameters or private request content.
                LOG.error("requestId={} code=INTERNAL_ERROR type={}",ApiErrors.requestId(request),e.getClass().getSimpleName());
                return business(new ApiException(500,"INTERNAL_ERROR","Something went wrong. Please try again."),request);
            }
        }

        package com.webox.shared;
        import java.io.*;
        import java.time.Clock;
        import jakarta.servlet.*;
        import jakarta.servlet.http.*;
        import org.springframework.boot.web.servlet.FilterRegistrationBean;
        import org.springframework.boot.jackson.autoconfigure.JsonFactoryBuilderCustomizer;
        import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
        import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
        import org.springframework.core.Ordered;
        import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter;
        import tools.jackson.core.StreamReadConstraints;
        import tools.jackson.core.StreamReadFeature;
        import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;
        @Configuration(proxyBeanMethods=false)
        public class WebConfiguration {
            public static final int MAX_JSON_BYTES=1_048_576;
            @Bean Clock applicationClock() { return Clock.systemUTC(); }
            @Bean JsonFactoryBuilderCustomizer jsonLimits() {
                return builder -> builder.streamReadConstraints(StreamReadConstraints.builder().maxNestingDepth(40).maxStringLength(MAX_JSON_BYTES).maxNumberLength(32).build())
                        .enable(StreamReadFeature.STRICT_DUPLICATE_DETECTION);
            }
            @Bean FilterRegistrationBean<OncePerRequestFilter> requestBoundary(JsonMapper mapper) {
                var filter=new OncePerRequestFilter() {
                    @Override protected void doFilterInternal(HttpServletRequest request,HttpServletResponse response,FilterChain chain) throws IOException,ServletException {
                        response.setHeader("X-Request-Id",ApiErrors.requestId(request));
                        if(request.getRequestURI().startsWith("/api/")) response.setHeader("Cache-Control","no-store");
                        if(request.getContentType()!=null && request.getContentType().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT).startsWith("application/json")) {
                            if(request.getContentLengthLong()>MAX_JSON_BYTES) { tooLarge(mapper,request,response); return; }
                            byte[] bytes=request.getInputStream().readNBytes(MAX_JSON_BYTES+1);
                            if(bytes.length>MAX_JSON_BYTES) { tooLarge(mapper,request,response); return; }
                            var wrapped=new HttpServletRequestWrapper(request) {
                                @Override public ServletInputStream getInputStream() {
                                    var input=new ByteArrayInputStream(bytes);
                                    return new ServletInputStream() {
                                        @Override public int read() { return input.read(); }
                                        @Override public int read(byte[] b,int o,int l) { return input.read(b,o,l); }
                                        @Override public boolean isFinished() { return input.available()==0; }
                                        @Override public boolean isReady() { return true; }
                                        @Override public void setReadListener(ReadListener listener) {
                                            try { if(!isFinished()) listener.onDataAvailable(); if(isFinished()) listener.onAllDataRead(); }
                                            catch(IOException e) { listener.onError(e); }
                                        }
                                    };
                                }
                                @Override public BufferedReader getReader() { return new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(getInputStream(),java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8)); }
                            };
                            chain.doFilter(wrapped,response); return;
                        }
                        chain.doFilter(request,response);
                    }
                };
                var bean=new FilterRegistrationBean<OncePerRequestFilter>(filter);
                bean.setOrder(Ordered.HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE+20); bean.setAsyncSupported(true); return bean;
            }
            private static void tooLarge(JsonMapper mapper,HttpServletRequest req,HttpServletResponse res) throws IOException {
                ApiErrors.write(mapper,req,res,new ApiException(400,"VALIDATION_ERROR","The JSON request is too large."));
            }
        }

        CREATE TABLE outbox_events (
            id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
            event_type VARCHAR(40) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
            aggregate_key VARCHAR(100) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
            payload JSON NOT NULL,
            created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
            published_at DATETIME(6) NULL,
            attempt_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            next_attempt_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
            last_error_code VARCHAR(80) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NULL,
            CONSTRAINT ck_outbox_event_type CHECK (event_type IN ('inventory.updated','menu.changed')),
            CONSTRAINT ck_outbox_attempt_count CHECK (attempt_count >= 0),
            INDEX ix_outbox_pending (published_at,next_attempt_at,created_at,id)

        cat > backend/src/main/java/com/webox/inventory/OutboxWriter.java <<'EOF'
        package com.webox.inventory;
        import java.sql.Timestamp;
        import java.time.LocalDate;
        import java.util.Map;
        import java.util.UUID;
        import com.webox.shared.BusinessClock;
        import com.webox.shared.ValueRules;
        import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
        import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
        import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronizationManager;
        import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;
        /** Typed public payloads prevent accidental persistence of personal order data. */
        @Component
        public class OutboxWriter {
            private final JdbcTemplate jdbc; private final JsonMapper mapper; private final BusinessClock clock;
            public OutboxWriter(JdbcTemplate jdbc,JsonMapper mapper,BusinessClock clock) { this.jdbc=jdbc;this.mapper=mapper;this.clock=clock; }
            public void inventoryUpdated(LocalDate date,UUID dishId,long remaining,long version,long revision) {
                ValueRules.safeInteger(remaining); ValueRules.safeInteger(version); ValueRules.safeInteger(revision);
                if (remaining>Integer.MAX_VALUE) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Stock exceeds the supported limit.");
                write("inventory.updated",date+"/"+dishId,Map.of("deliveryDate",date.toString(),"dishId",dishId.toString(),"remaining",remaining,"version",version,"menuRevision",revision,"occurredAt",clock.now().toString()));
            }
            public void menuChanged(LocalDate date,long revision) {
                ValueRules.safeInteger(revision);
                write("menu.changed",date.toString(),Map.of("deliveryDate",date.toString(),"menuRevision",revision));
            }
            private void write(String type,String aggregate,Map<String,Object> payload) {
                if(!TransactionSynchronizationManager.isActualTransactionActive() || TransactionSynchronizationManager.isCurrentTransactionReadOnly())
                    throw new IllegalStateException("Outbox writes require an active business write transaction.");
                Timestamp now=Timestamp.from(clock.now());
                jdbc.update("INSERT INTO outbox_events(id,event_type,aggregate_key,payload,created_at,next_attempt_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                    UUID.randomUUID().toString(),type,aggregate,mapper.writeValueAsString(payload),now,now);
            }
        }
        EOF

        package com.webox.auth;
        import com.webox.shared.ApiErrors;
        import com.webox.shared.ApiException;
        import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
        import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
        import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
        import org.springframework.http.HttpMethod;
        import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity;
        import org.springframework.security.web.SecurityFilterChain;
        import org.springframework.security.web.csrf.HttpSessionCsrfTokenRepository;
        import org.springframework.security.web.csrf.CsrfException;
        import org.springframework.security.web.context.HttpSessionSecurityContextRepository;
        import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetailsService;
        import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UsernameNotFoundException;
        import org.springframework.session.web.http.DefaultCookieSerializer;
        import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;
        @Configuration(proxyBeanMethods=false)
        public class SecurityConfiguration {
            @Bean HttpSessionCsrfTokenRepository csrfRepository() {
                var repo=new HttpSessionCsrfTokenRepository(); repo.setHeaderName("X-XSRF-TOKEN"); return repo;
            }
            @Bean HttpSessionSecurityContextRepository securityContextRepository() { return new HttpSessionSecurityContextRepository(); }
            @Bean UserDetailsService disabledDefaultUser() { return name -> { throw new UsernameNotFoundException("Use the application login endpoint."); }; }
            @Bean DefaultCookieSerializer cookieSerializer(@Value("${server.servlet.session.cookie.secure}") boolean secure) {
                var cookie=new DefaultCookieSerializer();cookie.setCookieName("WEBOXSESSION");cookie.setCookiePath("/");
                cookie.setUseHttpOnlyCookie(true);cookie.setUseSecureCookie(secure);cookie.setSameSite("Lax");cookie.setUseBase64Encoding(false);return cookie;
            }
            @Bean SecurityFilterChain security(HttpSecurity http,JsonMapper mapper,HttpSessionCsrfTokenRepository csrf,HttpSessionSecurityContextRepository contexts) throws Exception {
                http.formLogin(c->c.disable()).httpBasic(c->c.disable()).logout(c->c.disable()).requestCache(c->c.disable());
                http.securityContext(c->c.securityContextRepository(contexts).requireExplicitSave(true));
                http.csrf(c->c.csrfTokenRepository(csrf));
                http.authorizeHttpRequests(c->c
                    .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET,"/api/v1/health","/api/v1/auth/csrf","/media/*").permitAll()
                    .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.POST,"/api/v1/auth/register","/api/v1/auth/login").permitAll()
                    .requestMatchers("/api/v1/admin/**").hasRole("Admin")
                    .requestMatchers("/api/v1/**").authenticated().anyRequest().denyAll());
                http.exceptionHandling(c->c
                    .authenticationEntryPoint((req,res,e)->ApiErrors.write(mapper,req,res,new ApiException(401,"UNAUTHENTICATED","Please sign in to continue.")))
                    .accessDeniedHandler((req,res,e)->ApiErrors.write(mapper,req,res,e instanceof CsrfException
                        ? new ApiException(403,"CSRF_INVALID","Your security token is invalid. Please refresh and try again.")
                        : new ApiException(403,"FORBIDDEN","You do not have permission to perform this action."))));
                return http.build();
            }
        }

        package com.webox.auth;
        import org.springframework.session.SessionRepository;
        import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
        /** Read-only repository lookup; no save, HTTP request or last-access update. */
        @Component
        public class SessionValidity {
            private final SessionRepository<?> sessions;
            public SessionValidity(SessionRepository<?> sessions) { this.sessions=sessions; }
            public boolean active(String sessionId) {
                if(sessionId==null) return false;
                var session=sessions.findById(sessionId);
                return session!=null && !session.isExpired() && session.getAttribute("SPRING_SECURITY_CONTEXT")!=null;
            }
        }

        package com.webox.shared;
        import java.util.Map;
        import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
        import org.springframework.dao.DataAccessException;
        import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
        @RestController
        public class HealthController {
            private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
            public HealthController(JdbcTemplate jdbc) { this.jdbc=jdbc; }
            @GetMapping("/api/v1/health")
            public Map<String,String> health() {
                try { if(!Integer.valueOf(1).equals(jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT 1",Integer.class))) throw new IllegalStateException(); }
                catch(DataAccessException | IllegalStateException e) {
                    throw new ApiException(503,"TEMPORARY_UNAVAILABLE","The service is temporarily unavailable. Please retry.",true,Map.of());
                }
                return Map.of("status","UP");
            }
        }

        import type { ApiErrorBody, Csrf } from './types';
        let session = new AbortController();
        let csrf: Promise<Csrf> | undefined;
        export class ApiError extends Error {
          readonly code: string;
          readonly retryable: boolean;
          constructor(readonly status: number, readonly details: ApiErrorBody) {
            super(details.message); this.name = 'ApiError'; this.code = details.code; this.retryable = details.retryable;
          }
        }
        export function resetApiSession(): void {
          session.abort(); session = new AbortController(); csrf = undefined;
        }
        async function decode<T>(response: Response): Promise<T> {
          if (response.status === 204) return undefined as T;
          let body: unknown;
          try { body = await response.json(); }
          catch { throw new Error('The service returned an invalid response. Please try again.'); }
          if (!response.ok) {
            if (body && typeof body === 'object' && 'code' in body && typeof body.code === 'string'
              && 'message' in body && typeof body.message === 'string' && 'retryable' in body && typeof body.retryable === 'boolean') {
              throw new ApiError(response.status, body as ApiErrorBody);
            }
            throw new Error('The service returned an invalid response. Please try again.');
          }
          return body as T;
        }
        export function getCsrf(): Promise<Csrf> {
          if (!csrf) {
            const activeSession = session;
            csrf = fetch('/api/v1/auth/csrf', { credentials: 'same-origin', cache: 'no-store', redirect: 'error', signal: activeSession.signal })
              .then(decode<Csrf>).then(value => {
                activeSession.signal.throwIfAborted();
                if (value.headerName !== 'X-XSRF-TOKEN' || !value.token) throw new Error('The service returned an invalid security token.');
                return value;
              }).catch(error => { if (session === activeSession) csrf = undefined; throw error; });
          }
          return csrf;
        }
        export async function api<T>(path: string, options: { method?: string; json?: unknown; signal?: AbortSignal; headers?: HeadersInit } = {}): Promise<T> {
          if (!path.startsWith('/') || path.startsWith('//') || path.includes('\\') || /[\r\n]/.test(path)) throw new Error('API path must be relative to this application.');
          const method = (options.method ?? 'GET').toUpperCase();
          const signal = options.signal ? AbortSignal.any([session.signal, options.signal]) : session.signal;
          signal.throwIfAborted();
          const headers = new Headers(options.headers);
          headers.set('Accept', 'application/json');
          if (options.json !== undefined) headers.set('Content-Type', 'application/json');
          if (!['GET', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS'].includes(method)) {
            const token = await getCsrf(); signal.throwIfAborted(); headers.set(token.headerName, token.token);
          }
          try {
            const response = await fetch(`/api/v1${path}`, { method, headers, credentials: 'same-origin', cache: 'no-store', redirect: 'error',
              body: options.json === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(options.json), signal });
            signal.throwIfAborted();
            const value = await decode<T>(response); signal.throwIfAborted(); return value;
          } catch (error) {
            if (error instanceof ApiError && error.code === 'CSRF_INVALID') csrf = undefined;
            throw error;
          }
        }

        import com.webox.WeBoxApplication;
        import com.webox.auth.UserIdentity;
        import com.webox.shared.DomainTypes.Role;
        import org.springframework.boot.builder.SpringApplicationBuilder;
        import org.springframework.boot.test.context.TestConfiguration;
        import org.springframework.context.annotation.*;
        import org.springframework.core.annotation.Order;
        import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
        import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity;
        import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;
        import org.springframework.security.web.SecurityFilterChain;
        import org.springframework.session.jdbc.JdbcIndexedSessionRepository;
        import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
        import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;
        /** Only on the test classpath. Owns a disposable container and temporary media directory. */
        public class E2eBackend extends MySqlTestSupport {
            public static void main(String[] args) {
                String key=System.getenv("WEBOX_E2E_FIXTURE_KEY");
                if(key==null || key.length()<32) throw new IllegalStateException("An ephemeral E2E fixture key is required.");
                URI origin=URI.create(System.getenv().getOrDefault("WEBOX_E2E_API_ORIGIN","http://127.0.0.1:18081"));
                int port=origin.getPort();
                if(!"http".equals(origin.getScheme()) || !Set.of("127.0.0.1","localhost").contains(origin.getHost()) || port<1024 || port>65535 || Set.of(3306,5173,8080).contains(port))
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("A dedicated loopback test port is required.");
                new SpringApplicationBuilder(WeBoxApplication.class,TimeConfiguration.class,Fixtures.class)
                    .profiles("test","e2e").run("--server.address=127.0.0.1","--server.port="+port,
                        "--spring.datasource.url="+jdbcUrl(),"--spring.datasource.username="+MYSQL.getUsername(),
                        "--spring.datasource.password="[REDACTED_SECRET]"--webox.media-root="+MEDIA_ROOT,
                        "--server.servlet.session.cookie.secure=false");
            }
            @TestConfiguration(proxyBeanMethods=false) @Import(FixtureController.class)
            static class Fixtures {
                @Bean FixtureFactory fixtureFactory(JdbcIndexedSessionRepository sessions) { return new FixtureFactory(sessions); }
                @Bean @Order(0) SecurityFilterChain fixtureSecurity(HttpSecurity http) throws Exception {
                    return http.securityMatcher("/__test/**").csrf(c->c.disable())
                        .authorizeHttpRequests(c->c.anyRequest().permitAll()).build();
                }
            }
            @RestController static class FixtureController {
                private final FixtureFactory fixtures;
                FixtureController(FixtureFactory fixtures) { this.fixtures=fixtures; }
                @PostMapping("/__test/sessions") Map<String,Object> session(@RequestHeader("X-WeBox-Fixture-Key") String key,@RequestBody Map<String,String> body) {
                    String expected=System.getenv("WEBOX_E2E_FIXTURE_KEY");
                    if(expected==null || !java.security.MessageDigest.isEqual(expected.getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8),key.getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8)))
                        throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN);
                    var identity=fixtures.identity(Role.valueOf(body.getOrDefault("role","Employee")));
                    return Map.of("user",identity.user(),"sessionId",identity.sessionId());
                }
                @GetMapping("/api/v1/__fixture/identity") UserIdentity identity(Authentication auth) { return (UserIdentity)auth.getPrincipal(); }
            }
        }

        import type { BrowserContext } from '@playwright/test';
        import type { Role, User } from '../../src/shared/api/types';
        export async function identitySession(context: BrowserContext, role: Role = 'Employee'): Promise<User> {
          const origin = process.env.WEBOX_E2E_API_ORIGIN ?? 'http://127.0.0.1:18081';
          const key = process.env.WEBOX_E2E_FIXTURE_KEY;
          if (!key) throw new Error('E2E fixture key is missing. Start the isolated test server through Playwright.');
          const response = await context.request.post(`${origin}/__test/sessions`, { headers: { 'X-WeBox-Fixture-Key': key }, data: { role } });
          if (!response.ok()) throw new Error(`Cannot create isolated test identity (${response.status()}).`);
          const result = await response.json() as { user: User; sessionId: string };
          await context.addCookies([{ name: 'WEBOXSESSION', value: result.sessionId, domain: '127.0.0.1', path: '/', httpOnly: true, secure: false, sameSite: 'Lax' }]);
          return result.user;
        }

    - [ ] T026 [US1] 在 `frontend/src/features/auth/LoginPage.tsx`、`frontend/src/features/auth/RegisterPage.tsx` 和 `frontend/src/features/auth/session.ts` 实现英文登录注册与CSRF轮换、getCurrentUser恢复、空闲失效及主动退出；Employee默认/menu，Admin默认/console/dishes。
    - [ ] T027 [US1] 在 `frontend/src/app/router.tsx`、`frontend/src/app/SessionBoundary.tsx` 接入身份/角色导航和可扩展注销清理回调；仅认证后加载本人数据，禁止旧请求回填到另一个账号；保留后续按账号草稿，不存身份token。
    - [ ] T028 [US1] 在 `frontend/tests/e2e/auth.spec.ts` 运行真实后端/MySQL注册、重登、刷新、退出与角色负向场景，连同US1测试将证据写入 `docs/validation/us1.md`；覆盖AC-US01-01–05并注明跨实体所有权待所属故事接入，不提前标全系统权限验收完成。
    
    ## Phase 4: User Story 2 — 浏览每日菜单并构建准确购物车 (P1)
    
    **Goal**：按日期浏览菜单、搜索筛选、配置与金额准确的账号隔离购物车。
    
    **Entry gate**：US1完成；所需媒体/菜品/每日供应模型在本故事先建立。
    
    ## 2. 账号、偏好与地址
    
    ### users
    
    | 字段 | 类型与规则 |
    | --- | --- |
    | id | UUID 主键 |
    | email | VARCHAR(200)，trim 后的展示邮箱 |
    | normalized_email | VARCHAR(200)，trim + `Locale.ROOT` 小写；使用二进制排序规则精确唯一，避免重音折叠 |
    | password_hash | VARCHAR(255)，包含算法标识、参数及盐的 Argon2id 编码；不保存原始密码 |
    | role | Employee / Admin；管理员由受控初始化过程创建 |
    | version | 非负整数 |
    | created_at, updated_at | UTC 时间 |
    
    唯一索引：`normalized_email`。注册与登录密码为 8–128 个字符且包含字母与数字；验证原输入，不采用 bcrypt 的 72 字节截断。密码哈希、CSRF token、会话内容不得进入业务日志、AI 提示或 API 用户响应。
    
    用户行也是同一员工订单写操作的串行锁：创建订单、取消和管理员确认/完成/取消均先锁订单所属用户，而不是锁操作者管理员。管理员操作前可只读定位订单的不可变 owner，再按规定锁序重新读取与校验。
    
    ### dietary_preferences / preference_cuisines / preference_allergens
    
    | 实体 | 字段与约束 |
    | --- | --- |
    | dietary_preferences | `user_id` 同时为主键及 users 外键；`spice`、`flavor` 可为 NULL；`budget_min_cents`、`budget_max_cents` 可为 NULL；`version`；UTC `updated_at` |
    | preference_cuisines | 复合主键 `(user_id, category)`；user_id 关联偏好根记录；category 受枚举约束 |
    | preference_allergens | 复合主键 `(user_id, allergen)`；user_id 关联偏好根记录；allergen 受枚举约束 |
    
    预算上下限必须同时为 NULL 或同时为非负整数，设置时下限不大于上限。不存在偏好记录等价于全部未设置；第一次保存创建根记录。清除偏好保留根记录并清空集合/可选字段、递增 version，避免丢失并发版本。
    
    更新按 user → preference 根记录加锁，以客户端 expected version 防止覆盖其他页面刚保存的内容；子集合替换与版本递增在同一事务中完成。过敏原是普通加购提醒的依据，也是 AI 候选的硬过滤条件，两种使用方式不能混淆。
    
    ### delivery_addresses
    
    | 字段 | 类型与规则 |
    | --- | --- |
    | id | UUID 主键 |
    | user_id | users 外键；每次按当前用户过滤读取 |
    | address_text | VARCHAR(200)，trim 后非空，不擅自合并内部空格或改变大小写 |
    | created_at, last_used_at | UTC 时间 |
    
    索引：`(user_id,last_used_at,id)`；唯一约束 `(user_id,address_text)`，地址文本采用精确比较，仅复用完全相同的 trim 后地址。输入新地址只在下单成功事务中持久化；订单失败不能留下被宣称成功使用的地址。订单保存独立 `delivery_address_snapshot`，后续地址变化不影响历史。

    # WeBox 验收场景与执行台账
    
    **日期**：2026-10-16。本文所有业务、质量及交付验收均为 **未执行**；文档静态检查另记，不代替应用、MySQL、LLM、负载或真人验证。
    
    共 **81 项**：51 个用户场景、11 项质量目标、10 项交付检查、9 组差异夹具；全部未执行。
    
    依据：[spec.md](spec.md)、[修订决策](decisions.md)、[原文追溯](requirements-source.md)。参考版180个场景只作为来源索引；本表按本项目已采用规则重新编号，不混用参考版收入、会话或其他未采用判据。
    
    ## 执行规则
    
    - 每次执行记录时间、环境/版本、角色与账号、业务日期、夹具、输入、实际结果、证据路径和执行者；状态可为未执行/通过/失败/阻塞。空证据或缺运行环境不得标通过。
    - 隔离夹具，控制截止时钟，避免唯一餐次、库存或旧数据掩盖被测规则。涉及权限、库存、份数和状态的场景同时核验直接请求及数据库结果。
    - 每个AC编号保持稳定。修改判据记录对应决策，补充场景使用新编号；通过结果须注明适用版本，不能沿用旧口径测试结论。
    - 运行方法与固定夹具见 [quickstart.md](quickstart.md)，文档质量清单只评审需求质量。

        日期：2026-10-16。环境沿用 [Phase 1](environment.md)。测试使用新建 MySQL 8.4.11 Testcontainers 容器、独立媒体目录和固定 Clock；不使用 Compose 业务库或 H2。
        
        ## 实现与实测
        
        - Java 固定枚举映射、整数分乘加/版本溢出检查、Unicode 码点与无效代理字符校验、密码不trim、上海运营日期与10:00/15:00截止时间。前后端共享 `shared/fixtures/values.json`，最大安全整数显示为 `90071992547409.91`。
        - 统一英文错误与 requestId、API no-store、未知/重复字段及标量类型转换拒绝、1 MiB JSON请求上限；错误日志仅记错误码、异常类型和requestId。已验证数字不能隐式转成文本。
        - V001采用 Spring Session JDBC4.1.1官方MySQL schema；V002保存事务outbox。空库启动迁移成功，重复 migrate 返回0项，官方会话索引保留。事件必须在写事务内创建，回滚不留事件，提交后仍未发布。
        - 默认拒绝、公开健康/CSRF入口、Admin边界、持久化WEBOXSESSION、HttpOnly/Lax、本地非Secure、8h空闲配置。会话有效性直接只读查询，验证前后LAST_ACCESS_TIME相同；过期不可用。
        - 健康200只含status；关闭测试连接池后返回503安全错误（该负向测试验证实际连接池不可用，未声称停掉MySQL进程）。模型不参与普通健康判定。
        - OpenAPI60个schema生成TypeScript类型；客户端同源Cookie/CSRF、AbortSignal、账号切换取消旧请求，内存中保存CSRF和Query状态。员工/Console分别提供英文导航与响应式基础布局；功能占位不冒充业务成功。
        - 浏览器独立后端启动器创建临时MySQL与媒体目录、生成短期夹具密钥、等待真实health；测试夹具和控制端点只在test classpath，不打入生产jar。夹具只创建身份和数据库会话，业务用户实体在US1补齐。

                ContractAssertions.matches("Csrf",result.getContentAsString());

                    .andExpect(status().is(expected)).andReturn().getResponse();
                if(expected!=204) ContractAssertions.response(path,"post",expected,response.getContentAsString());return response;
            }

                mvc.perform(get("/api/v1/auth/me").cookie(anonymous.cookie())).andExpect(status().isUnauthorized());

                mvc.perform(get("/api/v1/auth/me").cookie(anonymous.cookie())).andExpect(status().isUnauthorized());
                var me=mvc.perform(get("/api/v1/auth/me").cookie(authenticated)).andExpect(status().isOk()).andReturn().getResponse();
                ContractAssertions.matches("User",me.getContentAsString());assertEquals(json.readTree(registration.getContentAsString()),json.readTree(me.getContentAsString()));
                postJson("/auth/logout",new Browser(authenticated,anonymous.token()),Map.of(),403);

        import java.sql.Timestamp;
        import java.time.Instant;

        import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
        import org.springframework.jdbc.core.RowMapper;
        import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;
        import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronizationManager;
        @Repository
        public class UserRepository {
            private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
            private static final RowMapper<UserRow> ROW=(rs,n)->new UserRow(rs.getString("id"),rs.getString("email"),rs.getString("normalized_email"),rs.getString("password_hash"),Role.valueOf(rs.getString("role")));
            public UserRepository(JdbcTemplate jdbc) { this.jdbc=jdbc; }
            public Optional<UserRow> byEmail(String normalized) { return jdbc.query("SELECT id,email,normalized_email,password_hash,role FROM users WHERE normalized_email=?",ROW,normalized).stream().findFirst(); }
            public Optional<UserRow> byId(String id) { return jdbc.query("SELECT id,email,normalized_email,password_hash,role FROM users WHERE id=?",ROW,id).stream().findFirst(); }
            public Optional<UserRow> lockOwner(String id) {
                if(!TransactionSynchronizationManager.isActualTransactionActive()) throw new IllegalStateException("Owner locking requires a transaction.");
                return jdbc.query("SELECT id,email,normalized_email,password_hash,role FROM users WHERE id=? FOR UPDATE",ROW,id).stream().findFirst();
            }
            public void insert(UserRow user,Instant now) {
                jdbc.update("INSERT INTO users(id,email,normalized_email,password_hash,role,created_at,updated_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",user.id(),user.email(),user.normalizedEmail(),user.passwordHash(),user.role().name(),Timestamp.from(now),Timestamp.from(now));
            }
            public record UserRow(String id,String email,String normalizedEmail,String passwordHash,Role role) {
                public UserIdentity identity() { return new UserIdentity(id,email,role); }
                @Override public String toString() { return "UserRow[redacted]"; }
            }
        }

        package com.webox.auth;
        import com.webox.shared.*;
        import com.webox.shared.DomainTypes.Role;
        import java.util.Locale;
        import java.util.UUID;
        import jakarta.validation.Validator;
        import jakarta.validation.constraints.Email;
        import org.springframework.dao.DuplicateKeyException;
        import org.springframework.security.crypto.argon2.Argon2PasswordEncoder;
        import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
        @Service
        public class AuthService {
            // Argon2id: 19 MiB memory, 2 iterations, parallelism 1, 16-byte salt, 32-byte hash.
            private final Argon2PasswordEncoder passwords=new Argon2PasswordEncoder(16,32,1,19456,2);
            private final String dummyHash=passwords.encode(UUID.randomUUID().toString());
            private final UserRepository users;private final BusinessClock clock;private final Validator validator;
            public AuthService(UserRepository users,BusinessClock clock,Validator validator) { this.users=users;this.clock=clock;this.validator=validator; }
            record EmailInput(@Email String value) {}
            public String email(String value) {
                String clean;
                try { clean=ValueRules.requiredText(value,200); } catch(IllegalArgumentException e) { throw ApiException.validation("email","Enter a valid email address of at most 200 characters."); }
                if(!validator.validate(new EmailInput(clean)).isEmpty()) throw ApiException.validation("email","Enter a valid email address.");
                return clean;
            }
            private String password(String value) {
                try { return ValueRules.password(value); } catch(IllegalArgumentException e) { throw ApiException.validation("password","Password must contain 8 to 128 characters, including a letter and a number."); }
            }
            public UserIdentity register(String email,String password) { return create(email(email),password(password),Role.Employee); }
            private UserIdentity create(String email,String password,Role role) {
                var row=new UserRepository.UserRow(UUID.randomUUID().toString(),email,email.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT),passwords.encode(password),role);
                try { users.insert(row,clock.now()); }
                catch(DuplicateKeyException e) { throw new ApiException(409,"EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED","This email is already registered. Please sign in."); }
                return row.identity();
            }
            public UserIdentity login(String input,String rawPassword) {
                String email=email(input);String password=[REDACTED_SECRET]
                var found=users.byEmail(email.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT));
                boolean valid=passwords.matches(password,found.map(UserRepository.UserRow::passwordHash).orElse(dummyHash));
                if(!valid || found.isEmpty()) throw new ApiException(401,"INVALID_CREDENTIALS","Email or password is incorrect.");
                return found.get().identity();
            }
            public UserIdentity initializeAdmin(String input,String initialPassword) {
                String email=email(input);var existing=users.byEmail(email.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT));
                if(existing.isPresent()) {
                    if(existing.get().role()!=Role.Admin) throw new IllegalStateException("The configured administrator email belongs to an employee; refusing to elevate it.");
                    return existing.get().identity();
                }
                return create(email,password(initialPassword),Role.Admin);
            }
        }
        EOF

        package com.webox.auth;
        import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
        import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
        import java.util.List;
        import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
        import org.springframework.security.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken;
        import org.springframework.security.core.annotation.AuthenticationPrincipal;
        import org.springframework.security.core.authority.SimpleGrantedAuthority;
        import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
        import org.springframework.security.web.authentication.logout.SecurityContextLogoutHandler;
        import org.springframework.security.web.authentication.session.ChangeSessionIdAuthenticationStrategy;
        import org.springframework.security.web.context.HttpSessionSecurityContextRepository;
        import org.springframework.security.web.csrf.CsrfAuthenticationStrategy;
        import org.springframework.security.web.csrf.HttpSessionCsrfTokenRepository;
        import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
        @RestController
        @RequestMapping("/api/v1/auth")
        public class AuthController {
            private final AuthService service;private final HttpSessionSecurityContextRepository contexts;private final HttpSessionCsrfTokenRepository csrf;
            public AuthController(AuthService service,HttpSessionSecurityContextRepository contexts,HttpSessionCsrfTokenRepository csrf) { this.service=service;this.contexts=contexts;this.csrf=csrf; }
            public record Credentials(String email,String password) { @Override public String toString() { return "Credentials[redacted]"; } }
            @PostMapping("/register") @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
            public UserIdentity register(@RequestBody Credentials body) { return service.register(body.email(),body.password()); }
            @PostMapping("/login")
            public UserIdentity login(@RequestBody Credentials body,HttpServletRequest request,HttpServletResponse response) {
                var user=service.login(body.email(),body.password());
                var authentication=UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken.authenticated(user,null,List.of(new SimpleGrantedAuthority("ROLE_"+user.role().name())));
                new ChangeSessionIdAuthenticationStrategy().onAuthentication(authentication,request,response);
                new CsrfAuthenticationStrategy(csrf).onAuthentication(authentication,request,response);
                var context=SecurityContextHolder.createEmptyContext();context.setAuthentication(authentication);
                SecurityContextHolder.setContext(context);contexts.saveContext(context,request,response);
                return user;
            }
            @GetMapping("/me") public UserIdentity me(@AuthenticationPrincipal UserIdentity user) { return user; }
            @PostMapping("/logout") @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
            public void logout(HttpServletRequest request,HttpServletResponse response) {
                var authentication=SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication();
                csrf.saveToken(null,request,response);
                new SecurityContextLogoutHandler().logout(request,response,authentication);
            }
        }

        /** Same application entry point; only the explicit seed profile runs this once. */
        @Component @Profile("seed")

            private final AdminInitializer admins;private final Environment environment;private final ConfigurableApplicationContext context;
            public SeedApplication(AdminInitializer admins,Environment environment,ConfigurableApplicationContext context) { this.admins=admins;this.environment=environment;this.context=context; }

                // T089 adds idempotent menu/media/supply initialization before closing.
                context.close();

        }
