        cat > frontend/src/features/auth/session.ts <<'EOF'
        import { createContext, createElement, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
        import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
        import { api, ApiError, onUnauthorized, resetApiSession } from '../../shared/api/client';
        import type { User } from '../../shared/api/types';
        const cleanup = new Set<() => void>();
        export function onSessionEnd(callback: () => void): () => void { cleanup.add(callback); return () => { cleanup.delete(callback); }; }
        type Session = { user: User | null; loading: boolean; error: string | null; refresh: () => Promise<void>; login: (email: string, password: string) => Promise<User>; logout: () => Promise<void> };
        const Context = createContext<Session | null>(null);
        export function SessionProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
          const queries = useQueryClient();
          const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(null);
          const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
          const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
          const generation = useRef(0);
          const clear = useCallback(() => {
            generation.current++; resetApiSession(); void queries.cancelQueries(); queries.clear();
            for (const close of cleanup) close();
            setUser(null); setLoading(false); setError(null);
          }, [queries]);
          const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
            const active = generation.current;
            try {
              const restored = await api<User>('/auth/me');
              if (active === generation.current) { setUser(restored); setError(null); }
            } catch (e) {
              if (e instanceof ApiError && e.status === 401) { if (active === generation.current) setUser(null); }
              else if (!(e instanceof DOMException && e.name === 'AbortError') && active === generation.current) setError('Could not check your session. Please try again.');
            } finally { if (active === generation.current) setLoading(false); }
          }, []);
          useEffect(() => {
            const unsubscribe = onUnauthorized(clear);
            void refresh();
            const focus = () => { void refresh(); };
            window.addEventListener('focus', focus);
            return () => { unsubscribe(); window.removeEventListener('focus', focus); generation.current++; resetApiSession(); };
          }, [clear, refresh]);
          const login = useCallback(async (email: string, password: string) => {
            const authenticated = await api<User>('/auth/login', { method: 'POST', json: { email, password } });
            clear();setUser(authenticated);return authenticated;
          }, [clear]);
          const logout = useCallback(async () => {
            try { await api<void>('/auth/logout', { method: 'POST' }); }
            catch(e) { if (!(e instanceof ApiError && e.status === 401)) throw e; }
            clear();
          }, [clear]);
          return createElement(Context.Provider, { value: { user, loading, error, refresh, login, logout } }, children);
        }
        export function useSession(): Session {
          const value = useContext(Context);if (!value) throw new Error('SessionProvider is required.');return value;
        }
        export function homeFor(user: User): string { return user.role === 'Admin' ? '/console/dishes' : '/menu'; }
        EOF
        cat > frontend/src/app/SessionBoundary.tsx <<'EOF'
        import { Navigate, Outlet } from 'react-router';
        import { homeFor, useSession } from '../features/auth/session';
        import { ErrorNotice, Loading } from '../shared/ui/Status';
        export function SessionBoundary({ admin = false }: { admin?: boolean }) {
          const session = useSession();
          if (session.loading) return <Loading>Checking your session…</Loading>;
          if (session.error) return <ErrorNotice message={session.error} retry={() => { void session.refresh(); }} />;
          if (!session.user) return <Navigate to="/login" replace />;
          if (admin && session.user.role !== 'Admin') return <section className="panel"><h1>Access denied</h1><p>Administrator access is required.</p></section>;
          return <Outlet />;
        }
        export function GuestBoundary() {
          const session = useSession();
          if (session.loading) return <Loading>Checking your session…</Loading>;
          if (session.user) return <Navigate to={homeFor(session.user)} replace />;
          return <Outlet />;
        }

    本节是服务端适配器边界，不是公开 API。只有运维配置能决定服务地址和模型；浏览器不能直接访问 provider、改变 base URL 或指定任意模型。
    
    | 项目 | 默认值/约束 |
    | --- | --- |
    | Transport | OpenRouter HTTPS `POST /api/v1/chat/completions`。 |
    | Base URL | `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`，只能由服务端运维配置。 |
    | Authentication | 后端 `Authorization: Bearer`，密钥从 `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` 读取；不得向浏览器、日志或测试报告暴露。 |
    | Model | 默认 `openai/gpt-4.1-mini`，使用 `OPENROUTER_MODEL` 显式配置；记录实际返回模型/provider/generation ID，不伪造托管模型 digest。 |
    | 第一阶段 | `stream:false` + 意图 `response_format: {type:"json_schema", json_schema:{name,strict:true,schema}}`；只提取诉求。 |
    | 第二阶段 | `stream:true` + 推荐 JSON Schema，最多三项 `{dishId,reason}`。 |
    | Generation | 初始默认 `temperature:0`、`max_tokens:512`、`provider:{require_parameters:true}`；第一阶段可使用更短输出预算，调优保留业务与性能约束。 |
    | 权限 | 模型无数据库/订单写入/执行工具，无任意网络工具。 |
    | 数据最小化 | 仅传诉求、必要菜单事实、偏好及本人所需历史摘要；不传邮箱、配送地址、密码、会话/CSRF token 或他人记录。 |
    
    意图输出 schema 至少表达 `repeatPolicy`、`repeatFrom`、`repeatThrough`、`repeatEvidence`、`needsClarification` 和可识别偏好；显式范围用含首尾日期表达，再由服务器规范化为查询边界。模型返回日期和证据也须校验，不可直接拼入查询。业务日期由服务器提供，不能信任模型自己的当前日期。
    
    第二阶段要求下列逻辑输出结构，`dishId` 可用本次候选 ID 构造 schema enum；schema 不替代服务器候选及实时业务校验：
    
    ```json
    {
      "recommendations": [
        {
          "dishId": "7c3d454a-62ad-4e1e-83b0-d15dcf0a1b99",
          "reason": "This mild Japanese dish matches your preferences and adds variety to your recent meals."
        }
      ]
    }
    ```
    
    `/chat/completions` 的外层使用 SSE。适配器正确处理 UTF-8 分片、注释、多行 `data:` 和事件边界，再从 `choices[].delta.content` 增量解析内层 JSON；不把半个 item 当作卡片。任何外层 `error`、非成功 HTTP 响应、拒绝、异常 EOF、输出预算耗尽/截断均算失败。HTTP 200 不代表模型成功。只有完整合法 JSON、`finish_reason:"stop"` 以及 `[DONE]` 都已收到，才可发送业务 `done`。最终 usage 帧可携带空 content 并重复 stop，应作为计量帧处理，不重复终止。

        import { expect, it } from 'vitest';
        import { cartReducer, initialCart, totalCents, totalQuantity } from './cartReducer';
        import { configuration } from './configuration';
        import { pasta, spaghetti, fusilli, cheese } from './cartFixtures';
        it('normalizes option order, merges matching configurations and totals two pasta at 5900 cents', () => {
          let state = cartReducer(initialCart, { type: 'add', dish: pasta, optionIds: [cheese, spaghetti] });
          state = cartReducer(state, { type: 'add', dish: pasta, optionIds: [spaghetti, cheese, cheese] });
          expect(state.lines).toHaveLength(1);expect(totalQuantity(state)).toBe(2);expect(totalCents(state)).toBe(5900);
          state = cartReducer(state, { type: 'add', dish: pasta, optionIds: [fusilli] });
          expect(state.lines).toHaveLength(2);expect(totalCents(state)).toBe(8550);
        });
        it('rejects missing required, multiple single choices and foreign options', () => {
          for (const optionIds of [[], [spaghetti, fusilli], [spaghetti, 'foreign']]) expect(() => configuration(pasta, optionIds)).toThrow();
        });
        it('processes fast actions exactly once and caps all increases at five or stock', () => {
          let state = initialCart;
          for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) state = cartReducer(state, { type: 'add', dish: pasta, optionIds: [spaghetti] });
          expect(totalQuantity(state)).toBe(5);expect(state.error).toMatch(/5/);
          state = cartReducer(state, { type: 'decrease', key: state.lines[0].key });expect(totalQuantity(state)).toBe(4);
          state = cartReducer(state, { type: 'add', dish: pasta, optionIds: [spaghetti] });expect(totalQuantity(state)).toBe(5);
          state = cartReducer(state, { type: 'remove', key: state.lines[0].key });expect(totalQuantity(state)).toBe(0);
          state = cartReducer(state, { type: 'add', dish: { ...pasta, remaining: 0 }, optionIds: [spaghetti] });expect(totalQuantity(state)).toBe(0);expect(state.error).toBeTruthy();
        });
        it('removes only submitted quantities while keeping additions made during submission', () => {
          let state = cartReducer(initialCart, { type: 'add', dish: pasta, optionIds: [spaghetti] });const submitted = [{ key: state.lines[0].key, quantity: 1 }];
          state = cartReducer(state, { type: 'add', dish: pasta, optionIds: [spaghetti] });
          state = cartReducer(state, { type: 'submitted', lines: submitted });expect(totalQuantity(state)).toBe(1);
        });
        it('rejects unsafe total arithmetic', () => {
          expect(() => configuration({ ...pasta, basePriceCents: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER }, [spaghetti, cheese])).toThrow();
        });

    ---
    name: "imagegen"
    description: "Generate or edit raster images when the task benefits from AI-created bitmap visuals such as photos, illustrations, textures, sprites, mockups, or transparent-background cutouts. Use when Codex should create a brand-new image, transform an existing image, or derive visual variants from references, and the output should be a bitmap asset rather than repo-native code or vector. Do not use when the task is better handled by editing existing SVG/vector/code-native assets, extending an established icon or logo system, or building the visual directly in HTML/CSS/canvas."
    ---
    
    # Image Generation Skill
    
    Generates or edits images for the current project (for example website assets, game assets, UI mockups, product mockups, wireframes, logo design, photorealistic images, or infographics).
    
    ## Top-level modes and rules
    
    This skill has exactly two top-level modes:
    
    - **Default built-in tool mode (preferred):** built-in `image_gen` tool for image generation, editing, and transparent-image requests. Does not require `OPENAI_API_KEY`.
    - **Fallback CLI mode:** `scripts/image_gen.py` CLI. Use when the user explicitly asks for or confirms the CLI/API/model path. Requires `OPENAI_API_KEY`.
    
    Within CLI fallback, the CLI exposes three subcommands:
    
    - `generate`
    - `edit`
    - `generate-batch`
    
    Rules:
    - Use the built-in `image_gen` tool by default for normal image generation and editing requests.
    - Do not switch to CLI fallback for ordinary quality, size, or file-path control.
    - For transparent images, ask built-in `image_gen` for a transparent background and preserve the generated alpha.
    - Never silently switch from built-in `image_gen` or CLI `gpt-image-2` to CLI `gpt-image-1.5`; ask the user first unless they explicitly requested `gpt-image-1.5`.
    - The word `batch` by itself does not mean CLI fallback. If the user asks for many assets or says to batch-generate assets without explicitly asking for CLI/API/model controls, stay on the built-in path and issue one built-in call per requested asset or variant.
    - If the built-in tool fails or is unavailable, tell the user the CLI fallback exists and that it requires `OPENAI_API_KEY`. Proceed only if the user explicitly asks for that fallback.
    - If the user explicitly asks for CLI mode, use the bundled `scripts/image_gen.py` workflow. Do not create one-off SDK runners.
    - Never modify `scripts/image_gen.py`. If something is missing, ask the user before doing anything else.
    
    Built-in save-path policy:
    - In built-in tool mode, Codex saves generated images under `$CODEX_HOME/*` by default.
    - Do not describe or rely on OS temp as the default built-in destination.
    - Do not describe or rely on a destination-path argument (if any) on the built-in `image_gen` tool. If a specific location is needed, generate first and then move or copy the selected output from `$CODEX_HOME/generated_images/...`.
    - Save-path precedence in built-in mode:
      1. If the user names a destination, move or copy the selected output there.
      2. If the image is meant for the current project, move or copy the final selected image into the workspace before finishing.
      3. If the image is only for preview or brainstorming, render it inline; the underlying file can remain at the default `$CODEX_HOME/*` path.
    - Never leave a project-referenced asset only at the default `$CODEX_HOME/*` path.
    - Do not overwrite an existing asset unless the user explicitly asked for replacement; otherwise create a sibling versioned filename such as `hero-v2.png` or `item-icon-edited.png`.
    
    Shared prompt guidance for both modes lives in `references/prompting.md` and `references/sample-prompts.md`.
    
    Fallback-only docs/resources for CLI mode:
    - `references/cli.md`
    - `references/image-api.md`
    - `references/codex-network.md`
    - `scripts/image_gen.py`
    
    ## When to use
    - Generate a new image (concept art, product shot, cover, website hero)
    - Generate a new image using one or more reference images for style, composition, or mood
    - Edit an existing image (inpainting, lighting or weather transformations, background replacement, object removal, compositing, transparent background)
    - Produce many assets or variants for one task
    
    ## When not to use
    - Extending or matching an existing SVG/vector icon set, logo system, or illustration library inside the repo
    - Creating simple shapes, diagrams, wireframes, or icons that are better produced directly in SVG, HTML/CSS, or canvas
    - Making a small project-local asset edit when the source file already exists in an editable native format
    - Any task where the user clearly wants deterministic code-native output instead of a generated bitmap
    
    ## Decision tree
    
    Think about two separate questions:
    
    1. **Intent:** is this a new image or an edit of an existing image?
    2. **Execution strategy:** is this one asset or many assets/variants?
    
    Intent:
    - If the user wants to modify an existing image while preserving parts of it, treat the request as **edit**.
    - If the user provides images only as references for style, composition, mood, or subject guidance, treat the request as **generate**.
    - If the user provides no images, treat the request as **generate**.
    
    Built-in edit semantics:
    - Built-in edit mode is for images already visible in the conversation context, such as attached images or images generated earlier in the thread.
    - If the user wants to edit a local image file with the built-in tool, first load it with built-in `view_image` tool so the image is visible in the conversation context, then proceed with the built-in edit flow.
    - Do not promise arbitrary filesystem-path editing through the built-in tool.
    - If a local file still needs direct file-path control, masks, or other explicit CLI-only parameters, use the explicit CLI fallback only when the user asks for it.
    - For edits, preserve invariants aggressively and save non-destructively by default.
    
    Execution strategy:
    - In the built-in default path, produce many assets or variants by issuing one `image_gen` call per requested asset or variant.
    - In the CLI fallback path, use the CLI `generate-batch` subcommand only when the user explicitly chose CLI mode and needs many prompts/assets.
    - For many distinct assets, do not use `n` as a substitute for separate prompts. `n` is for variants of one prompt; distinct assets need distinct built-in calls or distinct CLI `generate-batch` jobs.
    
    Assume the user wants a new image unless they clearly ask to change an existing one.
    
    ## Workflow
    1. Decide the top-level mode: built-in by default, including transparent-output requests; fallback CLI only if explicitly requested or confirmed.
    2. Decide the intent: `generate` or `edit`.
    3. Decide whether the output is preview-only or meant to be consumed by the current project.
    4. Decide the execution strategy: single asset vs repeated built-in calls vs CLI `generate-batch`.
    5. Collect inputs up front: prompt(s), exact text (verbatim), constraints/avoid list, and any input images.
    6. For every input image, label its role explicitly:
       - reference image
       - edit target
       - supporting insert/style/compositing input
    7. If the edit target is only on the local filesystem and you are staying on the built-in path, inspect it with `view_image` first so the image is available in conversation context.
    8. If the user asked for a photo, illustration, sprite, product image, banner, or other explicitly raster-style asset, use `image_gen` rather than substituting SVG/HTML/CSS placeholders. If the request is for an icon, logo, or UI graphic that should match existing repo-native SVG/vector/code assets, prefer editing those directly instead.
    9. Augment the prompt based on specificity:
       - If the user's prompt is already specific and detailed, normalize it into a clear spec without adding creative requirements.
       - If the user's prompt is generic, add tasteful augmentation only when it materially improves output quality.
    10. Use the built-in `image_gen` tool by default.
    11. For transparent-output requests, ask built-in `image_gen` for a transparent background and preserve the generated alpha channel.
    12. Inspect outputs and validate: subject, style, composition, text accuracy, and invariants/avoid items.
    13. Iterate with a single targeted change, then re-check.
    14. For preview-only work, render the image inline; the underlying file may remain at the default `$CODEX_HOME/generated_images/...` path.
    15. For project-bound work, move or copy the selected artifact into the workspace and update any consuming code or references. Never leave a project-referenced asset only at the default `$CODEX_HOME/generated_images/...` path.
    16. For batches or multi-asset requests, persist every requested deliverable final in the workspace unless the user explicitly asked to keep outputs preview-only. Discarded variants do not need to be kept unless requested.
    17. If the user explicitly chooses or confirms the CLI fallback, then use the fallback-only docs for model, quality, size, `input_fidelity`, masks, output format, output paths, and network setup.
    18. Always report the final saved path(s) for any workspace-bound asset(s), plus the final prompt or prompt set and whether the built-in tool or fallback CLI mode was used.
    
    ## Transparent image requests
    
    Ask built-in `image_gen` for a genuinely transparent background and preserve its alpha.
    
    ## Prompt augmentation
    
    Reformat user prompts into a structured, production-oriented spec. Make the user's goal clearer and more actionable, but do not blindly add detail.
    
    Treat this as prompt-shaping guidance, not a closed schema. Use only the lines that help, and add a short extra labeled line when it materially improves clarity.
    
    ### Specificity policy
    
    Use the user's prompt specificity to decide how much augmentation is appropriate:
    
    - If the prompt is already specific and detailed, preserve that specificity and only normalize/structure it.
    - If the prompt is generic, you may add tasteful augmentation when it will materially improve the result.
    
    Allowed augmentations:
    - composition or framing hints
    - polish level or intended-use hints
    - practical layout guidance
    - reasonable scene concreteness that supports the stated request
    
    Not allowed augmentations:
    - extra characters or objects that are not implied by the request
    - brand names, slogans, palettes, or narrative beats that are not implied
    - arbitrary side-specific placement unless the surrounding layout supports it
    
    ## Use-case taxonomy (exact slugs)
    
    Classify each request into one of these buckets and keep the slug consistent across prompts and references.
    
    Generate:
    - photorealistic-natural — candid/editorial lifestyle scenes with real texture and natural lighting.
    - product-mockup — product/packaging shots, catalog imagery, merch concepts.
    - ui-mockup — app/web interface mockups and wireframes; specify the desired fidelity.
    - infographic-diagram — diagrams/infographics with structured layout and text.
    - scientific-educational — classroom explainers, scientific diagrams, and learning visuals with required labels and accuracy constraints.
    - ads-marketing — campaign concepts and ad creatives with audience, brand position, scene, and exact tagline/copy.
    - productivity-visual — slide, chart, workflow, and data-heavy business visuals.
    - logo-brand — logo/mark exploration, vector-friendly.
    - illustration-story — comics, children’s book art, narrative scenes.
    - stylized-concept — style-driven concept art, 3D/stylized renders.
    - historical-scene — period-accurate/world-knowledge scenes.
    
    Edit:
    - text-localization — translate/replace in-image text, preserve layout.
    - identity-preserve — try-on, person-in-scene; lock face/body/pose.
    - precise-object-edit — remove/replace a specific element (including interior swaps).
    - lighting-weather — time-of-day/season/atmosphere changes only.
    - background-extraction — transparent background / clean cutout. Ask built-in `image_gen` for actual transparency.
    - style-transfer — apply reference style while changing subject/scene.
    - compositing — multi-image insert/merge with matched lighting/perspective.
    - sketch-to-render — drawing/line art to photoreal render.
    
    ## Shared prompt schema
    
    Use the following labeled spec as shared prompt scaffolding for both top-level modes:
    
    ```text
    Use case: <taxonomy slug>
    Asset type: <where the asset will be used>
    Primary request: <user's main prompt>
    Input images: <Image 1: role; Image 2: role> (optional)
    Scene/backdrop: <environment>
    Subject: <main subject>
    Style/medium: <photo/illustration/3D/etc>
    Composition/framing: <wide/close/top-down; placement>
    Lighting/mood: <lighting + mood>
    Color palette: <palette notes>
    Materials/textures: <surface details>
    Text (verbatim): "<exact text>"
    Constraints: <must keep/must avoid>
    Avoid: <negative constraints>
    ```
    
    Notes:
    - `Asset type` and `Input images` are prompt scaffolding, not dedicated CLI flags.
    - `Scene/backdrop` refers to the visual setting. It is not the same as the fallback CLI `background` parameter, which controls output transparency behavior.
    - Fallback-only execution notes such as `Quality:`, `Input fidelity:`, masks, output format, and output paths belong in the CLI path only. Do not treat them as built-in `image_gen` tool arguments.
    
    Augmentation rules:
    - Keep it short.
    - Add only the details needed to improve the prompt materially.
    - For edits, explicitly list invariants (`change only X; keep Y unchanged`).
    - If any critical detail is missing and blocks success, ask a question; otherwise proceed.
    
    ## Examples
    
    ### Generation example (hero image)
    ```text
    Use case: product-mockup
    Asset type: landing page hero
    Primary request: a minimal hero image of a ceramic coffee mug
    Style/medium: clean product photography
    Composition/framing: wide composition with usable negative space for page copy if needed
    Lighting/mood: soft studio lighting
    Constraints: no logos, no text, no watermark
    ```
    
    ### Edit example (invariants)
    ```text
    Use case: precise-object-edit
    Asset type: product photo background replacement
    Primary request: replace only the background with a warm sunset gradient
    Constraints: change only the background; keep the product and its edges unchanged; no text; no watermark
    ```
    
    ## Prompting best practices
    - Structure prompt as scene/backdrop -> subject -> details -> constraints.
    - Include intended use (ad, UI mock, infographic) to set the mode and polish level.
    - Use camera/composition language for photorealism.
    - Only use SVG/vector stand-ins when the user explicitly asked for vector output or a non-image placeholder.
    - Quote exact text and specify typography + placement.
    - For tricky words, spell them letter-by-letter and require verbatim rendering.
    - For multi-image inputs, reference images by index and describe how they should be used.
    - For edits, repeat invariants every iteration to reduce drift.
    - Iterate with single-change follow-ups.
    - If the prompt is generic, add only the extra detail that will materially help.
    - If the prompt is already detailed, normalize it instead of expanding it.
    - For CLI fallback only, see `references/cli.md` and `references/image-api.md` for model, `quality`, `input_fidelity`, masks, output format, and output-path guidance.
    - For transparent images, ask built-in `image_gen` for actual transparency and preserve its alpha.
    
    More principles shared by both modes: `references/prompting.md`.
    Copy/paste specs shared by both modes: `references/sample-prompts.md`.
    
    ## Guidance by asset type
    Asset-type templates (website assets, game assets, wireframes, logo) are consolidated in `references/sample-prompts.md`.
    
    ## gpt-image-2 guidance for CLI fallback
    
    The fallback CLI defaults to `gpt-image-2`.
    
    - Use `gpt-image-2` for new CLI/API workflows unless the user confirms a different model.
    - CLI `gpt-image-2` does not support `background=transparent`; ask before using `gpt-image-1.5` unless the user explicitly requested that model.
    - `gpt-image-2` always uses high fidelity for image inputs; do not set `input_fidelity` with this model.
    - `gpt-image-2` supports `quality` values `low`, `medium`, `high`, and `auto`.
    - Use `quality low` for fast drafts, thumbnails, and quick iterations. Use `medium`, `high`, or `auto` for final assets, dense text, diagrams, identity-sensitive edits, or high-resolution outputs.
    - Square images are typically fastest to generate. Use `1024x1024` for fast square drafts.
    - If the user asks for 4K-style output, use `3840x2160` for landscape or `2160x3840` for portrait.
    - `gpt-image-2` size may be `auto` or `WIDTHxHEIGHT` if all constraints hold: max edge `<= 3840px`, both edges multiples of `16px`, long-to-short ratio `<= 3:1`, total pixels between `655,360` and `8,294,400`.
    
    Popular `gpt-image-2` sizes:
    - `1024x1024` square
    - `1536x1024` landscape
    - `1024x1536` portrait
    - `2048x2048` 2K square
    - `2048x1152` 2K landscape
    - `3840x2160` 4K landscape
    - `2160x3840` 4K portrait
    - `auto`
    
    ## Fallback CLI mode only
    
    ### Temp and output conventions
    These conventions apply only to the CLI fallback. They do not describe built-in `image_gen` output behavior.
    - Use `tmp/imagegen/` for intermediate files (for example JSONL batches); delete them when done.
    - Write final artifacts under `output/imagegen/`.
    - Use `--out` or `--out-dir` to control output paths; keep filenames stable and descriptive.
    
    ### Dependencies
    Prefer `uv` for dependency management in this repo.
    
    Required Python package:
    ```bash
    uv pip install openai
    ```
    
    Optional for image inspection and downscaling:
    ```bash
    uv pip install pillow
    ```
    
    Portability note:
    - If you are using the installed skill outside this repo, install dependencies into that environment with its package manager.
    - In uv-managed environments, `uv pip install ...` remains the preferred path.
    
    ### Environment
    - `OPENAI_API_KEY` must be set for live API calls.
    - Do not ask the user for `OPENAI_API_KEY` when using the built-in `image_gen` tool.
    - Never ask the user to paste the full key in chat. Ask them to set it locally and confirm when ready.
    
    If the key is missing, give the user these steps:
    1. Create an API key in the OpenAI platform UI: https://platform.openai.com/api-keys
    2. Set `OPENAI_API_KEY` as an environment variable in their system.
    3. Offer to guide them through setting the environment variable for their OS/shell if needed.
    
    If installation is not possible in this environment, tell the user which dependency is missing and how to install it into their active environment.
    
    ### Script-mode notes
    - CLI commands + examples: `references/cli.md`
    - API parameter quick reference: `references/image-api.md`
    - Network approvals / sandbox settings for CLI mode: `references/codex-network.md`
    
    ## Reference map
    - `references/prompting.md`: shared prompting principles for both modes.
    - `references/sample-prompts.md`: shared copy/paste prompt recipes for both modes.
    - `references/cli.md`: fallback-only CLI usage via `scripts/image_gen.py`.
    - `references/image-api.md`: fallback-only API/CLI parameter reference.
    - `references/codex-network.md`: fallback-only network/sandbox troubleshooting for CLI mode.
    - `scripts/image_gen.py`: fallback-only CLI implementation. Use only when the user explicitly chooses or confirms CLI mode.

         CHECK(revision BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)
        ) ENGINE=InnoDB;
        CREATE TABLE daily_supply (
         delivery_date DATE NOT NULL,
         dish_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
         scheduled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
         total_quantity INT NOT NULL, allocated_quantity INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
         version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
         updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
         PRIMARY KEY(delivery_date,dish_id),
         FOREIGN KEY(delivery_date) REFERENCES daily_menus(delivery_date) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
         FOREIGN KEY(dish_id) REFERENCES dishes(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
         CHECK(scheduled IN (0,1)), CHECK(total_quantity>=0 AND allocated_quantity>=0 AND allocated_quantity<=total_quantity),
         CHECK(version BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991),
         INDEX ix_supply_dish_date(dish_id,delivery_date)
        ) ENGINE=InnoDB;

        @Repository
        public class MediaRepository {
            private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
            public MediaRepository(JdbcTemplate jdbc) { this.jdbc=jdbc; }
            public Optional<Asset> find(String id) {
                return jdbc.query("SELECT id,storage_key,served_mime,served_bytes,content_sha256,width,height FROM media_assets WHERE id=?",
                    (rs,n)->new Asset(rs.getString(1),rs.getString(2),rs.getString(3),rs.getLong(4),rs.getString(5),rs.getInt(6),rs.getInt(7)),id).stream().findFirst();
            }
            public void insert(Asset asset,String uploader,String originalName,String sourceMime,long sourceBytes,String attribution,Instant now) {
                if(!"Admin".equals(jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT role FROM users WHERE id=?",String.class,uploader))) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Only administrators can create media.");
                jdbc.update("INSERT INTO media_assets(id,uploaded_by,original_filename,source_mime,source_bytes,content_sha256,width,height,storage_key,served_mime,served_bytes,source_attribution,created_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                    asset.id(),uploader,originalName,sourceMime,sourceBytes,asset.sha256(),asset.width(),asset.height(),asset.storageKey(),asset.mime(),asset.bytes(),attribution,LocalDateTime.ofInstant(now,ZoneOffset.UTC));
            }
            public record Asset(String id,String storageKey,String mime,long bytes,String sha256,int width,int height) {}
        }

        package com.webox.catalog;
        import java.time.LocalDate;
        import java.util.*;
        import com.webox.shared.DomainTypes.Category;
        import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
        import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;
        @Repository
        public class MenuQueryRepository {
            private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
            private static final String MEMBERS=" FROM daily_supply s JOIN dishes d ON d.id=s.dish_id WHERE s.delivery_date=? AND s.scheduled=TRUE AND d.is_listed=TRUE";
            public MenuQueryRepository(JdbcTemplate jdbc) { this.jdbc=jdbc; }
            public record Member(String dishId,long dishVersion,int remaining,long inventoryVersion) {}
            public record Results(List<Member> members,long total) {}
            public Results page(LocalDate date,List<Category> categories,String search,int page,int size) {
                var sql=new StringBuilder(MEMBERS);var params=new ArrayList<Object>();params.add(date);
                if(!categories.isEmpty()) { sql.append(" AND d.category IN (").append(String.join(",",Collections.nCopies(categories.size(),"?"))).append(")");categories.forEach(c->params.add(c.value())); }
                if(!search.isEmpty()) {
                    String escaped="%"+search.replace("!","!!").replace("%","!%").replace("_","!_")+"%";
                    sql.append(" AND (d.name LIKE ? ESCAPE '!' OR d.description LIKE ? ESCAPE '!')");params.add(escaped);params.add(escaped);
                }
                long total=jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT COUNT(*)"+sql,Long.class,params.toArray());
                params.add(size);params.add((long)page*size);
                var members=jdbc.query("SELECT d.id,d.version,s.total_quantity-s.allocated_quantity,s.version"+sql+" ORDER BY d.name,d.id LIMIT ? OFFSET ?",(rs,n)->new Member(rs.getString(1),rs.getLong(2),rs.getInt(3),rs.getLong(4)),params.toArray());
                return new Results(members,total);
            }
            public Optional<Member> member(LocalDate date,String dishId) {
                return jdbc.query("SELECT d.id,d.version,s.total_quantity-s.allocated_quantity,s.version"+MEMBERS+" AND d.id=?",(rs,n)->new Member(rs.getString(1),rs.getLong(2),rs.getInt(3),rs.getLong(4)),date,dishId).stream().findFirst();
            }
        }

        package com.webox.catalog;
        import java.time.Duration;
        import java.util.Set;
        import java.util.function.Supplier;
        import com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.*;
        import com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.stats.CacheStats;
        import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
        import io.micrometer.core.instrument.binder.cache.CaffeineCacheMetrics;
        import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
        import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
        import org.springframework.transaction.support.*;
        @Component
        public class MenuDetailsCache {
            private record Key(String id,long version) {}
            private final Cache<Key,MenuModels.Details> cache;
            @Autowired public MenuDetailsCache(MeterRegistry metrics) {
                this(Duration.ofMinutes(5),10000,Ticker.systemTicker());CaffeineCacheMetrics.monitor(metrics,cache,"menuDishDetails");
            }
            public MenuDetailsCache(Duration expiration,int capacity,Ticker ticker) {
                cache=Caffeine.newBuilder().maximumSize(capacity).expireAfterWrite(expiration).ticker(ticker).recordStats().build();
            }
            public MenuModels.Details get(String id,long version,Supplier<MenuModels.Details> loader) {
                return cache.get(new Key(id,version),key->{var loaded=loader.get();if(!key.id().equals(loaded.dishId()) || key.version()!=loaded.dishVersion()) throw new IllegalStateException("Mismatched menu cache version.");return loaded;});
            }
            public void invalidateAfterCommit(Set<String> ids) {
                Set<String> snapshot=Set.copyOf(ids);
                if(!TransactionSynchronizationManager.isActualTransactionActive()) throw new IllegalStateException("Cache invalidation requires a business transaction.");
                TransactionSynchronizationManager.registerSynchronization(new TransactionSynchronization() {
                    @Override public void afterCommit() { cache.asMap().keySet().removeIf(key->snapshot.contains(key.id())); }
                });
            }
            public long size() { return cache.estimatedSize(); }
            public void cleanUp() { cache.cleanUp(); }
            public CacheStats stats() { return cache.stats(); }
        }

        package com.webox.catalog;
        import java.time.LocalDate;
        import java.util.List;
        import com.webox.shared.*;
        import com.webox.shared.DomainTypes.Category;
        import com.webox.inventory.SupplyRepository;
        import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
        import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.*;
        import static com.webox.catalog.MenuModels.*;
        @Service
        @Transactional(readOnly=true,isolation=Isolation.REPEATABLE_READ)
        public class MenuService {
            private final MenuQueryRepository query;private final DishRepository dishes;private final SupplyRepository supply;private final MenuDetailsCache cache;private final BusinessClock clock;
            public MenuService(MenuQueryRepository query,DishRepository dishes,SupplyRepository supply,MenuDetailsCache cache,BusinessClock clock) { this.query=query;this.dishes=dishes;this.supply=supply;this.cache=cache;this.clock=clock; }
            public MenuPage page(LocalDate date,List<Category> categories,String search,int page,int size) {
                var result=query.page(date,categories,search,page,size);
                return new MenuPage(date,clock.now(),BusinessClock.ZONE.getId(),supply.menuRevision(date),result.members().stream().map(this::view).toList(),page,size,result.total());
            }
            public MenuDish dish(LocalDate date,String id) { return view(query.member(date,id).orElseThrow(()->new ApiException(404,"NOT_FOUND","This dish is not available on the selected date."))); }
            private MenuDish view(MenuQueryRepository.Member member) {
                var details=cache.get(member.dishId(),member.dishVersion(),()->dishes.details(member.dishId(),member.dishVersion()));
                return MenuDish.of(details,member.remaining(),member.inventoryVersion(),new PreferenceMatch(false,false));
            }
        }

        package com.webox.media;
        import java.nio.file.*;
        import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
        import com.webox.shared.ApiException;
        import com.webox.shared.ValueRules;
        import org.springframework.core.io.FileSystemResource;
        import org.springframework.core.io.Resource;
        import org.springframework.http.*;
        import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
        @RestController
        public class PublicMediaController {
            private final MediaRepository media;private final Path root;
            public PublicMediaController(MediaRepository media,Path mediaRoot) { this.media=media;this.root=mediaRoot; }
            @GetMapping("/media/{mediaId}") public ResponseEntity<Resource> image(@PathVariable String mediaId) {
                var asset=media.find(ValueRules.uuid(mediaId)).orElseThrow(PublicMediaController::missing);
                try {
                    Path path=root.resolve(asset.storageKey()).normalize();
                    if(!path.startsWith(root) || !Files.isRegularFile(path,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) throw missing();
                    Path real=path.toRealPath();if(!real.startsWith(root.toRealPath()) || Files.size(real)!=asset.bytes()) throw missing();
                    return ResponseEntity.ok().contentType(MediaType.parseMediaType(asset.mime())).contentLength(asset.bytes())
                        .cacheControl(CacheControl.maxAge(365,TimeUnit.DAYS).cachePublic().immutable()).header("X-Content-Type-Options","nosniff")
                        .eTag("\""+asset.sha256()+"\"").body(new FileSystemResource(real));
                } catch(java.io.IOException e) { throw missing(); }
            }
            private static ApiException missing() { return new ApiException(404,"NOT_FOUND","This image is not available."); }
        }

       - **File-based coordination**: Tasks affecting the same files must run sequentially
       - **Validation checkpoints**: Verify each phase completion before proceeding
    
    7. Implementation execution rules:
       - **Setup first**: Initialize project structure, dependencies, configuration
       - **Tests before code**: If you need to write tests for contracts, entities, and integration scenarios

       - **Polish and validation**: Unit tests, performance optimization, documentation

       - For parallel tasks [P], continue with successful tasks, report failed ones

    **Tests**：规格 A-014 引入的交付约束 DC-009 明确要求可运行并通过的核心业务测试，计划与 quickstart 已规定验证入口，因此包含测试任务。每阶段先编写有意义的契约/业务测试，确认因目标行为缺失而失败，再实施并运行至通过；缺依赖、编译错误或跳过不算有效红灯/通过。真实 MySQL、真实 LLM、浏览器负载和真人验收各自留证，测试替身仅限隔离故障注入。

    ## Format: `[ID] [P?] [Story] Description`
    
    - 未完成任务使用 `- [ ] Tnnn`，完成且有证据后改为 `- [X] Tnnn`；故事阶段使用 `[USn]`，公共阶段不带故事标签。

    ## Phase 3: User Story 1 — 员工建立账号并持续访问个人空间 (P1)
    
    **Goal**：注册、登录、刷新、退出和服务端角色边界。
    
    **Entry gate**：Phase 2完成；不依赖其他用户故事。
    
    **Independent Test / Checkpoint**：新员工注册后显式登录，刷新保持身份，退出后受限访问拒绝；重复邮箱/非法密码/CSRF/角色注入拒绝。个人实体所有权在相应故事及最终全栈矩阵再次验证。

    ## Phase 4: User Story 2 — 浏览每日菜单并构建准确购物车 (P1)
    
    **Goal**：按日期浏览菜单、搜索筛选、配置与金额准确的账号隔离购物车。
    
    **Entry gate**：US1完成；所需媒体/菜品/每日供应模型在本故事先建立。
    
    **Independent Test / Checkpoint**：使用真实SQL夹具与图片验证汉堡必选项、配置归并、快速加购最多5份、意面两份59元、刷新/重开/换账号草稿及变价失效提示；不依赖US6管理界面。

    import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;
    @Repository
    public class MenuQueryRepository {
        private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
        private static final String MEMBERS=" FROM daily_supply s JOIN dishes d ON d.id=s.dish_id WHERE s.delivery_date=? AND s.scheduled=TRUE AND d.is_listed=TRUE";
        public MenuQueryRepository(JdbcTemplate jdbc) { this.jdbc=jdbc; }
        public record Member(String dishId,long dishVersion,int remaining,long inventoryVersion) {}
        public record Results(List<Member> members,long total) {}
        public Results page(LocalDate date,List<Category> categories,String search,int page,int size) {
            var sql=new StringBuilder(MEMBERS);var params=new ArrayList<Object>();params.add(date);
            if(!categories.isEmpty()) { sql.append(" AND d.category IN (").append(String.join(",",Collections.nCopies(categories.size(),"?"))).append(")");categories.forEach(c->params.add(c.value())); }
            if(!search.isEmpty()) {
                String escaped="%"+search.replace("!","!!").replace("%","!%").replace("_","!_")+"%";
                sql.append(" AND (d.name LIKE ? ESCAPE '!' OR d.description LIKE ? ESCAPE '!')");params.add(escaped);params.add(escaped);
            }
            long total=jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT COUNT(*)"+sql,Long.class,params.toArray());
            params.add(size);params.add((long)page*size);
            var members=jdbc.query("SELECT d.id,d.version,s.total_quantity-s.allocated_quantity,s.version"+sql+" ORDER BY d.name,d.id LIMIT ? OFFSET ?",(rs,n)->new Member(rs.getString(1),rs.getLong(2),rs.getInt(3),rs.getLong(4)),params.toArray());
            return new Results(members,total);
        }
        public Optional<Member> member(LocalDate date,String dishId) {
            return jdbc.query("SELECT d.id,d.version,s.total_quantity-s.allocated_quantity,s.version"+MEMBERS+" AND d.id=?",(rs,n)->new Member(rs.getString(1),rs.getLong(2),rs.getInt(3),rs.getLong(4)),date,dishId).stream().findFirst();
        }
    }

    import com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.*;
    import com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.stats.CacheStats;
    import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
    import io.micrometer.core.instrument.binder.cache.CaffeineCacheMetrics;
    import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
    import org.springframework.transaction.support.*;
    @Component
    public class MenuDetailsCache {
        private record Key(String id,long version) {}
        private final Cache<Key,MenuModels.Details> cache;
        @Autowired public MenuDetailsCache(MeterRegistry metrics) {
            this(Duration.ofMinutes(5),10000,Ticker.systemTicker());CaffeineCacheMetrics.monitor(metrics,cache,"menuDishDetails");
        }
        public MenuDetailsCache(Duration expiration,int capacity,Ticker ticker) {
            cache=Caffeine.newBuilder().maximumSize(capacity).expireAfterWrite(expiration).ticker(ticker).recordStats().build();
        }
        public MenuModels.Details get(String id,long version,Supplier<MenuModels.Details> loader) {
            return cache.get(new Key(id,version),key->{var loaded=loader.get();if(!key.id().equals(loaded.dishId()) || key.version()!=loaded.dishVersion()) throw new IllegalStateException("Mismatched menu cache version.");return loaded;});
        }
        public void invalidateAfterCommit(Set<String> ids) {
            Set<String> snapshot=Set.copyOf(ids);
            if(!TransactionSynchronizationManager.isActualTransactionActive()) throw new IllegalStateException("Cache invalidation requires a business transaction.");
            TransactionSynchronizationManager.registerSynchronization(new TransactionSynchronization() {
                @Override public void afterCommit() { cache.asMap().keySet().removeIf(key->snapshot.contains(key.id())); }
            });
        }
        public long size() { return cache.estimatedSize(); }
        public void cleanUp() { cache.cleanUp(); }
        public CacheStats stats() { return cache.stats(); }
    }

            private MutableClock(AtomicReference<Instant> current, ZoneId zone) { this.current = current; this.zone = zone; }
            public void set(Instant instant) { current.set(instant); }
            @Override public ZoneId getZone() { return zone; }

        public Optional<Asset> find(String id) {
            return jdbc.query("SELECT id,storage_key,served_mime,served_bytes,content_sha256,width,height FROM media_assets WHERE id=?",
                (rs,n)->new Asset(rs.getString(1),rs.getString(2),rs.getString(3),rs.getLong(4),rs.getString(5),rs.getInt(6),rs.getInt(7)),id).stream().findFirst();

            if(!"Admin".equals(jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT role FROM users WHERE id=?",String.class,uploader))) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Only administrators can create media.");
            jdbc.update("INSERT INTO media_assets(id,uploaded_by,original_filename,source_mime,source_bytes,content_sha256,width,height,storage_key,served_mime,served_bytes,source_attribution,created_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                asset.id(),uploader,originalName,sourceMime,sourceBytes,asset.sha256(),asset.width(),asset.height(),asset.storageKey(),asset.mime(),asset.bytes(),attribution,LocalDateTime.ofInstant(now,ZoneOffset.UTC));
        }
        public record Asset(String id,String storageKey,String mime,long bytes,String sha256,int width,int height) {}
    }

    import org.springframework.core.io.Resource;
    import org.springframework.http.*;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
    @RestController
    public class PublicMediaController {
        private final MediaRepository media;private final Path root;
        public PublicMediaController(MediaRepository media,Path mediaRoot) { this.media=media;this.root=mediaRoot; }
        @GetMapping("/media/{mediaId}") public ResponseEntity<Resource> image(@PathVariable String mediaId) {
            var asset=media.find(ValueRules.uuid(mediaId)).orElseThrow(PublicMediaController::missing);
            try {
                Path path=root.resolve(asset.storageKey()).normalize();
                if(!path.startsWith(root) || !Files.isRegularFile(path,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) throw missing();
                Path real=path.toRealPath();if(!real.startsWith(root.toRealPath()) || Files.size(real)!=asset.bytes()) throw missing();
                return ResponseEntity.ok().contentType(MediaType.parseMediaType(asset.mime())).contentLength(asset.bytes())
                    .cacheControl(CacheControl.maxAge(365,TimeUnit.DAYS).cachePublic().immutable()).header("X-Content-Type-Options","nosniff")
                    .eTag("\""+asset.sha256()+"\"").body(new FileSystemResource(real));
            } catch(java.io.IOException e) { throw missing(); }
        }
        private static ApiException missing() { return new ApiException(404,"NOT_FOUND","This image is not available."); }
    }

    export const MAX_SAFE_INTEGER = Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
    export function safeInteger(value: number): number {
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value < 0) throw new Error('Value must be a non-negative safe integer.');
      return value;
    }
    export function money(cents: number): string {
      const exact = BigInt(safeInteger(cents));
      return `${exact / 100n}.${String(exact % 100n).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    }
    export function parseMoney(input: string): number {
      if (!/^\d{1,14}(\.\d{1,2})?$/.test(input)) throw new Error('Enter a valid amount with at most two decimal places.');
      const [whole, fraction = ''] = input.split('.');
      const cents = BigInt(whole) * 100n + BigInt(fraction.padEnd(2, '0'));
      if (cents > BigInt(MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)) throw new Error('Amount exceeds the supported limit.');
      return Number(cents);
    }
    export function codePoints(text: string): number {
      // A lone surrogate cannot be stored faithfully in utf8mb4.
      for (const point of text) {
        const code = point.codePointAt(0)!;
        if (code >= 0xd800 && code <= 0xdfff) throw new Error('Text contains invalid Unicode.');
      }
      return Array.from(text).length;
    }
    export function requiredText(text: string, max: number): string {
      const normalized = text.trim();
      const length = codePoints(normalized);
      if (!length || length > max) throw new Error(`Text must contain 1 to ${max} characters.`);
      return normalized;
    }
    export function password(text: string): string {
      const length = codePoints(text);
      if (length < 8 || length > 128 || !/[A-Za-z]/.test(text) || !/[0-9]/.test(text)) {
        throw new Error('Password must contain 8 to 128 characters, including a letter and a number.');
      }
      return text;
    }

    import { createContext, createElement, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
    import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    import { api, ApiError, onUnauthorized, resetApiSession } from '../../shared/api/client';
    import type { User } from '../../shared/api/types';
    const cleanup = new Set<() => void>();
    export function onSessionEnd(callback: () => void): () => void { cleanup.add(callback); return () => { cleanup.delete(callback); }; }
    type Session = { user: User | null; loading: boolean; error: string | null; refresh: () => Promise<void>; login: (email: string, password: string) => Promise<User>; logout: () => Promise<void> };
    const Context = createContext<Session | null>(null);
    export function SessionProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
      const queries = useQueryClient();
      const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(null);
      const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
      const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
      const generation = useRef(0);
      const clear = useCallback(() => {
        generation.current++; resetApiSession(); void queries.cancelQueries(); queries.clear();
        for (const close of cleanup) close();
        setUser(null); setLoading(false); setError(null);
      }, [queries]);
      const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
        const active = generation.current;
        try {
          const restored = await api<User>('/auth/me');
          if (active === generation.current) { setUser(restored); setError(null); }
        } catch (e) {
          if (e instanceof ApiError && e.status === 401) { if (active === generation.current) setUser(null); }
          else if (!(e instanceof DOMException && e.name === 'AbortError') && active === generation.current) setError('Could not check your session. Please try again.');
        } finally { if (active === generation.current) setLoading(false); }
      }, []);
      useEffect(() => {
        const unsubscribe = onUnauthorized(clear);
        void refresh();
        const focus = () => { void refresh(); };
        window.addEventListener('focus', focus);
        return () => { unsubscribe(); window.removeEventListener('focus', focus); generation.current++; resetApiSession(); };
      }, [clear, refresh]);
      const login = useCallback(async (email: string, password: string) => {
        const authenticated = await api<User>('/auth/login', { method: 'POST', json: { email, password } });
        clear();setUser(authenticated);return authenticated;
      }, [clear]);
      const logout = useCallback(async () => {
        try { await api<void>('/auth/logout', { method: 'POST' }); }
        catch(e) { if (!(e instanceof ApiError && e.status === 401)) throw e; }
        clear();
      }, [clear]);
      return createElement(Context.Provider, { value: { user, loading, error, refresh, login, logout } }, children);
    }
    export function useSession(): Session {
      const value = useContext(Context);if (!value) throw new Error('SessionProvider is required.');return value;
    }
    export function homeFor(user: User): string { return user.role === 'Admin' ? '/console/dishes' : '/menu'; }

    +export function configuration(dish: MenuDish, selected: string[]): { optionIds: string[]; unitPriceCents: number; key: string } {
    +  const optionIds = [...new Set(selected.map(id => id.toLowerCase()))].sort();
    +  const remaining = new Set(optionIds);

    +  for (const group of dish.optionGroups) {

    +    if (group.selectionMode === 'Single' && options.length > 1) throw new Error(`Choose only one option for ${group.name}.`);

    +  if (price > BigInt(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)) throw new Error('This amount exceeds the supported limit.');

    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    # Run npm with the project's Node 24 without changing the global installation.
    set -euo pipefail
    
    webox_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
    webox_node="${WEBOX_NODE_BIN:-$webox_root/.local/toolchains/node24/bin/node}"
    if [[ ! -x "$webox_node" ]]; then
      if [[ -n "${WEBOX_NODE_BIN:-}" ]]; then
        printf 'WEBOX_NODE_BIN is not executable: %s\n' "$webox_node" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      webox_node="$(command -v node || true)"
    fi
    if [[ -z "$webox_node" ]]; then
      printf 'Node 24 is required. Set WEBOX_NODE_BIN to its absolute executable path.\n' >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    webox_node="$(cd "$(dirname "$webox_node")" && pwd)/$(basename "$webox_node")"
    webox_node_version="$("$webox_node" --version)"
    case "$webox_node_version" in
      v24.*) ;;
      *) printf 'Node 24 is required; found %s (%s).\n' "$webox_node_version" "$webox_node" >&2; exit 1 ;;
    esac
    
    export PATH="$(dirname "$webox_node"):$PATH"
    if ! command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      printf 'npm 11 is required and was not found on PATH.\n' >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    webox_npm_version="$(npm --version)"
    case "$webox_npm_version" in
      11.*) ;;
      *) printf 'npm 11 is required; found %s.\n' "$webox_npm_version" >&2; exit 1 ;;
    esac
    
    export npm_config_cache="${npm_config_cache:-$webox_root/.local/npm}"
    cd "$webox_root/frontend"
    exec npm "$@"

        public Details details(String id,long version) {
            var base=jdbc.query("SELECT id,name,description,media_id,base_price_cents,category,protein_source,spice,version FROM dishes WHERE id=? AND version=?",
                (rs,n)->new Details(rs.getString(1),rs.getString(2),rs.getString(3),"/media/"+rs.getString(4),rs.getLong(5),Category.parse(rs.getString(6)),rs.getString(7),List.of(),SpiceLevel.valueOf(rs.getString(8)),List.of(),rs.getLong(9)),id,version).stream().findFirst()
                    .orElseThrow(()->new ApiException(404,"NOT_FOUND","This dish is not available."));
            var allergens=jdbc.query("SELECT allergen FROM dish_allergens WHERE dish_id=? ORDER BY allergen",(rs,n)->Allergen.valueOf(rs.getString(1)),id);
            Map<String,List<Allergen>> optionAllergens=new HashMap<>();
            jdbc.query("SELECT a.option_id,a.allergen FROM option_allergens a JOIN customization_options o ON o.id=a.option_id JOIN customization_groups g ON g.id=o.group_id WHERE g.dish_id=? ORDER BY a.allergen",rs->{optionAllergens.computeIfAbsent(rs.getString(1),k->new ArrayList<>()).add(Allergen.valueOf(rs.getString(2)));},id);
            Map<String,List<Option>> options=new HashMap<>();
            jdbc.query("SELECT o.group_id,o.id,o.name,o.extra_price_cents FROM customization_options o JOIN customization_groups g ON g.id=o.group_id WHERE g.dish_id=? ORDER BY o.display_order,o.id",rs->{String option=rs.getString(2);options.computeIfAbsent(rs.getString(1),k->new ArrayList<>()).add(new Option(option,rs.getString(3),rs.getLong(4),optionAllergens.getOrDefault(option,List.of())));},id);
            var groups=jdbc.query("SELECT id,name,required,selection_mode FROM customization_groups WHERE dish_id=? ORDER BY display_order,id",
                (rs,n)->new OptionGroup(rs.getString(1),rs.getString(2),rs.getBoolean(3),SelectionType.valueOf(rs.getString(4)),options.getOrDefault(rs.getString(1),List.of())),id);
            return new Details(base.dishId(),base.name(),base.description(),base.imageUrl(),base.basePriceCents(),base.category(),base.protein(),allergens,base.spiceLevel(),groups,base.dishVersion());

    export async function identitySession(context: BrowserContext, role: Role = 'Employee'): Promise<User> {
      const origin = process.env.WEBOX_E2E_API_ORIGIN ?? 'http://127.0.0.1:18081';
      const key = process.env.WEBOX_E2E_FIXTURE_KEY;
      if (!key) throw new Error('E2E fixture key is missing. Start the isolated test server through Playwright.');
      const response = await context.request.post(`${origin}/__test/sessions`, { headers: { 'X-WeBox-Fixture-Key': key }, data: { role } });
      if (!response.ok()) throw new Error(`Cannot create isolated test identity (${response.status()}).`);
      const result = await response.json() as { user: User; sessionId: string };
      await context.addCookies([{ name: 'WEBOXSESSION', value: result.sessionId, domain: '127.0.0.1', path: '/', httpOnly: true, secure: false, sameSite: 'Lax' }]);
      return result.user;
    }

    export function shanghaiDate(now = new Date()): string {
      const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', { timeZone: 'Asia/Shanghai', year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit' }).formatToParts(now);
      return ['year', 'month', 'day'].map(name => parts.find(part => part.type === name)!.value).join('-');
    }
    export function menuDish(date: string, id: string, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<MenuDish> { return api(`/menus/${date}/dishes/${id}`, { signal }); }
    export function useMenuQuery(date: string, selected: Category[], search: string, page: number, recommended = false) {
      const params = new URLSearchParams({ search, page: String(page), size: '24', recommended: String(recommended) });
      [...selected].sort().forEach(category => params.append('categories', category));
      return useQuery({ queryKey: ['menu', date, params.toString()], queryFn: ({ signal }) => api<MenuPage>(`/menus/${date}?${params}`, { signal }) });
    }

    package com.webox.support;
    
    import java.nio.file.*;

    import org.springframework.session.jdbc.JdbcIndexedSessionRepository;

    import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionTemplate;
    
    /** Verified images and relational fixtures in the disposable test database only. */
    public final class CatalogFixtures {
        private static final AtomicInteger DATES = new AtomicInteger();
        private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
        private final MediaRepository media;
        private final Path root;
        private final FixtureFactory users;
        private final TransactionTemplate transaction;
        private static final LocalDateTime NOW = LocalDateTime.of(2026,10,16,1,0);
        public CatalogFixtures(JdbcTemplate jdbc, MediaRepository media, Path root, JdbcIndexedSessionRepository sessions, AuthService auth, PlatformTransactionManager manager) {
            this.jdbc=jdbc;this.media=media;this.root=root;this.users=new FixtureFactory(sessions,auth);this.transaction=new TransactionTemplate(manager);
        }
        public record Menu(LocalDate date,String adminId,String burger,String pasta,String salad,String chinese,String japanese,String hidden,String unscheduled,String mediaId,Map<String,String> options) {}
        public Menu create() {
            var admin=users.identity(Role.Admin).user().userId();
            String burgerImage=image(admin,"classic-beef-burger.png"),pastaImage=image(admin,"tomato-pasta.png"),saladImage=image(admin,"garden-salad.jpg");
            return transaction.execute(status->{
                LocalDate date=LocalDate.of(2032,1,1).plusDays(DATES.getAndIncrement());
                jdbc.update("INSERT INTO daily_menus VALUES (?,?,?,?)",date,1,admin,NOW);
                var options=new LinkedHashMap<String,String>();
                String burger=dish(date,"Classic Beef Burger","Grilled beef, lettuce and tomato. Customize your bun and sauce.",3200,"Western","Beef",burgerImage,true,true,20);
                group(burger,"Bun",true,"Single",0,options,new Choice("Plain bun",0,"Gluten"),new Choice("Brioche bun",200,"Gluten","Egg","Dairy"));
                group(burger,"Sauce",true,"Single",1,options,new Choice("Ketchup",0),new Choice("Mayonnaise",0,"Egg"));
                group(burger,"Burger extras",false,"Multiple",2,options,new Choice("Extra cheese",300,"Dairy"));
                jdbc.update("INSERT INTO dish_allergens VALUES (?,?)",burger,"Gluten");
                String pasta=dish(date,"Tomato Pasta","Pasta with tomato sauce and fresh basil.",2650,"Western","Wheat",pastaImage,true,true,20);
                group(pasta,"Pasta type",true,"Single",0,options,new Choice("Spaghetti",0,"Gluten"),new Choice("Fusilli",0,"Gluten"));
                group(pasta,"Add-ons",false,"Multiple",1,options,new Choice("Cheese",300,"Dairy"));
                jdbc.update("INSERT INTO dish_allergens VALUES (?,?)",pasta,"Gluten");
                String salad=dish(date,"Garden Salad","Fresh greens, chickpeas and a bright dressing.",1800,"Light Meal","Chickpeas",saladImage,true,true,0);
                String chinese=dish(date,"Chinese Garden Salad","Fresh greens with a 100% plant-based dressing_!.",1800,"Chinese","Chickpeas",saladImage,true,true,20);
                String japanese=dish(date,"Japanese Garden Salad","Fresh greens with soy dressing.",1800,"Japanese","Chickpeas",saladImage,true,true,20);
                String hidden=dish(date,"Hidden Salad","An unpublished dish.",1800,"Light Meal","Chickpeas",saladImage,false,true,20);
                String unscheduled=dish(date,"Unscheduled Salad","A dish not on this date.",1800,"Light Meal","Chickpeas",saladImage,true,false,20);
                return new Menu(date,admin,burger,pasta,salad,chinese,japanese,hidden,unscheduled,saladImage,Map.copyOf(options));
            });
        }
        public String dish(LocalDate date,String name,String description,long price,String category,String protein,String image,boolean listed,boolean scheduled,int total) {
            String id=UUID.randomUUID().toString();
            jdbc.update("INSERT INTO dishes VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?, ?,?,?,?,?)",id,name,description,price,category,protein,"None",image,listed,1,NOW,NOW);
            jdbc.update("INSERT INTO daily_supply VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",date,id,scheduled,total,0,0,NOW);return id;
        }
        private record Choice(String name,long extra,String... allergens) {}
        private void group(String dish,String name,boolean required,String mode,int order,Map<String,String> options,Choice... choices) {
            String group=UUID.randomUUID().toString();jdbc.update("INSERT INTO customization_groups VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)",group,dish,name,mode,required,order);
            for(int i=0;i<choices.length;i++) {
                var choice=choices[i];String id=UUID.randomUUID().toString();options.put(choice.name(),id);
                jdbc.update("INSERT INTO customization_options VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)",id,group,choice.name(),choice.extra(),i);
                for(String allergen:choice.allergens()) jdbc.update("INSERT INTO option_allergens VALUES (?,?)",id,allergen);
            }
        }
        private String image(String admin,String filename) {
            try(var stream=CatalogFixtures.class.getResourceAsStream("/seed/images/"+filename)) {
                if(stream==null) throw new IllegalStateException("Missing image fixture");
                byte[] bytes=stream.readAllBytes();var decoded=ImageIO.read(new java.io.ByteArrayInputStream(bytes));
                if(decoded==null || decoded.getWidth()>8192 || decoded.getHeight()>8192 || (long)decoded.getWidth()*decoded.getHeight()>16777216 || bytes.length>5242880) throw new IllegalStateException("Invalid image fixture");
                String id=UUID.randomUUID().toString(),format=filename.endsWith(".png")?"png":"jpeg",key=id+"."+format;
                var output=new java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream();if(!ImageIO.write(decoded,format,output)) throw new IllegalStateException("Image encoder missing");
                byte[] served=output.toByteArray();Files.write(root.resolve(key),served,StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW);
                String sha=HexFormat.of().formatHex(java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(served));
                media.insert(new MediaRepository.Asset(id,key,"image/"+format,served.length,sha,decoded.getWidth(),decoded.getHeight()),admin,filename,"image/"+format,bytes.length,"Test fixture; see seed/ATTRIBUTION.md",NOW.toInstant(ZoneOffset.UTC));return id;
            } catch(java.io.IOException | java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException e) { throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot prepare verified test image",e); }
        }
    }

    package com.webox.shared;
    import java.time.*;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
    import com.webox.shared.DomainTypes.Meal;
    @Component
    public final class BusinessClock {
        public static final ZoneId ZONE = ZoneId.of("Asia/Shanghai");
        private final Clock clock;
        public BusinessClock(Clock clock) { this.clock = clock; }
        public Instant now() { return clock.instant(); }
        public LocalDate today() { return now().atZone(ZONE).toLocalDate(); }
        public Instant cutoff(LocalDate date, Meal meal) {
            return date.atTime(meal == Meal.Lunch ? 10 : 15, 0).atZone(ZONE).toInstant();
        }
    }

    import type { BrowserContext } from '@playwright/test';
    export type MenuFixture = { date: string; pasta: string; burger: string; salad: string; options: Record<string, string> };

    }
    export async function changeDish(context: BrowserContext, id: string, change: 'price' | 'unlist') {
      const response = await context.request.post(`${process.env.WEBOX_E2E_API_ORIGIN ?? 'http://127.0.0.1:18081'}/__test/catalog/${id}`, { headers: { 'X-WeBox-Fixture-Key': process.env.WEBOX_E2E_FIXTURE_KEY! }, data: { change } });

      servlet:
        session:
          timeout: ${SESSION_TIMEOUT:8h}
          cookie:
            name: WEBOXSESSION
            http-only: true
            secure: ${SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE:false}
            same-site: lax
      error:
        include-message: never
        include-stacktrace: never
        include-binding-errors: never
    spring:
      application:
        name: webox
      datasource:
        url: ${DB_URL:jdbc:mysql://127.0.0.1:3306/webox?connectionTimeZone=UTC&forceConnectionTimeZoneToSession=true}
        username: ${DB_USERNAME:webox}
        password: ${DB_PASSWORD:}
        hikari:
          connection-init-sql: "SET time_zone = '+00:00'"
          connection-timeout: 3000
          maximum-pool-size: 16
      session:
        timeout: ${SESSION_TIMEOUT:8h}
        jdbc:
          initialize-schema: never
      servlet:
        multipart:
          max-file-size: 5MB
          max-request-size: 6MB
      jackson:
        deserialization:
          fail-on-unknown-properties: true
          fail-on-trailing-tokens: true
          accept-float-as-int: false
        mapper:
          allow-coercion-of-scalars: false
      sql:
        init:
          mode: never
    management:
      endpoints:
        web:
          exposure:
            include: health
      endpoint:
        health:
          show-details: never
    webox:
      media-root: ${MEDIA_ROOT:.local/media}

    package com.webox.support;
    import com.webox.WeBoxApplication;
    import com.webox.catalog.MenuDetailsCache;
    import com.webox.catalog.MenuService;
    import org.springframework.boot.WebApplicationType;
    import org.springframework.boot.builder.SpringApplicationBuilder;
    /** Launched twice as separate JVMs; credentials are inherited through environment variables. */
    public final class CacheRestartProbe {
        public static void main(String[] args) {
            try(var context=new SpringApplicationBuilder(WeBoxApplication.class).web(WebApplicationType.NONE).profiles("test").run()) {
                var cache=context.getBean(MenuDetailsCache.class);var service=context.getBean(MenuService.class);
                if(cache.size()!=0 || cache.stats().missCount()!=0) throw new AssertionError("Process must start with a cold cache");
                var first=service.dish(java.time.LocalDate.parse(args[0]),args[1]);var second=service.dish(java.time.LocalDate.parse(args[0]),args[1]);
                if(!first.equals(second) || cache.stats().missCount()!=1 || cache.stats().hitCount()!=1) throw new AssertionError("Cold/warm reads must agree");
                System.out.println("CACHE_PROBE="+first.dishId()+":"+first.dishVersion()+":"+first.basePriceCents()+":"+first.remaining()+":"+first.inventoryVersion());
            }
        }
    }

    specs/001-webox-meal-ordering/spec.md:338:- **FR-028**: 普通加购 MUST 按菜品基础标签与已选选项标签的并集计算过敏原；命中本人标记时弹窗列出命中项，继续才加入，拒绝不改变购物车。配置变化出现新匹配时重新提醒；普通菜单不得据此过滤菜品。
    specs/001-webox-meal-ordering/spec.md:372:- **FR-036**: 管理员 MUST 可查看全部订单，执行 `Pending → Confirmed → Completed` 或 `Pending → Cancelled`；不允许回退、跳过确认或取消 Confirmed/Completed。已取消订单重复取消返回当前结果且不重复恢复库存；取消与确认并发仅一个转换成功。员工随后查看得到相同状态。
    specs/001-webox-meal-ordering/spec.md:400:- **FR-042**: 推荐 MUST 排除未上架、未安排、售罄，以及菜品基础标签或任一当前选项标签命中本人过敏原的整道菜；不因某次未选该选项而放宽 AI 排除。对近 7 天已点菜品降优先级，明确要求不重复时按要求排除，没有匹配候选时说明原因。
    specs/001-webox-meal-ordering/spec.md:432:- **Cart / Cart Item**: 员工待购买的菜品、配置组合、数量及当前金额；相同菜品与配置构成一个条目。
    specs/001-webox-meal-ordering/spec.md:434:- **Recommendation**: 一次自然语言选餐诉求及基于当前可用菜品形成的推荐项与理由；不创建独立于真实菜单的商品。
    specs/001-webox-meal-ordering/spec.md:538:- **A-010 — 推荐时间与过敏原**: “近 7 天”为运营今天及前 6 个自然日的非取消配送记录；默认软排重，明确诉求按指定日期硬排除。菜品基础标签和选项标签分别录入；普通加购按实际配置并集提醒，AI 按基础及所有当前选项的并集保守排除。管理员录入已知成分，空标签只表示未标记，不承诺绝对安全，不根据菜名推断真实成分。
    specs/001-webox-meal-ordering/spec.md:554:- **A-014 — 交付与治理依赖**: 交付要求以 [delivery-constraints.md](delivery-constraints.md) 为入口；用户补充的无开发时限、全部功能必交付优先，其余要求以 PRD §7 原文为准；当前 `.specify/memory/constitution.md` 仍为占位模板，未提供已批准的额外原则。图片资源已定位且待实施时导入；原始 AI 编程对话导出、推荐服务与运行环境仍须落实，不宣称本规格已经提供可运行产品。

    # US1 账号与会话验证
    
    日期：2026-10-16。T020–T028 完成。使用 JDK17 / Spring Boot4.1.1 / MySQL8.4.11 临时容器、Node24 / React19.2 / Router7.18.4，以及 Chromium156、Firefox157、WebKit27.2。功能账号为每次生成的 UUID 邮箱，覆盖 example.com 与 example.org，不限制企业域名；日期固定2026-10-16（账号功能不依赖配送日期）。自动化执行者：Codex。
    
    ## 通过的场景
    
    | AC | 实际输入与结果 | 证据 |
    | --- | --- | --- |
    | AC-US01-01 | 唯一邮箱注册201、角色Employee，注册后me仍401；显式登录200，刷新后仍返回相同User | AuthContractIT；auth.spec.ts × 9组合 |
    | AC-US01-02 | 大小写重复邮箱409 EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED；错误密码401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS；浏览器保留邮箱并显示英文原因 | 同上 |
    | AC-US01-03 | 登录更换session ID，旧匿名ID失效，旧CSRF被403拒绝；取新CSRF后退出204，旧会话me401；数据库8h空闲期越界后拒绝访问 | AuthContractIT；auth.spec.ts；auth.test.tsx |
    | AC-US01-04（部分） | 匿名被401拒绝，Employee访问Console API403/UI Access denied，Admin成功登录并进入独立Console导航 | AuthContractIT、HealthContractIT、auth.spec.ts；跨用户订单/地址/偏好尚无实体，完整AC保持未执行 |
    | AC-US01-05 | 无效/超长邮箱、7字符或无字母/数字及129码点密码400；含emoji的128码点密码可注册登录，截短版本不可登录；SQL只保存Argon2id哈希 | AuthContractIT；浏览器非法密码输入检查 |
    
    退出同时取消旧API请求、清个人Query缓存、调用流清理回调；身份与密码不存localStorage。刷新通过服务器恢复身份，Admin/Employee分别默认到Console/Menu。单元测试检查个人缓存被移除与清理回调执行。
    
    V003提供UUID账号、规范化邮箱二进制唯一约束、角色CHECK、版本和UTC时间。Argon2id参数为19 MiB、2 iterations、parallelism1、16-byte盐、32-byte哈希；未知账号也执行一次dummy哈希匹配，用户反馈固定。
    
    seed profile使用同一主应用，以非Web方式运行管理员初始化并关闭context；真实数据库连续运行两次，第二次不同初始密码未覆盖已存哈希。将已有Employee配置为管理员会失败，不隐式提权；普通Web启动不执行seed。

    # Tasks: WeBox 企业员工餐食订购平台
    
    **Input**：[plan.md](plan.md)、[spec.md](spec.md)、[research.md](research.md)、[data-model.md](data-model.md)、[contracts/README.md](contracts/README.md)、[contracts/openapi.yaml](contracts/openapi.yaml)、[contracts/streaming.md](contracts/streaming.md)、[quickstart.md](quickstart.md)、[delivery-constraints.md](delivery-constraints.md)、[decisions.md](decisions.md)、[requirements-source.md](requirements-source.md)、[acceptance.md](acceptance.md)。
    
    **日期**：2026-10-16。**状态**：T001–T028（工程、基础能力、US1账号故事）已完成，进入US2菜单与购物车。后端22个测试、前端11个单元测试及36个浏览器测试通过；OpenRouter真实生成探针通过。验收台账4项通过、77项未执行，US1跨实体owner场景待后续完成。证据见 [environment.md](../../docs/validation/environment.md)、[foundation.md](../../docs/validation/foundation.md)、[us1.md](../../docs/validation/us1.md)。
    
    **范围**：Tier 1–3 全部必交付，无开发时限；MVP 仅为实施检查点，不缩减最终 47 条 FR、11 条 SC、10 条 DC。原始 PRD 与既有决策优先，不能把参考项目未采用的规则带入实现。
    
    **Tests**：规格 A-014 引入的交付约束 DC-009 明确要求可运行并通过的核心业务测试，计划与 quickstart 已规定验证入口，因此包含测试任务。每阶段先编写有意义的契约/业务测试，确认因目标行为缺失而失败，再实施并运行至通过；缺依赖、编译错误或跳过不算有效红灯/通过。真实 MySQL、真实 LLM、浏览器负载和真人验收各自留证，测试替身仅限隔离故障注入。
    
    **Organization**：按 US1–US9 和 P1→P2→P3 分阶段；共享模型归属首次使用的故事，库存事务在 US3 即完成，US7 补实时投递与恢复。US4 补全规则交互和边界证明，不推迟 US2/US3 已需的数量与截单强校验。
    
    ## Format: `[ID] [P?] [Story] Description`
    
    - 未完成任务使用 `- [ ] Tnnn`，完成且有证据后改为 `- [X] Tnnn`；故事阶段使用 `[USn]`，公共阶段不带故事标签。
    - `[P]` 仅表示阶段入口及标明的前置任务完成后，同组不同文件可并行；不授权跳过前置任务，也不自动启动其他代理。
    - 没有 `[P]` 的任务按编号串行；每个阶段末验收任务依赖该阶段全部实现及测试任务。
    - 模型任务中的「…」为数据模型逐字约束，须同时落实到迁移、服务校验和接口映射；不能只写 SQL CHECK 而漏掉跨行或权限校验。
    
    ## Path Conventions
    
    所有代码路径均相对于仓库根 `/Users/zhoubo/weboxspec`；具体创建与验证进度以任务勾选和证据记录为准。后端 `backend/src/main/java/com/webox/`，测试 `backend/src/test/java/com/webox/`；前端 `frontend/src/`，端到端 `frontend/tests/e2e/`；报告 `docs/validation/`。迁移编号在本清单预分配，禁止并行任务重复占用同一版本。数据库始终为独立 MySQL 8.4；当前无 Git 仓库，不把提交/推送作为任务完成前提。宪章为占位模板，不新增审批规则。
    
    ## Phase 1: Setup — 工程与可重复环境
    
    **Goal**：建立前后端、独立 MySQL、锁定依赖与验证入口。
    
    **Entry gate**：无；仅依赖已有设计文档。
    
    **Independent Test / Checkpoint**：JDK 17/Node 24 和 Docker 实际可用；空工程可构建，独立 MySQL 健康；不能以命令存在代替运行证据。
    
    - 已统一仅完成订单收入/销量、管理员取消及幂等重放、本机购物车恢复、5MiB上传、选项过敏原、用户原文地址、Caffeine版本化菜单缓存和种子基线；原有库存占用与有效订单唯一性语义保留。
    - 118条来源REQ、10条采用决策、47条FR、11条SC、10条DC及81项验收记录均可追溯；验收台账全部未执行。51个用户场景与规格一致。
    - 校验1,252个本地链接/锚点与行号引用、118段来源短引（忽略Markdown强调标记），检查编号唯一、旧口径残留及Markdown表格/锚点；原PRD SHA-256保持不变。
    - API保持32个操作；仅扩展已有管理员状态接口和选项/快照/告警类型，无需新增端点。原始图片包20张已定位并通过完整性检查，尚未导入应用资源。
    - 当前没有应用代码或业务数据库迁移，本次新增字段按未来初始迁移实现；运行验收、性能与真人测试仍未执行。
    
    ### 分析后修复记录（2026-10-16）
    
    - 按用户“按照建议修复4个问题”的授权完成 A1、I1、I2、I3：A1 明确 AI 功能与性能分组、完整分母、失败计量及浏览器计时；I1 区分运行时上传媒体与必须交付的种子图片；I2 统一查询日 D、D-6 至 D 趋势及当前库存语义；I3 将阶段状态更新为任务分解完成、待实施。
    - 同步规格、计划、数据模型、契约、任务、修订决策与验收指南；SC-010/011 与 AC-SC-010/011 判据一致。137 个任务编号、12 个阶段、29 个并行标记及 81 个验收编号和执行状态保持不变；114 条模型表格约束与任务逐字一致。
    - 静态复核通过：60 个 schema、32 个 HTTP 操作、15 个请求/响应示例、7 个流事件示例、13 个正向和 20 个拒绝边界；本地链接/锚点/来源引用和 Markdown 表格有效。OpenAPI 仅澄清描述，接口及数据结构未变。原始 PRD、来源追溯、宪章模板和需求质量清单未改动。
    - 以上为文档修复与静态验证；全部实施任务仍待执行，81 项业务、质量及交付验收仍未执行。
    # WeBox 启动与验收指南
    
    **日期**：2026-10-16
    **适用范围**：Tier 1、Tier 2、Tier 3 全部必交付；没有开发或交付时限。
    
    **当前状态**：T001–T028已完成，正在实施US2。工程、基础能力与账号流程已验证，4项AC通过、77项未执行。完整菜单/订单/seed样例/推荐/看板和最终验收仍待落实。见[账号记录](../../docs/validation/us1.md)与[验收台账](acceptance.md)。
    
    业务基线见 [spec.md](spec.md)，接口及错误格式见 [contracts/openapi.yaml](contracts/openapi.yaml)，流式语义见 [contracts/streaming.md](contracts/streaming.md)，持久化与状态规则见 [data-model.md](data-model.md)，选型依据见 [research.md](research.md)。本指南提供运行和验证步骤，不包含实现代码。
    
    ## 1. 环境与交付前提
    
    准备 JDK 17、Node 24 LTS 与 npm、支持 Compose v2 的 Docker 环境，以及可用的 OpenRouter API 凭据。后端使用项目内 Maven Wrapper 3.9 系列，不要求全局 Maven。前端为 Vite 8，后端为 Spring Boot 4.1.1。MySQL 8.4 必须作为独立服务真实运行；测试也使用独立 MySQL Testcontainers，不能替换为 H2 或其他内存数据库。
    
    需要能下载锁定依赖、MySQL 镜像、Playwright 浏览器，并可访问 OpenRouter HTTPS API。记录 JDK/Node/Docker/浏览器版本、客户端硬件、配置及实际返回的模型/provider/generation ID、暖机和并发。上游硬件与模型 digest 不可得时如实注明；性能必须实测。
    
    实施后仓库应提供以下入口：
    
    | 入口 | 用途 |
    | --- | --- |
    | `.env.example` | 环境变量模板，仅含示例，不含真实凭据 |
    | `infra/compose.yaml` | 仅启动名为 `mysql` 的独立 MySQL 8.4 服务，使用命名持久卷 |
    | `backend/mvnw`、`backend/pom.xml` | 后端启动、迁移、种子及测试入口 |
    | `frontend/package-lock.json`、`frontend/package.json` | 可重复安装与前端脚本 |
    | `.local/media/` 或 `MEDIA_ROOT` 指定目录 | 后端上传媒体的持久目录，重启不清空 |
    | `README.md` | 从零配置、API、架构、实际测试报告及原始对话导出位置 |
    | `ai-conversations/` | 工具原生导出的完整 AI 编程对话；若另存，README 明确路径 |

    package com.webox.shared;
    import java.util.List;
    import java.util.Map;
    import java.util.Set;
    /** Only server-authored messages and authorized context belong in public errors. */
    public final class ApiException extends RuntimeException {
        private static final Set<String> CONTEXT_KEYS = Set.of("fieldErrors", "itemIssues", "existingOrderId", "suggestedDeliveryDate", "suggestedMeal");
        private final int status;
        private final String code;
        private final boolean retryable;
        private final Map<String,Object> context;
        public ApiException(int status, String code, String message) { this(status,code,message,false,Map.of()); }
        public ApiException(int status, String code, String message, boolean retryable, Map<String,Object> context) {
            super(message);
            if (!CONTEXT_KEYS.containsAll(context.keySet())) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported error context.");
            this.status=status; this.code=code; this.retryable=retryable; this.context=Map.copyOf(context);
        }
        public int status() { return status; }
        public String code() { return code; }
        public boolean retryable() { return retryable; }
        public Map<String,Object> context() { return context; }
        public static ApiException validation(String field, String message) {
            return new ApiException(400,"VALIDATION_ERROR","Please check the highlighted fields.",false,
                    Map.of("fieldErrors",List.of(Map.of("field",field,"message",message))));
        }
    }
