    package com.webox.shared;
    
    import java.util.Locale;
    import java.util.regex.Pattern;
    
    /** Shared scalar rules. No floating point is used for money. */
    public final class ValueRules {
        public static final long MAX_SAFE_INTEGER = 9007199254740991L;
        private static final Pattern EDGE_SPACE = Pattern.compile("^[\\x09-\\x0D\\x20\\u00A0\\u1680\\u2000-\\u200A\\u2028\\u2029\\u202F\\u205F\\u3000\\uFEFF]+|[\\x09-\\x0D\\x20\\u00A0\\u1680\\u2000-\\u200A\\u2028\\u2029\\u202F\\u205F\\u3000\\uFEFF]+$");
        private ValueRules() {}
        public static String uuid(String value) {
            if(value==null || !value.matches("[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid identifier.");
            return java.util.UUID.fromString(value).toString();
        }
        public static java.time.LocalDate date(String value) {
            if(value==null || !value.matches("[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid date.");
            try { return java.time.LocalDate.parse(value); }
            catch(java.time.format.DateTimeParseException e) { throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid date."); }
        }
        public static long safeInteger(long value) {
            if (value < 0 || value > MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Value must be a non-negative safe integer.");
            return value;
        }
        public static long add(long a, long b) {
            safeInteger(a); safeInteger(b);
            if (a > MAX_SAFE_INTEGER - b) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Total exceeds the supported amount.");
            return a + b;
        }
        public static long multiply(long a, long b) {
            safeInteger(a); safeInteger(b);
            if (b != 0 && a > MAX_SAFE_INTEGER / b) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Total exceeds the supported amount.");
            return a * b;
        }
        public static long nextVersion(long value) { return add(value, 1); }
        public static String money(long cents) {
            safeInteger(cents);
            return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%d.%02d", cents / 100, cents % 100);
        }
        public static String requiredText(String text, int max) {
            if (text == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("This field is required.");
            String normalized = EDGE_SPACE.matcher(text).replaceAll("");
            int length = codePoints(normalized);
            if (length == 0 || length > max) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Text must contain 1 to " + max + " characters.");
            return normalized;
        }
        public static String password(String text) {
            int length = codePoints(text);
            if (length < 8 || length > 128 || !Pattern.compile("[A-Za-z]").matcher(text).find() || !Pattern.compile("[0-9]").matcher(text).find())
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Password must contain 8 to 128 characters, including a letter and a number.");
            return text;
        }
        public static int codePoints(String text) {
            if (text == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("This field is required.");
            for (int i=0; i<text.length(); i++) {
                char c=text.charAt(i);
                if (Character.isHighSurrogate(c)) {
                    if (++i >= text.length() || !Character.isLowSurrogate(text.charAt(i))) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Text contains invalid Unicode.");
                } else if (Character.isLowSurrogate(c)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Text contains invalid Unicode.");
            }
            return text.codePointCount(0,text.length());
        }
    }
    package com.webox.auth;
    import java.sql.Timestamp;
    import java.time.Instant;
    import java.util.Optional;

    import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
    import org.springframework.jdbc.core.RowMapper;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;
    import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronizationManager;
    @Repository
    public class UserRepository {
        private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
        private static final RowMapper<UserRow> ROW=(rs,n)->new UserRow(rs.getString("id"),rs.getString("email"),rs.getString("normalized_email"),rs.getString("password_hash"),Role.valueOf(rs.getString("role")));
        public UserRepository(JdbcTemplate jdbc) { this.jdbc=jdbc; }
        public Optional<UserRow> byEmail(String normalized) { return jdbc.query("SELECT id,email,normalized_email,password_hash,role FROM users WHERE normalized_email=?",ROW,normalized).stream().findFirst(); }
        public Optional<UserRow> byId(String id) { return jdbc.query("SELECT id,email,normalized_email,password_hash,role FROM users WHERE id=?",ROW,id).stream().findFirst(); }
        public Optional<UserRow> lockOwner(String id) {
            if(!TransactionSynchronizationManager.isActualTransactionActive()) throw new IllegalStateException("Owner locking requires a transaction.");
            return jdbc.query("SELECT id,email,normalized_email,password_hash,role FROM users WHERE id=? FOR UPDATE",ROW,id).stream().findFirst();
        }
        public void insert(UserRow user,Instant now) {
            jdbc.update("INSERT INTO users(id,email,normalized_email,password_hash,role,created_at,updated_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",user.id(),user.email(),user.normalizedEmail(),user.passwordHash(),user.role().name(),Timestamp.from(now),Timestamp.from(now));
        }
        public record UserRow(String id,String email,String normalizedEmail,String passwordHash,Role role) {
            public UserIdentity identity() { return new UserIdentity(id,email,role); }
            @Override public String toString() { return "UserRow[redacted]"; }
        }
    }

    # Implementation Plan: WeBox 企业员工餐食订购平台
    
    **Branch**: `001-webox-meal-ordering`（setup-plan 返回的逻辑特性标识；当前目录无 Git 仓库，未创建实际分支） | **Date**: 2026-10-16 | **Spec**: [spec.md](spec.md)
    
    **Input**: `specs/001-webox-meal-ordering/spec.md` 及 [delivery-constraints.md](delivery-constraints.md)。用户已明确取消开发/交付时限，并要求全部可选功能实现。
    
    **Status**: T001–T028完成，进入US2菜单与购物车。账号、会话与基础能力已在真实MySQL和三浏览器矩阵验证；4项AC通过、77项未执行，其他故事与最终交付尚未完成。证据见 [US1记录](../../docs/validation/us1.md)。
    
    ## Summary
    
    完整交付员工选餐与订餐、Console 运营管理、准确实时库存、真实 AI 推荐和经营看板。全部 FR-001–047、SC-001–011 都是交付门槛，P1/P2/P3 仅决定实施先后。
    
    采用 React SPA + Java 17 / Spring Boot 4.1.1 模块化单体 + 独立 MySQL 8.4 LTS。订单与库存使用同库显式事务、唯一索引和稳定行锁保证正确性（写事务 READ COMMITTED，报价读取和报表使用只读 REPEATABLE READ 快照）；库存更新通过事务 outbox 与 SSE 发布。真实推荐通过 OpenRouter 调用配置模型（默认 openai/gpt-4.1-mini），在服务器过滤和验证后逐张输出可购买卡片。服务初期按单实例部署设计，不引入 Redis 或分布式事务。
    
    ## Technical Context
    
    **Language/Version**: Java 17；TypeScript 5.9.x；Node 24 LTS；SQL 使用 MySQL 8.4 LTS 语义。基线来源及替代方案见 [research.md](research.md)。

    package com.webox.inventory;
    import java.sql.Timestamp;
    import java.time.LocalDate;
    import java.util.Map;
    import java.util.UUID;
    import com.webox.shared.BusinessClock;
    import com.webox.shared.ValueRules;
    import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
    import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronizationManager;
    import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;
    /** Typed public payloads prevent accidental persistence of personal order data. */
    @Component
    public class OutboxWriter {
        private final JdbcTemplate jdbc; private final JsonMapper mapper; private final BusinessClock clock;
        public OutboxWriter(JdbcTemplate jdbc,JsonMapper mapper,BusinessClock clock) { this.jdbc=jdbc;this.mapper=mapper;this.clock=clock; }
        public void inventoryUpdated(LocalDate date,UUID dishId,long remaining,long version,long revision) {
            ValueRules.safeInteger(remaining); ValueRules.safeInteger(version); ValueRules.safeInteger(revision);
            if (remaining>Integer.MAX_VALUE) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Stock exceeds the supported limit.");
            write("inventory.updated",date+"/"+dishId,Map.of("deliveryDate",date.toString(),"dishId",dishId.toString(),"remaining",remaining,"version",version,"menuRevision",revision,"occurredAt",clock.now().toString()));
        }
        public void menuChanged(LocalDate date,long revision) {
            ValueRules.safeInteger(revision);
            write("menu.changed",date.toString(),Map.of("deliveryDate",date.toString(),"menuRevision",revision));
        }
        private void write(String type,String aggregate,Map<String,Object> payload) {
            if(!TransactionSynchronizationManager.isActualTransactionActive() || TransactionSynchronizationManager.isCurrentTransactionReadOnly())
                throw new IllegalStateException("Outbox writes require an active business write transaction.");
            Timestamp now=Timestamp.from(clock.now());
            jdbc.update("INSERT INTO outbox_events(id,event_type,aggregate_key,payload,created_at,next_attempt_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                UUID.randomUUID().toString(),type,aggregate,mapper.writeValueAsString(payload),now,now);
        }
    }

    | quote_id | 原报价 UUID，唯一；订单不依赖报价存在才能读取/重放，不配置删除订单的级联关系 |
    | idempotency_key | UUID 字符串；与 user_id 组成唯一键，与订单同生命周期保留 |
    | request_hash | SHA-256 固定长度摘要；规范化请求的稳定表示 |
    | delivery_date, meal | 从已确认且有效的报价复制，创建后不可改变 |
    | delivery_address_snapshot | VARCHAR(200)，trim 后非空，创建后不可改变 |
    | status | Pending / Confirmed / Completed / Cancelled |
    | active_slot | 生成列：Pending/Confirmed 为 1，其他状态为 NULL；不可由应用直接写入 |
    | total_quantity, total_cents | 1–5 份和安全整数分；等于全部条目合计，创建后不可改变 |
    | version | 非负整数，状态每次改变递增 |
    | created_at | UTC |
    | confirmed_at, completed_at, cancelled_at | 可空 UTC，分别在对应成功转换中设置；禁止互相矛盾的组合 |
    | updated_at | UTC |
    
    必须存在的唯一索引：
    
    - `(user_id,idempotency_key)`：同一结算意图只创建一次。
    - `quote_id`：同一个报价最多关联一个订单，不能换 key 绕过消费限制。
    - `(user_id,delivery_date,meal,active_slot)`：仅 Pending/Confirmed 占有效餐次名额；MySQL 允许多个 NULL，因此保留任意多笔 Cancelled/Completed 历史。
    
    查询索引：员工列表 `(user_id,created_at,id)`；管理员与看板 `(delivery_date,status,meal,id)`；近期推荐历史 `(user_id,delivery_date,status,id)`。避免将 status 放进所谓有效订单唯一键而允许 Pending 和 Confirmed 各存在一笔。
    
    ### order_items
    
    字段：`id` UUID 主键、`order_id` FK、`dish_id`（保留真实菜品身份）、`dish_name_snapshot`、`dish_version_snapshot`（API 的 dishVersion）、`configuration_key`、`options_snapshot`、`effective_allergens_snapshot`、`base_price_cents`、`unit_price_cents`、`quantity`、`subtotal_cents`。内容结构与报价条目一致，写入后不可修改；索引 `(order_id,id)` 和 `(dish_id,order_id)`。
    
    订单名称、选项名称、单价、金额和配送地址完全从快照展示，不能通过当前 dishes/options/addresses 的 JOIN 重新计算。dish_id 用于汇总销量与恢复供应；菜品只能下架，不能删除被历史引用的身份。order_items 的删除不向任何当前资源传播；订单不提供硬删除入口。
    
    ### 合法状态转换
    
    | 当前状态 | 动作与角色 | 结果 | 有效餐次名额 | 库存占用 |
    | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
    | 无订单 | Employee 提交有效报价 | Pending | 新增占位 | 增加原订单总份数 |
    | Pending | 本人或 Admin 取消 | Cancelled | 释放 | 减少原订单各菜品份数，恰好一次 |
    | Pending | Admin 确认 | Confirmed | 保持 | 不变 |
    | Confirmed | Admin 完成 | Completed | 释放 | 保持，不恢复 |
    | Cancelled | 本人或 Admin 重复取消 | Cancelled，成功返回当前结果 | 无变化 | 无变化 |
    | 其他组合 | 任意非法转换 | 冲突拒绝 | 无变化 | 无变化 |
    
    Completed/Cancelled 都是该订单的终态。Completed 不阻止在截止前使用新报价、新 key 重新下单；库存仍受限制。管理员操作先验证身份并锁 owner/order。目标与当前均为 Cancelled 时先于版本比较返回 200 当前订单，不写时间、版本、库存或事件；除此之外先校验 expectedVersion，旧版本返回 VERSION_CONFLICT。其余相同状态返回 INVALID_ORDER_TRANSITION；不能把 Completed 上的确认请求当作允许回退，也不允许跳过 Confirmed。
    
    ### 请求规范化与幂等重放
    
    创建请求只接受 `quoteId` 和 `addressId` / `addressText` 二选一，header 接受 UUID `Idempotency-Key`，不接受客户端声明的总价、用户 ID 或订单状态。
    
    canonical hash 包含协议版本、quoteId、地址选择方式，以及规范化 UUID addressId 或 trim 后 addressText。地址选择方式不同视为不同请求；同地址文本和已保存 addressId 不人为认定为同一请求。JSON 字段顺序、无意义首尾空格和 UUID 表示差异在规范化后稳定；不把当前价格、当前时间或会改变的数据库地址查阅结果放入 hash。
    
    同一 user/key 且 hash 相同返回同一订单及当前状态；hash 不同返回 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`。重放不再扣库存、存地址、消耗报价或写业务变更事件，即使报价过期、菜单改变、订单已取消或配送截止也一样。失败事务不保存成功 key；修改请求或重新确认报价应使用新的结算 key。
    
    ## 7. 事务顺序与并发规则
    
    ### 统一锁规则
    
    - 订单写路径：`user → quote（创建时）/order（变更时）→ dish（ID 升序）→ daily_supply（日期、dish ID 升序）`。创建持有 quote 后写入新 order；已有 order 的状态修改不锁其 quote，避免反向依赖。
    - 管理员菜单路径：`dish（ID 升序）→ daily_menus（日期升序）→ daily_supply（日期、dish ID 升序）`。只锁实际需要的行，不从 supply 反向补锁 dish 或日期元数据。
    - 菜品编辑：先锁 dish，子组/选项及过敏原随根记录修改；如需更新相关日期 revision，再按日期升序锁元数据。不得先锁 daily_menus 后再锁 dish。
    - 用户偏好或地址维护需要 user 时也必须先取 user；订单写路径不调用另一个会反向取锁的资料维护事务。
    - 稳定排序按存储中的规范化 UUID 比较。多行锁使用明确顺序的逐行/有序操作，不假定任意 IN 查询按输入顺序锁定。
    
    订单与运营写事务显式采用 READ COMMITTED，关键根记录和供应仍使用锁定读取及条件更新、唯一约束；这样不会在早先幂等普通查询建立旧快照后，将当前 dish version 与过时 options 混读。报价生成读取与看板聚合独立采用只读 REPEATABLE READ 一致性快照，不能通过改动全局隔离级别混淆两类目标。
    
    事务内不得调用 OpenRouter、写入上传大文件、等客户端确认或向慢 SSE 连接阻塞发送。死锁与锁超时有限次数重试整个事务；外层重试保留请求 key。任何业务失败、唯一冲突或持久化异常都回滚完整事务，不能留下部分占用。
    
    ### 创建订单
    
    1. 验证身份、CSRF、请求结构和长度，规范化请求并计算 hash；快速查询当前 user/key。找到后按 hash 重放或报冲突，先于任何报价/时间验证。
    2. 开启事务并锁当前 user 行；再次查询 user/key，处理两个请求在快速查询后并发进入的情况。
    3. 锁当前用户所属 quote。不存在/他人报价不泄露内容；已消费而 key 不匹配返回 `QUOTE_CONSUMED`。校验到期时间、份数与报价完整性。
    4. 查询当前 user/date/meal 的有效订单，存在则返回可打开该订单的冲突。锁所有相关 dish，锁对应 daily_supply；校验最新版本、选项、上架、scheduled 和报价快照。
    5. 在锁获取后再次以服务端 Clock 判断报价到期与订餐截止，避免等待锁越过边界仍成交。过期餐次返回建议日期/餐次，保留购物车，要求确认后重新报价。
    6. 按 dish 汇总不同配置的需求，检查所有供应行；条件更新 allocated，必须满足剩余量足够。任何一行不足则整单回滚，并返回具体菜品与可用数量供用户调整。
    7. 以报价与当前有效地址生成订单/条目快照，保存或复用新地址，写入 `consumed_order_id`；唯一约束兜底防止重复 key、重复 quote 和重复有效餐次。
    8. 同事务写 outbox，提交成功后返回订单。若提交结果不确定，客户端仍用原 key 解析结果；若唯一冲突，先回滚再用新事务优先查同 key，其次查消费报价/有效订单。
    
    库存、订单、地址、报价消费和 outbox 共享一个事务边界，不将扣库存拆成独立提交。锁定读取使用当前已提交行，不能在需要实时校验处依赖更早普通 SELECT 的快照。

    package com.webox.shared;
    import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
    import org.slf4j.Logger;
    import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
    import org.springframework.dao.DataAccessException;
    import org.springframework.dao.TransientDataAccessException;
    import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
    import org.springframework.http.converter.HttpMessageNotReadableException;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.MethodArgumentNotValidException;
    import org.springframework.web.method.annotation.MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException;
    import org.springframework.web.servlet.resource.NoResourceFoundException;
    import org.springframework.web.multipart.MaxUploadSizeExceededException;
    import org.springframework.web.HttpRequestMethodNotSupportedException;
    import org.springframework.web.HttpMediaTypeNotSupportedException;
    import java.util.Map;
    @RestControllerAdvice
    public class ApiExceptionHandler {
        private static final Logger LOG=LoggerFactory.getLogger(ApiExceptionHandler.class);
        @ExceptionHandler(ApiException.class)
        public ResponseEntity<Map<String,Object>> business(ApiException e,HttpServletRequest request) {
            return ResponseEntity.status(e.status()).header("Cache-Control","no-store").body(ApiErrors.body(request,e));
        }
        @ExceptionHandler({HttpMessageNotReadableException.class,MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException.class,IllegalArgumentException.class,HttpRequestMethodNotSupportedException.class,HttpMediaTypeNotSupportedException.class,org.springframework.web.bind.ServletRequestBindingException.class,org.springframework.web.method.annotation.HandlerMethodValidationException.class,jakarta.validation.ConstraintViolationException.class})
        public ResponseEntity<Map<String,Object>> invalid(Exception e,HttpServletRequest request) {
            return business(new ApiException(400,"VALIDATION_ERROR","The request contains invalid or unsupported fields."),request);
        }
        @ExceptionHandler(MethodArgumentNotValidException.class)
        public ResponseEntity<Map<String,Object>> fields(MethodArgumentNotValidException e,HttpServletRequest request) {
            var errors=e.getBindingResult().getFieldErrors().stream().map(error->Map.of("field",error.getField(),"message","This field is invalid or required.")).toList();
            return business(new ApiException(400,"VALIDATION_ERROR","Please check the highlighted fields.",false,Map.of("fieldErrors",errors)),request);
        }
        @ExceptionHandler(NoResourceFoundException.class)
        public ResponseEntity<Map<String,Object>> missing(Exception e,HttpServletRequest request) {
            return business(new ApiException(404,"NOT_FOUND","The requested resource was not found."),request);
        }
        @ExceptionHandler(MaxUploadSizeExceededException.class)
        public ResponseEntity<Map<String,Object>> upload(Exception e,HttpServletRequest request) {
            return business(new ApiException(413,"IMAGE_TOO_LARGE","The image exceeds the 5 MiB limit."),request);
        }
        @ExceptionHandler(TransientDataAccessException.class)
        public ResponseEntity<Map<String,Object>> temporary(Exception e,HttpServletRequest request) {
            LOG.warn("requestId={} code=TEMPORARY_UNAVAILABLE type={}",ApiErrors.requestId(request),e.getClass().getSimpleName());
            return business(new ApiException(503,"TEMPORARY_UNAVAILABLE","The service is temporarily unavailable. Please retry.",true,Map.of()),request);
        }
        @ExceptionHandler({DataAccessException.class,Exception.class})
        public ResponseEntity<Map<String,Object>> unexpected(Exception e,HttpServletRequest request) {
            // Exception messages and stacks can contain SQL parameters or private request content.
            LOG.error("requestId={} code=INTERNAL_ERROR type={}",ApiErrors.requestId(request),e.getClass().getSimpleName());
            return business(new ApiException(500,"INTERNAL_ERROR","Something went wrong. Please try again."),request);
        }
    }

    | --- | --- |
    | 400 VALIDATION_ERROR | 字段、长度、枚举、数量格式或必选配置无效；保持已填内容并就地提示 |
    | 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS / UNAUTHENTICATED | 登录错误或会话失效；前者明确英文反馈，后者进入登录 |
    | 403 FORBIDDEN / CSRF_INVALID | 权限不足或 token 不匹配；不可通过改客户端身份恢复权限 |
    | 404 NOT_FOUND | 不存在或无权查看的个人资源，不泄露 owner |
    | 409 EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED | 规范化邮箱已存在；改邮箱或登录 |
    | 422 INVALID_DELIVERY_DATE / ORDER_LIMIT_EXCEEDED | 过去日期或总份数超限；调整选择 |
    | 409 SLOT_EXPIRED | 附 suggestedDeliveryDate/suggestedMeal；明确切换并重新确认 |
    | 409 ACTIVE_ORDER_EXISTS | 附 existingOrderId；打开已有有效订单，不跳到更晚餐次绕过 |
    | 409 DISH_CHANGED / DISH_UNAVAILABLE | 附 itemIssues；展示变化并重新确认，不静默改价/替换 |
    | 409 INSUFFICIENT_STOCK | 附具体 dishId 与 availableQuantity；整单失败、保留购物车 |
    | 409 QUOTE_EXPIRED / QUOTE_CONSUMED | 重新报价；已成功的同 key 必须仍重放，不返回该错误 |
    | 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED | 同成功 key 不同内容；不自动覆盖或返回另一笔新单 |
    | 409 VERSION_CONFLICT | 运营/偏好资料被并发修改；重读最新内容再确认保存 |
    | 409 ORDER_NOT_CANCELLABLE / INVALID_ORDER_TRANSITION | 状态不允许，展示最新状态；不回退、不恢复不该恢复的库存 |
    | 409 SUPPLY_BELOW_ALLOCATED | 新总量低于现有占用；保留当前总量并提示限制 |
    | 413 IMAGE_TOO_LARGE / 415 IMAGE_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED / 422 IMAGE_INVALID | 文件大小、类型或真实解码失败；允许重新选图 |
    | 429 RATE_LIMITED / 503 TEMPORARY_UNAVAILABLE | 有界限流或锁等待/依赖暂不可用；遵循 Retry-After，重试写订单复用原 key |
    | 503 AI_BUSY / AI_UNAVAILABLE | 流建立前模型队列满或不可用；普通菜单继续可用 |
    
    流建立后的 AI 错误以 [streaming.md](streaming.md) 的 error 事件结束，不将 HTTP 200 误认为完成；INTENT_CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED 是产品内对用户诉求的反馈，不是本计划仍有未决需求。

    10:- **Decision**：Java 17、Spring Boot 4.1.1、Spring MVC、Spring Security、Spring JDBC、Spring Session JDBC、Flyway、MySQL 8.4 LTS / InnoDB。Maven Wrapper 使用 3.9 系列，Spring 依赖遵循 Boot BOM。首轮实施锁定其余依赖补丁与容器 digest，不使用动态 `latest`。
    11:- **Rationale**：用户指定 Java 17 + Spring Boot + 独立 MySQL。官方资料确认 Boot 4.1.1 支持 Java 17。约 200 员工的业务适合单体内的明确事务边界，显式 SQL 便于核查库存锁序与统计。
    18:- **Rationale**：SPA 与独立 Java 服务边界清晰；上述系列已有官方发布，Node 24 满足 Vite 的 Node 要求。Query 负责远端状态，reducer 负责最多 5 份的购物车，组件职责可独立验证。React、react-dom、react-is 锁定一致兼容版本。
    29:## R-04 下单幂等与有效餐次唯一性
    32:- **Rationale**：幂等表示同一意图不能重复，有效订单约束表示不同意图也不能占同一餐次。MySQL 唯一索引允许多个 NULL，取消与完成释放有效名额但保留历史记录。旧 key 与订单同生命周期保留，取消后仍返回原订单。
    33:- **Alternatives considered**：应用层先查后插不能处理竞态；按 status 建唯一索引会允许 Pending 与 Confirmed 同时存在；不另设需人工同步释放的订单占位表。用户行短锁序列化同人订单写入，并有数据库唯一约束兜底，无需独立幂等预留表。
    38:- **Decision**：每日菜品供应保留 total、allocated、version；remaining 为差值。按菜品汇总各配置需求，订单、条目快照、地址、库存及 outbox 在同一 MySQL 事务完成。统一采用 user → order/quote → dish（ID 排序）→ daily supply（日期/ID 排序）的适用锁序；任何地方不反向取锁。业务写事务使用 READ COMMITTED，权威字段锁定读取；报价读取和报表采用只读 REPEATABLE READ，避免当前根版本与旧子表快照混读。
    39:- **Rationale**：数量不为负、整单原子提交和取消恢复必须共享权威数据；全部配置与午晚餐共用每日供应。取消与确认竞争同一用户/订单锁，只有合法转换成功。Completed 释放有效餐次名额但仍占供应。
    40:- **Alternatives considered**：Redis 库存会增加双写和恢复复杂度；仅禁用按钮无法保证正确性。死锁/锁超时只做有限次完整事务重试，不能重放某条 SQL；失败事务先回滚，之后在新事务解析幂等/唯一冲突。
    45:- **Decision**：持久化短期 checkout quote（5 分钟），固定菜品、配置版本、数量、日期餐次和整数分金额；不预留库存。提交使用 quoteId + 地址 + Idempotency-Key。价格/选项变更或越过截止返回可恢复冲突，重新确认后创建新 quote 和新 key。成功的同 key 重放不依赖 quote 仍存在。
    89:- **Decision**：JUnit 与 Spring 测试、真实 MySQL Testcontainers、Vitest 5/Testing Library、Playwright、Gatling HTTP/SSE。使用注入的测试 Clock，而非生产调时入口。版本通过各工程锁定；Testcontainers 运行独立 MySQL 进程，不用 H2 代替。

    import java.util.Optional;
    import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;
    @Repository
    public class SupplyRepository {
        private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
        public SupplyRepository(JdbcTemplate jdbc) { this.jdbc=jdbc; }
        public long menuRevision(LocalDate date) { return jdbc.query("SELECT revision FROM daily_menus WHERE delivery_date=?",(rs,n)->rs.getLong(1),date).stream().findFirst().orElse(0L); }
        public Optional<Supply> find(LocalDate date,String dishId) {
            return jdbc.query("SELECT total_quantity,allocated_quantity,version,scheduled FROM daily_supply WHERE delivery_date=? AND dish_id=?",(rs,n)->new Supply(date,dishId,rs.getInt(1),rs.getInt(2),rs.getLong(3),rs.getBoolean(4)),date,dishId).stream().findFirst();
        }
        public record Supply(LocalDate date,String dishId,int total,int allocated,long version,boolean scheduled) { public int remaining() { return total-allocated; } }
    }

    class OrderTransactionIT extends OrderingTestSupport {
        @Test void twentyIdenticalRequestsCreateOneOrderAndOneInventoryEvent() throws Exception {
            var user=browser();var menu=menu();String quote=quote(user,menu,2),key=UUID.randomUUID().toString();var body=Map.of("quoteId",quote,"addressText","Office A");
            var responses=concurrent(20,i->postJson("/orders",user,body,key));assertEquals(1,responses.stream().filter(r->r.getStatus()==201).count());assertEquals(19,responses.stream().filter(r->r.getStatus()==200).count());
            assertEquals(1,responses.stream().map(r->field(r,"orderId")).distinct().count());
            assertEquals(1,jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE user_id=?",Integer.class,user.identity().user().userId()));
            assertEquals(2,jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT allocated_quantity FROM daily_supply WHERE delivery_date=? AND dish_id=?",Integer.class,menu.date(),menu.pasta()));
            assertEquals(1,jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outbox_events WHERE aggregate_key=?",Integer.class,menu.date()+"/"+menu.pasta()));
            error(postJson("/orders",user,Map.of("quoteId",quote,"addressText","Office B"),key),409,"IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED");
            error(postJson("/orders",user,body,UUID.randomUUID().toString()),409,"QUOTE_CONSUMED");
        }
        @Test void twentyPeopleCompeteForTenPortionsWithoutOverselling() throws Exception {
            var menu=menu();jdbc.update("UPDATE daily_supply SET total_quantity=10 WHERE delivery_date=? AND dish_id=?",menu.date(),menu.pasta());
            var people=new ArrayList<Browser>();var quotes=new ArrayList<String>();for(int i=0;i<20;i++) {var person=browser();people.add(person);quotes.add(quote(person,menu,1));}
            var responses=concurrent(20,i->postJson("/orders",people.get(i),Map.of("quoteId",quotes.get(i),"addressText","Office"),UUID.randomUUID().toString()));
            assertEquals(10,responses.stream().filter(r->r.getStatus()==201).count());for(var response:responses) if(response.getStatus()!=201) error(response,409,"INSUFFICIENT_STOCK");
            assertEquals(10,jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT allocated_quantity FROM daily_supply WHERE delivery_date=? AND dish_id=?",Integer.class,menu.date(),menu.pasta()));
            assertEquals(10,jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE delivery_date=?",Integer.class,menu.date()));
        }

            assertEquals(0,jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT SUM(allocated_quantity) FROM daily_supply WHERE delivery_date=?",Integer.class,menu.date()));
            assertEquals(0,jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE user_id=?",Integer.class,user.identity().user().userId()));assertEquals(0,json.readTree(read("/me/addresses",user).getContentAsString()).size());
            assertEquals(0,jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outbox_events WHERE aggregate_key LIKE ?",Integer.class,menu.date()+"/%"));
        }
        @FunctionalInterface interface Request { MockHttpServletResponse run(int index) throws Exception; }
        static List<MockHttpServletResponse> concurrent(int count,Request request) throws Exception {
            var pool=Executors.newFixedThreadPool(count);var ready=new CountDownLatch(count);var go=new CountDownLatch(1);var futures=new ArrayList<Future<MockHttpServletResponse>>();
            try {
                for(int i=0;i<count;i++) {final int index=i;futures.add(pool.submit(()->{ready.countDown();if(!go.await(10,TimeUnit.SECONDS)) throw new AssertionError("Barrier timed out");return request.run(index);}));}
                assertTrue(ready.await(10,TimeUnit.SECONDS));go.countDown();var results=new ArrayList<MockHttpServletResponse>();for(var future:futures) results.add(future.get(30,TimeUnit.SECONDS));return results;
            } finally { go.countDown();pool.shutdownNow(); }
        }
    }

    import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
    import org.springframework.session.jdbc.JdbcIndexedSessionRepository;
    import org.springframework.transaction.PlatformTransactionManager;
    import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.MockMvc;
    import org.springframework.mock.web.MockHttpServletResponse;
    import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;
    import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders.*;
    import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
    public abstract class OrderingTestSupport extends MySqlTestSupport {
        @Autowired protected MockMvc mvc;@Autowired protected JdbcTemplate jdbc;@Autowired protected JsonMapper json;
        @Autowired protected JdbcIndexedSessionRepository sessions;@Autowired protected AuthService auth;@Autowired protected MediaRepository media;@Autowired protected PlatformTransactionManager manager;
        public record Browser(FixtureFactory.IdentitySession identity,String csrf) {}
        protected Browser browser() throws Exception {
            var identity=new FixtureFactory(sessions,auth).identity(Role.Employee);
            var response=mvc.perform(get("/api/v1/auth/csrf").cookie(identity.cookie())).andReturn().getResponse();assertEquals(200,response.getStatus());
            return new Browser(identity,json.readTree(response.getContentAsString()).get("token").asString());
        }
        protected CatalogFixtures.Menu menu() { return new CatalogFixtures(jdbc,media,MEDIA_ROOT,sessions,auth,manager).create(); }
        protected MockHttpServletResponse postJson(String path,Browser user,Object body,String key) throws Exception {
            var request=post("/api/v1"+path).cookie(user.identity().cookie()).header("X-XSRF-TOKEN",user.csrf());
            if(body!=null) request.contentType("application/json").content(json.writeValueAsString(body));if(key!=null) request.header("Idempotency-Key",key);
            return mvc.perform(request).andReturn().getResponse();
        }
        protected MockHttpServletResponse read(String path,Browser user) throws Exception { return mvc.perform(get("/api/v1"+path).cookie(user.identity().cookie())).andReturn().getResponse(); }
        protected Map<String,Object> line(String dish,long version,int quantity,String... options) { return Map.of("dishId",dish,"dishVersion",version,"quantity",quantity,"optionIds",List.of(options)); }
        protected Map<String,Object> request(CatalogFixtures.Menu menu,int quantity) { return Map.of("deliveryDate",menu.date().toString(),"meal","Lunch","items",List.of(line(menu.pasta(),1,quantity,menu.options().get("Spaghetti"),menu.options().get("Cheese")))); }
        protected String quote(Browser user,CatalogFixtures.Menu menu,int quantity) throws Exception {
            var response=postJson("/checkout/quotes",user,request(menu,quantity),null);assertEquals(201,response.getStatus(),"Quote must be available");ContractAssertions.matches("Quote",response.getContentAsString());return field(response,"quoteId");
        }
        protected String field(MockHttpServletResponse response,String name) { return json.readTree(response.getContentAsString()).path(name).asString(); }
        protected void error(MockHttpServletResponse response,int status,String code) { assertEquals(status,response.getStatus());ContractAssertions.matches("Error",response.getContentAsString());assertEquals(code,field(response,"code")); }
    }

    package com.webox.ordering;
    import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
    import java.security.*;
    import java.util.HexFormat;
    import com.webox.shared.ValueRules;
    /** The stable request identity never depends on mutable address rows, quote expiry or prices. */
    public record IdempotencyRequest(String key,String quoteId,String addressId,String addressText,String hash) {
        public static IdempotencyRequest normalize(String key,OrderingModels.OrderCreate body) {
            if(body==null || (body.addressId()==null)==(body.addressText()==null)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Choose a saved address or enter a new address.");
            String quote=ValueRules.uuid(body.quoteId()),id=body.addressId()==null?null:ValueRules.uuid(body.addressId()),text=body.addressText()==null?null:ValueRules.requiredText(body.addressText(),200);
            // Length prefixes make the fields unambiguous even when an address contains delimiters.
            String address=id==null?text:id,kind=id==null?"text":"id";
            return new IdempotencyRequest(ValueRules.uuid(key),quote,id,text,digest("webox-order-v1|"+quote+"|"+kind+"|"+address.length()+":"+address));
        }
        public static String digest(String text) {
            try { return HexFormat.of().formatHex(MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(text.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))); }
            catch(NoSuchAlgorithmException e) { throw new IllegalStateException("SHA-256 is required",e); }
        }
        @Override public String toString() { return "IdempotencyRequest[redacted]"; }
    }

    package com.webox.ordering;
    import java.time.*;
    import java.util.Map;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
    import com.webox.shared.*;
    import com.webox.shared.DomainTypes.Meal;
    @Component
    public class OrderPolicy {
        private final BusinessClock clock;private final OrderRepository orders;
        public OrderPolicy(BusinessClock clock,OrderRepository orders) { this.clock=clock;this.orders=orders; }
        public void quantity(long total) { if(total<1 || total>5) throw new ApiException(422,"ORDER_LIMIT_EXCEEDED","An order must contain 1 to 5 portions."); }
        public void slot(LocalDate date,Meal meal) {
            if(date==null || meal==null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Select a delivery date and meal.");
            Instant now=clock.now();LocalDate today=now.atZone(BusinessClock.ZONE).toLocalDate();
            if(date.isBefore(today)) throw new ApiException(422,"INVALID_DELIVERY_DATE","Choose today or a future delivery date.");
            if(!now.isBefore(clock.cutoff(date,meal))) {
                boolean dinner=now.isBefore(clock.cutoff(today,Meal.Dinner));
                throw new ApiException(409,"SLOT_EXPIRED","This meal has closed. Confirm the suggested delivery date and meal before continuing.",false,Map.of("suggestedDeliveryDate",dinner?today:today.plusDays(1),"suggestedMeal",dinner?Meal.Dinner:Meal.Lunch));
            }
        }
        public void active(String user,LocalDate date,Meal meal) { orders.active(user,date,meal).ifPresent(id->{throw new ApiException(409,"ACTIVE_ORDER_EXISTS","You already have an active order for this meal.",false,Map.of("existingOrderId",id));}); }
        public void notExpired(Instant expires) { if(!clock.now().isBefore(expires)) throw new ApiException(409,"QUOTE_EXPIRED","This quote has expired. Review your cart and request a new quote."); }
    }

        public Quote create(String user,QuoteRequest request) {

                ValueRules.uuid(item.dishId());ValueRules.safeInteger(item.dishVersion());var ids=item.optionIds().stream().map(ValueRules::uuid).toList();if(new HashSet<>(ids).size()!=ids.size()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate option.");

                policy.slot(date,request.meal());policy.active(user,date,request.meal());var merged=new TreeMap<String,PricedLine>();var demand=new TreeMap<String,Integer>();var available=new HashMap<String,Integer>();
                for(var item:request.items()) {
                    String id=ValueRules.uuid(item.dishId());var member=menu.member(date,id).orElseThrow(()->itemError("DISH_UNAVAILABLE",id,"This dish is not available on the selected date.",Map.of()));
                    if(member.dishVersion()!=item.dishVersion()) throw itemError("DISH_CHANGED",id,"This dish has changed. Review its current price and options.",Map.of("currentDishVersion",member.dishVersion()));
                    var details=dishes.details(id,member.dishVersion());var choices=new TreeSet<>(item.optionIds().stream().map(ValueRules::uuid).toList());var remaining=new HashSet<>(choices);var selected=new ArrayList<OptionSnapshot>();var allergens=new TreeSet<Allergen>(Comparator.comparing(Enum::name));allergens.addAll(details.allergens());long price=details.basePriceCents();
                    for(var group:details.optionGroups()) {

    package com.webox.inventory;
    import java.time.LocalDate;
    import java.util.*;
    import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
    import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronizationManager;
    import com.webox.shared.*;
    import com.webox.ordering.QuoteService;
    import com.webox.ordering.OrderingModels.PricedLine;
    @Service
    public class InventoryMutationService {
        private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;private final SupplyRepository supply;private final OutboxWriter outbox;private final BusinessClock clock;
        public InventoryMutationService(JdbcTemplate jdbc,SupplyRepository supply,OutboxWriter outbox,BusinessClock clock) { this.jdbc=jdbc;this.supply=supply;this.outbox=outbox;this.clock=clock; }
        public record Dish(String id,long version,boolean listed) {}
        public record Locked(LocalDate date,SortedMap<String,Integer> demand,Map<String,Dish> dishes,Map<String,SupplyRepository.Supply> supplies) {}
        public Locked lock(LocalDate date,List<PricedLine> items) {
            if(!TransactionSynchronizationManager.isActualTransactionActive() || TransactionSynchronizationManager.isCurrentTransactionReadOnly()) throw new IllegalStateException("Inventory requires a business write transaction.");
            var demand=new TreeMap<String,Integer>();for(var item:items) demand.merge(item.dishId(),item.quantity(),Math::addExact);
            var roots=new HashMap<String,Dish>();var rows=new HashMap<String,SupplyRepository.Supply>();
            // Complete every root lock before taking any supply lock; never rely on IN-list order.
            for(String id:demand.keySet()) roots.put(id,jdbc.query("SELECT id,version,is_listed FROM dishes WHERE id=? FOR UPDATE",(rs,n)->new Dish(rs.getString(1),rs.getLong(2),rs.getBoolean(3)),id).stream().findFirst().orElseThrow(()->QuoteService.itemError("DISH_UNAVAILABLE",id,"This dish is no longer available.",Map.of())));
            for(String id:demand.keySet()) rows.put(id,jdbc.query("SELECT total_quantity,allocated_quantity,version,scheduled FROM daily_supply WHERE delivery_date=? AND dish_id=? FOR UPDATE",(rs,n)->new SupplyRepository.Supply(date,id,rs.getInt(1),rs.getInt(2),rs.getLong(3),rs.getBoolean(4)),date,id).stream().findFirst().orElseThrow(()->QuoteService.itemError("DISH_UNAVAILABLE",id,"This dish is not scheduled for the selected date.",Map.of())));
            return new Locked(date,Collections.unmodifiableSortedMap(demand),Map.copyOf(roots),Map.copyOf(rows));
        }
        public void validateForPurchase(Locked locked,List<PricedLine> items) {
            for(var item:items) {
                var dish=locked.dishes().get(item.dishId());var row=locked.supplies().get(item.dishId());
                if(!dish.listed() || !row.scheduled()) throw QuoteService.itemError("DISH_UNAVAILABLE",dish.id(),"This dish is no longer available on the selected date.",Map.of());
                if(dish.version()!=item.dishVersion()) throw QuoteService.itemError("DISH_CHANGED",dish.id(),"This dish has changed. Confirm a new quote before ordering.",Map.of("currentDishVersion",dish.version()));
            }
        }
        public void allocate(Locked locked) { mutate(locked,false); }
        public void restore(Locked locked) { mutate(locked,true); }
        private void mutate(Locked locked,boolean restore) {
            for(var entry:locked.demand().entrySet()) {
                var row=locked.supplies().get(entry.getKey());int quantity=entry.getValue();
                if(!restore && row.remaining()<quantity) throw QuoteService.itemError("INSUFFICIENT_STOCK",row.dishId(),"This dish no longer has enough stock. Please adjust your cart.",Map.of("availableQuantity",row.remaining()));
                if(restore && row.allocated()<quantity) throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot restore more than the allocated stock.");
                int allocated=restore?row.allocated()-quantity:Math.addExact(row.allocated(),quantity);long version=ValueRules.nextVersion(row.version());
                int count=jdbc.update("UPDATE daily_supply SET allocated_quantity=?,version=?,updated_at=? WHERE delivery_date=? AND dish_id=? AND version=? AND total_quantity>=?",allocated,version,java.sql.Timestamp.from(clock.now()),row.date(),row.dishId(),row.version(),allocated);
                if(count!=1) throw new IllegalStateException("Locked inventory changed unexpectedly.");
                outbox.inventoryUpdated(row.date(),UUID.fromString(row.dishId()),row.total()-allocated,version,supply.menuRevision(row.date()));
            }
        }
    }

    public class OrderStatusService {
        private final UserRepository users;private final OrderRepository orders;private final OrderItemRepository items;private final InventoryMutationService inventory;private final OrderTransactionExecutor transactions;private final BusinessClock clock;
        public OrderStatusService(UserRepository users,OrderRepository orders,OrderItemRepository items,InventoryMutationService inventory,OrderTransactionExecutor transactions,BusinessClock clock) {this.users=users;this.orders=orders;this.items=items;this.inventory=inventory;this.transactions=transactions;this.clock=clock;}
        public Order cancel(String user,String id) { return change(user,id,OrderStatus.Cancelled,null,false); }
        public Order administer(UserIdentity actor,String id,OrderStatus target,long expectedVersion) {
            if(actor.role()!=Role.Admin) throw new ApiException(403,"FORBIDDEN","Administrator access is required.");ValueRules.safeInteger(expectedVersion);return change(actor.userId(),id,target,expectedVersion,true);
        }
        private Order change(String actor,String id,OrderStatus target,Long version,boolean administrator) {
            var located=orders.find(id).orElseThrow(OrderRepository::missing);String owner=located.userId();if(!administrator && !owner.equals(actor)) throw OrderRepository.missing();
            return transactions.execute(()->{
                users.lockOwner(owner).orElseThrow(OrderRepository::missing);var order=orders.lock(id,owner);
                if(order.status()==OrderStatus.Cancelled && target==OrderStatus.Cancelled) return orders.view(order);
                if(administrator && order.version()!=version) throw new ApiException(409,"VERSION_CONFLICT","This order has changed. Reload its current status.");
                boolean allowed=order.status()==OrderStatus.Pending && (target==OrderStatus.Confirmed || target==OrderStatus.Cancelled) || order.status()==OrderStatus.Confirmed && target==OrderStatus.Completed;
                if(!allowed) throw new ApiException(409,administrator?"INVALID_ORDER_TRANSITION":"ORDER_NOT_CANCELLABLE",administrator?"This order status change is not allowed.":"Only a pending order can be cancelled.");
                if(target==OrderStatus.Cancelled) inventory.restore(inventory.lock(order.date(),items.list(order.id())));
                orders.transition(order,target,clock.now());return orders.owned(id,owner);
            },null);
        }
    }

    package com.webox.ordering;
    import java.util.Map;
    import java.util.function.Supplier;
    import org.springframework.dao.*;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
    import org.springframework.transaction.*;
    import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionTemplate;
    import com.webox.shared.ApiException;
    @Component
    public class OrderTransactionExecutor {
        private final TransactionTemplate transaction;
        public OrderTransactionExecutor(PlatformTransactionManager manager) {
            transaction=new TransactionTemplate(manager);transaction.setIsolationLevel(TransactionDefinition.ISOLATION_READ_COMMITTED);transaction.setPropagationBehavior(TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW);
        }
        public <T> T execute(Supplier<T> operation,Supplier<T> uniqueConflict) {
            for(int attempt=0;attempt<3;attempt++) {
                try { return transaction.execute(status->operation.get()); }
                catch(DuplicateKeyException conflict) {
                    // TransactionTemplate has fully rolled back before conflict resolution starts.
                    if(uniqueConflict==null) throw conflict;return transaction.execute(status->uniqueConflict.get());
                } catch(PessimisticLockingFailureException conflict) {
                    if(attempt==2) throw unavailable();java.util.concurrent.locks.LockSupport.parkNanos((attempt+1)*10_000_000L);
                }
            }
            throw unavailable();
        }
        public static ApiException unavailable() { return new ApiException(503,"TEMPORARY_UNAVAILABLE","The order could not be completed yet. Retry with the same request.",true,Map.of()); }
    }

    import java.util.*;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

    import com.webox.inventory.InventoryMutationService;
    import com.webox.shared.*;
    import static com.webox.ordering.OrderingModels.*;
    @Service
    public class PlaceOrderService {
        private final UserRepository users;private final QuoteRepository quotes;private final OrderRepository orders;private final OrderItemRepository items;private final AddressRepository addresses;private final OrderPolicy policy;private final InventoryMutationService inventory;private final OrderTransactionExecutor transactions;private final BusinessClock clock;
        public PlaceOrderService(UserRepository users,QuoteRepository quotes,OrderRepository orders,OrderItemRepository items,AddressRepository addresses,OrderPolicy policy,InventoryMutationService inventory,OrderTransactionExecutor transactions,BusinessClock clock) { this.users=users;this.quotes=quotes;this.orders=orders;this.items=items;this.addresses=addresses;this.policy=policy;this.inventory=inventory;this.transactions=transactions;this.clock=clock; }
        public record Result(Order order,boolean replayed) {}
        public Result create(String user,String key,OrderCreate body) {
            var request=IdempotencyRequest.normalize(key,body);var existing=orders.byKey(user,request.key());if(existing.isPresent()) return replay(existing.get(),request);
            return transactions.execute(()->createLocked(user,request),()->resolveConflict(user,request));
        }
        private Result replay(OrderRepository.Row row,IdempotencyRequest request) {
            if(!row.hash().equals(request.hash())) throw new ApiException(409,"IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED","This request key belongs to a different order request.");return new Result(orders.view(row),true);
        }
        private Result createLocked(String user,IdempotencyRequest request) {
            users.lockOwner(user).orElseThrow(OrderRepository::missing);
            var existing=orders.byKey(user,request.key());if(existing.isPresent()) return replay(existing.get(),request);
            // Also catches a consumed quote whose expired quote row has since been cleaned up.
            if(orders.byQuote(user,request.quoteId()).isPresent()) throw consumed();
            var quote=quotes.lockOwned(request.quoteId(),user).orElseThrow(()->new ApiException(404,"NOT_FOUND","This quote was not found."));
            if(quote.consumedOrderId()!=null) throw consumed();policy.notExpired(quote.expiresAt());policy.quantity(quote.quantity());policy.active(user,quote.date(),quote.meal());
            var lines=quotes.items(quote.id());long total=0;int quantity=0;for(var line:lines) {total=ValueRules.add(total,line.subtotalCents());quantity+=line.quantity();}
            if(lines.isEmpty() || total!=quote.total() || quantity!=quote.quantity()) throw new IllegalStateException("Quote totals are inconsistent.");
            var locked=inventory.lock(quote.date(),lines);inventory.validateForPurchase(locked,lines);
            // Both checks happen after all potentially blocking row locks.
            policy.notExpired(quote.expiresAt());policy.slot(quote.date(),quote.meal());
            String address=request.addressId()==null?request.addressText():addresses.resolve(user,request.addressId());
            inventory.allocate(locked);var now=clock.now();var row=orders.insert(user,request,quote,address,now);
            items.insert(row.id(),lines);addresses.use(user,address,now);quotes.consume(quote.id(),row.id());return new Result(orders.view(row),false);
        }
        private Result resolveConflict(String user,IdempotencyRequest request) {
            var existing=orders.byKey(user,request.key());if(existing.isPresent()) return replay(existing.get(),request);
            if(orders.byQuote(user,request.quoteId()).isPresent()) throw consumed();
            var quote=quotes.lockOwned(request.quoteId(),user);if(quote.isPresent()) {if(quote.get().consumedOrderId()!=null) throw consumed();policy.active(user,quote.get().date(),quote.get().meal());}
            throw OrderTransactionExecutor.unavailable();
        }
        private static ApiException consumed() { return new ApiException(409,"QUOTE_CONSUMED","This quote has already been used. Review your existing order or request a new quote."); }
    }

    import { useState } from 'react';
    import { Link } from 'react-router';
    import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    import { api } from '../../shared/api/client';
    import type { OrderPage, OrderStatus } from '../../shared/api/types';
    import { money } from '../../shared/values';
    import { ErrorNotice, Loading } from '../../shared/ui/Status';
    import { useSession } from '../auth/session';
    export function OrdersPage() {
      const { user } = useSession();const [page, setPage] = useState(0), [status, setStatus] = useState<OrderStatus | ''>('');
      const params = new URLSearchParams({ page: String(page), size: '24' });if (status) params.set('status', status);
      const orders = useQuery({ queryKey: ['orders', user!.userId, params.toString()], queryFn: ({ signal }) => api<OrderPage>(`/orders?${params}`, { signal }) });
      return <section><div className="page-heading"><div><p className="eyebrow">YOUR WORKDAY TABLE</p><h1>Your orders</h1><p>Your meals, delivery details and current order status.</p></div><Link to="/menu">Browse menu</Link></div><div className="field order-filter"><label htmlFor="order-status">Order status</label><select id="order-status" value={status} onChange={event => { setStatus(event.target.value as OrderStatus | '');setPage(0); }}><option value="">All orders</option>{['Pending', 'Confirmed', 'Completed', 'Cancelled'].map(value => <option key={value}>{value}</option>)}</select></div>
        {orders.isPending && <Loading>Loading your orders…</Loading>}{orders.isError && <ErrorNotice message="Your orders could not be loaded." retry={() => { void orders.refetch(); }} />}
        {orders.data && <>{!orders.data.items.length && <div className="panel empty-state"><h2>No orders found</h2><p>Try another status or explore the menu for your next meal.</p></div>}<div className="order-list">{orders.data.items.map(order => <article className="panel order-card" key={order.orderId}><div className="order-card-heading"><h2>{order.deliveryDate} · {order.meal}</h2><span className={`order-status status-${order.status.toLowerCase()}`}>{order.status}</span></div><p className="order-number">{order.orderNumber}</p><p>{order.items.map(item => `${item.quantity} × ${item.dishName}`).join(' · ')}</p><p>{order.addressText}</p><div className="order-card-heading"><strong>¥{money(order.totalCents)}</strong><Link to={`/orders/${order.orderId}`}>View order</Link></div></article>)}</div>{orders.data.totalElements > 24 && <nav className="pagination" aria-label="Order pages"><button type="button" disabled={page === 0} onClick={() => setPage(value => value - 1)}>Previous</button><span>Page {page + 1} of {Math.ceil(orders.data.totalElements / 24)}</span><button type="button" disabled={(page + 1) * 24 >= orders.data.totalElements} onClick={() => setPage(value => value + 1)}>Next</button></nav>}</>}
      </section>;
    }

    package com.webox.shared;
    import java.io.*;
    import java.time.Clock;
    import jakarta.servlet.*;
    import jakarta.servlet.http.*;
    import org.springframework.boot.web.servlet.FilterRegistrationBean;
    import org.springframework.boot.jackson.autoconfigure.JsonFactoryBuilderCustomizer;
    import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
    import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
    import org.springframework.core.Ordered;
    import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter;
    import tools.jackson.core.StreamReadConstraints;
    import tools.jackson.core.StreamReadFeature;
    import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;
    @Configuration(proxyBeanMethods=false)
    public class WebConfiguration {
        public static final int MAX_JSON_BYTES=1_048_576;
        @Bean org.springframework.boot.jackson.autoconfigure.JsonMapperBuilderCustomizer strictEnums() {
            return builder -> builder.enable(tools.jackson.databind.cfg.EnumFeature.FAIL_ON_NUMBERS_FOR_ENUMS)
                .withCoercionConfig(tools.jackson.databind.type.LogicalType.Textual, config -> {
                    for (var shape : new tools.jackson.databind.cfg.CoercionInputShape[]{tools.jackson.databind.cfg.CoercionInputShape.Integer, tools.jackson.databind.cfg.CoercionInputShape.Float, tools.jackson.databind.cfg.CoercionInputShape.Boolean})
                        config.setCoercion(shape, tools.jackson.databind.cfg.CoercionAction.Fail);
                });
        }
        @Bean java.nio.file.Path mediaRoot(@org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value("${webox.media-root}") String configured) throws IOException {
            var directory = java.nio.file.Path.of(configured).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
            java.nio.file.Files.createDirectories(directory);
            if (!java.nio.file.Files.isWritable(directory)) throw new IllegalStateException("The media directory is not writable.");
            return directory;
        }
        @Bean Clock applicationClock() { return Clock.systemUTC(); }
        @Bean JsonFactoryBuilderCustomizer jsonLimits() {
            return builder -> builder.streamReadConstraints(StreamReadConstraints.builder().maxNestingDepth(40).maxStringLength(MAX_JSON_BYTES).maxNumberLength(32).build())
                    .enable(StreamReadFeature.STRICT_DUPLICATE_DETECTION);
        }
        @Bean FilterRegistrationBean<OncePerRequestFilter> requestBoundary(JsonMapper mapper) {
            var filter=new OncePerRequestFilter() {
                @Override protected void doFilterInternal(HttpServletRequest request,HttpServletResponse response,FilterChain chain) throws IOException,ServletException {
                    response.setHeader("X-Request-Id",ApiErrors.requestId(request));
                    if(request.getRequestURI().startsWith("/api/")) response.setHeader("Cache-Control","no-store");
                    if(request.getContentType()!=null && (request.getContentType().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT).startsWith("application/json") || request.getContentType().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT).split(";",2)[0].endsWith("+json"))) {
                        if(request.getContentLengthLong()>MAX_JSON_BYTES) { tooLarge(mapper,request,response); return; }
                        byte[] bytes=request.getInputStream().readNBytes(MAX_JSON_BYTES+1);
                        if(bytes.length>MAX_JSON_BYTES) { tooLarge(mapper,request,response); return; }
                        var wrapped=new HttpServletRequestWrapper(request) {
                            @Override public ServletInputStream getInputStream() {
                                var input=new ByteArrayInputStream(bytes);
                                return new ServletInputStream() {
                                    @Override public int read() { return input.read(); }
                                    @Override public int read(byte[] b,int o,int l) { return input.read(b,o,l); }
                                    @Override public boolean isFinished() { return input.available()==0; }
                                    @Override public boolean isReady() { return true; }
                                    @Override public void setReadListener(ReadListener listener) {
                                        try { if(!isFinished()) listener.onDataAvailable(); if(isFinished()) listener.onAllDataRead(); }
                                        catch(IOException e) { listener.onError(e); }
                                    }
                                };
                            }

                        chain.doFilter(wrapped,response); return;
                    }
                    chain.doFilter(request,response);
                }
            };
            var bean=new FilterRegistrationBean<OncePerRequestFilter>(filter);
            bean.setOrder(Ordered.HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE+20); bean.setAsyncSupported(true); return bean;
        }
        private static void tooLarge(JsonMapper mapper,HttpServletRequest req,HttpServletResponse res) throws IOException {
            ApiErrors.write(mapper,req,res,new ApiException(400,"VALIDATION_ERROR","The JSON request is too large."));

        @Test void twentyRealOrdersPreserveAllIntegerAmountsAndCanBeReachedThroughPagination() throws Exception {
            var user=browser();var menu=menu();var ids=new HashSet<String>();long verifiedCents=0;
            for(int i=0;i<20;i++) {
                boolean burger=i%2==0,extra=i%3!=0;int quantity=i%5+1;var selected=new ArrayList<String>();long unit;
                if(burger) {selected.add(menu.options().get(i%4==0?"Brioche bun":"Plain bun"));selected.add(menu.options().get("Ketchup"));if(extra)selected.add(menu.options().get("Extra cheese"));unit=3200+(i%4==0?200:0)+(extra?300:0);}
                else {selected.add(menu.options().get(i%3==0?"Fusilli":"Spaghetti"));if(extra)selected.add(menu.options().get("Cheese"));unit=2650+(extra?300:0);}
                String dish=burger?menu.burger():menu.pasta();var body=Map.of("deliveryDate",menu.date().toString(),"meal","Lunch","items",List.of(line(dish,1,quantity,selected.toArray(String[]::new))));
                var quote=postJson("/checkout/quotes",user,body,null);assertEquals(201,quote.getStatus());assertEquals(unit*quantity,json.readTree(quote.getContentAsString()).get("totalCents").asLong());
                var order=postJson("/orders",user,Map.of("quoteId",field(quote,"quoteId"),"addressText","Office"),UUID.randomUUID().toString());assertEquals(201,order.getStatus());ContractAssertions.matches("Order",order.getContentAsString());String id=field(order,"orderId");ids.add(id);
                assertEquals(unit*quantity,json.readTree(order.getContentAsString()).get("totalCents").asLong());assertEquals(unit*quantity,jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT SUM(subtotal_cents) FROM order_items WHERE order_id=?",Long.class,id));verifiedCents+=unit*quantity;
                if(i<19) assertEquals(200,postJson("/orders/"+id+"/cancel",user,null,null).getStatus());
            }
            var listed=new HashSet<String>();for(int page=0;page<3;page++) {var response=read("/orders?size=7&page="+page,user);assertEquals(200,response.getStatus());ContractAssertions.matches("OrderPage",response.getContentAsString());var jsonPage=json.readTree(response.getContentAsString());assertEquals(20,jsonPage.get("totalElements").asInt());jsonPage.get("items").forEach(item->listed.add(item.get("orderId").asString()));}
            assertEquals(ids,listed);assertEquals(verifiedCents,jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT SUM(total_cents) FROM orders WHERE user_id=?",Long.class,user.identity().user().userId()));assertEquals(19,json.readTree(read("/orders?status=Cancelled",user).getContentAsString()).get("totalElements").asInt());
        }

        日期：2026-10-16。T045–T061完成，T062最终浏览器回归进行中。执行者：Codex。使用真实MySQL8.4.11隔离容器、JDK17、Spring Boot4.1.1及三浏览器×三视口，沿用[环境记录](environment.md)。
        
        ## 实现
        
        V007–V010创建地址、五分钟报价、订单和不可变条目快照。地址按用户/原文二进制唯一，只有订单成功事务才保存或更新最近使用时间。订单保留原quote UUID，但不依赖quote行存活；成功key与订单同生命周期，取消、完成或清理旧quote后仍能重放。
        
        报价先在只读REPEATABLE READ中校验日期、配置、版本与真实库存，按菜品/规范化配置归并，算基础及所选选项过敏原并集与整数分价格，再短事务保存。报价不占库存。
        
        订单写事务使用READ COMMITTED，按user→quote→升序dish→升序supply锁定，锁后再次判断到期及截单。订单、条目、地址、库存、quote消费和outbox原子提交；条件更新和唯一约束兜底。成功key/hash优先于报价、地址和时段检查；唯一冲突完整回滚后在新事务解析。锁失败最多重试整个事务三次，仍失败返回503可重试，保留原key。
        
        Pending可取消一次，重复取消不变更时间/版本/库存/事件。Confirmed→Completed保留库存占用但释放有效餐次；管理员状态服务已实现并用真实数据库验证，管理员HTTP与界面仍属US6。
        
        前端完成日期/餐次、历史或新地址、服务端报价、过期与改价恢复、订单历史分页/过滤/详情、取消。冻结提交保存在当前账号的内存上下文，不写localStorage；网络结果未知时只能复用原key/payload，跨页面仍保留。短暂会话检查失败隐藏操作但不丢掉冻结请求；只有成功响应才按配置扣除本次份数，保留等待期间新增的份数。用户原文以React文本节点显示。

            var user=browser();var menu=menu();
            for(String boundary:List.of("09:59:59","10:00:00","14:59:59","15:00:00","23:59:59")) {
                TEST_CLOCK.set(menu.date().atTime(LocalTime.parse(boundary)).atZone(ZoneId.of("Asia/Shanghai")).toInstant());
                for(String meal:List.of("Lunch","Dinner")) {
                    var request=new HashMap<String,Object>(request(menu,1));request.put("meal",meal);var result=postJson("/checkout/quotes",user,request,null);
                    boolean closed=LocalTime.parse(boundary).compareTo(LocalTime.of(meal.equals("Lunch")?10:15,0))>=0;
                    if(!closed) {assertEquals(201,result.getStatus());assertEquals(menu.date().toString(),field(result,"deliveryDate"));assertEquals(meal,field(result,"meal"));}
                    else {error(result,409,"SLOT_EXPIRED");boolean dinner=boundary.compareTo("15:00:00")<0;assertEquals(dinner?menu.date().toString():menu.date().plusDays(1).toString(),field(result,"suggestedDeliveryDate"));assertEquals(dinner?"Dinner":"Lunch",field(result,"suggestedMeal"));}

    export function purchaseAvailability(state: CartState, dish: MenuDish): { canAdd: boolean; reason: string | null } {
      let reason: string | null = null;
      const quantity = state.lines.reduce((sum, line) => sum + line.quantity, 0);
      const sameDish = state.lines.filter(line => line.dish.dishId === dish.dishId), count = sameDish.reduce((sum, line) => sum + line.quantity, 0);
      if (quantity >= 5) reason = 'You can add up to 5 portions per order.';
      else if (sameDish.some(line => line.issue || line.dish.dishVersion !== dish.dishVersion)) reason = 'Review the changed item in your cart before adding more.';
      else if (dish.remaining === 0) reason = 'Sold Out. Choose another dish.';
      else if (count >= dish.remaining) reason = `Only ${dish.remaining} portions are available for this dish.`;
      return { canAdd: reason === null, reason };
    }

    export function DeliverySelection({ date, meal, locked, onChange, onReady }: { date: string; meal: Meal; locked: boolean; onChange: (slot: Slot) => void; onReady: (ready: boolean) => void }) {
      const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null), [confirmation, setConfirmation] = useState(false), [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null), [, tick] = useState(0);
      const time = useQuery({ queryKey: ['business-clock', date], enabled: !locked, queryFn: async ({ signal }) => {
        const response = await api<MenuPage>(`/menus/${date}?size=1`, { signal });return { serverTime: Date.parse(response.serverTime), receivedAt: performance.now() };
      } });
      useEffect(() => { const timer = setInterval(() => tick(value => value + 1), 1000);return () => clearInterval(timer); }, []);

    import { Link } from 'react-router';
    import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    import { api } from '../../shared/api/client';
    import type { Meal, OrderPage } from '../../shared/api/types';
    import { useSession } from '../auth/session';
    import { ErrorNotice, Loading } from '../../shared/ui/Status';
    export function ExistingOrderAction({ date, meal, locked, onFound, onReady }: { date: string; meal: Meal; locked: boolean; onFound: (id: string | null) => void; onReady: (ready: boolean) => void }) {
      const { user } = useSession();
      const query = useQuery({ queryKey: ['active-order', user!.userId, date, meal], enabled: !locked, queryFn: async ({ signal }) => {
        for (const status of ['Pending', 'Confirmed']) {
          for (let page = 0; ; page++) {
            const result = await api<OrderPage>(`/orders?status=${status}&size=100&page=${page}`, { signal });
            const match = result.items.find(order => order.deliveryDate === date && order.meal === meal);if (match) return match.orderId;
            if ((page + 1) * 100 >= result.totalElements) break;
          }
        }
        return null;
      } });
      useEffect(() => { onFound(query.data ?? null);onReady(locked || (!query.isPending && !query.isError)); }, [query.data, query.isPending, query.isError, locked, onFound, onReady]);
      if (locked) return null;
      if (query.isPending) return <Loading>Checking for an existing order…</Loading>;
      if (query.isError) return <ErrorNotice message="Existing orders could not be checked." retry={() => { void query.refetch(); }} />;
      return query.data ? <div className="notice"><p>You already have an active order for this delivery date and meal.</p><Link className="button" to={`/orders/${query.data}`}>View Existing Order</Link></div> : null;
    }

    +  const slot: Slot = hour < 15 ? { date: today, meal: 'Dinner' } : { date: tomorrow, meal: 'Lunch' };
    +  return { slot, changed: true, error: null, notice: `${current.meal} has closed. We selected ${slot.meal} on ${slot.date}. Confirm the new delivery selection before reviewing your order.` };

    import java.time.*;
    import java.util.*;

    @Service
    public class QuoteService {
        private final MenuQueryRepository menu;private final DishRepository dishes;private final QuoteRepository quotes;private final OrderPolicy policy;private final BusinessClock clock;
        private final TransactionTemplate read,write;
        public QuoteService(MenuQueryRepository menu,DishRepository dishes,QuoteRepository quotes,OrderPolicy policy,BusinessClock clock,PlatformTransactionManager manager) {
            this.menu=menu;this.dishes=dishes;this.quotes=quotes;this.policy=policy;this.clock=clock;
            read=new TransactionTemplate(manager);read.setReadOnly(true);read.setIsolationLevel(TransactionDefinition.ISOLATION_REPEATABLE_READ);
            write=new TransactionTemplate(manager);write.setIsolationLevel(TransactionDefinition.ISOLATION_READ_COMMITTED);
        }
        public Quote create(String user,QuoteRequest request) {
            if(request==null || request.items()==null || request.items().isEmpty() || request.items().size()>5 || request.meal()==null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Choose 1 to 5 cart lines and a meal.");
            LocalDate date=ValueRules.date(request.deliveryDate());
            for(var item:request.items()) {
                if(item==null || item.dishVersion()==null || item.quantity()==null || item.quantity()<1 || item.quantity()>5 || item.optionIds()==null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid cart line.");
                ValueRules.uuid(item.dishId());ValueRules.safeInteger(item.dishVersion());var ids=item.optionIds().stream().map(ValueRules::uuid).toList();if(new HashSet<>(ids).size()!=ids.size()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate option.");
            }
            int count=request.items().stream().mapToInt(CartItem::quantity).sum();policy.quantity(count);
            var priced=read.execute(status->{
                policy.slot(date,request.meal());policy.active(user,date,request.meal());var merged=new TreeMap<String,PricedLine>();var demand=new TreeMap<String,Integer>();var available=new HashMap<String,Integer>();
                for(var item:request.items()) {
                    String id=ValueRules.uuid(item.dishId());var member=menu.member(date,id).orElseThrow(()->itemError("DISH_UNAVAILABLE",id,"This dish is not available on the selected date.",Map.of()));
                    if(member.dishVersion()!=item.dishVersion()) throw itemError("DISH_CHANGED",id,"This dish has changed. Review its current price and options.",Map.of("currentDishVersion",member.dishVersion()));
                    var details=dishes.details(id,member.dishVersion());var choices=new TreeSet<>(item.optionIds().stream().map(ValueRules::uuid).toList());var remaining=new HashSet<>(choices);var selected=new ArrayList<OptionSnapshot>();var allergens=new TreeSet<Allergen>(Comparator.comparing(Enum::name));allergens.addAll(details.allergens());long price=details.basePriceCents();
                    for(var group:details.optionGroups()) {
                        var options=group.options().stream().filter(option->choices.contains(option.optionId())).toList();
                        if(group.required() && options.isEmpty() || group.selectionMode()==SelectionType.Single && options.size()>1) throw ApiException.validation("items.optionIds","Complete the required choices and select at most one option in each single-choice group.");
                        for(var option:options) { remaining.remove(option.optionId());price=ValueRules.add(price,option.extraCents());allergens.addAll(option.allergens());selected.add(new OptionSnapshot(option.optionId(),group.groupId(),group.name(),option.name(),option.extraCents(),option.allergens())); }
                    }
                    if(!remaining.isEmpty()) throw ApiException.validation("items.optionIds","An option does not belong to this dish.");
                    selected.sort(Comparator.comparing(OptionSnapshot::optionId));var line=new PricedLine(id,details.name(),details.dishVersion(),selected,item.quantity(),details.basePriceCents(),price,ValueRules.multiply(price,item.quantity()),new ArrayList<>(allergens));
                    String key=id+":"+line.configurationKey();var previous=merged.get(key);if(previous!=null) line=new PricedLine(id,line.dishName(),line.dishVersion(),selected,previous.quantity()+line.quantity(),line.basePriceCents(),price,ValueRules.multiply(price,previous.quantity()+line.quantity()),line.effectiveAllergens());merged.put(key,line);
                    demand.merge(id,item.quantity(),Integer::sum);available.put(id,member.remaining());
                }
                for(var entry:demand.entrySet()) if(entry.getValue()>available.get(entry.getKey())) throw itemError("INSUFFICIENT_STOCK",entry.getKey(),"This dish no longer has enough stock.",Map.of("availableQuantity",available.get(entry.getKey())));
                return List.copyOf(merged.values());
            });
            long total=0;for(var item:priced) total=ValueRules.add(total,item.subtotalCents());Instant now=clock.now().truncatedTo(java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit.MICROS);
            var quote=new Quote(UUID.randomUUID().toString(),date,request.meal(),priced,count,total,now.plusSeconds(300),now,List.of());
            write.executeWithoutResult(status->quotes.insert(user,quote));return quote;
        }
        public static ApiException itemError(String code,String dish,String message,Map<String,Object> extra) {
            var issue=new HashMap<String,Object>(extra);issue.put("dishId",dish);issue.put("code",code);issue.put("message",message);
            return new ApiException(409,code,message,false,Map.of("itemIssues",List.of(issue)));
        }
    }

    export function purchaseAvailability(state: CartState, dish: MenuDish): { canAdd: boolean; reason: string | null } {
      let reason: string | null = null;
      const quantity = state.lines.reduce((sum, line) => sum + line.quantity, 0);

      else if (dish.remaining === 0) reason = 'Sold Out. Choose another dish.';
      else if (count >= dish.remaining) reason = `Only ${dish.remaining} portions are available for this dish.`;
      return { canAdd: reason === null, reason };

    # US3 报价、地址、下单与订单验证
    
    日期：2026-10-16。T045–T062完成。执行者：Codex。使用真实MySQL8.4.11隔离容器、JDK17、Spring Boot4.1.1及三浏览器×三视口，沿用[环境记录](environment.md)。
    
    ## 实现
    
    V007–V010创建地址、五分钟报价、订单和不可变条目快照。地址按用户/原文二进制唯一，只有订单成功事务才保存或更新最近使用时间。订单保留原quote UUID，但不依赖quote行存活；成功key与订单同生命周期，取消、完成或清理旧quote后仍能重放。
    
    报价先在只读REPEATABLE READ中校验日期、配置、版本与真实库存，按菜品/规范化配置归并，算基础及所选选项过敏原并集与整数分价格，再短事务保存。报价不占库存。
    
    订单写事务使用READ COMMITTED，按user→quote→升序dish→升序supply锁定，锁后再次判断到期及截单。订单、条目、地址、库存、quote消费和outbox原子提交；条件更新和唯一约束兜底。成功key/hash优先于报价、地址和时段检查；唯一冲突完整回滚后在新事务解析。锁失败最多重试整个事务三次，仍失败返回503可重试，保留原key。
    
    Pending可取消一次，重复取消不变更时间/版本/库存/事件。Confirmed→Completed保留库存占用但释放有效餐次；管理员状态服务已实现并用真实数据库验证，管理员HTTP与界面仍属US6。
    
    前端完成日期/餐次、历史或新地址、服务端报价、过期与改价恢复、订单历史分页/过滤/详情、取消。冻结提交保存在当前账号的内存上下文，不写localStorage；网络结果未知时只能复用原key/payload，跨页面仍保留。短暂会话检查失败隐藏操作但不丢掉冻结请求；只有成功响应才按配置扣除本次份数，保留等待期间新增的份数。用户原文以React文本节点显示。

    import type { Meal } from '../../shared/api/types';
    import { shanghaiDate } from '../menu/menuQuery';
    export type Slot = { date: string; meal: Meal };
    export type Selection = { slot: Slot; changed: boolean; error: string | null; notice: string | null };
    export function selectSlot(current: Slot, serverNow: number): Selection {
      const unchanged = { slot: current, changed: false, error: null, notice: null };
      if (!Number.isFinite(serverNow)) return { ...unchanged, error: 'The server time is unavailable. Please try again.' };
      const today = shanghaiDate(new Date(serverNow));
      if (current.date < today) return { ...unchanged, error: 'Choose today or a future delivery date.' };
      if (current.date > today) return unchanged;
      const hour = Number(new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', { timeZone: 'Asia/Shanghai', hour: '2-digit', hourCycle: 'h23' }).format(new Date(serverNow)));
      if (hour < (current.meal === 'Lunch' ? 10 : 15)) return unchanged;
      const tomorrow = new Date(Date.parse(`${today}T00:00:00Z`) + 86_400_000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const slot: Slot = hour < 15 ? { date: today, meal: 'Dinner' } : { date: tomorrow, meal: 'Lunch' };
      return { slot, changed: true, error: null, notice: `${current.meal} has closed. We selected ${slot.meal} on ${slot.date}. Confirm the new delivery selection before reviewing your order.` };
    }

                    boolean closed=LocalTime.parse(boundary).compareTo(LocalTime.of(meal.equals("Lunch")?10:15,0))>=0;

                    else {error(result,409,"SLOT_EXPIRED");boolean dinner=boundary.compareTo("15:00:00")<0;assertEquals(dinner?menu.date().toString():menu.date().plusDays(1).toString(),field(result,"suggestedDeliveryDate"));assertEquals(dinner?"Dinner":"Lunch",field(result,"suggestedMeal"));}

            TEST_CLOCK.set(menu.date().plusDays(1).atStartOfDay(ZoneId.of("Asia/Shanghai")).toInstant());error(postJson("/checkout/quotes",user,request(menu,1),null),422,"INVALID_DELIVERY_DATE");

        public UserRepository(JdbcTemplate jdbc) { this.jdbc=jdbc; }
        public Optional<UserRow> byEmail(String normalized) { return jdbc.query("SELECT id,email,normalized_email,password_hash,role FROM users WHERE normalized_email=?",ROW,normalized).stream().findFirst(); }
        public Optional<UserRow> byId(String id) { return jdbc.query("SELECT id,email,normalized_email,password_hash,role FROM users WHERE id=?",ROW,id).stream().findFirst(); }
        public Optional<UserRow> lockOwner(String id) {
            if(!TransactionSynchronizationManager.isActualTransactionActive()) throw new IllegalStateException("Owner locking requires a transaction.");
            return jdbc.query("SELECT id,email,normalized_email,password_hash,role FROM users WHERE id=? FOR UPDATE",ROW,id).stream().findFirst();
        }

            jdbc.update("INSERT INTO users(id,email,normalized_email,password_hash,role,created_at,updated_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",user.id(),user.email(),user.normalizedEmail(),user.passwordHash(),user.role().name(),Timestamp.from(now),Timestamp.from(now));
        }

    package com.webox.catalog;
    import java.time.LocalDate;
    import java.util.*;
    import com.webox.shared.DomainTypes.Category;
    import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;
    @Repository
    public class MenuQueryRepository {
        private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
        private static final String MEMBERS=" FROM daily_supply s JOIN dishes d ON d.id=s.dish_id WHERE s.delivery_date=? AND s.scheduled=TRUE AND d.is_listed=TRUE";
        public MenuQueryRepository(JdbcTemplate jdbc) { this.jdbc=jdbc; }
        public record Member(String dishId,long dishVersion,int remaining,long inventoryVersion) {}
        public record Results(List<Member> members,long total) {}
        public Results page(LocalDate date,List<Category> categories,String search,int page,int size) {
            var sql=new StringBuilder(MEMBERS);var params=new ArrayList<Object>();params.add(date);
            if(!categories.isEmpty()) { sql.append(" AND d.category IN (").append(String.join(",",Collections.nCopies(categories.size(),"?"))).append(")");categories.forEach(c->params.add(c.value())); }
            if(!search.isEmpty()) {
                String escaped="%"+search.replace("!","!!").replace("%","!%").replace("_","!_")+"%";
                sql.append(" AND (d.name LIKE ? ESCAPE '!' OR d.description LIKE ? ESCAPE '!')");params.add(escaped);params.add(escaped);
            }
            long total=jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT COUNT(*)"+sql,Long.class,params.toArray());
            params.add(size);params.add((long)page*size);
            var members=jdbc.query("SELECT d.id,d.version,s.total_quantity-s.allocated_quantity,s.version"+sql+" ORDER BY d.name,d.id LIMIT ? OFFSET ?",(rs,n)->new Member(rs.getString(1),rs.getLong(2),rs.getInt(3),rs.getLong(4)),params.toArray());
            return new Results(members,total);
        }
        public Optional<Member> member(LocalDate date,String dishId) {
            return jdbc.query("SELECT d.id,d.version,s.total_quantity-s.allocated_quantity,s.version"+MEMBERS+" AND d.id=?",(rs,n)->new Member(rs.getString(1),rs.getLong(2),rs.getInt(3),rs.getLong(4)),date,dishId).stream().findFirst();
        }
    }

        public MenuService(MenuQueryRepository query,DishRepository dishes,SupplyRepository supply,MenuDetailsCache cache,BusinessClock clock) { this.query=query;this.dishes=dishes;this.supply=supply;this.cache=cache;this.clock=clock; }
        public MenuPage page(LocalDate date,List<Category> categories,String search,int page,int size) {
            var result=query.page(date,categories,search,page,size);
            return new MenuPage(date,clock.now(),BusinessClock.ZONE.getId(),supply.menuRevision(date),result.members().stream().map(this::view).toList(),page,size,result.total());
        }

        }
    }

    const employee = { userId: 'd65a8dfd-51f2-4009-88b0-ddd16a2c14de', email: 'employee@example.com', role: 'Employee' };
    const response = (data: unknown, status = 200) => new Response(status === 204 ? null : JSON.stringify(data), { status });
    let signedIn = false;
    let requests: string[] = [];
    beforeEach(() => {
      signedIn = false; requests = []; localStorage.clear();
      vi.stubGlobal('fetch', vi.fn(async (url: string, init?: RequestInit) => {
        requests.push(url);
        if (url.endsWith('/csrf')) return response({ token: 'csrf', headerName: 'X-XSRF-TOKEN' });
        if (url.endsWith('/me')) return signedIn ? response(employee) : response({ code: 'UNAUTHENTICATED', message: 'Please sign in.', retryable: false }, 401);
        if (url.endsWith('/register')) return response(employee, 201);
        if (url.endsWith('/login')) {
          if (JSON.parse(init?.body as string).password !== 'Example123') return response({ code: 'INVALID_CREDENTIALS', message: 'Email or password is incorrect.', retryable: false }, 401);
          signedIn = true; return response(employee);
        }
        if (url.endsWith('/logout')) { signedIn = false; return response(null, 204); }
        throw new Error('Unexpected endpoint');
      }));
    });
    afterEach(() => vi.unstubAllGlobals());
    it('registration leads to explicit sign in without storing the password', async () => {
      history.replaceState(null, '', '/register');render(<App />);const user = userEvent.setup();

      await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create account' }));
      expect(await screen.findByText('Account created. Sign in to continue.')).toBeVisible();
      expect(requests.some(url => url.endsWith('/login'))).toBe(false);

    });

      history.replaceState(null, '', '/login');render(<App />);const user = userEvent.setup();
      await user.type(await screen.findByLabelText('Email'), 'employee@example.com');await user.type(screen.getByLabelText('Password'), 'Wrong123');
      await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign in' }));
      expect(await screen.findByText('Email or password is incorrect.')).toBeVisible();expect(screen.getByLabelText('Email')).toHaveValue('employee@example.com');
      await user.clear(screen.getByLabelText('Password'));await user.type(screen.getByLabelText('Password'), 'Example123');await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign in' }));
      await waitFor(() => expect(location.pathname).toBe('/menu'));expect(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Sign out' })).toBeVisible();
      await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign out' }));await waitFor(() => expect(location.pathname).toBe('/login'));
    });
    it('restores the authenticated identity and rejects the employee console route', async () => {
