      const closed = vi.fn();const unsubscribe = onSessionEnd(closed);
      try {
        render(<QueryClientProvider client={queries}><SessionProvider><BrowserRouter><AppRoutes /></BrowserRouter></SessionProvider></QueryClientProvider>);
        const user = userEvent.setup();await user.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Sign out' }));
        await waitFor(() => expect(location.pathname).toBe('/login'));
        expect(closed).toHaveBeenCalled();expect(queries.getQueryData(['personal-orders', employee.userId])).toBeUndefined();
      } finally { unsubscribe(); }
    });

    package com.webox.support;
    import java.util.*;
    import com.webox.auth.AuthService;

    import com.webox.media.MediaRepository;
    import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
    import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
    import org.springframework.session.jdbc.JdbcIndexedSessionRepository;
    import org.springframework.transaction.PlatformTransactionManager;
    import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.MockMvc;
    import org.springframework.mock.web.MockHttpServletResponse;
    import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;
    import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders.*;
    import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
    public abstract class OrderingTestSupport extends MySqlTestSupport {
        @Autowired protected MockMvc mvc;@Autowired protected JdbcTemplate jdbc;@Autowired protected JsonMapper json;
        @Autowired protected JdbcIndexedSessionRepository sessions;@Autowired protected AuthService auth;@Autowired protected MediaRepository media;@Autowired protected PlatformTransactionManager manager;
        public record Browser(FixtureFactory.IdentitySession identity,String csrf) {}
        protected Browser browser() throws Exception {
            var identity=new FixtureFactory(sessions,auth).identity(Role.Employee);
            var response=mvc.perform(get("/api/v1/auth/csrf").cookie(identity.cookie())).andReturn().getResponse();assertEquals(200,response.getStatus());
            return new Browser(identity,json.readTree(response.getContentAsString()).get("token").asString());
        }
        protected CatalogFixtures.Menu menu() { return new CatalogFixtures(jdbc,media,MEDIA_ROOT,sessions,auth,manager).create(); }
        protected MockHttpServletResponse postJson(String path,Browser user,Object body,String key) throws Exception {
            var request=post("/api/v1"+path).cookie(user.identity().cookie()).header("X-XSRF-TOKEN",user.csrf());
            if(body!=null) request.contentType("application/json").content(json.writeValueAsString(body));if(key!=null) request.header("Idempotency-Key",key);
            return mvc.perform(request).andReturn().getResponse();
        }
        protected MockHttpServletResponse read(String path,Browser user) throws Exception { return mvc.perform(get("/api/v1"+path).cookie(user.identity().cookie())).andReturn().getResponse(); }
        protected Map<String,Object> line(String dish,long version,int quantity,String... options) { return Map.of("dishId",dish,"dishVersion",version,"quantity",quantity,"optionIds",List.of(options)); }
        protected Map<String,Object> request(CatalogFixtures.Menu menu,int quantity) { return Map.of("deliveryDate",menu.date().toString(),"meal","Lunch","items",List.of(line(menu.pasta(),1,quantity,menu.options().get("Spaghetti"),menu.options().get("Cheese")))); }
        protected String quote(Browser user,CatalogFixtures.Menu menu,int quantity) throws Exception {
            var response=postJson("/checkout/quotes",user,request(menu,quantity),null);assertEquals(201,response.getStatus(),"Quote must be available");ContractAssertions.matches("Quote",response.getContentAsString());return field(response,"quoteId");
        }
        protected String responseBody(MockHttpServletResponse response) { return new String(response.getContentAsByteArray(),java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8); }
        protected String field(MockHttpServletResponse response,String name) { return json.readTree(responseBody(response)).path(name).asString(); }
        protected void error(MockHttpServletResponse response,int status,String code) { assertEquals(status,response.getStatus());ContractAssertions.matches("Error",responseBody(response));assertEquals(code,field(response,"code")); }
    }
    package com.webox.support;
    import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
    import java.util.Map;
    import org.yaml.snakeyaml.Yaml;
    import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;
    import com.networknt.schema.SchemaRegistry;
    import com.networknt.schema.SpecificationVersion;
    import com.networknt.schema.InputFormat;
    import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
    /** Reads the authoritative OpenAPI document, including nested $refs and format constraints. */
    public final class ContractAssertions {
        private static final JsonMapper JSON=JsonMapper.builder().build();
        private static final Map<String,Object> API=readContract();
        private static final SchemaRegistry REGISTRY=SchemaRegistry.withDefaultDialect(SpecificationVersion.DRAFT_2020_12);
        private ContractAssertions() {}
        private static Map<String,Object> readContract() {
            try(var in=ContractAssertions.class.getResourceAsStream("/contracts/openapi.yaml")) {
                if(in==null) throw new IllegalStateException("OpenAPI contract is missing.");
                return new Yaml().load(in);
            } catch(java.io.IOException e) { throw new IllegalStateException(e); }
        }
        public static void matches(String schemaName,String body) {
            var wrapper=new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();wrapper.put("$ref","#/components/schemas/"+schemaName);wrapper.put("components",API.get("components"));
            assertSchema(wrapper,body);
        }
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        public static void response(String path,String method,int status,String body) {
            Map<String,Object> paths=(Map<String,Object>)API.get("paths");
            Map<String,Object> item=(Map<String,Object>)paths.get(path);
            Map<String,Object> operation=(Map<String,Object>)item.get(method);
            Map<String,Object> responses=(Map<String,Object>)operation.get("responses");
            Map<String,Object> response=(Map<String,Object>)responses.get(String.valueOf(status));
            assertNotNull(response,"Response status must be declared in OpenAPI");
            Map<String,Object> content=(Map<String,Object>)response.get("content");
            Map<String,Object> media=(Map<String,Object>)content.get("application/json");
            var wrapper=new LinkedHashMap<>((Map<String,Object>)media.get("schema"));wrapper.put("components",API.get("components"));
            assertSchema(wrapper,body);
        }
        private static void assertSchema(Map<String,Object> schema,String body) {
            var compiled=REGISTRY.getSchema(JSON.writeValueAsString(schema),InputFormat.JSON);
            var errors=compiled.validate(body,InputFormat.JSON,ctx->ctx.executionConfig(config->config.formatAssertionsEnabled(true)));
            assertTrue(errors.isEmpty(),()->"Response violates the declared schema: "+errors);
        }
    }

    **日期**：2026-10-16。当前 **4项通过、77项未执行**；文档静态检查另记，不代替应用、MySQL、LLM、负载或真人验证。
    
    共 **81 项**：51 个用户场景、11 项质量目标、10 项交付检查、9 组差异夹具；4项通过、77项未执行。
    
    依据：[spec.md](spec.md)、[修订决策](decisions.md)、[原文追溯](requirements-source.md)。参考版180个场景只作为来源索引；本表按本项目已采用规则重新编号，不混用参考版收入、会话或其他未采用判据。
    
    ## 执行规则
    
    - 每次执行记录时间、环境/版本、角色与账号、业务日期、夹具、输入、实际结果、证据路径和执行者；状态可为未执行/通过/失败/阻塞。空证据或缺运行环境不得标通过。
    - 隔离夹具，控制截止时钟，避免唯一餐次、库存或旧数据掩盖被测规则。涉及权限、库存、份数和状态的场景同时核验直接请求及数据库结果。
    - 每个AC编号保持稳定。修改判据记录对应决策，补充场景使用新编号；通过结果须注明适用版本，不能沿用旧口径测试结论。
    - 运行方法与固定夹具见 [quickstart.md](quickstart.md)，文档质量清单只评审需求质量。

    ## 质量目标
    
    以规范中完整测试条件执行，不仅检查数值写在文档中。
    
    | AC | 依据 | 验证目标与条件 | 状态 | 证据 |
    | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
    | <a id="ac-sc-001"></a>AC-SC-001 | [SC-001](spec.md#sc-001) | 在 10 名首次使用者的验收任务中，至少 9 人无需协助即可在手机或桌面完成注册、选餐和下单，单人耗时不超过 5 分钟，并能准确指出配送日期、餐次和地址。 | 未执行 | — |
    | <a id="ac-sc-002"></a>AC-SC-002 | [SC-002](spec.md#sc-002) | 在 375、768、1440 像素宽度下，全部员工流程（含 AI 选餐与库存查看）均可完成；逐页检查的系统提供文案及预置菜单内容 100% 为英文，用户自由地址保留原文，无遮挡关键操作或页面级横向滚动。 | 未执行 | — |
    | <a id="ac-sc-003"></a>AC-SC-003 | [SC-003](spec.md#sc-003) | 在 200 名同时活跃员工、500 个菜单菜品的验收场景中，95% 的菜单打开/筛选/搜索在 2 秒内显示可用结果，95% 的购物车操作在 0.3 秒内显示结果，95% 的有效下单在 3 秒内显示明确结果；不以省略业务校验换取速度。 | 未执行 | — |
    | <a id="ac-sc-004"></a>AC-SC-004 | [SC-004](spec.md#sc-004) | 覆盖普通菜品、单选、多选、付费加料及混合数量的至少 20 个验收订单，配置保留正确率与金额精确到分的一致率均为 100%。 | 通过 | [US3验证](../../docs/validation/us3.md) |
    | <a id="ac-sc-005"></a>AC-SC-005 | [SC-005](spec.md#sc-005) | 数量为 0/1/5/6、各截单边界、跨日、无菜单、价格变化及同餐次有效订单场景全部得到预期结果；同一次提交并行重试 20 次只产生一个订单，两个独立提交竞争同餐次时最多产生一个有效订单。 | 未执行 | — |
    | <a id="ac-sc-006"></a>AC-SC-006 | [SC-006](spec.md#sc-006) | 账号、偏好、地址、菜单、每日库存和订单在正常重启后全部可恢复；未授权账号访问个人记录或 Console 的验收尝试 100% 被拒绝，刷新保持登录、退出后受限访问失败。 | 未执行 | — |
    | <a id="ac-sc-007"></a>AC-SC-007 | [SC-007](spec.md#sc-007) | 管理员无需修改程序即可在 5 分钟内新增菜品、上传图片、安排次日供应并完成上下架；员工重新打开菜单后 2 秒内看到已生效结果；合法订单状态变化与员工所见一致。 | 未执行 | — |
    | <a id="ac-sc-008"></a>AC-SC-008 | [SC-008](spec.md#sc-008) | 至少 9/10 名验收使用者能正确解释过敏原警告与预算提示的含义，以及是否可以继续；全部命中过敏原的加购场景得到提醒，超预算但其他条件有效的订单可以成功提交。 | 未执行 | — |
    | <a id="ac-sc-009"></a>AC-SC-009 | [SC-009](spec.md#sc-009) | 初始 10 份供应由 20 名员工同时各购买 1 份时最多成功 10 份、剩余量不为负；取消后准确恢复；95% 的已连接菜单页面在库存变更后 2 秒内显示新数量。 | 未执行 | — |
    | <a id="ac-sc-010"></a>AC-SC-010 | [SC-010](spec.md#sc-010) | 至少 20 组包含过敏原、售罄、预算和近期订单的功能诉求中，推荐 100% 指向真实可售且无过敏原冲突菜品。性能另以预先登记的至少 20 次有有效候选、预期 COMPLETE 的正常请求为固定样本，首张有效卡片呈现 p95 ≤5 秒、完整完成 p95 ≤20 秒；全部尝试计入分母，缺首卡或未 COMPLETE 的对应耗时计为正无穷，不得事后剔除失败。预期 NO_MATCH、澄清与故障用例独立核验，不纳入首卡性能样本；分组和计时遵循流契约 3.4。至少 8/10 名使用者认为理由与个人诉求相关。 | 未执行 | — |
    | <a id="ac-sc-011"></a>AC-SC-011 | [SC-011](spec.md#sc-011) | 对至少覆盖连续 7 天、四种订单状态和不同配置的已知订单样本，分别验证省略 date 的运营今天及显式 date 为非今天的 D；看板所有指标统一取各自查询日，趋势覆盖该日及前六日，每个计数、金额、销量和库存预警与独立核算 100% 一致；刷新后 3 秒内反映已完成的订单变化。 | 未执行 | — |

    # WeBox
    
    企业员工餐食订购平台，交付范围包含全部 Tier 1–3。用户界面与菜单资料使用英文。
    
    工程、基础能力、账号、菜单、购物车与订餐闭环 T001–T062 已完成，正在实施规则交互；全部可选故事与最终交付尚未完成。任务及验证状态分别见 [tasks.md](specs/001-webox-meal-ordering/tasks.md) 和 [验收台账](specs/001-webox-meal-ordering/acceptance.md)，不能将工程配置创建视为业务验收通过。
    
    ## 环境
    
    - JDK 17、Node 24 LTS 与 npm。
    - Docker Compose v2 和可访问的 Docker 守护进程；MySQL 8.4 使用独立容器与持久卷。
    - OpenRouter API 凭据，默认模型 `openai/gpt-4.1-mini`；可通过 `OPENROUTER_MODEL` 配置。
    - Maven Central、npm registry 与镜像源和 OpenRouter API可访问，以生成并验证依赖锁定结果。
    
    完整启动、测试及交付约定见 [quickstart.md](specs/001-webox-meal-ordering/quickstart.md)。阶段一的实际进度见[环境记录](docs/validation/environment.md)。当前 JDK17 构建、MySQL 真实集成测试、前端类型/单元/构建、三浏览器×三尺寸99组浏览器测试和 OpenRouter 生成探针均通过。
    
    前端可通过 `./scripts/frontend.sh <npm 参数>` 运行。脚本优先使用 `WEBOX_NODE_BIN` 指定的可执行文件，其次使用项目本地 `.local/toolchains/node24/bin/node`，最后检查 PATH；强制 Node 24 / npm 11，并将 npm 缓存放在项目 `.local/npm`。例如：
    
    ```bash
    ./scripts/frontend.sh --version
    # 若 Node 24 未在 PATH 中，指定本机实际安装路径：
    WEBOX_NODE_BIN=/absolute/path/to/node24/bin/node ./scripts/frontend.sh --version
    ```
    
    当前开发机使用校验过的官方 Node 24.22.0 和 Temurin JDK 17.0.20.1；本机安装位于忽略的 `.local/`，不作为交付依赖。其他机器提供 Node 24 和 `JAVA_HOME` 指向的 JDK 17 即可。项目 `.npmrc` 固定官方 registry；已生成完整锁文件，后续安装使用 `./scripts/frontend.sh ci`。后端入口为 `./scripts/backend.sh verify`，调用官方 Maven Wrapper，并使用项目本地依赖缓存。
    
    ## 本地配置
    
    首次从仓库根目录复制 `.env.example` 为 `.env`，已有配置请保留。填写数据库密码和管理员初始密码，并使 `DB_USERNAME`/`DB_PASSWORD` 与 MySQL 应用用户一致。模板已固定官方 MySQL 8.4.11 镜像 digest；Compose 使用 `weboxspec` 项目名及独立持久卷。
    
    ```bash
    test -e .env || cp .env.example .env
    chmod 600 .env
    set -a
    source .env
    set +a
    mkdir -p "$MEDIA_ROOT"
    ```
    
    默认本地后端端口为 8080，前端为 5173；前端代理 `/api` 和 `/media`，保持同源 Cookie 与 CSRF。生产必须配置 HTTPS 和 `SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE=true`。会话空闲期限默认 8h；AI 并发、队列、20 秒总时限和 SSE 容量均在模板中列出。
    
    `.env`、上传媒体、数据库卷、模型、构建产物和测试会话不进入源码交付。种子图片、`seed/menu.json`、图片来源记录、依赖锁文件和 Maven Wrapper 必须随源码交付；部署不得依赖开发机 Downloads 路径。
    
    ## 设计与交付入口
    
    - [规格与业务边界](specs/001-webox-meal-ordering/spec.md)
    - [架构与实施计划](specs/001-webox-meal-ordering/plan.md)

    **Input**: 用户指定依据项目目录中的 [AI Vibe Coding V3.0 - PRD.md](../../AI%20Vibe%20Coding%20V3.0%20-%20PRD.md)（V3.0，2026-03-24）生成规格；2026-10-16 补充要求：“无时间约束，所有可选功能都实现”。此补充优先于原文的时限和可选范围表述。
    
    **Product Goal**: 让约 200 名企业员工在手机和电脑上完成选餐、配置和订餐，让食堂获得准确的备餐订单并管理每日菜单。

    **Scope**:
    
    - 完整交付 MUST 覆盖 Tier 1、Tier 2、Tier 3 的全部功能，包括库存实时展示与扣减、AI 选餐助手和经营看板；47 条功能需求和 11 条成功标准全部适用。
    - P1/P2/P3 仅表示实施顺序，不表示任何功能可以省略或推迟到本次交付之外。
    - 用户明确不设开发或交付时间限制，原 PRD 的 1.5 小时挑战时限不适用；订餐截止时间、用户操作耗时和响应性能目标仍按业务规则与验收标准执行。
    - 系统提供的内容全部为英文；用户地址等自由文本保留原文并安全处理，不强制翻译。本文面向需求评审者，以中文描述业务。
    - 本期不包含在线支付、退款、配送路线跟踪、多企业运营、邮箱验证、找回密码及管理员自助注册。订单金额用于订餐记录与经营统计，不代表已实际收款。
    - 用户原文规定的交付和技术约束继续有效，单独记录于 [delivery-constraints.md](delivery-constraints.md)，由后续规划承接。

    type Cart = { state: CartState; date: string; setDate: (value: string) => void; busy: boolean; notice: string | null; dispatch: (action: CartAction) => void; refresh: () => void; checkout: CheckoutSubmission };
    const Context = createContext<Cart | null>(null);
    export function CartProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
      const { user } = useSession();
      const [state, setState] = useState(initialCart), [date, setDate] = useState(shanghaiDate), [busy, setBusy] = useState(true), [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
      const current = useRef(state), owner = useRef<string | null>(null), epoch = useRef(0), request = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
      const [checkout] = useState(() => new CheckoutSubmission());
      const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
        if (!user) return;
        request.current?.abort();const controller = new AbortController();request.current = controller;
        const generation = ++epoch.current;setBusy(true);
        const restored = owner.current === user.userId ? { draft: draftFromState(current.current), error: null } : loadDraft(user.userId);

          const result = await reconcileDraft(restored.draft, async id => {

        }
      }, [user?.userId, date]);
      useEffect(() => {
        void refresh();const focus = () => { void refresh(); };window.addEventListener('focus', focus);
        const unsubscribe = onSessionEnd(() => { epoch.current++;request.current?.abort();owner.current = null;current.current = initialCart;setState(initialCart); });
        return () => { epoch.current++;request.current?.abort();window.removeEventListener('focus', focus);unsubscribe(); };
      }, [refresh]);
      const dispatch = (action: CartAction) => {
        if (!user || (busy && action.type !== 'submitted') || owner.current !== user.userId) return;
        if (action.type === 'submitted') { request.current?.abort();setBusy(false); }
        epoch.current++;const next = cartReducer(current.current, action);current.current = next;setState(next);
        const error = saveDraft(user.userId, next);setNotice(error);
      };

    import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    import { api } from '../../shared/api/client';
    import type { Category, MenuDish, MenuPage } from '../../shared/api/types';
    export const categories: Category[] = ['Chinese', 'Western', 'Japanese', 'Light Meal', 'Korean', 'Southeast Asian'];
    export function shanghaiDate(now = new Date()): string {
      const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', { timeZone: 'Asia/Shanghai', year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit' }).formatToParts(now);
      return ['year', 'month', 'day'].map(name => parts.find(part => part.type === name)!.value).join('-');
    }
    export function menuDish(date: string, id: string, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<MenuDish> { return api(`/menus/${date}/dishes/${id}`, { signal }); }
    export function useMenuQuery(date: string, selected: Category[], search: string, page: number, recommended = false) {
      const params = new URLSearchParams({ search, page: String(page), size: '24', recommended: String(recommended) });
      [...selected].sort().forEach(category => params.append('categories', category));
      return useQuery({ queryKey: ['menu', date, params.toString()], queryFn: ({ signal }) => api<MenuPage>(`/menus/${date}?${params}`, { signal }) });
    }
    export const MAX_SAFE_INTEGER = Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
    export function safeInteger(value: number): number {
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value < 0) throw new Error('Value must be a non-negative safe integer.');
      return value;
    }
    export function money(cents: number): string {
      const exact = BigInt(safeInteger(cents));
      return `${exact / 100n}.${String(exact % 100n).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    }
    export function parseMoney(input: string): number {
      if (!/^\d{1,14}(\.\d{1,2})?$/.test(input)) throw new Error('Enter a valid amount with at most two decimal places.');
      const [whole, fraction = ''] = input.split('.');
      const cents = BigInt(whole) * 100n + BigInt(fraction.padEnd(2, '0'));
      if (cents > BigInt(MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)) throw new Error('Amount exceeds the supported limit.');
      return Number(cents);
    }
    export function codePoints(text: string): number {
      // A lone surrogate cannot be stored faithfully in utf8mb4.
      for (const point of text) {
        const code = point.codePointAt(0)!;
        if (code >= 0xd800 && code <= 0xdfff) throw new Error('Text contains invalid Unicode.');
      }
      return Array.from(text).length;
    }
    export function requiredText(text: string, max: number): string {
      const normalized = text.trim();
      const length = codePoints(normalized);
      if (!length || length > max) throw new Error(`Text must contain 1 to ${max} characters.`);
      return normalized;
    }
    export function password(text: string): string {
      const length = codePoints(text);
      if (length < 8 || length > 128 || !/[A-Za-z]/.test(text) || !/[0-9]/.test(text)) {
        throw new Error('Password must contain 8 to 128 characters, including a letter and a number.');
      }
      return text;
    }
    import type { MenuDish } from '../../shared/api/types';
    import { configuration } from './configuration';
    import { safeInteger } from '../../shared/values';
    import type { StoredCartLine } from './cartStorage';
    import { purchaseAvailability } from './purchaseAvailability';
    export type CartLine = { key: string; dish: MenuDish; optionIds: string[]; quantity: number; unitPriceCents: number; issue?: 'changed' | 'unavailable'; original?: StoredCartLine };
    export type CartState = { lines: CartLine[]; error: string | null };
    export const initialCart: CartState = { lines: [], error: null };
    export type CartAction = { type: 'add'; dish: MenuDish; optionIds: string[] } | { type: 'decrease' | 'remove' | 'confirm'; key: string } | { type: 'submitted'; lines: { key: string; quantity: number }[] };
    export function cartReducer(state: CartState, action: CartAction): CartState {
      try {
        if (action.type === 'add') {
          const config = configuration(action.dish, action.optionIds);
          const available = purchaseAvailability(state, action.dish);if (!available.canAdd) throw new Error(available.reason!);
          const existing = state.lines.find(line => line.key === config.key);
          const lines = existing ? state.lines.map(line => line.key === config.key ? { ...line, quantity: line.quantity + 1 } : line) : [...state.lines, { ...config, dish: action.dish, quantity: 1 }];
          const next = { lines, error: null }; totalCents(next); return next;
        }
        if (action.type === 'submitted') {
          const quantities = new Map(action.lines.map(line => [line.key, safeInteger(line.quantity)]));
          return { error: null, lines: state.lines.map(line => ({ ...line, quantity: line.quantity - (quantities.get(line.key) ?? 0) })).filter(line => line.quantity > 0) };
        }
        if (action.type === 'confirm') { const next: CartState = { error: null, lines: state.lines.map(line => {
          if (line.key !== action.key || line.issue !== 'changed') return line;
          const config = configuration(line.dish, line.optionIds);
          return { ...config, dish: line.dish, quantity: line.quantity };
        }) };totalCents(next);return next; }
        return { error: null, lines: state.lines.flatMap(line => line.key !== action.key ? [line] : action.type === 'remove' || line.quantity === 1 ? [] : [{ ...line, quantity: line.quantity - 1 }]) };
      } catch (error) { return { ...state, error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Could not update your cart.' }; }
    }
    export function totalQuantity(state: CartState): number { return state.lines.reduce((sum, line) => sum + line.quantity, 0); }
    export function totalCents(state: CartState): number {
      const total = state.lines.reduce((sum, line) => sum + BigInt(safeInteger(line.unitPriceCents)) * BigInt(safeInteger(line.quantity)), 0n);
      if (total > BigInt(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)) throw new Error('The cart total exceeds the supported limit.');
      return Number(total);
    }

    **Why this priority**: 保证食堂的备餐计划可执行，防止超量、过期和重复订餐。
    
    **Independent Test**: 使用可控制的运营时间以及已有订单，验证时间边界、数量边界和同时提交。
    
    **Acceptance Scenarios**:
    
    1. **Given** 购物车已有 5 份，**When** 查看菜单添加按钮或购物车加号，**Then** 均不可增加且解释上限；即使绕过页面限制尝试提交 6 份，也不能生成订单。
    2. **Given** 当日午餐截止前尚可订，**When** 运营时间到达 10:00 或员工在 10:30 提交当日午餐，**Then** 所选餐次切换到当日晚餐并显示英文通知；当日 15:00 及之后则切换到次日午餐。
    3. **Given** 配送日为未来且所选餐次尚未截止，**When** 进入或提交结算，**Then** 保留原选择；已过期日期不会被悄悄当作当天订单处理。
    4. **Given** 本人已在所选日期和餐次有 `Pending` 或 `Confirmed` 订单，**When** 进入结算或切换到该餐次，**Then** `Place Order` 变为 `View Existing Order`，点击打开已有订单；同时从不同页面提交也不会出现两个有效订单。
    5. **Given** 同餐次订单已 `Cancelled` 或 `Completed` 且仍未截单，**When** 员工明确发起一笔新的结算，**Then** 可重新订餐；旧提交的重试仍返回旧订单。
    6. **Given** 自动切换后目标日期没有所选菜品，或购物车内菜品已下架、价格或配置改变，**When** 提交，**Then** 明确列出需调整内容并保留购物车，不静默替换菜品或按未确认的新价格下单。
    
    ---
    
    ### User Story 5 - 保存饮食偏好并获得可控提醒 (Priority: P2)
    
    员工保存自己的过敏原、偏好菜系、辣度、口味浓淡及预算，通过开关控制个性化展示，并自行决定是否继续选择含过敏原或超预算的餐食。
    
    **Why this priority**: 降低日常选餐成本，同时让提醒与用户决定保持清晰。
    
    **Independent Test**: 为一个员工设置偏好，对照开关状态、含过敏原菜品和不同金额的购物车进行验证。
    
    **Acceptance Scenarios**:
    
    1. **Given** 员工保存偏好，**When** 刷新或重新登录，**Then** 设置仍存在；非法预算如负数、下限大于上限不能保存并有英文反馈。
    2. **Given** 员工标记 `Egg` 过敏且菜品包含 `Egg`，**When** 尝试加入购物车，**Then** 弹窗列出命中的过敏原；拒绝不改变购物车，选择继续才添加，菜品仍可在普通菜单中看到。
    3. **Given** 员工偏好 `Japanese` 和 `None` 辣度，**When** 开启 `Recommended for Me`，**Then** 优先展示偏好菜系、在同一优先组中优先匹配辣度并高亮命中项；关闭时恢复默认顺序，不改变搜索和筛选条件。
    4. **Given** 单餐预算上限为 ¥30.00，**When** 结算金额为 ¥30.01，**Then** 出现英文超预算提示但仍可提交；金额等于上限时不提示超出。
    
    5. **Given** 基础菜品无 Egg、可选加料标记 Egg，且员工标记 Egg，**When** 不选该加料、再选择该加料或修改已有配置，**Then** 仅实际配置命中时提醒；新增匹配重新确认，拒绝保留原购物车。
    
    ---
    
    ### User Story 6 - 管理员维护菜品、每日供应并处理订单 (Priority: P2)
    
    package com.webox.auth;
    import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
    import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
    import java.util.List;
    import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
    import org.springframework.security.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken;
    import org.springframework.security.core.annotation.AuthenticationPrincipal;
    import org.springframework.security.core.authority.SimpleGrantedAuthority;
    import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
    import org.springframework.security.web.authentication.logout.SecurityContextLogoutHandler;
    import org.springframework.security.web.authentication.session.ChangeSessionIdAuthenticationStrategy;
    import org.springframework.security.web.context.HttpSessionSecurityContextRepository;
    import org.springframework.security.web.csrf.CsrfAuthenticationStrategy;
    import org.springframework.security.web.csrf.HttpSessionCsrfTokenRepository;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
    @org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.condition.ConditionalOnWebApplication
    @RestController
    @RequestMapping("/api/v1/auth")
    public class AuthController {
        private final AuthService service;private final HttpSessionSecurityContextRepository contexts;private final HttpSessionCsrfTokenRepository csrf;
        public AuthController(AuthService service,HttpSessionSecurityContextRepository contexts,HttpSessionCsrfTokenRepository csrf) { this.service=service;this.contexts=contexts;this.csrf=csrf; }
        public record Credentials(String email,String password) { @Override public String toString() { return "Credentials[redacted]"; } }
        @PostMapping("/register") @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
        public UserIdentity register(@RequestBody Credentials body) { return service.register(body.email(),body.password()); }
        @PostMapping("/login")
        public UserIdentity login(@RequestBody Credentials body,HttpServletRequest request,HttpServletResponse response) {
            var user=service.login(body.email(),body.password());
            var authentication=UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken.authenticated(user,null,List.of(new SimpleGrantedAuthority("ROLE_"+user.role().name())));
            new ChangeSessionIdAuthenticationStrategy().onAuthentication(authentication,request,response);
            new CsrfAuthenticationStrategy(csrf).onAuthentication(authentication,request,response);
            var context=SecurityContextHolder.createEmptyContext();context.setAuthentication(authentication);
            SecurityContextHolder.setContext(context);contexts.saveContext(context,request,response);
            return user;
        }
        @GetMapping("/me") public UserIdentity me(@AuthenticationPrincipal UserIdentity user) { return user; }
        @PostMapping("/logout") @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
        public void logout(HttpServletRequest request,HttpServletResponse response) {
            var authentication=SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication();
            csrf.saveToken(null,request,response);
            new SecurityContextLogoutHandler().logout(request,response,authentication);
        }
    }

    @Configuration(proxyBeanMethods=false)

                .withCoercionConfig(tools.jackson.databind.type.LogicalType.Textual, config -> {
                    for (var shape : new tools.jackson.databind.cfg.CoercionInputShape[]{tools.jackson.databind.cfg.CoercionInputShape.Integer, tools.jackson.databind.cfg.CoercionInputShape.Float, tools.jackson.databind.cfg.CoercionInputShape.Boolean})
                        config.setCoercion(shape, tools.jackson.databind.cfg.CoercionAction.Fail);
                });
        }
        @Bean java.nio.file.Path mediaRoot(@org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value("${webox.media-root}") String configured) throws IOException {
            var directory = java.nio.file.Path.of(configured).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
            java.nio.file.Files.createDirectories(directory);
            if (!java.nio.file.Files.isWritable(directory)) throw new IllegalStateException("The media directory is not writable.");
            return directory;
        }
        @Bean Clock applicationClock() { return Clock.systemUTC(); }
        @Bean JsonFactoryBuilderCustomizer jsonLimits() {

                    .enable(StreamReadFeature.STRICT_DUPLICATE_DETECTION);
        }
        @Bean FilterRegistrationBean<OncePerRequestFilter> requestBoundary(JsonMapper mapper) {
            var filter=new OncePerRequestFilter() {
                @Override protected void doFilterInternal(HttpServletRequest request,HttpServletResponse response,FilterChain chain) throws IOException,ServletException {
                    response.setHeader("X-Request-Id",ApiErrors.requestId(request));
                    if(request.getRequestURI().startsWith("/api/")) response.setHeader("Cache-Control","no-store");
                    if(request.getContentType()!=null && (request.getContentType().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT).startsWith("application/json") || request.getContentType().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT).split(";",2)[0].endsWith("+json"))) {
                        if(request.getContentLengthLong()>MAX_JSON_BYTES) { tooLarge(mapper,request,response); return; }
                        byte[] bytes=request.getInputStream().readNBytes(MAX_JSON_BYTES+1);
                        if(bytes.length>MAX_JSON_BYTES) { tooLarge(mapper,request,response); return; }
                        var wrapped=new HttpServletRequestWrapper(request) {
                            @Override public ServletInputStream getInputStream() {
                                var input=new ByteArrayInputStream(bytes);
                                return new ServletInputStream() {
                                    @Override public int read() { return input.read(); }
                                    @Override public int read(byte[] b,int o,int l) { return input.read(b,o,l); }
                                    @Override public boolean isFinished() { return input.available()==0; }
                                    @Override public boolean isReady() { return true; }
                                    @Override public void setReadListener(ReadListener listener) {
                                        try { if(!isFinished()) listener.onDataAvailable(); if(isFinished()) listener.onAllDataRead(); }
                                        catch(IOException e) { listener.onError(e); }
                                    }
                                };
                            }
                            @Override public BufferedReader getReader() { return new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(getInputStream(),java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8)); }
                        };
                        chain.doFilter(wrapped,response); return;
                    }
                    chain.doFilter(request,response);
                }
            };
            var bean=new FilterRegistrationBean<OncePerRequestFilter>(filter);
            bean.setOrder(Ordered.HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE+20); bean.setAsyncSupported(true); return bean;
        }
        private static void tooLarge(JsonMapper mapper,HttpServletRequest req,HttpServletResponse res) throws IOException {
            ApiErrors.write(mapper,req,res,new ApiException(400,"VALIDATION_ERROR","The JSON request is too large."));
        }
    }

        // The full cross-browser cart/order rules matrix lives in tests/e2e/order-rules.spec.ts.
        import { useState } from 'react';
        import { afterEach, vi } from 'vitest';
        import { fireEvent, render, screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
        import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
        import * as client from '../../shared/api/client';
        import { DeliverySelection } from './DeliverySelection';
        import type { Slot } from './slotSelection';
        afterEach(() => vi.restoreAllMocks());
        function SelectionHarness({ locked = false }: { locked?: boolean }) {
          const [slot, setSlot] = useState<Slot>({ date: '2026-10-16', meal: 'Lunch' }), [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
          return <><DeliverySelection {...slot} locked={locked} onChange={setSlot} onReady={setReady} /><button disabled={!ready}>Review</button></>;
        }
        it('refreshes server time on focus and requires explicit confirmation after switching', async () => {
          let serverTime = '2026-10-16T09:59:58+08:00';
          vi.spyOn(client, 'api').mockImplementation(async () => ({ serverTime } as never));
          const queries = new QueryClient({ defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: false } } });
          render(<QueryClientProvider client={queries}><SelectionHarness /></QueryClientProvider>);
          await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Review', exact: true })).toBeEnabled());
          serverTime = '2026-10-16T10:00:00+08:00';fireEvent(window, new Event('focus'));
          await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByLabelText('Meal')).toHaveValue('Dinner'));
          expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Review', exact: true })).toBeDisabled();
          fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Confirm delivery selection' }));
          await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Review', exact: true })).toBeEnabled());queries.clear();
        });
        it('preserves a frozen submission when the window regains focus after the cutoff', async () => {
          const request = vi.spyOn(client, 'api').mockResolvedValue({ serverTime: '2026-10-16T15:00:00+08:00' } as never);
          const queries = new QueryClient();render(<QueryClientProvider client={queries}><SelectionHarness locked /></QueryClientProvider>);
          fireEvent(window, new Event('focus'));expect(screen.getByLabelText('Meal')).toHaveValue('Lunch');expect(screen.getByLabelText('Meal')).toBeDisabled();expect(request).not.toHaveBeenCalled();queries.clear();
        });
        EOF

            String burgerImage=image(admin,"classic-beef-burger.png"),pastaImage=image(admin,"tomato-pasta.png"),saladImage=image(admin,"garden-salad.jpg");

                var options=new LinkedHashMap<String,String>();
                String burger=dish(date,"Classic Beef Burger","Grilled beef, lettuce and tomato. Customize your bun and sauce.",3200,"Western","Beef",burgerImage,true,true,20);
                group(burger,"Bun",true,"Single",0,options,new Choice("Plain bun",0,"Gluten"),new Choice("Brioche bun",200,"Gluten","Egg","Dairy"));
                group(burger,"Sauce",true,"Single",1,options,new Choice("Ketchup",0),new Choice("Mayonnaise",0,"Egg"));
                group(burger,"Burger extras",false,"Multiple",2,options,new Choice("Extra cheese",300,"Dairy"),new Choice("Extra tomato",100));
                jdbc.update("INSERT INTO dish_allergens VALUES (?,?)",burger,"Gluten");
                String pasta=dish(date,"Tomato Pasta","Pasta with tomato sauce and fresh basil.",2650,"Western","Wheat",pastaImage,true,true,20);
                group(pasta,"Pasta type",true,"Single",0,options,new Choice("Spaghetti",0,"Gluten"),new Choice("Fusilli",0,"Gluten"));
                group(pasta,"Add-ons",false,"Multiple",1,options,new Choice("Cheese",300,"Dairy"),new Choice("Extra basil",100));
                jdbc.update("INSERT INTO dish_allergens VALUES (?,?)",pasta,"Gluten");
                String salad=dish(date,"Garden Salad","Fresh greens, chickpeas and a bright dressing.",1800,"Light Meal","Chickpeas",saladImage,true,true,0);
                String chinese=dish(date,"Chinese Garden Salad","Fresh greens with a 100% plant-based dressing_!.",1800,"Chinese","Chickpeas",saladImage,true,true,20);
                String japanese=dish(date,"Japanese Garden Salad","Fresh greens with soy dressing.",1800,"Japanese","Chickpeas",saladImage,true,true,20);
                String hidden=dish(date,"Hidden Salad","An unpublished dish.",1800,"Light Meal","Chickpeas",saladImage,false,true,20);
                String unscheduled=dish(date,"Unscheduled Salad","A dish not on this date.",1800,"Light Meal","Chickpeas",saladImage,true,false,20);

            String group=UUID.randomUUID().toString();jdbc.update("INSERT INTO customization_groups VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)",group,dish,name,mode,required,order);
            for(int i=0;i<choices.length;i++) {

                jdbc.update("INSERT INTO customization_options VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)",id,group,choice.name(),choice.extra(),i);

         spice VARCHAR(16) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NULL,
         flavor VARCHAR(16) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NULL,
         budget_min_cents BIGINT NULL, budget_max_cents BIGINT NULL,

         CHECK(spice IS NULL OR spice IN ('None','Mild','Medium','Hot')),
         CHECK(flavor IS NULL OR flavor IN ('Light','Moderate','Strong')),
         CHECK(version BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991),
         CHECK((budget_min_cents IS NULL AND budget_max_cents IS NULL) OR

            public Preferences replace(String user,Write body) {

        package com.webox.ordering;
        import java.util.*;
        import com.webox.auth.PreferencesRepository;
        import com.webox.shared.ValueRules;
        import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
        import static com.webox.ordering.OrderingModels.*;
        @Component
        public class CheckoutWarnings {
            private final PreferencesRepository preferences;
            public CheckoutWarnings(PreferencesRepository preferences) {this.preferences=preferences;}
            public List<Map<String,Object>> forItems(String user,List<PricedLine> items) {
                var personal=preferences.get(user);var warnings=new ArrayList<Map<String,Object>>();long total=0;
                for(int index=0;index<items.size();index++) {
                    var item=items.get(index);total=ValueRules.add(total,item.subtotalCents());var matches=item.effectiveAllergens().stream().filter(personal.allergens()::contains).map(Enum::name).sorted().toList();
                    if(!matches.isEmpty()) warnings.add(Map.of("code","FLAGGED_ALLERGEN","message","This selection contains your flagged allergens: "+String.join(", ",matches)+". You may continue if you choose.","dishId",item.dishId(),"itemIndex",index,"allergens",matches));
                }
                if(personal.budgetMaxCents()!=null && total>personal.budgetMaxCents()) warnings.add(Map.of("code","BUDGET_EXCEEDED","message","This order exceeds your maximum meal budget. You can still place the order."));
                return List.copyOf(warnings);
            }
        }

        import type { Allergen, MenuDish } from '../../shared/api/types';
        import { parseMoney } from '../../shared/values';
        export function matchedAllergens(dish: MenuDish, options: string[], flagged: Allergen[]): Allergen[] {
          const declared = new Set([...dish.allergens, ...dish.optionGroups.flatMap(group => group.options.filter(option => options.includes(option.optionId)).flatMap(option => option.allergens))]);
          return [...new Set(flagged)].filter(allergen => declared.has(allergen)).sort();
        }
        export function newAllergens(matches: Allergen[], acknowledged: Allergen[]): Allergen[] { return matches.filter(allergen => !acknowledged.includes(allergen)); }
        export function budgetRange(min: string, max: string): { budgetMinCents: number | null; budgetMaxCents: number | null } {
          if (!min.trim() && !max.trim()) return { budgetMinCents: null, budgetMaxCents: null };
          if (!min.trim() || !max.trim()) throw new Error('Set both budget limits, or clear both.');
          const budgetMinCents = parseMoney(min.trim()), budgetMaxCents = parseMoney(max.trim());
          if (budgetMinCents > budgetMaxCents) throw new Error('Maximum budget must be at least the minimum budget.');
          return { budgetMinCents, budgetMaxCents };
        }

        import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
        import { useEffect } from 'react';
        import { api } from '../../shared/api/client';
        import type { Preferences } from '../../shared/api/types';
        import { useSession } from '../auth/session';
        export function usePreferences() {
          const { user } = useSession();
          const query = useQuery({ queryKey: ['preferences', user!.userId], queryFn: ({ signal }) => api<Preferences>('/me/preferences', { signal }) });
          const refresh = query.refetch;
          useEffect(() => { const focus = () => { void refresh(); };window.addEventListener('focus', focus);return () => window.removeEventListener('focus', focus); }, [refresh]);
          return query;
        }

    import type { MenuDish } from '../../shared/api/types';
    import { safeInteger } from '../../shared/values';
    export function configuration(dish: MenuDish, selected: string[], requireComplete = true): { optionIds: string[]; unitPriceCents: number; key: string } {
      const optionIds = [...new Set(selected.map(id => id.toLowerCase()))].sort();
      const remaining = new Set(optionIds);
      let price = BigInt(safeInteger(dish.basePriceCents));
      for (const group of dish.optionGroups) {
        const options = group.options.filter(option => remaining.has(option.optionId));
        if (requireComplete && group.required && !options.length) throw new Error(`Choose an option for ${group.name}.`);
        if (group.selectionMode === 'Single' && options.length > 1) throw new Error(`Choose only one option for ${group.name}.`);
        for (const option of options) { remaining.delete(option.optionId); price += BigInt(safeInteger(option.extraCents)); }
      }
      if (remaining.size) throw new Error('An option is no longer available. Choose your options again.');
      if (price > BigInt(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)) throw new Error('This amount exceeds the supported limit.');
      return { optionIds, unitPriceCents: Number(price), key: JSON.stringify([dish.dishId, ...optionIds]) };
    }

    public final class FixtureFactory {
        private final SessionRepository<?> sessions;

        public FixtureFactory(SessionRepository<?> sessions, com.webox.auth.AuthService auth) { this.sessions=sessions;this.auth=auth; }
        public IdentitySession identity(Role role) { return create(sessions,role,auth); }
        private static <S extends Session> IdentitySession create(SessionRepository<S> sessions,Role role,com.webox.auth.AuthService auth) {
            String id=UUID.randomUUID().toString();
            var user=role==Role.Admin ? auth.initializeAdmin(id+"@example.com","Fixture123"+id) : auth.register(id+"@example.com","Fixture123"+id);
            var context=SecurityContextHolder.createEmptyContext();
            context.setAuthentication(UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken.authenticated(user,null,List.of(new SimpleGrantedAuthority("ROLE_"+role.name()))));
            var session=sessions.createSession();session.setAttribute("SPRING_SECURITY_CONTEXT",context);sessions.save(session);
            return new IdentitySession(user,session.getId());
        }
        public record IdentitySession(UserIdentity user,String sessionId) {
            public Cookie cookie() { return new Cookie("WEBOXSESSION",sessionId); }
        }
    }

    # Menu image sources
    
    Images are bundled locally; startup never depends on a developer Downloads path or remote image URL. Generated illustrations represent the configured dish, not photographs of an actual restaurant's products. Food/allergen claims come from explicit menu data, never from images.
    
    - `images/garden-salad.jpg`: unchanged user-provided archive entry `product_images/image_12_s-1712826759815.jpg`. Its initial use is the Garden Salad fixture.
    - `images/classic-beef-burger.png`: generated 2026-10-16 using the built-in image_gen tool with the imagegen skill. Prompt: “Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: square dish photograph for a workday meal-ordering menu. Subject: one appetizing classic beef burger in a plain toasted bun, beef patty, green lettuce, sliced tomato, small amount of sauce; no cheese or other optional toppings. Natural realistic food photography, three-quarter angle, entire burger on a simple matte white plate, warm ivory tabletop, soft daylight, restrained clean composition, no side dishes. No text, no branding, no watermarks. This is a reusable local menu asset; create a single square image.”
    - `images/tomato-pasta.png`: generated 2026-10-16 using the built-in image_gen tool with the imagegen skill. Prompt: “Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: square dish photograph for a workday meal-ordering menu. Subject: a serving of spaghetti coated in rich tomato sauce, small fresh basil leaves, no cheese, no meat, no side dishes.     ### delivery_addresses
    
    | 字段 | 类型与规则 |
    | --- | --- |
    | id | UUID 主键 |
    | user_id | users 外键；每次按当前用户过滤读取 |
    | address_text | VARCHAR(200)，trim 后非空，不擅自合并内部空格或改变大小写 |
    | created_at, last_used_at | UTC 时间 |
    
    索引：`(user_id,last_used_at,id)`；唯一约束 `(user_id,address_text)`，地址文本采用精确比较，仅复用完全相同的 trim 后地址。输入新地址只在下单成功事务中持久化；订单失败不能留下被宣称成功使用的地址。订单保存独立 `delivery_address_snapshot`，后续地址变化不影响历史。
    
    ## 3. 菜品、配置与媒体
    
    ### dishes / dish_allergens
    
    | 字段 | 类型与规则 |
    | --- | --- |
    | dishes.id | UUID 主键 |
    | name | VARCHAR(100)，非空英文名称 |
    | description | VARCHAR(2000)，非空英文描述 |
    | base_price_cents | BIGINT，非负且不超过安全整数上界 |
    | category | Category 枚举 |
    | protein_source | VARCHAR(200)，非空英文内容 |
    | spice | Spice 枚举 |
    | media_id | media_assets 外键；必须指向已验证、可展示的图片 |
    | is_listed | BOOLEAN；只有上架且按目标日期安排的菜品进入员工菜单 |
    | version | 整数；资料、图片、过敏原、配置或价格变化均递增 |
    | created_at, updated_at | UTC 时间 |
    | dish_allergens | `(dish_id,allergen)` 复合主键，dish_id 外键；空集合表示无已声明过敏原 |
    
    索引：`(is_listed,category,name,id)`、`(name,id)`；名称不是唯一身份。关键词按名称/描述进行不区分大小写的包含查询，转义 LIKE 的 `%`、`_`、反斜线等字符，输入是文字，不是查询语法；500 菜品规模先测量现有索引和分页，无需引入搜索服务。
    
    菜品基础标签存于 dish_allergens；选项标签存于 option_allergens，不能将所有加料混写为菜品基础标签。下架不删除菜品、历史条目或供应；再次上架也不会改变已成交快照。管理员编辑按 dish 根行锁串行化，并校验 expected version，子表修改与 dish version 递增原子完成。
    
    ### customization_groups / customization_options
    
    | 实体 | 字段与约束 |
    | --- | --- |
    | customization_groups | `id` UUID；`dish_id` FK；`name` VARCHAR(100) 非空；`selection_mode` Single/Multiple；`required` BOOLEAN；`display_order` 非负整数 |
    | customization_options | `id` UUID；`group_id` FK；`name` VARCHAR(100) 非空；`extra_price_cents` 非负 BIGINT；`display_order` 非负整数 |
    | option_allergens | `(option_id,allergen)` 复合主键；option_id 外键，allergen 使用统一枚举；空集合表示未标记 |
    
    索引：groups `(dish_id,display_order,id)`，options `(group_id,display_order,id)`。配置组和选项由所属 dish version 覆盖，不单独建立与菜品不一致的报价版本。
    
    普通配置有效过敏原 = dish_allergens ∪ 已选 option_allergens；报价逐条计算告警，不混入同菜其他配置；FLAGGED_ALLERGEN 的 itemIndex 指向归并后 Quote.items 的零基序号，allergens 为该条目与个人标记的非空交集。加购和编辑配置出现新的个人匹配时重新提醒，拒绝则保留原条目。AI 过滤使用基础标签与所有当前选项标签的并集。选项标签变动递增 dish version、使旧报价需重新确认；不根据菜名猜测标签，空标签不代表安全承诺。
    
    跨行校验：有配置组时每组至少一个选项；required 组必须选择；Single 组只能选一个；Multiple 组不得重复 option；选项必须属于所提交菜品的有效组。当前配置可在锁 dish 后整体维护；报价与订单保留 option/group ID 及名称/价格/选项过敏原快照，不对这些当前可变子记录建立会破坏历史的级联依赖。
    
    ### media_assets
    
    | 字段 | 类型与规则 |
    | --- | --- |
    | id | UUID 主键 |
    | uploaded_by | users 外键，创建者必须为管理员 |
    | original_filename | VARCHAR(255)，仅审计文本，不参与路径拼接，不作为下载响应的可信文件名 |
    | source_mime, source_bytes | 真实检测的 JPEG/PNG/WebP 类型；输入大小 1–5,242,880 字节 |
    | content_sha256 | 固定长度摘要，便于内容核对；不作为业务权限标识 |
    | width, height | 正整数；解码前/过程中执行像素和内存上限，实施默认每边不超过 8192、总像素不超过 16,777,216 |
    | storage_key | 服务端随机生成的相对资源键，唯一；解析后的路径必须位于受控持久媒体目录内 |
    | served_mime, served_bytes | 统一转换后的 image/jpeg 或 image/png 及字节数；转换产物同样不得超过 5,242,880 字节；若无法在上限内生成则拒绝且保留旧图 |
    | source_attribution | 可选来源及授权说明，用于替代素材的交付记录 |
    | created_at | UTC 时间 |
    
    只有完整解码和转换成功后才写入可引用记录；不保存用户声称的 MIME 作为验证结论，不将原始 SVG/HTML 或可执行内容作为图片发布。文件写入使用临时文件和原子重命名，失败清理临时文件；数据库提交失败导致的无引用资源由受控清理处理。被菜品引用的资源不能删除，媒体目录与数据库一起备份。
    
    ## 4. 每日菜单和共享供应
    package com.webox.media;
    import java.time.Instant;
    import java.time.LocalDateTime;
    import java.time.ZoneOffset;
    import java.util.Optional;
    import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;
    @Repository
    public class MediaRepository {
        private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
        public MediaRepository(JdbcTemplate jdbc) { this.jdbc=jdbc; }
        public Optional<Asset> find(String id) {
            return jdbc.query("SELECT id,storage_key,served_mime,served_bytes,content_sha256,width,height FROM media_assets WHERE id=?",
                (rs,n)->new Asset(rs.getString(1),rs.getString(2),rs.getString(3),rs.getLong(4),rs.getString(5),rs.getInt(6),rs.getInt(7)),id).stream().findFirst();
        }
        public void insert(Asset asset,String uploader,String originalName,String sourceMime,long sourceBytes,String attribution,Instant now) {
            if(!"Admin".equals(jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT role FROM users WHERE id=?",String.class,uploader))) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Only administrators can create media.");
            jdbc.update("INSERT INTO media_assets(id,uploaded_by,original_filename,source_mime,source_bytes,content_sha256,width,height,storage_key,served_mime,served_bytes,source_attribution,created_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                asset.id(),uploader,originalName,sourceMime,sourceBytes,asset.sha256(),asset.width(),asset.height(),asset.storageKey(),asset.mime(),asset.bytes(),attribution,LocalDateTime.ofInstant(now,ZoneOffset.UTC));
        }
        public record Asset(String id,String storageKey,String mime,long bytes,String sha256,int width,int height) {}
    }

                    .orElseThrow(()->new ApiException(404,"NOT_FOUND","This dish is not available."));

            jdbc.query("SELECT a.option_id,a.allergen FROM option_allergens a JOIN customization_options o ON o.id=a.option_id JOIN customization_groups g ON g.id=o.group_id WHERE g.dish_id=? ORDER BY a.allergen",rs->{optionAllergens.computeIfAbsent(rs.getString(1),k->new ArrayList<>()).add(Allergen.valueOf(rs.getString(2)));},id);
            Map<String,List<Option>> options=new HashMap<>();

    package com.webox.inventory;
    import java.sql.Timestamp;
    import java.time.LocalDate;
    import java.util.Map;
    import java.util.UUID;
    import com.webox.shared.BusinessClock;
    import com.webox.shared.ValueRules;
    import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
    import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronizationManager;
    import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;
    /** Typed public payloads prevent accidental persistence of personal order data. */
    @Component
    public class OutboxWriter {
        private final JdbcTemplate jdbc; private final JsonMapper mapper; private final BusinessClock clock;
        public OutboxWriter(JdbcTemplate jdbc,JsonMapper mapper,BusinessClock clock) { this.jdbc=jdbc;this.mapper=mapper;this.clock=clock; }
        public void inventoryUpdated(LocalDate date,UUID dishId,long remaining,long version,long revision) {
            ValueRules.safeInteger(remaining); ValueRules.safeInteger(version); ValueRules.safeInteger(revision);
            if (remaining>Integer.MAX_VALUE) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Stock exceeds the supported limit.");
            write("inventory.updated",date+"/"+dishId,Map.of("deliveryDate",date.toString(),"dishId",dishId.toString(),"remaining",remaining,"version",version,"menuRevision",revision,"occurredAt",clock.now().toString()));
        }
        public void menuChanged(LocalDate date,long revision) {
            ValueRules.safeInteger(revision);
            write("menu.changed",date.toString(),Map.of("deliveryDate",date.toString(),"menuRevision",revision));
        }
        private void write(String type,String aggregate,Map<String,Object> payload) {
            if(!TransactionSynchronizationManager.isActualTransactionActive() || TransactionSynchronizationManager.isCurrentTransactionReadOnly())
                throw new IllegalStateException("Outbox writes require an active business write transaction.");
            Timestamp now=Timestamp.from(clock.now());
            jdbc.update("INSERT INTO outbox_events(id,event_type,aggregate_key,payload,created_at,next_attempt_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                UUID.randomUUID().toString(),type,aggregate,mapper.writeValueAsString(payload),now,now);
        }
    }

    package com.webox.ordering;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
    import com.webox.auth.*;
    import com.webox.inventory.InventoryMutationService;
    import com.webox.shared.*;
    import com.webox.shared.DomainTypes.*;
    import static com.webox.ordering.OrderingModels.*;
    @Service
    public class OrderStatusService {
        private final UserRepository users;private final OrderRepository orders;private final OrderItemRepository items;private final InventoryMutationService inventory;private final OrderTransactionExecutor transactions;private final BusinessClock clock;
        public OrderStatusService(UserRepository users,OrderRepository orders,OrderItemRepository items,InventoryMutationService inventory,OrderTransactionExecutor transactions,BusinessClock clock) {this.users=users;this.orders=orders;this.items=items;this.inventory=inventory;this.transactions=transactions;this.clock=clock;}
        public Order cancel(String user,String id) { return change(user,id,OrderStatus.Cancelled,null,false); }
        public Order administer(UserIdentity actor,String id,OrderStatus target,long expectedVersion) {
            if(actor.role()!=Role.Admin) throw new ApiException(403,"FORBIDDEN","Administrator access is required.");ValueRules.safeInteger(expectedVersion);return change(actor.userId(),id,target,expectedVersion,true);
        }
        private Order change(String actor,String id,OrderStatus target,Long version,boolean administrator) {
            var located=orders.find(id).orElseThrow(OrderRepository::missing);String owner=located.userId();if(!administrator && !owner.equals(actor)) throw OrderRepository.missing();
            return transactions.execute(()->{
                users.lockOwner(owner).orElseThrow(OrderRepository::missing);var order=orders.lock(id,owner);
                if(order.status()==OrderStatus.Cancelled && target==OrderStatus.Cancelled) return orders.view(order);
                if(administrator && order.version()!=version) throw new ApiException(409,"VERSION_CONFLICT","This order has changed. Reload its current status.");
                boolean allowed=order.status()==OrderStatus.Pending && (target==OrderStatus.Confirmed || target==OrderStatus.Cancelled) || order.status()==OrderStatus.Confirmed && target==OrderStatus.Completed;
                if(!allowed) throw new ApiException(409,administrator?"INVALID_ORDER_TRANSITION":"ORDER_NOT_CANCELLABLE",administrator?"This order status change is not allowed.":"Only a pending order can be cancelled.");
                if(target==OrderStatus.Cancelled) inventory.restore(inventory.lock(order.date(),items.list(order.id())));
                orders.transition(order,target,clock.now());return orders.owned(id,owner);
            },null);
        }
    }

    | 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS / UNAUTHENTICATED | 登录错误或会话失效；前者明确英文反馈，后者进入登录 |
    | 403 FORBIDDEN / CSRF_INVALID | 权限不足或 token 不匹配；不可通过改客户端身份恢复权限 |
    | 404 NOT_FOUND | 不存在或无权查看的个人资源，不泄露 owner |
    | 409 EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED | 规范化邮箱已存在；改邮箱或登录 |
    | 422 INVALID_DELIVERY_DATE / ORDER_LIMIT_EXCEEDED | 过去日期或总份数超限；调整选择 |
    | 409 SLOT_EXPIRED | 附 suggestedDeliveryDate/suggestedMeal；明确切换并重新确认 |
    | 409 ACTIVE_ORDER_EXISTS | 附 existingOrderId；打开已有有效订单，不跳到更晚餐次绕过 |
    | 409 DISH_CHANGED / DISH_UNAVAILABLE | 附 itemIssues；展示变化并重新确认，不静默改价/替换 |
    | 409 INSUFFICIENT_STOCK | 附具体 dishId 与 availableQuantity；整单失败、保留购物车 |
    | 409 QUOTE_EXPIRED / QUOTE_CONSUMED | 重新报价；已成功的同 key 必须仍重放，不返回该错误 |
    | 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED | 同成功 key 不同内容；不自动覆盖或返回另一笔新单 |
    | 409 VERSION_CONFLICT | 运营/偏好资料被并发修改；重读最新内容再确认保存 |
    | 409 ORDER_NOT_CANCELLABLE / INVALID_ORDER_TRANSITION | 状态不允许，展示最新状态；不回退、不恢复不该恢复的库存 |
    | 409 SUPPLY_BELOW_ALLOCATED | 新总量低于现有占用；保留当前总量并提示限制 |
    | 413 IMAGE_TOO_LARGE / 415 IMAGE_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED / 422 IMAGE_INVALID | 文件大小、类型或真实解码失败；允许重新选图 |
    | 429 RATE_LIMITED / 503 TEMPORARY_UNAVAILABLE | 有界限流或锁等待/依赖暂不可用；遵循 Retry-After，重试写订单复用原 key |
    | 503 AI_BUSY / AI_UNAVAILABLE | 流建立前模型队列满或不可用；普通菜单继续可用 |
    
    流建立后的 AI 错误以 [streaming.md](streaming.md) 的 error 事件结束，不将 HTTP 200 误认为完成；INTENT_CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED 是产品内对用户诉求的反馈，不是本计划仍有未决需求。

        ## 实现
        
        V011保存偏好根、菜系和过敏原集合。首次读取为version0；PUT只操作登录者，先锁user再锁偏好，校验expectedVersion后整体替换，清除保留根并递增版本。预算必须同时为空或同时为非负安全整数且下限不大于上限；缺字段、重复/未知枚举、非整数和越界均拒绝。12个并发替换只有1个成功，11个409，集合不会交叉混入。
        
        Recommended for Me保持搜索和菜系筛选，按偏好菜系、组内辣度、名称/ID排序；口味强度仅保存供推荐使用。匹配字段在个人请求中计算，公共菜品版本缓存不含用户偏好；另一账号读取同一缓存不会得到前一账号的标记。
        
        统一购物车入口检查基础标签及实际选项，匹配个人过敏原后弹窗列出新增命中项。拒绝/Escape保持原配置、份数和金额；继续才原子应用。配置编辑保留份数、同配置归并；增加同一已确认配置不重复提醒，新增匹配再次确认。确认期间购物车或偏好变化时要求重试，防止旧确认应用到新状态。确认只在当前账号会话中保留，草稿不持久化个人过敏原确认。

            }

    package com.webox.auth;
    import com.webox.shared.*;
    import com.webox.shared.DomainTypes.Role;
    import java.util.Locale;
    import java.util.UUID;
    import jakarta.validation.Validator;
    import jakarta.validation.constraints.Email;
    import org.springframework.dao.DuplicateKeyException;
    import org.springframework.security.crypto.argon2.Argon2PasswordEncoder;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
    @Service
    public class AuthService {
        // Argon2id: 19 MiB memory, 2 iterations, parallelism 1, 16-byte salt, 32-byte hash.
        private final Argon2PasswordEncoder passwords=new Argon2PasswordEncoder(16,32,1,19456,2);
        private final String dummyHash=passwords.encode(UUID.randomUUID().toString());
        private final UserRepository users;private final BusinessClock clock;private final Validator validator;
        public AuthService(UserRepository users,BusinessClock clock,Validator validator) { this.users=users;this.clock=clock;this.validator=validator; }
        record EmailInput(@Email String value) {}
        public String email(String value) {
            String clean;
            try { clean=ValueRules.requiredText(value,200); } catch(IllegalArgumentException e) { throw ApiException.validation("email","Enter a valid email address of at most 200 characters."); }
            if(!validator.validate(new EmailInput(clean)).isEmpty()) throw ApiException.validation("email","Enter a valid email address.");
            return clean;
        }
        private String password(String value) {
            try { return ValueRules.password(value); } catch(IllegalArgumentException e) { throw ApiException.validation("password","Password must contain 8 to 128 characters, including a letter and a number."); }
        }
        public UserIdentity register(String email,String password) { return create(email(email),password(password),Role.Employee); }
        private UserIdentity create(String email,String password,Role role) {
            var row=new UserRepository.UserRow(UUID.randomUUID().toString(),email,email.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT),passwords.encode(password),role);
            try { users.insert(row,clock.now()); }
            catch(DuplicateKeyException e) { throw new ApiException(409,"EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED","This email is already registered. Please sign in."); }
            return row.identity();
        }
        public UserIdentity login(String input,String rawPassword) {
            String email=email(input);String password=password(rawPassword);
            var found=users.byEmail(email.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT));
            boolean valid=passwords.matches(password,found.map(UserRepository.UserRow::passwordHash).orElse(dummyHash));
            if(!valid || found.isEmpty()) throw new ApiException(401,"INVALID_CREDENTIALS","Email or password is incorrect.");
            return found.get().identity();
        }
        public UserIdentity initializeAdmin(String input,String initialPassword) {
            String email=email(input);var existing=users.byEmail(email.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT));
            if(existing.isPresent()) {
                if(existing.get().role()!=Role.Admin) throw new IllegalStateException("The configured administrator email belongs to an employee; refusing to elevate it.");
                return existing.get().identity();
            }
            return create(email,password(initialPassword),Role.Admin);
        }
    }
    package com.webox.shared;
    
    import java.util.Locale;
    import java.util.regex.Pattern;
    
    /** Shared scalar rules. No floating point is used for money. */
    public final class ValueRules {
        public static final long MAX_SAFE_INTEGER = 9007199254740991L;
        private static final Pattern EDGE_SPACE = Pattern.compile("^[\\x09-\\x0D\\x20\\u00A0\\u1680\\u2000-\\u200A\\u2028\\u2029\\u202F\\u205F\\u3000\\uFEFF]+|[\\x09-\\x0D\\x20\\u00A0\\u1680\\u2000-\\u200A\\u2028\\u2029\\u202F\\u205F\\u3000\\uFEFF]+$");
        private ValueRules() {}
        public static String uuid(String value) {
            if(value==null || !value.matches("[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid identifier.");
            return java.util.UUID.fromString(value).toString();
        }
        public static java.time.LocalDate date(String value) {
            if(value==null || !value.matches("[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid date.");
            try { return java.time.LocalDate.parse(value); }
            catch(java.time.format.DateTimeParseException e) { throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid date."); }
        }
        public static long safeInteger(long value) {
            if (value < 0 || value > MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Value must be a non-negative safe integer.");
            return value;
        }
        public static long add(long a, long b) {
            safeInteger(a); safeInteger(b);
            if (a > MAX_SAFE_INTEGER - b) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Total exceeds the supported amount.");
            return a + b;
        }
        public static long multiply(long a, long b) {
            safeInteger(a); safeInteger(b);
            if (b != 0 && a > MAX_SAFE_INTEGER / b) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Total exceeds the supported amount.");
            return a * b;
        }
        public static long nextVersion(long value) { return add(value, 1); }
        public static String money(long cents) {
            safeInteger(cents);
            return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%d.%02d", cents / 100, cents % 100);
        }
        public static String requiredText(String text, int max) {
            if (text == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("This field is required.");
            String normalized = EDGE_SPACE.matcher(text).replaceAll("");
            int length = codePoints(normalized);
            if (length == 0 || length > max) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Text must contain 1 to " + max + " characters.");
            return normalized;
        }
        public static String password(String text) {
            int length = codePoints(text);
            if (length < 8 || length > 128 || !Pattern.compile("[A-Za-z]").matcher(text).find() || !Pattern.compile("[0-9]").matcher(text).find())
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Password must contain 8 to 128 characters, including a letter and a number.");
            return text;
        }
        public static int codePoints(String text) {
            if (text == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("This field is required.");
            for (int i=0; i<text.length(); i++) {
                char c=text.charAt(i);
                if (Character.isHighSurrogate(c)) {
                    if (++i >= text.length() || !Character.isLowSurrogate(text.charAt(i))) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Text contains invalid Unicode.");
                } else if (Character.isLowSurrogate(c)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Text contains invalid Unicode.");
            }
            return text.codePointCount(0,text.length());
        }
    }

        package com.webox.media;
        import java.awt.image.BufferedImage;
        import java.io.*;
        import java.util.*;
        import javax.imageio.*;
        import javax.imageio.stream.MemoryCacheImageInputStream;
        import com.webox.shared.ApiException;
        import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
        @Component
        public class ImageCodec {
            public static final int MAX_BYTES=5_242_880,MAX_SIDE=8192;
            public static final long MAX_PIXELS=16_777_216;
            public record Decoded(BufferedImage image,String sourceMime) {}
            public Decoded decode(byte[] bytes,String claimedMime) {
                if(bytes.length==0) throw invalid();if(bytes.length>MAX_BYTES) throw tooLarge();
                try(var input=new MemoryCacheImageInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(bytes))) {
                    var readers=ImageIO.getImageReaders(input);if(!readers.hasNext()) throw unsupported();var reader=readers.next();
                    try {
                        String format=reader.getFormatName().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);if(format.equals("jpg"))format="jpeg";
                        if(!Set.of("jpeg","png","webp").contains(format))throw unsupported();String mime="image/"+format;
                        if(claimedMime==null || !mime.equals(claimedMime.split(";",2)[0].strip().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)))throw unsupported();
                        reader.setInput(input,true,true);int width=reader.getWidth(0),height=reader.getHeight(0);
                        if(width<1 || height<1 || width>MAX_SIDE || height>MAX_SIDE || (long)width*height>MAX_PIXELS)throw invalid();
                        var warning=new java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean();reader.addIIOReadWarningListener((source,message)->warning.set(true));var decoded=reader.read(0);
                        if(decoded==null || warning.get() || decoded.getWidth()!=width || decoded.getHeight()!=height)throw invalid();
                        return new Decoded(decoded,mime);
                    } finally {reader.dispose();}
                } catch(ApiException e) {throw e;}catch(IOException | RuntimeException e) {throw invalid();}
            }
            public byte[] encode(BufferedImage image,String format) {
                // The cap applies while writing and again at the service boundary.
                var output=new ByteArrayOutputStream() {
                    private void check(int count) {if((long)size()+count>MAX_BYTES)throw tooLarge();}
                    @Override public synchronized void write(int value) {check(1);super.write(value);}
                    @Override public synchronized void write(byte[] bytes,int offset,int length) {check(length);super.write(bytes,offset,length);}
                };
                try {if(!ImageIO.write(image,format,output))throw invalid();return output.toByteArray();}
                catch(ApiException e) {throw e;}catch(IOException | RuntimeException e) {throw invalid();}
            }
            public static ApiException invalid() {return new ApiException(422,"IMAGE_INVALID","Use a complete image no larger than 8192 pixels per side and 16,777,216 pixels in total.");}
            public static ApiException unsupported() {return new ApiException(415,"IMAGE_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED","Upload a JPEG, PNG or WebP image with its matching content type.");}
            public static ApiException tooLarge() {return new ApiException(413,"IMAGE_TOO_LARGE","The uploaded image and its display copy must each be at most 5 MiB.");}
        }

        import java.io.*;
        import java.nio.file.*;
        import java.security.*;
        import java.util.*;
        import com.webox.auth.UserIdentity;
        import com.webox.shared.*;
        import com.webox.shared.DomainTypes.Role;
        import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
        import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
        import org.springframework.transaction.support.*;
        import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;
        @Service
        public class MediaService {
            private final MediaRepository media;private final ImageCodec codec;private final Path root;private final BusinessClock clock;
            public MediaService(MediaRepository media,ImageCodec codec,Path mediaRoot,BusinessClock clock) throws IOException {this.media=media;this.codec=codec;this.root=mediaRoot.toRealPath();this.clock=clock;}
            public record Media(String mediaId,String url,String contentType,long byteLength) {}
            @Transactional public Media upload(UserIdentity actor,MultipartFile file) {
                if(actor.role()!=Role.Admin)throw new ApiException(403,"FORBIDDEN","Administrator access is required.");
                if(file==null || file.isEmpty())throw ImageCodec.invalid();if(file.getSize()>ImageCodec.MAX_BYTES)throw ImageCodec.tooLarge();
                try(var input=file.getInputStream()) {return store(actor,input.readNBytes(ImageCodec.MAX_BYTES+1),file.getContentType(),file.getOriginalFilename(),null);}
                catch(IOException e) {throw ImageCodec.invalid();}
            }
            @Transactional public Media store(UserIdentity actor,byte[] source,String mime,String original,String attribution) {
                if(actor.role()!=Role.Admin)throw new ApiException(403,"FORBIDDEN","Administrator access is required.");
                var decoded=codec.decode(source,mime);String format=decoded.sourceMime().equals("image/jpeg")?"jpeg":"png";byte[] encoded;
                try {encoded=codec.encode(decoded.image(),format);}finally{decoded.image().flush();}
                if(encoded.length==0)throw ImageCodec.invalid();if(encoded.length>ImageCodec.MAX_BYTES)throw ImageCodec.tooLarge();
                String name=original==null || original.isBlank()?"upload":original;if(ValueRules.codePoints(name)>255)name=name.substring(0,name.offsetByCodePoints(0,255));
                String id=UUID.randomUUID().toString(),key=id+"."+format;Path destination=root.resolve(key);Path temporary=null;
                try {
                    temporary=Files.createTempFile(root,"upload-",".tmp");Files.write(temporary,encoded);Files.move(temporary,destination,StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE);
                    TransactionSynchronizationManager.registerSynchronization(new TransactionSynchronization() { @Override public void afterCompletion(int status) {if(status!=STATUS_COMMITTED)delete(destination);} });
                    String sha=HexFormat.of().formatHex(MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(encoded));
                    media.insert(new MediaRepository.Asset(id,key,"image/"+format,encoded.length,sha,decoded.image().getWidth(),decoded.image().getHeight()),actor.userId(),name,decoded.sourceMime(),source.length,attribution,clock.now());
                    return new Media(id,"/media/"+id,"image/"+format,encoded.length);
                } catch(IOException | NoSuchAlgorithmException e) {delete(destination);throw new ApiException(503,"TEMPORARY_UNAVAILABLE","The image could not be stored. Please try again.",true,Map.of());}
                catch(RuntimeException e) {delete(destination);throw e;}
                finally {if(temporary!=null)delete(temporary);}
            }
            private static void delete(Path path) {try{Files.deleteIfExists(path);}catch(IOException ignored){/* Unreferenced files are handled by media maintenance. */}}
        }

        package com.webox.catalog;
        import java.time.LocalDate;
        import java.util.*;
        import com.webox.inventory.OutboxWriter;
        import com.webox.shared.*;
        import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
        import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
        import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronizationManager;
        @Component
        public class CatalogChangePublisher {
            private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;private final OutboxWriter outbox;private final MenuDetailsCache cache;private final BusinessClock clock;
            public CatalogChangePublisher(JdbcTemplate jdbc,OutboxWriter outbox,MenuDetailsCache cache,BusinessClock clock){this.jdbc=jdbc;this.outbox=outbox;this.cache=cache;this.clock=clock;}
            /** Caller already holds the dish root. Daily-menu writers acquire that root before membership changes. */
            public void changed(String dish,String actor) {
                if(!TransactionSynchronizationManager.isActualTransactionActive() || TransactionSynchronizationManager.isCurrentTransactionReadOnly())throw new IllegalStateException("Catalog changes require a write transaction.");
                var dates=jdbc.query("SELECT delivery_date FROM daily_supply WHERE dish_id=? ORDER BY delivery_date",(rs,n)->rs.getDate(1).toLocalDate(),dish);var revisions=new LinkedHashMap<LocalDate,Long>();
                for(var date:dates)revisions.put(date,jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT revision FROM daily_menus WHERE delivery_date=? FOR UPDATE",Long.class,date));
                for(var entry:revisions.entrySet()) {
                    LocalDate date=entry.getKey();jdbc.queryForList("SELECT version FROM daily_supply WHERE delivery_date=? AND dish_id=? FOR UPDATE",date,dish);long next=ValueRules.nextVersion(entry.getValue());
                    jdbc.update("UPDATE daily_menus SET revision=?,updated_by=?,updated_at=? WHERE delivery_date=?",next,actor,java.sql.Timestamp.from(clock.now()),date);outbox.menuChanged(date,next);
                }
                cache.invalidateAfterCommit(Set.of(dish));
            }
        }

                long revision=revision(date,false).orElse(0L);var rows=jdbc.query("SELECT s.dish_id,d.name,s.scheduled,s.total_quantity,s.allocated_quantity,s.version FROM daily_supply s JOIN dishes d ON d.id=s.dish_id WHERE s.delivery_date=? ORDER BY d.name,d.id",(rs,n)->new Supply(rs.getString(1),rs.getString(2),rs.getBoolean(3),rs.getInt(4),rs.getInt(5),rs.getInt(4)-rs.getInt(5),rs.getLong(6)),date);return new DailyMenu(date,revision,rows);
            }
            @Transactional(isolation=Isolation.READ_COMMITTED)
            public DailyMenu replace(UserIdentity actor,LocalDate date,DailyMenuWrite body) {
                AdminDishService.admin(actor);if(body==null || body.expectedRevision()==null || body.items()==null)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Provide the menu revision and supply items.");ValueRules.safeInteger(body.expectedRevision());var requested=new TreeMap<String,Integer>();
                for(var item:body.items()){if(item==null || item.totalQuantity()==null || item.totalQuantity()<0)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Supply must be a non-negative integer.");String id=ValueRules.uuid(item.dishId());if(requested.putIfAbsent(id,item.totalQuantity())!=null)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Each dish may appear only once.");}
                AdminDishService.version(revision(date,false).orElse(0L),body.expectedRevision());
                var ids=new TreeSet<>(jdbc.queryForList("SELECT dish_id FROM daily_supply WHERE delivery_date=?",String.class,date));ids.addAll(requested.keySet());
                for(String id:ids) if(jdbc.queryForList("SELECT id FROM dishes WHERE id=? FOR UPDATE",String.class,id).isEmpty())throw ApiException.validation("items.dishId","Choose an existing dish.");
                var current=revision(date,true);AdminDishService.version(current.orElse(0L),body.expectedRevision());Timestamp now=Timestamp.from(clock.now());
                if(current.isEmpty()) {try{jdbc.update("INSERT INTO daily_menus VALUES (?,?,?,?)",date,0,actor.userId(),now);}catch(DuplicateKeyException e){throw new ApiException(409,"VERSION_CONFLICT","This menu changed. Reload and review before saving.");}}
                long next=ValueRules.nextVersion(body.expectedRevision());var events=new ArrayList<Supply>();
                for(String id:ids) {
                    var rows=jdbc.query("SELECT scheduled,total_quantity,allocated_quantity,version FROM daily_supply WHERE delivery_date=? AND dish_id=? FOR UPDATE",(rs,n)->new Supply(id,"",rs.getBoolean(1),rs.getInt(2),rs.getInt(3),rs.getInt(2)-rs.getInt(3),rs.getLong(4)),date,id);boolean scheduled=requested.containsKey(id);
                    if(rows.isEmpty()) {int total=requested.get(id);jdbc.update("INSERT INTO daily_supply VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",date,id,true,total,0,1,now);events.add(new Supply(id,"",true,total,0,total,1));continue;}
                    var old=rows.get(0);int total=requested.getOrDefault(id,old.totalQuantity());if(total<old.allocatedQuantity())throw new ApiException(409,"SUPPLY_BELOW_ALLOCATED","Total supply cannot be lower than the portions already allocated.");
                    if(scheduled!=old.scheduled() || total!=old.totalQuantity()) {long version=ValueRules.nextVersion(old.version());jdbc.update("UPDATE daily_supply SET scheduled=?,total_quantity=?,version=?,updated_at=? WHERE delivery_date=? AND dish_id=?",scheduled,total,version,now,date,id);events.add(new Supply(id,"",scheduled,total,old.allocatedQuantity(),total-old.allocatedQuantity(),version));}
                }
                jdbc.update("UPDATE daily_menus SET revision=?,updated_by=?,updated_at=? WHERE delivery_date=?",next,actor.userId(),now,date);
                for(var event:events)outbox.inventoryUpdated(date,UUID.fromString(event.dishId()),event.remaining(),event.version(),next);outbox.menuChanged(date,next);return get(date);
            }
        }

        import java.time.*;
        import java.util.*;
        import com.webox.auth.*;

        import com.webox.shared.DomainTypes.*;
        import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
        import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.*;
        import static com.webox.ordering.OrderingModels.*;
        @Service
        @Transactional(readOnly=true,isolation=Isolation.REPEATABLE_READ)
        public class AdminOrderService {
            private final OrderRepository orders;private final UserRepository users;
            public AdminOrderService(OrderRepository orders,UserRepository users){this.orders=orders;this.users=users;}
            public record AdminOrder(String orderId,String orderNumber,LocalDate deliveryDate,Meal meal,String addressText,OrderStatus status,List<PricedLine> items,int totalQuantity,long totalCents,long version,Instant createdAt,Instant updatedAt,UserIdentity customer) {
                public static AdminOrder of(Order order,UserIdentity customer){return new AdminOrder(order.orderId(),order.orderNumber(),order.deliveryDate(),order.meal(),order.addressText(),order.status(),order.items(),order.totalQuantity(),order.totalCents(),order.version(),order.createdAt(),order.updatedAt(),customer);}
            }
            public record AdminOrderPage(List<AdminOrder> items,int page,int size,long totalElements) {}
            private AdminOrder view(OrderRepository.Row row){return AdminOrder.of(orders.view(row),users.byId(row.userId()).orElseThrow(OrderRepository::missing).identity());}
            public AdminOrder get(UserIdentity actor,String id){AdminDishService.admin(actor);return view(orders.find(id).orElseThrow(OrderRepository::missing));}
            public AdminOrderPage page(UserIdentity actor,LocalDate date,Meal meal,OrderStatus status,int page,int size){AdminDishService.admin(actor);var rows=orders.operationalPage(date,meal,status,page,size);return new AdminOrderPage(rows.rows().stream().map(this::view).toList(),page,size,rows.total());}
        }
