    package com.webox.shared;
    import java.util.List;
    import java.util.Map;
    import java.util.Set;
    /** Only server-authored messages and authorized context belong in public errors. */
    public final class ApiException extends RuntimeException {
        private static final Set<String> CONTEXT_KEYS = Set.of("fieldErrors", "itemIssues", "existingOrderId", "suggestedDeliveryDate", "suggestedMeal");
        private final int status;
        private final String code;
        private final boolean retryable;
        private final Map<String,Object> context;
        public ApiException(int status, String code, String message) { this(status,code,message,false,Map.of()); }
        public ApiException(int status, String code, String message, boolean retryable, Map<String,Object> context) {
            super(message);
            if (!CONTEXT_KEYS.containsAll(context.keySet())) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported error context.");
            this.status=status; this.code=code; this.retryable=retryable; this.context=Map.copyOf(context);
        }
        public int status() { return status; }
        public String code() { return code; }
        public boolean retryable() { return retryable; }
        public Map<String,Object> context() { return context; }
        public static ApiException validation(String field, String message) {
            return new ApiException(400,"VALIDATION_ERROR","Please check the highlighted fields.",false,
                    Map.of("fieldErrors",List.of(Map.of("field",field,"message",message))));
        }
    }

    import { expect, it } from 'vitest';
    import { cartReducer, initialCart, totalCents, totalQuantity } from './cartReducer';
    import { configuration } from './configuration';
    import { pasta, spaghetti, fusilli, cheese } from './cartFixtures';
    it('normalizes option order, merges matching configurations and totals two pasta at 5900 cents', () => {
      let state = cartReducer(initialCart, { type: 'add', dish: pasta, optionIds: [cheese, spaghetti] });
      state = cartReducer(state, { type: 'add', dish: pasta, optionIds: [spaghetti, cheese, cheese] });
      expect(state.lines).toHaveLength(1);expect(totalQuantity(state)).toBe(2);expect(totalCents(state)).toBe(5900);
      state = cartReducer(state, { type: 'add', dish: pasta, optionIds: [fusilli] });
      expect(state.lines).toHaveLength(2);expect(totalCents(state)).toBe(8550);
    });
    it('rejects missing required, multiple single choices and foreign options', () => {
      for (const optionIds of [[], [spaghetti, fusilli], [spaghetti, 'foreign']]) expect(() => configuration(pasta, optionIds)).toThrow();
      expect(configuration(pasta, [cheese], false).unitPriceCents).toBe(2950);
    });
    it('processes fast actions exactly once and caps all increases at five or stock', () => {
      let state = initialCart;
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) state = cartReducer(state, { type: 'add', dish: pasta, optionIds: [spaghetti] });
      expect(totalQuantity(state)).toBe(5);expect(state.error).toMatch(/5/);
      state = cartReducer(state, { type: 'decrease', key: state.lines[0].key });expect(totalQuantity(state)).toBe(4);
      state = cartReducer(state, { type: 'add', dish: pasta, optionIds: [spaghetti] });expect(totalQuantity(state)).toBe(5);
      state = cartReducer(state, { type: 'remove', key: state.lines[0].key });expect(totalQuantity(state)).toBe(0);
      state = cartReducer(state, { type: 'add', dish: { ...pasta, remaining: 0 }, optionIds: [spaghetti] });expect(totalQuantity(state)).toBe(0);expect(state.error).toBeTruthy();
    });
    it('removes only submitted quantities while keeping additions made during submission', () => {
      let state = cartReducer(initialCart, { type: 'add', dish: pasta, optionIds: [spaghetti] });const submitted = [{ key: state.lines[0].key, quantity: 1 }];
      state = cartReducer(state, { type: 'add', dish: pasta, optionIds: [spaghetti] });
      state = cartReducer(state, { type: 'submitted', lines: submitted });expect(totalQuantity(state)).toBe(1);
    });
    it('rejects unsafe total arithmetic', () => {
      expect(() => configuration({ ...pasta, basePriceCents: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER }, [spaghetti, cheese])).toThrow();
      const expensive = { ...pasta, basePriceCents: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER };
      const state = cartReducer(initialCart, { type: 'add', dish: expensive, optionIds: [spaghetti] });
      const rejected = cartReducer(state, { type: 'add', dish: expensive, optionIds: [spaghetti] });
      expect(totalQuantity(rejected)).toBe(1);expect(rejected.error).toMatch(/limit/);
    });
    it('applies the stock limit across different configurations without changing existing prices', () => {
      const limited = { ...pasta, remaining: 1 };
      const first = cartReducer(initialCart, { type: 'add', dish: limited, optionIds: [spaghetti] });
      const blocked = cartReducer(first, { type: 'add', dish: limited, optionIds: [fusilli] });
      expect(totalQuantity(blocked)).toBe(1);expect(blocked.error).toMatch(/Only 1/);
      const changed = cartReducer(first, { type: 'add', dish: { ...pasta, dishVersion: 2, basePriceCents: 3000 }, optionIds: [spaghetti] });
      expect(changed.error).toMatch(/Review/);expect(totalCents(changed)).toBe(2650);
    });

    import { beforeEach, expect, it } from 'vitest';
    import { loadDraft, reconcileDraft, saveDraft } from './cartStorage';
    import { cartReducer, initialCart } from './cartReducer';
    import { pasta, spaghetti } from './cartFixtures';
    const employeeA = '10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000011', employeeB = '10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000012';
    beforeEach(() => localStorage.clear());
    it('keeps drafts by confirmed account, survives reload and stores no credentials or checkout context', () => {
      const state = cartReducer(initialCart, { type: 'add', dish: pasta, optionIds: [spaghetti] });
      expect(saveDraft(employeeA, state)).toBeNull();expect(loadDraft(employeeA).draft.lines[0].quantity).toBe(1);
      expect(loadDraft(employeeB).draft.lines).toEqual([]);
      const persisted = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(`webox.cart.v1:${employeeA}`)!);
      expect(Object.keys(persisted).sort()).toEqual(['lines', 'version']);
      expect(Object.keys(persisted.lines[0]).sort()).toEqual(['dishId', 'dishVersion', 'quantity', 'selectedOptionIds', 'snapshot']);
      expect(JSON.stringify(persisted)).not.toMatch(/password|token|address|quote|preferenceMatch/);
    });
    it('rejects malformed, unsupported and impossible drafts with a visible recovery reason', () => {
      for (const value of ['{', JSON.stringify({ version: 99, lines: [] }), JSON.stringify({ version: 1, lines: [{ quantity: 6 }] })]) {
        localStorage.setItem(`webox.cart.v1:${employeeA}`, value);expect(loadDraft(employeeA).draft.lines).toEqual([]);expect(loadDraft(employeeA).error).toBeTruthy();
      }
    });
    it('revalidates current dishes and flags changed or unavailable items without submitting anything', async () => {
      saveDraft(employeeA, cartReducer(initialCart, { type: 'add', dish: pasta, optionIds: [spaghetti] }));
      const draft = loadDraft(employeeA).draft;
      expect((await reconcileDraft(draft, async () => ({ ...pasta, dishVersion: 2, basePriceCents: 3000 }))).changed).toContain(pasta.dishId);
      expect((await reconcileDraft(draft, async () => null)).unavailable).toContain(pasta.dishId);
    });
    it('keeps unconfirmed prices across reload, strips unknown fields and confirms explicitly', async () => {
      saveDraft(employeeA, cartReducer(initialCart, { type: 'add', dish: pasta, optionIds: [spaghetti] }));
      const draft = loadDraft(employeeA).draft;
      const changed = await reconcileDraft(draft, async () => ({ ...pasta, dishVersion: 2, basePriceCents: 3000 }));
      Object.assign(changed.state.lines[0].original!.snapshot, { token: 'must-not-persist' });
      saveDraft(employeeA, changed.state);expect(localStorage.getItem(`webox.cart.v1:${employeeA}`)).not.toContain('token');
      expect(loadDraft(employeeA).draft.lines[0].dishVersion).toBe(1);expect(loadDraft(employeeA).draft.lines[0].snapshot.unitPriceCents).toBe(2650);
      const confirmed = cartReducer(changed.state, { type: 'confirm', key: changed.state.lines[0].key });saveDraft(employeeA, confirmed);
      expect(loadDraft(employeeA).draft.lines[0].dishVersion).toBe(2);expect(loadDraft(employeeA).draft.lines[0].snapshot.unitPriceCents).toBe(3000);
    });

    #!/usr/bin/env bash

    if [[ -z "${JAVA_HOME:-}" && -x "$webox_root/.local/toolchains/java17/bin/java" ]]; then
      export JAVA_HOME="$webox_root/.local/toolchains/java17"
    fi
    if [[ -n "${JAVA_HOME:-}" ]]; then
      export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
    fi
    webox_java_version="$(java -version 2>&1 | head -1)"
    case "$webox_java_version" in
      *'version "17.'*) ;;
      *) printf 'JDK 17 is required; found %s. Set JAVA_HOME to a JDK 17 installation.\n' "$webox_java_version" >&2; exit 1 ;;
    esac
    export MAVEN_USER_HOME="${MAVEN_USER_HOME:-$webox_root/.local/maven}"
    export MAVEN_SKIP_RC=1
    cd "$webox_root/backend"
    exec ./mvnw "-Dmaven.repo.local=$MAVEN_USER_HOME/repository" "$@"

    # US5 饮食偏好与提醒验证
    
    日期：2026-10-16。执行者：Codex。T070–T079完成；真实MySQL8.4.11隔离容器，JDK17、Node24，浏览器矩阵沿用[环境记录](environment.md)。
    
    ## 实现
    
    V011保存偏好根、菜系和过敏原集合。首次读取为version0；PUT只操作登录者，先锁user再锁偏好，校验expectedVersion后整体替换，清除保留根并递增版本。预算必须同时为空或同时为非负安全整数且下限不大于上限；缺字段、重复/未知枚举、非整数和越界均拒绝。12个并发替换只有1个成功，11个409，集合不会交叉混入。
    
    Recommended for Me保持搜索和菜系筛选，按偏好菜系、组内辣度、名称/ID排序；口味强度仅保存供推荐使用。匹配字段在个人请求中计算，公共菜品版本缓存不含用户偏好；另一账号读取同一缓存不会得到前一账号的标记。
    
    统一购物车入口检查基础标签及实际选项，匹配个人过敏原后弹窗列出新增命中项。拒绝/Escape保持原配置、份数和金额；继续才原子应用。配置编辑保留份数、同配置归并；增加同一已确认配置不重复提醒，新增匹配再次确认。确认期间购物车或偏好变化时要求重试，防止旧确认应用到新状态。确认只在当前账号会话中保留，草稿不持久化个人过敏原确认。
    
    报价在同一只读快照内读取个人偏好和菜品配置，按归并后的itemIndex逐条返回FLAGGED_ALLERGEN及非空交集，不混同一菜的不同选项。预算仅总价严格大于上限时提示，低于下限和等于上限不提示超出。提醒不阻止合法订单。偏好改变刷新菜单并使未提交报价失效，结果未知的冻结请求保持原key。
    
    ## AC与证据
    
    | AC | 实际结果 |
    | --- | --- |
    | AC-US05-01 | 保存、刷新、重新登录均保留；负数/倒置/单边预算拒绝；并发冲突保留编辑，明确Reload后才能再保存；清除保存后重读为空 |
    | AC-US05-02 | 基础Egg标签与所选Egg选项均能匹配；浏览器拒绝不改购物车，继续才应用；普通菜单不隐藏过敏原菜品 |
    | AC-US05-03 | Japanese/None优先及高亮；开关保留Chinese/Japanese过滤和Salad搜索，关闭恢复名称顺序；后端另外覆盖同菜系内None先于Hot |
    | AC-US05-04 | 真实API及浏览器验证¥30.00无超预算提示、¥30.01提示但成功创建Pending订单；低于下限不额外阻止 |
    | AC-US05-05 | Plain/Ketchup不命中Egg；改Mayonnaise提示Egg，拒绝仍是Ketchup；已确认Egg后改Brioche只新增提示Dairy；Escape保留Plain与原份数 |
    | AC-REV-03（部分） | 普通加购、配置编辑与报价告警部分通过；AI整菜硬过滤留US8，整条AC仍未通过 |

    package com.webox.ordering;
    import java.util.Map;
    import java.util.function.Supplier;
    import org.springframework.dao.*;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
    import org.springframework.transaction.*;
    import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionTemplate;
    import com.webox.shared.ApiException;
    @Component
    public class OrderTransactionExecutor {
        private final TransactionTemplate transaction;
        public OrderTransactionExecutor(PlatformTransactionManager manager) {
            transaction=new TransactionTemplate(manager);transaction.setIsolationLevel(TransactionDefinition.ISOLATION_READ_COMMITTED);transaction.setPropagationBehavior(TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW);
        }
        public <T> T execute(Supplier<T> operation,Supplier<T> uniqueConflict) {
            for(int attempt=0;attempt<3;attempt++) {
                try { return transaction.execute(status->operation.get()); }
                catch(DuplicateKeyException conflict) {
                    // TransactionTemplate has fully rolled back before conflict resolution starts.
                    if(uniqueConflict==null) throw conflict;return transaction.execute(status->uniqueConflict.get());
                } catch(PessimisticLockingFailureException conflict) {
                    if(attempt==2) throw unavailable();java.util.concurrent.locks.LockSupport.parkNanos((attempt+1)*10_000_000L);
                }
            }
            throw unavailable();
        }
        public static ApiException unavailable() { return new ApiException(503,"TEMPORARY_UNAVAILABLE","The order could not be completed yet. Retry with the same request.",true,Map.of()); }
    }

    package com.webox.shared;
    import tools.jackson.core.JsonParser;
    import tools.jackson.databind.DeserializationContext;
    import tools.jackson.databind.ValueDeserializer;
    /** An omitted identifier means create a child; an explicit null is outside the API schema. */
    public final class OptionalIdDeserializer extends ValueDeserializer<String> {
        @Override public String deserialize(JsonParser parser,DeserializationContext context) {return ValueRules.uuid(context.readValue(parser,String.class));}
        @Override public Object getNullValue(DeserializationContext context) {throw new IllegalArgumentException("Omit a new option identifier instead of sending null.");}
        @Override public Object getAbsentValue(DeserializationContext context) {return null;}
    }

    ## Phase 10: User Story 8 — 用自然语言获得个性化选餐建议 (P3，必交付)
    
    **Goal**：真实OpenRouter两阶段推荐，硬过滤和验证后的逐卡流式展示。
    
    # WeBox 流式接口契约
    
    **日期**：2026-10-16
    **状态**：Phase 1 设计；接口与示例是实施目标，不代表服务已运行。
    **依据**：[规格](../spec.md) FR-037–044、[研究](../research.md) R-08–10。公共 HTTP 数据类型见 [OpenAPI](openapi.yaml)，本文补充连接、事件顺序和失败语义。
    
    ## 1. 共通协议
    
    - 公开接口前缀为 `/api/v1`。采用同源 Cookie session；服务器不得接受客户端提供的 userId 作为身份。
    - SSE 响应为 `Content-Type: text/event-stream; charset=utf-8`，禁止缓存与代理缓冲；部署代理须透传流并允许连接持续存活。每个事件使用 `event:`、单行 JSON `data:` 和空行分隔，UTF-8 编码。
    - UUID 字段使用标准 UUID 字符串。配送日期为 `YYYY-MM-DD`，按 `Asia/Shanghai` 解释；事件时间为带 `Z` 的 UTC RFC 3339 时间。
    - `version`、`menuRevision` 为非负 `integer/int64`，公开值限制在 `0..9007199254740991`，确保浏览器可精确比较；到达上限不得环绕或重置。库存 `remaining` 为非负整数，金额沿用公共 HTTP 契约的整数分。
    - 每 15 秒发送 SSE 注释心跳，例如 `: keep-alive`，注释不是业务事件，也不能算有效推荐内容。
    - 返回头发出前，身份失效返回 HTTP 401、权限/CSRF 失败返回 HTTP 403、无效请求返回 HTTP 400，沿用公共错误响应。流开始后无法改变 HTTP 状态；客户端必须读取终止业务事件，不能将 HTTP 200 当作业务完成。
    - 连接使用有界缓冲与写入超时。慢客户端或资源超限时关闭连接，不能无限增长队列、阻塞订单事务或静默丢事件后继续声称连接正常。
    
    ## 2. 库存订阅
    
    ### 2.1 请求与生命周期
    
    `GET /api/v1/menus/{date}/events`
    
    - 使用浏览器同源 `EventSource`，携带现有 session Cookie；这是只读接口，不需要 CSRF token。
    - `{date}` 为合法配送日期。某日没有菜单仍可订阅，初始快照返回空 `items`，后续管理员安排菜单后通知变更。
    - 每个浏览器页面只为当前选中日期保持一条连接；切换日期、退出或离开菜单时主动关闭。建议配置每会话最多 3 条、每应用实例最多 600 条库存连接，连接最长 30 分钟后正常关闭并重连；容量可依据 200 活跃员工场景压测调整，不能无界。
    - 建连时检查 session；每次心跳及事件发送前重新检查会话有效性。过期/撤销后发送 `session.expired` 并关闭，客户端调用 `EventSource.close()`、清除本人敏感页面状态并进入登录流程，不继续自动重连。
    - 网络错误、有限寿命到期或慢客户端关闭后，客户端先刷新会话状态，仍有效时以有上限的退避重新连接。隐藏页恢复可立即重连取得快照；不得让失效 session 持续刷请求。
    - 每次连接和重连均提供完整权威快照。此接口不承诺历史 replay；不依赖 `Last-Event-ID` 恢复，不要求业务事件带 `id:`。
    
    ### 2.2 事件
    
    | 事件 | 数据 | 语义 |
    | --- | --- | --- |
    | `inventory.snapshot` | `{deliveryDate, menuRevision, items:[{dishId, remaining, version}], serverTime}` | 目标日期当前员工可见菜单的完整库存快照；`items:[]` 合法。 |
    | `inventory.updated` | `{deliveryDate, menuRevision, dishId, remaining, version, occurredAt}` | 已提交的某条每日供应的绝对剩余量；不是加减量。 |
    | `menu.changed` | `{deliveryDate, menuRevision}` | 菜单成员、上下架或影响展示/配置的资料变化，要求重新获取该日期菜单。 |
    | `session.expired` | `{message}` | 英文说明会话已失效；终止连接，不携带本人数据。 |
    
    `MenuDish` 展示资料不通过库存事件补齐；收到 `menu.changed` 或未知 dishId 时，客户端重新取得普通菜单响应。菜单分页不限制快照范围：快照包含该日期完整可见菜单的供应信息，供已缓存页面与之后的分页结果合并。
    
    示例（生产 IDs 必须为真实记录）：
    
    ```text
    event: inventory.snapshot
    data: {"deliveryDate":"2026-10-17","menuRevision":12,"items":[{"dishId":"7c3d454a-62ad-4e1e-83b0-d15dcf0a1b99","remaining":4,"version":6}],"serverTime":"2026-10-16T08:00:00Z"}
    
    event: inventory.updated
    data: {"deliveryDate":"2026-10-17","menuRevision":12,"dishId":"7c3d454a-62ad-4e1e-83b0-d15dcf0a1b99","remaining":3,"version":7,"occurredAt":"2026-10-16T08:00:01Z"}
    
    event: menu.changed
    data: {"deliveryDate":"2026-10-17","menuRevision":13}
    
    : keep-alive
    
    event: session.expired
    data: {"message":"Your session has expired. Please sign in again."}
    
    ```
    
    ### 2.3 快照、版本与顺序
    
    服务器必须按下列顺序建立连接，以避免读取快照和开始监听之间漏掉更新：
    
    1. 先为该日期注册订阅并缓冲后续已提交事件。
    2. 在一个一致性只读事务中读取目标日期菜单 revision 与全部当前供应版本/剩余量。
    3. 发出 `inventory.snapshot`。
    4. 排空注册以来的缓冲事件，再进入正常实时发送；快照已覆盖的重复更新可保留，由版本规则幂等处理。
    
    供应版本以 `(deliveryDate, dishId)` 为单调递增范围；同日移出菜单又重新加入不得复用旧版本。菜单 revision 以配送日期为范围单调递增，结构或可展示资料变更时提升；仅库存数量变化不要求提升菜单 revision。跨多个日期生效的菜品变更须通知每个受影响日期。
    
    客户端将快照作为新连接的基准，按 dishId 对照移除快照中不再存在的缓存成员。随后仅应用比已知行版本大的 `inventory.updated`，忽略相同/较小版本；`menu.changed` 仅在 revision 更新时使菜单查询失效。比当前已知菜单 revision 更旧的库存事件不得把已下架成员重新加入页面；新的 revision 或未知成员先触发菜单重取。菜单 HTTP 响应也必须按版本合并，不能用晚到的旧 HTTP 响应覆盖更新的 SSE 数量。
    
    客户端切换日期或发起新连接后，来自旧连接的事件必须丢弃。`serverTime` 是快照读取时间，`occurredAt` 来自业务事务内 outbox 的 created_at；它不是数据库精确提交时间，不用来排序或替代版本。提交到显示的性能验收另以提交完成观测及浏览器采样计时。
    
    ### 2.4 持久化投递与恢复
    
    - 订单创建、取消或供应调整，在同一 MySQL 事务内更新库存版本并写入 outbox；回滚事务不得发出业务事件。
    - 首期单应用实例每 250ms 扫描未发布 outbox 记录，向已注册订阅者广播后标记已发布。扫描依据未发布状态，不使用“主键大于上次扫描 ID”的方式跳过可能晚提交的小 ID 记录。
    - 进程在广播后、标记前退出可能产生重复事件，因此按至少一次设计；客户端版本去重。至少一次不表示每个断线客户端能收到每个历史事件，重连快照才是恢复权威状态的保证。
    - 没有订阅者时也可完成发布标记，未来连接通过快照获得最新状态。慢客户端连接关闭后同样通过重连恢复，不能让其拖延全局 outbox 扫描。
    - 目前不承诺多应用实例广播。横向扩容前必须增加跨实例分发设计与相应验收，不能仅多启动一个实例并沿用单实例内存订阅表。
    
    ## 3. AI 推荐流
    
    ### 3.1 请求
    
    `POST /api/v1/recommendations/stream`
    
    - 浏览器使用同源 `fetch`、Cookie session 和当前 CSRF token 读取 SSE；不使用只支持 GET 的 `EventSource` 发送诉求。
    - Header：`Accept: text/event-stream`、`Content-Type: application/json` 以及公共认证契约规定的 CSRF header。
    - 请求体：
    
    ```json
    {
      "deliveryDate": "2026-10-17",
      "meal": "Lunch",
      "prompt": "I would like a mild Japanese meal, with nothing I ate yesterday."
    }
    ```
    
    `deliveryDate` 为目标配送日，`meal` 为 `Lunch` / `Dinner`；`prompt` trim 后非空，最多 1000 个字符，不截断后悄悄继续。服务器按结算同源规则校验日期/餐次，不把目标餐次自动换成另一餐次后继续推荐。请求不得包含 userId、provider URL、模型名或系统提示词。
    
    为当前请求生成 UUID `requestId`；浏览器发起新诉求时取消前一个请求并忽略旧 requestId 的后续事件。推荐无写订单、无库存预留、无幂等重放义务；重试是读取最新菜单的新推荐。
    
    ### 3.2 事件和终止状态
    
    | 事件 | 数据 | 语义 |
    | --- | --- | --- |
    | `meta` | `{requestId, deliveryDate}` | 流已建立；不表示有有效推荐，不满足首内容时延目标。 |
    | `card` | `{requestId, index, dish:MenuDish, reason}` | 一张已校验、发出前仍可售的卡片；index 从 0 连续递增。`MenuDish` 沿用 OpenAPI 公共 schema。 |
    | `done` | `{requestId, count, outcome:"COMPLETE"\|"NO_MATCH"}` | 正常终止；count 等于已经发出的卡片数。 |
    | `error` | `{requestId, code, message, retryable, partial}` | 失败终止；message 必须为英文，partial 表示此前是否已发出至少一张卡片。 |
    
    - 顺序为一个 `meta`、零至三个 `card`、恰好一个 `done` 或 `error`，然后关闭。请求未通过 HTTP 校验时不会建立该事件序列。
    - `COMPLETE` 的 count 为 1–3；`NO_MATCH` 的 count 为 0，并由界面显示英文说明，例如 “No dishes match your preferences and restrictions for this meal.”。不足三张是合法结果，不为凑数放宽限制。
    - 空候选可由确定性业务筛选直接给出 `NO_MATCH`，此时不需要空耗模型调用。存在候选却收到无效/无意义空输出，不能把 provider 失败冒充 `NO_MATCH`。
    - `reason` 为 1–240 个字符的英文纯文本，由真实模型生成并经服务端校验；前端按文本渲染，不将其解释为 HTML、Markdown 链接或执行指令。
    - `dish` 的名称、图片、价格、配置和库存资料由服务器从真实菜单取得，不采用模型自行生成的商品字段。
    - 已开始流后鉴权失效使用 `error` / `SESSION_EXPIRED`，不扩展此接口的事件类型。
    - 无终止事件的 EOF/断网视为失败。已有卡片可保留并标注结果未完成，普通加购再次核验可用性；不能显示完整成功提示。
    
    正常成功示例中的 `dish` 结构由公共 `MenuDish` schema 定义；以下示例只展示不依赖该结构的控制事件：
    
    ```text
    event: meta
    data: {"requestId":"48d690da-47b5-4c6b-b7ad-5d6cf6f1d610","deliveryDate":"2026-10-17"}
    
    event: done
    data: {"requestId":"48d690da-47b5-4c6b-b7ad-5d6cf6f1d610","count":0,"outcome":"NO_MATCH"}
    
    ```
    
    中途已输出卡片、随后超时的终止事件：
    
    ```text
    event: error
    data: {"requestId":"e7085990-4fde-43b0-aa8b-a62239f91879","code":"AI_TIMEOUT","message":"Recommendations took too long. Please retry or return to the menu.","retryable":true,"partial":true}
    
    ```
    
    | code | retryable | 用户恢复动作 |
    | --- | --- | --- |
    | `AI_BUSY` | true | 稍后重试或返回菜单。 |
    | `AI_UNAVAILABLE` | true | 服务恢复后重试；不暴露内部地址和原始 provider 错误。 |
    | `AI_TIMEOUT` | true | 重试或返回菜单。 |
    | `AI_INVALID_RESPONSE` | true | 拒绝非法/截断/不满足校验的模型内容，可重试。 |
    | `INTENT_CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED` | false | 英文说明含混条件并提示改写诉求，再发新请求。 |
    | `SESSION_EXPIRED` | false | 重新登录，取得新 CSRF token 后重新请求。 |
    
    队列已满可在开始响应前使用 HTTP 503 与 `AI_BUSY`；上游服务明确不可用也可使用 HTTP 503。其他已开始响应的失败均按 `error` 终止处理。
    
    ### 3.3 真实推荐管线
    
    1. 读取当前用户已保存偏好、目标日期菜单及近 7 天非取消订单。近 7 天以运营时区的今天及前 6 个自然日配送日期计算。
    package com.webox.inventory;
    import java.sql.Timestamp;
    import java.time.LocalDate;
    import java.util.Map;
    import java.util.UUID;
    import com.webox.shared.BusinessClock;
    import com.webox.shared.ValueRules;
    import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
    import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronizationManager;
    import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;
    /** Typed public payloads prevent accidental persistence of personal order data. */
    @Component
    public class OutboxWriter {
        private final JdbcTemplate jdbc; private final JsonMapper mapper; private final BusinessClock clock;
        public OutboxWriter(JdbcTemplate jdbc,JsonMapper mapper,BusinessClock clock) { this.jdbc=jdbc;this.mapper=mapper;this.clock=clock; }
        public void inventoryUpdated(LocalDate date,UUID dishId,long remaining,long version,long revision) {
            ValueRules.safeInteger(remaining); ValueRules.safeInteger(version); ValueRules.safeInteger(revision);
            if (remaining>Integer.MAX_VALUE) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Stock exceeds the supported limit.");
            write("inventory.updated",date+"/"+dishId,Map.of("deliveryDate",date.toString(),"dishId",dishId.toString(),"remaining",remaining,"version",version,"menuRevision",revision,"occurredAt",clock.now().toString()));
        }
        public void menuChanged(LocalDate date,long revision) {
            ValueRules.safeInteger(revision);
            write("menu.changed",date.toString(),Map.of("deliveryDate",date.toString(),"menuRevision",revision));
        }
        private void write(String type,String aggregate,Map<String,Object> payload) {
            if(!TransactionSynchronizationManager.isActualTransactionActive() || TransactionSynchronizationManager.isCurrentTransactionReadOnly())
                throw new IllegalStateException("Outbox writes require an active business write transaction.");
            Timestamp now=Timestamp.from(clock.now());
            jdbc.update("INSERT INTO outbox_events(id,event_type,aggregate_key,payload,created_at,next_attempt_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                UUID.randomUUID().toString(),type,aggregate,mapper.writeValueAsString(payload),now,now);
        }
    }
    package com.webox.inventory;
    import java.time.LocalDate;
    import java.util.Optional;
    import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;
    @Repository
    public class SupplyRepository {
        private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
        public SupplyRepository(JdbcTemplate jdbc) { this.jdbc=jdbc; }
        public long menuRevision(LocalDate date) { return jdbc.query("SELECT revision FROM daily_menus WHERE delivery_date=?",(rs,n)->rs.getLong(1),date).stream().findFirst().orElse(0L); }
        public Optional<Supply> find(LocalDate date,String dishId) {
            return jdbc.query("SELECT total_quantity,allocated_quantity,version,scheduled FROM daily_supply WHERE delivery_date=? AND dish_id=?",(rs,n)->new Supply(date,dishId,rs.getInt(1),rs.getInt(2),rs.getLong(3),rs.getBoolean(4)),date,dishId).stream().findFirst();
        }
        public record Supply(LocalDate date,String dishId,int total,int allocated,long version,boolean scheduled) { public int remaining() { return total-allocated; } }
    }
    package com.webox.inventory;
    import java.time.LocalDate;
    import java.util.*;
    import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
    import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronizationManager;
    import com.webox.shared.*;
    import com.webox.ordering.QuoteService;
    import com.webox.ordering.OrderingModels.PricedLine;
    @Service
    public class InventoryMutationService {
        private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;private final SupplyRepository supply;private final OutboxWriter outbox;private final BusinessClock clock;
        public InventoryMutationService(JdbcTemplate jdbc,SupplyRepository supply,OutboxWriter outbox,BusinessClock clock) { this.jdbc=jdbc;this.supply=supply;this.outbox=outbox;this.clock=clock; }
        public record Dish(String id,long version,boolean listed) {}
        public record Locked(LocalDate date,SortedMap<String,Integer> demand,Map<String,Dish> dishes,Map<String,SupplyRepository.Supply> supplies) {}
        public Locked lock(LocalDate date,List<PricedLine> items) {
            if(!TransactionSynchronizationManager.isActualTransactionActive() || TransactionSynchronizationManager.isCurrentTransactionReadOnly()) throw new IllegalStateException("Inventory requires a business write transaction.");
            var demand=new TreeMap<String,Integer>();for(var item:items) demand.merge(item.dishId(),item.quantity(),Math::addExact);
            var roots=new HashMap<String,Dish>();var rows=new HashMap<String,SupplyRepository.Supply>();
            // Complete every root lock before taking any supply lock; never rely on IN-list order.
            for(String id:demand.keySet()) roots.put(id,jdbc.query("SELECT id,version,is_listed FROM dishes WHERE id=? FOR UPDATE",(rs,n)->new Dish(rs.getString(1),rs.getLong(2),rs.getBoolean(3)),id).stream().findFirst().orElseThrow(()->QuoteService.itemError("DISH_UNAVAILABLE",id,"This dish is no longer available.",Map.of())));
            for(String id:demand.keySet()) rows.put(id,jdbc.query("SELECT total_quantity,allocated_quantity,version,scheduled FROM daily_supply WHERE delivery_date=? AND dish_id=? FOR UPDATE",(rs,n)->new SupplyRepository.Supply(date,id,rs.getInt(1),rs.getInt(2),rs.getLong(3),rs.getBoolean(4)),date,id).stream().findFirst().orElseThrow(()->QuoteService.itemError("DISH_UNAVAILABLE",id,"This dish is not scheduled for the selected date.",Map.of())));
            return new Locked(date,Collections.unmodifiableSortedMap(demand),Map.copyOf(roots),Map.copyOf(rows));
        }
        public void validateForPurchase(Locked locked,List<PricedLine> items) {
            for(var item:items) {
                var dish=locked.dishes().get(item.dishId());var row=locked.supplies().get(item.dishId());
                if(!dish.listed() || !row.scheduled()) throw QuoteService.itemError("DISH_UNAVAILABLE",dish.id(),"This dish is no longer available on the selected date.",Map.of());
                if(dish.version()!=item.dishVersion()) throw QuoteService.itemError("DISH_CHANGED",dish.id(),"This dish has changed. Confirm a new quote before ordering.",Map.of("currentDishVersion",dish.version()));
            }
        }
        public void allocate(Locked locked) { mutate(locked,false); }
        public void restore(Locked locked) { mutate(locked,true); }
        private void mutate(Locked locked,boolean restore) {
            for(var entry:locked.demand().entrySet()) {
                var row=locked.supplies().get(entry.getKey());int quantity=entry.getValue();
                if(!restore && row.remaining()<quantity) throw QuoteService.itemError("INSUFFICIENT_STOCK",row.dishId(),"This dish no longer has enough stock. Please adjust your cart.",Map.of("availableQuantity",row.remaining()));
                if(restore && row.allocated()<quantity) throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot restore more than the allocated stock.");
                int allocated=restore?row.allocated()-quantity:Math.addExact(row.allocated(),quantity);long version=ValueRules.nextVersion(row.version());
                int count=jdbc.update("UPDATE daily_supply SET allocated_quantity=?,version=?,updated_at=? WHERE delivery_date=? AND dish_id=? AND version=? AND total_quantity>=?",allocated,version,java.sql.Timestamp.from(clock.now()),row.date(),row.dishId(),row.version(),allocated);
                if(count!=1) throw new IllegalStateException("Locked inventory changed unexpectedly.");
                outbox.inventoryUpdated(row.date(),UUID.fromString(row.dishId()),row.total()-allocated,version,supply.menuRevision(row.date()));
            }
        }
    }
    CREATE TABLE outbox_events (
        id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
        event_type VARCHAR(40) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
        aggregate_key VARCHAR(100) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
        payload JSON NOT NULL,
        created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
        published_at DATETIME(6) NULL,
        attempt_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        next_attempt_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
        last_error_code VARCHAR(80) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NULL,
        CONSTRAINT ck_outbox_event_type CHECK (event_type IN ('inventory.updated','menu.changed')),
        CONSTRAINT ck_outbox_attempt_count CHECK (attempt_count >= 0),
        INDEX ix_outbox_pending (published_at,next_attempt_at,created_at,id)
    ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

    package com.webox.auth;
    import com.webox.shared.ApiErrors;
    import com.webox.shared.ApiException;
    import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
    import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
    import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
    import org.springframework.http.HttpMethod;
    import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity;
    import org.springframework.security.web.SecurityFilterChain;
    import org.springframework.security.web.csrf.HttpSessionCsrfTokenRepository;
    import org.springframework.security.web.csrf.CsrfException;
    import org.springframework.security.web.context.HttpSessionSecurityContextRepository;
    import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetailsService;
    import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UsernameNotFoundException;
    import org.springframework.session.web.http.DefaultCookieSerializer;
    import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;
    @org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.condition.ConditionalOnWebApplication
    @Configuration(proxyBeanMethods=false)
    public class SecurityConfiguration {
        @Bean HttpSessionCsrfTokenRepository csrfRepository() {
            var repo=new HttpSessionCsrfTokenRepository(); repo.setHeaderName("X-XSRF-TOKEN"); return repo;
        }
        @Bean HttpSessionSecurityContextRepository securityContextRepository() { return new HttpSessionSecurityContextRepository(); }
        @Bean UserDetailsService disabledDefaultUser() { return name -> { throw new UsernameNotFoundException("Use the application login endpoint."); }; }
        @Bean DefaultCookieSerializer cookieSerializer(@Value("${server.servlet.session.cookie.secure}") boolean secure) {
            var cookie=new DefaultCookieSerializer();cookie.setCookieName("WEBOXSESSION");cookie.setCookiePath("/");
            cookie.setUseHttpOnlyCookie(true);cookie.setUseSecureCookie(secure);cookie.setSameSite("Lax");cookie.setUseBase64Encoding(false);return cookie;
        }
        @Bean SecurityFilterChain security(HttpSecurity http,JsonMapper mapper,HttpSessionCsrfTokenRepository csrf,HttpSessionSecurityContextRepository contexts) throws Exception {
            http.formLogin(c->c.disable()).httpBasic(c->c.disable()).logout(c->c.disable()).requestCache(c->c.disable());
            http.securityContext(c->c.securityContextRepository(contexts).requireExplicitSave(true));
            http.csrf(c->c.csrfTokenRepository(csrf));
            http.authorizeHttpRequests(c->c
                .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET,"/api/v1/health","/api/v1/auth/csrf","/media/*").permitAll()
                .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.POST,"/api/v1/auth/register","/api/v1/auth/login").permitAll()
                .requestMatchers("/api/v1/admin/**").hasRole("Admin")
                .requestMatchers("/api/v1/**").authenticated().anyRequest().denyAll());
            http.exceptionHandling(c->c
                .authenticationEntryPoint((req,res,e)->ApiErrors.write(mapper,req,res,new ApiException(401,"UNAUTHENTICATED","Please sign in to continue.")))
                .accessDeniedHandler((req,res,e)->ApiErrors.write(mapper,req,res,e instanceof CsrfException
                    ? new ApiException(403,"CSRF_INVALID","Your security token is invalid. Please refresh and try again.")
                    : new ApiException(403,"FORBIDDEN","You do not have permission to perform this action."))));
            return http.build();
        }
    }

    # WeBox
    
    企业员工餐食订购平台，交付范围包含全部 Tier 1–3。用户界面与菜单资料使用英文。
    
    工程、基础能力、账号、菜单、购物车与订餐闭环 T001–T079 已完成，正在实施管理员功能；全部可选故事与最终交付尚未完成。任务及验证状态分别见 [tasks.md](specs/001-webox-meal-ordering/tasks.md) 和 [验收台账](specs/001-webox-meal-ordering/acceptance.md)，不能将工程配置创建视为业务验收通过。
    
    ## 环境
    
    - JDK 17、Node 24 LTS 与 npm。
    - Docker Compose v2 和可访问的 Docker 守护进程；MySQL 8.4 使用独立容器与持久卷。
    - OpenRouter API 凭据，默认模型 `openai/gpt-4.1-mini`；可通过 `OPENROUTER_MODEL` 配置。
    - Maven Central、npm registry 与镜像源和 OpenRouter API可访问，以生成并验证依赖锁定结果。
    
    完整启动、测试及交付约定见 [quickstart.md](specs/001-webox-meal-ordering/quickstart.md)。阶段一的实际进度见[环境记录](docs/validation/environment.md)。当前 JDK17 构建、MySQL 真实集成测试、前端类型/单元/构建、三浏览器×三尺寸171个浏览器用例（含受影响流程修正重跑）和 OpenRouter 生成探针均通过。
    
    前端可通过 `./scripts/frontend.sh <npm 参数>` 运行。脚本优先使用 `WEBOX_NODE_BIN` 指定的可执行文件，其次使用项目本地 `.local/toolchains/node24/bin/node`，最后检查 PATH；强制 Node 24 / npm 11，并将 npm 缓存放在项目 `.local/npm`。例如：
    
    ```bash
    ./scripts/frontend.sh --version
    # 若 Node 24 未在 PATH 中，指定本机实际安装路径：
    WEBOX_NODE_BIN=/absolute/path/to/node24/bin/node ./scripts/frontend.sh --version
    ```
    
    当前开发机使用校验过的官方 Node 24.22.0 和 Temurin JDK 17.0.20.1；本机安装位于忽略的 `.local/`，不作为交付依赖。其他机器提供 Node 24 和 `JAVA_HOME` 指向的 JDK 17 即可。项目 `.npmrc` 固定官方 registry；已生成完整锁文件，后续安装使用 `./scripts/frontend.sh ci`。后端入口为 `./scripts/backend.sh verify`，调用官方 Maven Wrapper，并使用项目本地依赖缓存。
    
    ## 本地配置
    
    首次从仓库根目录复制 `.env.example` 为 `.env`，已有配置请保留。填写数据库密码和管理员初始密码，并使 `DB_USERNAME`/`DB_PASSWORD` 与 MySQL 应用用户一致。模板已固定官方 MySQL 8.4.11 镜像 digest；Compose 使用 `weboxspec` 项目名及独立持久卷。
    
    ```bash
    test -e .env || cp .env.example .env
    chmod 600 .env
    set -a
    source .env
    set +a
    mkdir -p "$MEDIA_ROOT"
    ```
    
    默认本地后端端口为 8080，前端为 5173；前端代理 `/api` 和 `/media`，保持同源 Cookie 与 CSRF。生产必须配置 HTTPS 和 `SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE=true`。会话空闲期限默认 8h；AI 并发、队列、20 秒总时限和 SSE 容量均在模板中列出。
    
    `.env`、上传媒体、数据库卷、模型、构建产物和测试会话不进入源码交付。种子图片、`seed/menu.json`、图片来源记录、依赖锁文件和 Maven Wrapper 必须随源码交付；部署不得依赖开发机 Downloads 路径。

    specs/001-webox-meal-ordering/research.md:38:- **Decision**：每日菜品供应保留 total、allocated、version；remaining 为差值。按菜品汇总各配置需求，订单、条目快照、地址、库存及 outbox 在同一 MySQL 事务完成。统一采用 user → order/quote → dish（ID 排序）→ daily supply（日期/ID 排序）的适用锁序；任何地方不反向取锁。业务写事务使用 READ COMMITTED，权威字段锁定读取；报价读取和报表采用只读 REPEATABLE READ，避免当前根版本与旧子表快照混读。
    specs/001-webox-meal-ordering/data-model.md:268:订单与运营写事务显式采用 READ COMMITTED，关键根记录和供应仍使用锁定读取及条件更新、唯一约束；这样不会在早先幂等普通查询建立旧快照后，将当前 dish version 与过时 options 混读。报价生成读取与看板聚合独立采用只读 REPEATABLE READ 一致性快照，不能通过改动全局隔离级别混淆两类目标。
    specs/001-webox-meal-ordering/data-model.md:334:统计不设独立人工录入或预置收入表。服务端在显式 `READ ONLY + REPEATABLE READ` 事务的一致性快照中完成多条聚合查询，返回同一 `generatedAt`；不能在默认 READ COMMITTED 下把多个时点的结果拼成同一看板。
    specs/001-webox-meal-ordering/plan.md:13:采用 React SPA + Java 17 / Spring Boot 4.1.1 模块化单体 + 独立 MySQL 8.4 LTS。订单与库存使用同库显式事务、唯一索引和稳定行锁保证正确性（写事务 READ COMMITTED，报价读取和报表使用只读 REPEATABLE READ 快照）；库存更新通过事务 outbox 与 SSE 发布。真实推荐通过 OpenRouter 调用配置模型（默认 openai/gpt-4.1-mini），在服务器过滤和验证后逐张输出可购买卡片。服务初期按单实例部署设计，不引入 Redis 或分布式事务。

    ## 实现与约束
    
    Console支持菜品分页、搜索、分类、发布状态过滤；完整英文菜品/配置/标签编辑、图片上传预览；每日供应默认服务器运营次日，可切换当日；全订单按配送日期、餐次、状态过滤并处理。编辑采用expectedVersion/revision，冲突保留输入，明确重读后再保存；供应显示total、allocated、remaining，不能把总量调至实际占用以下。发布/状态冲突重新获取当前记录后要求重新操作。员工界面和HTTP均拒绝管理员权限操作。
    
    运营事务锁dish根、按日期锁daily_menus再锁supply，资料版本与所有受影响日期revision/outbox同事务更新，缓存仅提交后逐出。菜品身份保留，当前子配置可替换；历史报价和订单保存独立ID、名称、选项、标签与整数金额快照。后端以真实管理写入验证回滚不逐出、旧事务迟到只填旧版本、当前查询不会回退。每日菜单遗漏项变为未安排，保留供应行和已占用数量。
    
    订单管理复用既有状态/库存事务：Pending→Confirmed→Completed或Pending→Cancelled。Cancelled重复先于版本检查返回，库存只恢复一次；其他请求先检查版本。确认与取消并发只有一个合法成功。取消与确认/完成后的库存规则与员工下单一致。
    
    上传真实识别JPEG/PNG/WebP，使用TwelveMonkeys读取WebP，产出JPEG/PNG；输入与产物各不超过5,242,880字节。解码前读尺寸，单边8192、总像素16,777,216；拒绝伪MIME、截断、假图、空图与超限。随机文件名、受控目录内临时文件原子重命名；数据库失败/事务回滚清理新文件，旧引用及旧文件保留。`byteLength`为实际产物字节。
    
    正式九菜字段逐项转录原PRD §6，价格以整数分保存。原始20张图片已逐张核对，缺乏九道菜的准确对应照片，因此按[DEC-R08](../../specs/001-webox-meal-ordering/decisions.md#dec-r08)补充本地生成插图；提示词、生成方式、SHA-256及显式示例配方声明见[来源记录](../../backend/src/main/resources/seed/ATTRIBUTION.md)。基础标签保留PRD值，选项标签来自记录的配方声明，不从图片或菜名推断。Garden Salad仍仅为隔离测试素材。
    
    显式seed profile读取项目内manifest与图片，固定命名空间派生菜品和初始配置ID。V012固定锁行串行化种子运行；只创建缺失菜品和缺失日期菜单，已有日期菜单（含人工空菜单）、价格、配置、上下架、占用和管理员密码均不覆盖。首次D/D+1各九道20份，不创建订单或虚构收入；普通Web启动不执行初始化。已将独立可执行JAR复制至空临时目录，通过真实MySQL连续运行两次，确认资源完整且进程正常退出，无需源码或Downloads。

    package com.webox.auth;
    import org.springframework.session.SessionRepository;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
    /** Read-only repository lookup; no save, HTTP request or last-access update. */
    @org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.condition.ConditionalOnWebApplication
    @Component
    public class SessionValidity {
        private final SessionRepository<?> sessions;
        public SessionValidity(SessionRepository<?> sessions) { this.sessions=sessions; }
        public boolean active(String sessionId) {
            if(sessionId==null) return false;
            var session=sessions.findById(sessionId);
            if (session == null || session.isExpired()) return false;
            Object stored = session.getAttribute("SPRING_SECURITY_CONTEXT");
            if (!(stored instanceof org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContext context)) return false;
            var auth = context.getAuthentication();
            return auth != null && auth.isAuthenticated() && auth.getPrincipal() instanceof UserIdentity;
        }
    }

                    .enable(StreamReadFeature.STRICT_DUPLICATE_DETECTION);
        }
        @Bean FilterRegistrationBean<OncePerRequestFilter> requestBoundary(JsonMapper mapper) {
            var filter=new OncePerRequestFilter() {
                @Override protected void doFilterInternal(HttpServletRequest request,HttpServletResponse response,FilterChain chain) throws IOException,ServletException {
                    response.setHeader("X-Request-Id",ApiErrors.requestId(request));
                    if(request.getRequestURI().startsWith("/api/")) response.setHeader("Cache-Control","no-store");
                    if(request.getContentType()!=null && (request.getContentType().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT).startsWith("application/json") || request.getContentType().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT).split(";",2)[0].endsWith("+json"))) {
                        if(request.getContentLengthLong()>MAX_JSON_BYTES) { tooLarge(mapper,request,response); return; }
                        byte[] bytes=request.getInputStream().readNBytes(MAX_JSON_BYTES+1);
                        if(bytes.length>MAX_JSON_BYTES) { tooLarge(mapper,request,response); return; }
                        var wrapped=new HttpServletRequestWrapper(request) {
                            @Override public ServletInputStream getInputStream() {
                                var input=new ByteArrayInputStream(bytes);
                                return new ServletInputStream() {
                                    @Override public int read() { return input.read(); }
                                    @Override public int read(byte[] b,int o,int l) { return input.read(b,o,l); }
                                    @Override public boolean isFinished() { return input.available()==0; }
                                    @Override public boolean isReady() { return true; }
                                    @Override public void setReadListener(ReadListener listener) {
                                        try { if(!isFinished()) listener.onDataAvailable(); if(isFinished()) listener.onAllDataRead(); }
                                        catch(IOException e) { listener.onError(e); }
                                    }
                                };
                            }
                            @Override public BufferedReader getReader() { return new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(getInputStream(),java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8)); }
                        };
                        chain.doFilter(wrapped,response); return;
                    }
                    chain.doFilter(request,response);
                }
            };
            var bean=new FilterRegistrationBean<OncePerRequestFilter>(filter);
            bean.setOrder(Ordered.HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE+20); bean.setAsyncSupported(true); return bean;
        }
        private static void tooLarge(JsonMapper mapper,HttpServletRequest req,HttpServletResponse res) throws IOException {
            ApiErrors.write(mapper,req,res,new ApiException(400,"VALIDATION_ERROR","The JSON request is too large."));

    import { createContext, createElement, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
    import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    import { api, ApiError, onUnauthorized, resetApiSession } from '../../shared/api/client';
    import type { User } from '../../shared/api/types';
    const cleanup = new Set<() => void>();
    export function onSessionEnd(callback: () => void): () => void { cleanup.add(callback); return () => { cleanup.delete(callback); }; }
    type Session = { user: User | null; loading: boolean; error: string | null; refresh: () => Promise<void>; login: (email: string, password: string) => Promise<User>; logout: () => Promise<void> };
    const Context = createContext<Session | null>(null);
    export function SessionProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
      const queries = useQueryClient();
      const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(null);
      const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
      const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
      const generation = useRef(0);
      const clear = useCallback(() => {
        generation.current++; resetApiSession(); void queries.cancelQueries(); queries.clear();
        for (const close of cleanup) close();
        setUser(null); setLoading(false); setError(null);
      }, [queries]);
      const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
        const active = generation.current;
        try {
          const restored = await api<User>('/auth/me');
          if (active === generation.current) { setUser(restored); setError(null); }
        } catch (e) {
          if (e instanceof ApiError && e.status === 401) { if (active === generation.current) setUser(null); }
          else if (!(e instanceof DOMException && e.name === 'AbortError') && active === generation.current) setError('Could not check your session. Please try again.');
        } finally { if (active === generation.current) setLoading(false); }
      }, []);
      useEffect(() => {
        const unsubscribe = onUnauthorized(clear);
        void refresh();
        const focus = () => { void refresh(); };
        window.addEventListener('focus', focus);
        return () => { unsubscribe(); window.removeEventListener('focus', focus); generation.current++; resetApiSession(); };
      }, [clear, refresh]);
      const login = useCallback(async (email: string, password: string) => {
        const authenticated = await api<User>('/auth/login', { method: 'POST', json: { email, password } });
        clear();setUser(authenticated);return authenticated;
      }, [clear]);
      const logout = useCallback(async () => {
        try { await api<void>('/auth/logout', { method: 'POST' }); }
        catch(e) { if (!(e instanceof ApiError && e.status === 401)) throw e; }
        clear();
      }, [clear]);
      return createElement(Context.Provider, { value: { user, loading, error, refresh, login, logout } }, children);
    }
    export function useSession(): Session {
      const value = useContext(Context);if (!value) throw new Error('SessionProvider is required.');return value;
    }
    export function homeFor(user: User): string { return user.role === 'Admin' ? '/console/dishes' : '/menu'; }

    package com.webox.support;
    import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
    import java.util.Map;
    import org.yaml.snakeyaml.Yaml;
    import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;
    import com.networknt.schema.SchemaRegistry;
    import com.networknt.schema.SpecificationVersion;
    import com.networknt.schema.InputFormat;
    import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
    /** Reads the authoritative OpenAPI document, including nested $refs and format constraints. */
    public final class ContractAssertions {
        private static final JsonMapper JSON=JsonMapper.builder().build();
        private static final Map<String,Object> API=readContract();
        private static final SchemaRegistry REGISTRY=SchemaRegistry.withDefaultDialect(SpecificationVersion.DRAFT_2020_12);
        private ContractAssertions() {}
        private static Map<String,Object> readContract() {
            try(var in=ContractAssertions.class.getResourceAsStream("/contracts/openapi.yaml")) {
                if(in==null) throw new IllegalStateException("OpenAPI contract is missing.");
                return new Yaml().load(in);
            } catch(java.io.IOException e) { throw new IllegalStateException(e); }
        }
        public static void matches(String schemaName,String body) {
            var wrapper=new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();wrapper.put("$ref","#/components/schemas/"+schemaName);wrapper.put("components",API.get("components"));
            assertSchema(wrapper,body);
        }
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        public static void response(String path,String method,int status,String body) {
            Map<String,Object> paths=(Map<String,Object>)API.get("paths");
            Map<String,Object> item=(Map<String,Object>)paths.get(path);
            Map<String,Object> operation=(Map<String,Object>)item.get(method);
            Map<String,Object> responses=(Map<String,Object>)operation.get("responses");
            Map<String,Object> response=(Map<String,Object>)responses.get(String.valueOf(status));
            assertNotNull(response,"Response status must be declared in OpenAPI");
            Map<String,Object> content=(Map<String,Object>)response.get("content");
            Map<String,Object> media=(Map<String,Object>)content.get("application/json");
            var wrapper=new LinkedHashMap<>((Map<String,Object>)media.get("schema"));wrapper.put("components",API.get("components"));
            assertSchema(wrapper,body);
        }
        private static void assertSchema(Map<String,Object> schema,String body) {
            var compiled=REGISTRY.getSchema(JSON.writeValueAsString(schema),InputFormat.JSON);
            var errors=compiled.validate(body,InputFormat.JSON,ctx->ctx.executionConfig(config->config.formatAssertionsEnabled(true)));
            assertTrue(errors.isEmpty(),()->"Response violates the declared schema: "+errors);
        }
    }

    @AutoConfigureMockMvc(print=org.springframework.boot.webmvc.test.autoconfigure.MockMvcPrint.NONE)
    class InventoryStreamIT extends AdminTestSupport {
        @LocalServerPort int port;
        private static final HttpClient HTTP=HttpClient.newBuilder().connectTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(3)).version(HttpClient.Version.HTTP_1_1).build();
        private record Event(String name,String data) {}
        private class Stream implements AutoCloseable {
            final HttpResponse<InputStream> response;final BlockingQueue<Event> events=new LinkedBlockingQueue<>();final Thread reader;
            Stream(LocalDate date,Browser user) throws Exception {
                var request=HttpRequest.newBuilder(URI.create("http://127.0.0.1:"+port+"/api/v1/menus/"+date+"/events")).header("Cookie","WEBOXSESSION="+user.identity().sessionId()).header("Accept","text/event-stream").timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(5)).GET().build();
                response=HTTP.send(request,HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofInputStream());assertEquals(200,response.statusCode());assertTrue(response.headers().firstValue("Content-Type").orElse("").startsWith("text/event-stream"));assertEquals("no-store",response.headers().firstValue("Cache-Control").orElse(""));
                reader=new Thread(()->{try(var input=new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(response.body(),java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8))){String name="",data="",line;while((line=input.readLine())!=null){if(line.startsWith("event:"))name=line.substring(6).strip();else if(line.startsWith("data:"))data=line.substring(5).strip();else if(line.isEmpty() && !name.isEmpty()){events.offer(new Event(name,data));name="";data="";}}}catch(IOException ignored){}finally{events.offer(new Event("EOF",""));}},"inventory-test-reader");reader.setDaemon(true);reader.start();
            }
            Event next(String name) throws Exception {long deadline=System.nanoTime()+TimeUnit.SECONDS.toNanos(5);while(System.nanoTime()<deadline){var event=events.poll(100,TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);if(event==null)continue;if(event.name().equals(name))return event;assertNotEquals("EOF",event.name(),"Stream ended before "+name);}throw new AssertionError("Missing SSE event: "+name);}
            @Override public void close() throws Exception {response.body().close();reader.join(1000);}
        }

    export type InventoryState = { date: string; epoch: number; revision: number; entries: Record<string, InventoryEntry>; snapshot: boolean; status: 'connecting' | 'live' | 'offline' | 'expired'; refresh: number };
    export type InventoryAction = { epoch: number } & ({ type: 'snapshot'; value: InventorySnapshot } | { type: 'updated'; value: InventoryUpdated } | { type: 'changed'; value: MenuChanged } | { type: 'menu'; value: MenuPage } | { type: 'offline' | 'expired' });
    export function beginInventory(date: string, epoch: number): InventoryState { return { date, epoch, revision: 0, entries: {}, snapshot: false, status: 'connecting', refresh: 0 }; }
    export function inventoryState(state: InventoryState, _action: InventoryAction): InventoryState { return state; }
    export function inventoryDish(_state: InventoryState, dish: MenuDish): MenuDish | null { return dish; }

    import com.webox.auth.SessionValidity;

    import jakarta.annotation.*;
    import jakarta.servlet.*;
    import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
    import java.io.IOException;

    import java.time.LocalDate;

    import java.util.concurrent.*;

    import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.condition.ConditionalOnWebApplication;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
    import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;
    
    /** Single-instance fan-out. Business writers only append outbox; socket writes never run on their threads. */
    @Component @ConditionalOnWebApplication
    public class InventorySubscriptions {
        private final SessionValidity sessions;private final JsonMapper json;private final int perSession,maxConnections,capacity;
        private final long heartbeatNanos,lifetimeNanos,writeTimeoutNanos;
        private final Map<String,Connection> connections=new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
        private final ExecutorService writers;private final ScheduledExecutorService maintenance;
        private volatile boolean stopped;
        public InventorySubscriptions(SessionValidity sessions,JsonMapper json,
            @Value("${webox.inventory.heartbeat-ms:${SSE_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS:15000}}") long heartbeat,
            @Value("${webox.inventory.max-duration-ms:${SSE_MAX_DURATION_MS:1800000}}") long lifetime,
            @Value("${webox.inventory.max-per-session:${SSE_MAX_PER_SESSION:3}}") int perSession,
            @Value("${webox.inventory.max-connections:${SSE_MAX_CONNECTIONS:600}}") int maxConnections,
            @Value("${webox.inventory.queue-capacity:${SSE_QUEUE_CAPACITY:256}}") int capacity,
            @Value("${webox.inventory.write-timeout-ms:${SSE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_MS:5000}}") long timeout) {
            if(heartbeat<50 || lifetime<100 || perSession<1 || maxConnections<1 || capacity<2 || timeout<50)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid inventory stream limits.");
            this.sessions=sessions;this.json=json;this.perSession=perSession;this.maxConnections=maxConnections;this.capacity=capacity;
            heartbeatNanos=TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.toNanos(heartbeat);lifetimeNanos=TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.toNanos(lifetime);writeTimeoutNanos=TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.toNanos(timeout);
            writers=new ThreadPoolExecutor(8,8,0,TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS,new ArrayBlockingQueue<>(maxConnections),r->{var t=new Thread(r,"inventory-writer");t.setDaemon(true);return t;},new ThreadPoolExecutor.AbortPolicy());
            maintenance=Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor(r->{var t=new Thread(r,"inventory-maintenance");t.setDaemon(true);return t;});
        }
        @PostConstruct void start(){maintenance.scheduleWithFixedDelay(this::maintain,100,100,TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);}
        public synchronized Connection register(LocalDate date,String sessionId) {
            if(stopped || connections.size()>=maxConnections || connections.values().stream().filter(c->c.sessionId.equals(sessionId)).count()>=perSession)throw new ApiException(429,"RATE_LIMITED","Too many live inventory connections. Close another tab and try again.",true,Map.of());
            var connection=new Connection(date,sessionId);connections.put(connection.id,connection);return connection;
        }
        public void publish(LocalDate date,String event,String data) {
            byte[] bytes=frame(event,data);for(var connection:connections.values())if(connection.date.equals(date))connection.offer(bytes);
        }
        static byte[] frame(String event,String data){return ("event: "+event+"\ndata: "+data+"\n\n").getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);}
        private void maintain() {
            long now=System.nanoTime();for(var connection:connections.values()) {
                try {
                    if(now-connection.created>=lifetimeNanos || connection.stalled(now)){connection.close();continue;}
                    if(now-connection.heartbeat>=heartbeatNanos){connection.heartbeat=now;connection.offer(": keep-alive\n\n".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));}
                }catch(RuntimeException ignored){connection.close();}
            }
        }
        @PreDestroy void stop(){stopped=true;maintenance.shutdownNow();for(var connection:connections.values())connection.close();writers.shutdownNow();}
        public int size(){return connections.size();}
        public final class Connection {
            private final String id=UUID.randomUUID().toString(),sessionId;private final LocalDate date;
            private final long created=System.nanoTime();private volatile long heartbeat=created;
            private final ArrayDeque<byte[]> queue=new ArrayDeque<>();private final AtomicBoolean scheduled=new AtomicBoolean();
            private int queuedBytes;private boolean ready,closed,terminal,flushPending;private long pendingSince;
            private AsyncContext async;private ServletOutputStream output;
            private Connection(LocalDate date,String sessionId){this.date=date;this.sessionId=sessionId;}
            /** Register first, obtain a consistent DB snapshot, then prepend it to the buffered committed events. */
            public void begin(InventoryModels.Snapshot snapshot,AsyncContext async,HttpServletResponse response) throws IOException {
                byte[] bytes=frame("inventory.snapshot",json.writeValueAsString(snapshot));
                synchronized(this) {
                    if(closed) {async.complete();return;}
                    this.async=async;output=response.getOutputStream();queue.addFirst(bytes);queuedBytes+=bytes.length;ready=true;if(pendingSince==0)pendingSince=System.nanoTime();
                    if(queuedBytes>1_048_576 || queue.size()>capacity){close();return;}
                }
                async.setTimeout(TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS.toMillis(lifetimeNanos));async.addListener(new AsyncListener() {
                    @Override public void onComplete(AsyncEvent event){close();}
                    @Override public void onTimeout(AsyncEvent event){close();}
                    @Override public void onError(AsyncEvent event){close();}
                    @Override public void onStartAsync(AsyncEvent event){}
                });
                output.setWriteListener(new WriteListener() {
                    @Override public void onWritePossible(){kick();}
                    @Override public void onError(Throwable failure){close();}
                });
                kick();
            }
            private void offer(byte[] bytes) {
                synchronized(this) {
                    if(closed || terminal)return;
                    if(queue.size()>=capacity || (long)queuedBytes+bytes.length>1_048_576){close();return;}
                    queue.addLast(bytes);queuedBytes+=bytes.length;if(pendingSince==0)pendingSince=System.nanoTime();
                }kick();
            }
            private void kick() {
                synchronized(this){if(closed || !ready || output==null)return;}
                if(scheduled.compareAndSet(false,true))try{writers.execute(this::drain);}catch(RejectedExecutionException full){scheduled.set(false);close();}
            }
            private void drain() {
                boolean again=false;
                try {
                    for(int count=0;count<16;count++) {
                        synchronized(this){if(closed || !ready)return;if(!output.isReady())return;}
                        boolean check; synchronized(this){check=!terminal;}
                        if(check && !sessions.active(sessionId)) {
                            synchronized(this){queue.clear();queuedBytes=0;terminal=true;var expired=frame("session.expired","{\"message\":\"Your session has expired. Please sign in again.\"}");queue.add(expired);queuedBytes=expired.length;}
                        }
                        synchronized(this) {
                            if(closed)return;if(!output.isReady())return;
                            var bytes=queue.pollFirst();
                            if(bytes!=null){queuedBytes-=bytes.length;output.write(bytes);flushPending=true;pendingSince=System.nanoTime();}
                            if(flushPending && output.isReady()){output.flush();flushPending=false;}
                            if(queue.isEmpty() && !flushPending){pendingSince=0;if(terminal)close();return;}
                            if(!output.isReady())return;
                        }
                    }
                    synchronized(this){again=!closed && (!queue.isEmpty() || flushPending) && output.isReady();}
                }catch(IOException | RuntimeException failure){close();}
                finally {
                    scheduled.set(false);
                    // Covers an offer arriving between the final empty-queue check and releasing this job.
                    synchronized(this){if(!closed && ready && output!=null && (!queue.isEmpty() || flushPending)){try{again=output.isReady();}catch(RuntimeException ignored){close();}}}
                    if(again)kick();
                }
            }
            private synchronized boolean stalled(long now){return pendingSince!=0 && now-pendingSince>=writeTimeoutNanos;}
            public void close() {
                AsyncContext context;
                synchronized(this){if(closed)return;closed=true;queue.clear();queuedBytes=0;context=async;}
                connections.remove(id,this);
                if(context!=null)try{context.complete();}catch(IllegalStateException ignored){}
            }
        }
    }

    package com.webox.inventory;
    import java.sql.Timestamp;
    import java.time.*;
    import java.util.concurrent.*;
    import com.webox.shared.BusinessClock;
    import jakarta.annotation.*;
    import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
    import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.condition.ConditionalOnWebApplication;
    import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
    import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;
    @Component @ConditionalOnWebApplication
    public class OutboxDispatcher {
        private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;private final JsonMapper json;private final InventorySubscriptions subscriptions;private final BusinessClock clock;private final boolean enabled;private final long interval;
        private final ScheduledExecutorService worker=Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor(r->{var t=new Thread(r,"inventory-outbox");t.setDaemon(true);return t;});
        public OutboxDispatcher(JdbcTemplate jdbc,JsonMapper json,InventorySubscriptions subscriptions,BusinessClock clock,@Value("${webox.inventory.dispatch-enabled:true}") boolean enabled,@Value("${INVENTORY_POLL_INTERVAL_MS:250}") long interval){if(interval<10)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid inventory polling interval.");this.jdbc=jdbc;this.json=json;this.subscriptions=subscriptions;this.clock=clock;this.enabled=enabled;this.interval=interval;}
        private record Pending(String id,String type,String payload,int attempts) {}
        @PostConstruct void start(){if(enabled)worker.scheduleWithFixedDelay(()->{try{dispatch();}catch(RuntimeException ignored){/* Durable rows remain pending for the next poll. */}},interval,interval,TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);}
        @PreDestroy void stop(){worker.shutdownNow();}
        public synchronized void dispatch() {
            var rows=jdbc.query("SELECT id,event_type,payload,attempt_count FROM outbox_events WHERE published_at IS NULL AND next_attempt_at<=? ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 100",(rs,n)->new Pending(rs.getString(1),rs.getString(2),rs.getString(3),rs.getInt(4)),Timestamp.from(clock.now()));
            for(var row:rows) {
                try {
                    LocalDate date;
                    if(row.type().equals("inventory.updated"))date=json.readValue(row.payload(),InventoryModels.Updated.class).deliveryDate();
                    else if(row.type().equals("menu.changed"))date=json.readValue(row.payload(),InventoryModels.Changed.class).deliveryDate();
                    else throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported outbox event.");
                    subscriptions.publish(date,row.type(),row.payload());markPublished(row.id());
                }catch(RuntimeException failure) {
                    long delay=Math.min(30_000,250L*(1L<<Math.min(row.attempts(),7)));int attempts=Math.min(Integer.MAX_VALUE,row.attempts()+1);
                    jdbc.update("UPDATE outbox_events SET attempt_count=?,next_attempt_at=?,last_error_code='DISPATCH_FAILED' WHERE id=? AND published_at IS NULL",attempts,Timestamp.from(clock.now().plusMillis(delay)),row.id());
                }
            }
        }
        void markPublished(String id){jdbc.update("UPDATE outbox_events SET published_at=?,last_error_code=NULL WHERE id=? AND published_at IS NULL",Timestamp.from(clock.now()),id);}
    }

    +  if (state.snapshot && !stock) return null;

        }

            if (value instanceof String s) return s;

    import type { MenuDish } from '../../shared/api/types';
    import { useCart } from './CartProvider';
    import { purchaseAvailability } from './purchaseAvailability';
    export function usePurchaseAvailability(dish: MenuDish, editingKey?: string) { const cart = useCart();const state = editingKey ? { ...cart.state, lines: cart.state.lines.filter(line => line.key !== editingKey) } : cart.state;const availability = purchaseAvailability(state, dish);return cart.busy ? { canAdd: false, reason: 'Checking current prices and availability…' } : availability; }
    import type { InventoryEntry, InventorySnapshot, InventoryUpdated, MenuChanged, MenuDish, MenuPage } from '../../shared/api/types';
    export type InventoryState = { date: string; epoch: number; revision: number; entries: Record<string, InventoryEntry>; snapshot: boolean; status: 'connecting' | 'live' | 'offline' | 'expired'; refresh: number };
    export type InventoryAction = { epoch: number } & ({ type: 'snapshot'; value: InventorySnapshot } | { type: 'updated'; value: InventoryUpdated } | { type: 'changed'; value: MenuChanged } | { type: 'menu'; value: MenuPage } | { type: 'offline' | 'expired' });
    export function beginInventory(date: string, epoch: number): InventoryState { return { date, epoch, revision: 0, entries: {}, snapshot: false, status: 'connecting', refresh: 0 }; }
    export function inventoryState(state: InventoryState, action: InventoryAction): InventoryState {
      if (action.epoch !== state.epoch || state.status === 'expired') return state;
      if (action.type === 'expired') return { ...state, entries: {}, status: 'expired', snapshot: false };
      if (action.type === 'offline') return { ...state, status: 'offline' };
      const value = action.value;
      if (value.deliveryDate !== state.date || value.menuRevision < state.revision) return state;
      const revision = value.menuRevision, newer = revision > state.revision;
      if (action.type === 'snapshot') {
        const entries: InventoryState['entries'] = {};
        for (const row of action.value.items) { const known = state.entries[row.dishId];entries[row.dishId] = known && known.version > row.version ? known : row; }
        return { ...state, entries, revision, snapshot: true, status: 'live', refresh: state.refresh + (state.snapshot && newer ? 1 : 0) };
      }
      if (action.type === 'changed') return newer ? { ...state, revision, refresh: state.refresh + 1 } : state;
      if (action.type === 'updated') {
        const update = action.value, known = state.entries[update.dishId];
        if (!state.snapshot || !known) return { ...state, revision, refresh: state.refresh + 1 };
        if (!newer && update.version <= known.version) return state;
        const entries = update.version > known.version ? { ...state.entries, [update.dishId]: { dishId: update.dishId, remaining: update.remaining, version: update.version } } : state.entries;
        return { ...state, entries, revision, refresh: state.refresh + (newer ? 1 : 0) };
      }

    import { createContext, createElement, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
    import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    import { api, ApiError, onUnauthorized, resetApiSession } from '../../shared/api/client';
    import type { User } from '../../shared/api/types';
    const cleanup = new Set<() => void>();
    export function onSessionEnd(callback: () => void): () => void { cleanup.add(callback); return () => { cleanup.delete(callback); }; }
    type Session = { user: User | null; loading: boolean; error: string | null; refresh: () => Promise<void>; login: (email: string, password: string) => Promise<User>; logout: () => Promise<void>; expire: () => void };
    const Context = createContext<Session | null>(null);
    export function SessionProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
      const queries = useQueryClient();
      const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(null);
      const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
      const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
      const generation = useRef(0);
      const clear = useCallback(() => {
        generation.current++; resetApiSession(); void queries.cancelQueries(); queries.clear();
        for (const close of cleanup) close();
        setUser(null); setLoading(false); setError(null);
      }, [queries]);
      const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
        const active = generation.current;
        try {
          const restored = await api<User>('/auth/me');
          if (active === generation.current) { setUser(restored); setError(null); }
        } catch (e) {
          if (e instanceof ApiError && e.status === 401) { if (active === generation.current) setUser(null); }
          else if (!(e instanceof DOMException && e.name === 'AbortError') && active === generation.current) setError('Could not check your session. Please try again.');
        } finally { if (active === generation.current) setLoading(false); }
      }, []);
      useEffect(() => {
        const unsubscribe = onUnauthorized(clear);
        void refresh();
        const focus = () => { void refresh(); };
        window.addEventListener('focus', focus);
        return () => { unsubscribe(); window.removeEventListener('focus', focus); generation.current++; resetApiSession(); };
      }, [clear, refresh]);
      const login = useCallback(async (email: string, password: string) => {
        const authenticated = await api<User>('/auth/login', { method: 'POST', json: { email, password } });
        clear();setUser(authenticated);return authenticated;
      }, [clear]);
      const logout = useCallback(async () => {
        try { await api<void>('/auth/logout', { method: 'POST' }); }
        catch(e) { if (!(e instanceof ApiError && e.status === 401)) throw e; }
        clear();
      }, [clear]);
      return createElement(Context.Provider, { value: { user, loading, error, refresh, login, logout, expire: clear } }, children);
    }
    export function useSession(): Session {
      const value = useContext(Context);if (!value) throw new Error('SessionProvider is required.');return value;
    }

'Save changes' : 'Add to cart'}</button></div>

      </dialog>;

    const updated = (remaining: number, version: number, revision = 1) => ({ deliveryDate: date, menuRevision: revision, dishId: pasta.dishId, remaining, version, occurredAt: '2026-10-16T01:00:00Z' });

    it('a complete snapshot replaces membership, including an empty date', () => {

      const cleared = inventoryState(state, { type: 'snapshot', epoch, value: { ...snapshot(2), items: [] } });expect(cleared.entries).toEqual({});expect(inventoryDish(cleared, pasta)).toBeNull();
    });
    it('absolute stock versions deduplicate repeats and reject older events and HTTP responses', () => {

      state = inventoryState(state, { type: 'updated', epoch, value: updated(19, 1) });state = inventoryState(state, { type: 'updated', epoch, value: updated(18, 2) });
      state = inventoryState(state, { type: 'menu', epoch, value: { deliveryDate: date, menuRevision: 1, serverTime: snapshot().serverTime, businessTimezone: 'Asia/Shanghai', items: [{ ...pasta, remaining: 20, inventoryVersion: 0 }], page: 0, size: 24, totalElements: 1 } });expect(inventoryDish(state, pasta)?.remaining).toBe(18);expect(state.entries[pasta.dishId].version).toBe(2);
      state = inventoryState(state, { type: 'snapshot', epoch, value: snapshot(1, 19, 1) });expect(state.entries[pasta.dishId].remaining).toBe(18);
    });
    it('new revisions and unknown members request a refetch but old events cannot resurrect removed dishes', () => {
      let state = live();state = inventoryState(state, { type: 'updated', epoch, value: { ...updated(3, 1), dishId: other } });expect(state.refresh).toBeGreaterThan(0);expect(state.entries[other]).toBeUndefined();
      state = inventoryState(state, { type: 'changed', epoch, value: { deliveryDate: date, menuRevision: 2 } });expect(state.revision).toBe(2);expect(state.refresh).toBeGreaterThan(1);
      state = inventoryState(state, { type: 'snapshot', epoch, value: { ...snapshot(2), items: [] } });const before = state;state = inventoryState(state, { type: 'updated', epoch, value: updated(20, 99, 1) });expect(state).toBe(before);expect(state.entries).toEqual({});
    });
    it('old dates, prior connections, expired sessions and stale snapshot responses cannot mutate live state', () => {
      let state = live();expect(inventoryState(state, { type: 'updated', epoch: 0, value: updated(0, 9) })).toBe(state);expect(inventoryState(state, { type: 'snapshot', epoch, value: { ...snapshot(), deliveryDate: '2032-01-02' } })).toBe(state);
      state = inventoryState(state, { type: 'changed', epoch, value: { deliveryDate: date, menuRevision: 5 } });expect(inventoryState(state, { type: 'snapshot', epoch, value: snapshot(2) })).toBe(state);

       - **C**: `build/`, `bin/`, `obj/`, `out/`, `*.o`, `*.a`, `*.so`, `*.exe`, `*.dll`, `autom4te.cache/`, `config.status`, `config.log`, `.idea/`, `*.log`, `.env*`

       - **R**: `.Rproj.user/`, `.Rhistory`, `.RData`, `.Ruserdata`, `*.Rproj`, `packrat/`, `renv/`
       - **Universal**: `.DS_Store`, `Thumbs.db`, `*.tmp`, `*.swp`, `.vscode/`, `.idea/`
    
       **Tool-Specific Patterns**:
       - **Docker**: `node_modules/`, `.git/`, `Dockerfile*`, `.dockerignore`, `*.log*`, `.env*`, `coverage/`
       - **ESLint**: `node_modules/`, `dist/`, `build/`, `coverage/`, `*.min.js`
       - **Prettier**: `node_modules/`, `dist/`, `build/`, `coverage/`, `package-lock.json`, `yarn.lock`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`
       - **Terraform**: `.terraform/`, `*.tfstate*`, `*.tfvars`, `.terraform.lock.hcl`
       - **Kubernetes/k8s**: `*.secret.yaml`, `secrets/`, `.kube/`, `kubeconfig*`, `*.key`, `*.crt`
    
    5. Parse tasks.md structure and extract:
       - **Task phases**: Setup, Tests, Core, Integration, Polish
       - **Task dependencies**: Sequential vs parallel execution rules
       - **Task details**: ID, description, file paths, parallel markers [P]
       - **Execution flow**: Order and dependency requirements
    
    6. Execute implementation following the task plan:
       - **Phase-by-phase execution**: Complete each phase before moving to the next
       - **Respect dependencies**: Run sequential tasks in order, parallel tasks [P] can run together
       - **Follow TDD approach**: Execute test tasks before their corresponding implementation tasks
       - **File-based coordination**: Tasks affecting the same files must run sequentially
       - **Validation checkpoints**: Verify each phase completion before proceeding
    
    7. Implementation execution rules:
       - **Setup first**: Initialize project structure, dependencies, configuration
       - **Tests before code**: If you need to write tests for contracts, entities, and integration scenarios
       - **Core development**: Implement models, services, CLI commands, endpoints
       - **Integration work**: Database connections, middleware, logging, external services

            Stream(LocalDate date,Browser user) throws Exception {

                reader=new Thread(()->{try(var input=new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(response.body(),java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8))){String name="",data="",line;while((line=input.readLine())!=null){if(line.startsWith("event:"))name=line.substring(6).strip();else if(line.startsWith("data:"))data=line.substring(5).strip();else if(line.isEmpty() && !name.isEmpty()){events.offer(new Event(name,data));name="";data="";}}}catch(IOException ignored){}finally{events.offer(new Event("EOF",""));}},"inventory-test-reader");reader.setDaemon(true);reader.start();

    @ActiveProfiles("test")
    @Import(MySqlTestSupport.TimeConfiguration.class)
    public abstract class MySqlTestSupport {
        // Digest identifies MySQL 8.4.11. Testcontainers expects repository@digest without a tag.
        public static final String MYSQL_IMAGE = "mysql@sha256:24989179f58856db763f418010c1169fecc944e3ec1ea7e921572d83eb070f70";
        public static final Instant INITIAL_TIME = Instant.parse("2026-10-16T01:00:00Z");
        protected static final MutableClock TEST_CLOCK = new MutableClock(INITIAL_TIME, ZoneOffset.UTC);
        protected static final Path MEDIA_ROOT = temporaryMedia();
        protected static final MySQLContainer MYSQL = database();
    
        static {
            Runtime.getRuntime().addShutdownHook(new Thread(() -> {
                MYSQL.stop();
                try (var paths = Files.walk(MEDIA_ROOT)) {
                    paths.sorted(Comparator.reverseOrder()).forEach(path -> {
                        try { Files.deleteIfExists(path); } catch (IOException ignored) { /* Temporary files only. */ }
                    });
                } catch (IOException ignored) { /* The OS may already have removed the temporary directory. */ }
            }, "webox-test-cleanup"));
        }
    
        @org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach
        void restoreTestClock() { TEST_CLOCK.set(INITIAL_TIME); }
    
        private static Path temporaryMedia() {
            try { return Files.createTempDirectory("webox-test-media-"); }
            catch (IOException e) { throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot create isolated test media directory", e); }
        }
    
        private static MySQLContainer database() {
            if (!DockerClientFactory.instance().isDockerAvailable()) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("Docker is required for core MySQL integration tests; tests cannot be skipped.");
            }
            var mysql = new MySQLContainer(MYSQL_IMAGE)
                    .withDatabaseName("webox_test")
                    .withUsername("webox_test")
                    .withPassword(UUID.randomUUID().toString())
                    .withCommand("--character-set-server=utf8mb4", "--collation-server=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci", "--default-time-zone=+00:00");
            mysql.start();
            return mysql;
        }
    
        protected static String jdbcUrl() {
            String base = MYSQL.getJdbcUrl();
            return base + (base.contains("?") ? "&" : "?") + "connectionTimeZone=UTC&forceConnectionTimeZoneToSession=true";
        }
    
        @DynamicPropertySource
        static void databaseProperties(DynamicPropertyRegistry properties) {
            properties.add("spring.datasource.url", MySqlTestSupport::jdbcUrl);
            properties.add("spring.datasource.username", MYSQL::getUsername);
            properties.add("spring.datasource.password", MYSQL::getPassword);
            properties.add("webox.media-root", () -> MEDIA_ROOT.toString());
        }
    
        @TestConfiguration(proxyBeanMethods = false)
        public static class TimeConfiguration {
            @Bean @Primary Clock testClock() { return TEST_CLOCK; }
        }
    
        public static final class MutableClock extends Clock {
            private final AtomicReference<Instant> current;
            private final ZoneId zone;
            private final ThreadLocal<Instant> requestTime;
            public MutableClock(Instant instant, ZoneId zone) { this(new AtomicReference<>(instant), zone, new ThreadLocal<>()); }
            private MutableClock(AtomicReference<Instant> current, ZoneId zone, ThreadLocal<Instant> requestTime) { this.current = current; this.zone = zone;this.requestTime=requestTime; }
            public void set(Instant instant) { current.set(instant); }
            public void requestTime(Instant instant) { if(instant==null) requestTime.remove();else requestTime.set(instant); }
            @Override public ZoneId getZone() { return zone; }
            @Override public Clock withZone(ZoneId zone) { return new MutableClock(current, zone, requestTime); }
            @Override public Instant instant() { return requestTime.get()==null?current.get():requestTime.get(); }
        }
    }
