    @Service
    @Transactional(readOnly=true,isolation=Isolation.REPEATABLE_READ)
    public class AdminOrderService {
        private final OrderRepository orders;private final UserRepository users;
        public AdminOrderService(OrderRepository orders,UserRepository users){this.orders=orders;this.users=users;}
        public record AdminOrder(String orderId,String orderNumber,LocalDate deliveryDate,Meal meal,String addressText,OrderStatus status,List<PricedLine> items,int totalQuantity,long totalCents,long version,Instant createdAt,Instant updatedAt,UserIdentity customer) {
            public static AdminOrder of(Order order,UserIdentity customer){return new AdminOrder(order.orderId(),order.orderNumber(),order.deliveryDate(),order.meal(),order.addressText(),order.status(),order.items(),order.totalQuantity(),order.totalCents(),order.version(),order.createdAt(),order.updatedAt(),customer);}
        }
        public record AdminOrderPage(List<AdminOrder> items,int page,int size,long totalElements) {}
        private AdminOrder view(OrderRepository.Row row){return AdminOrder.of(orders.view(row),users.byId(row.userId()).orElseThrow(OrderRepository::missing).identity());}
        public AdminOrder get(UserIdentity actor,String id){AdminDishService.admin(actor);return view(orders.find(id).orElseThrow(OrderRepository::missing));}
        public AdminOrderPage page(UserIdentity actor,LocalDate date,Meal meal,OrderStatus status,int page,int size){AdminDishService.admin(actor);var rows=orders.operationalPage(date,meal,status,page,size);return new AdminOrderPage(rows.rows().stream().map(this::view).toList(),page,size,rows.total());}
    }
    package com.webox.catalog;
    import java.time.LocalDate;
    import java.util.*;
    import com.webox.shared.DomainTypes.Category;
    import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;
    @Repository
    public class MenuQueryRepository {
        private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
        private static final String MEMBERS=" FROM daily_supply s JOIN dishes d ON d.id=s.dish_id WHERE s.delivery_date=? AND s.scheduled=TRUE AND d.is_listed=TRUE";
        public MenuQueryRepository(JdbcTemplate jdbc) { this.jdbc=jdbc; }
        public record Member(String dishId,long dishVersion,int remaining,long inventoryVersion) {}
        public record Results(List<Member> members,long total) {}
        public Results page(LocalDate date,List<Category> categories,String search,int page,int size) {
            return page(date,categories,search,page,size,com.webox.auth.PreferencesModels.Preferences.empty(),false);
        }
        public Results page(LocalDate date,List<Category> categories,String search,int page,int size,com.webox.auth.PreferencesModels.Preferences preferences,boolean recommended) {
            var sql=new StringBuilder(MEMBERS);var params=new ArrayList<Object>();params.add(date);
            if(!categories.isEmpty()) { sql.append(" AND d.category IN (").append(String.join(",",Collections.nCopies(categories.size(),"?"))).append(")");categories.forEach(c->params.add(c.value())); }
            if(!search.isEmpty()) {
                String escaped="%"+search.replace("!","!!").replace("%","!%").replace("_","!_")+"%";
                sql.append(" AND (d.name LIKE ? ESCAPE '!' OR d.description LIKE ? ESCAPE '!')");params.add(escaped);params.add(escaped);
            }
            long total=jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT COUNT(*)"+sql,Long.class,params.toArray());
            var order=new StringBuilder(" ORDER BY ");
            if(recommended && !preferences.cuisines().isEmpty()) {order.append("(d.category IN (").append(String.join(",",Collections.nCopies(preferences.cuisines().size(),"?"))).append(")) DESC,");preferences.cuisines().forEach(c->params.add(c.value()));}
            if(recommended && preferences.spiceLevel()!=null) {order.append("(d.spice=?) DESC,");params.add(preferences.spiceLevel().name());}
            order.append("d.name,d.id LIMIT ? OFFSET ?");params.add(size);params.add((long)page*size);
            var members=jdbc.query("SELECT d.id,d.version,s.total_quantity-s.allocated_quantity,s.version"+sql+order,(rs,n)->new Member(rs.getString(1),rs.getLong(2),rs.getInt(3),rs.getLong(4)),params.toArray());
            return new Results(members,total);
        }
        public Optional<Member> member(LocalDate date,String dishId) {
            return jdbc.query("SELECT d.id,d.version,s.total_quantity-s.allocated_quantity,s.version"+MEMBERS+" AND d.id=?",(rs,n)->new Member(rs.getString(1),rs.getLong(2),rs.getInt(3),rs.getLong(4)),date,dishId).stream().findFirst();
        }
    }

        private ReportingFixtures.Fixture fixture(){return new ReportingFixtures(jdbc,new CatalogFixtures(jdbc,media,MEDIA_ROOT,sessions,auth,manager),new FixtureFactory(sessions,auth)).create();}
        private JsonNode expected(ReportingFixtures.Fixture fixture,String which)throws Exception {
            JsonNode source;try(var in=getClass().getResourceAsStream("/reporting/expected-metrics.json")){source=json.readTree(in).path(which);}
            var value=(ObjectNode)source.deepCopy();LocalDate date=which.equals("D")?fixture.date():fixture.today();value.put("date",date.toString());
            for(var raw:value.path("topDishes")){var item=(ObjectNode)raw;String key=item.remove("dish").asString();item.put("dishId",fixture.dishes().get(key));}
            for(var raw:value.path("inventoryAlerts")){var item=(ObjectNode)raw;String key=item.remove("dish").asString();item.put("dishId",fixture.dishes().get(key));item.put("name","Current menu "+key);}
            for(var raw:value.path("trend")){var item=(ObjectNode)raw;int offset=item.remove("offset").asInt();item.put("date",date.plusDays(offset).toString());}return value;
        }
        @Test void allMetricsUseOneDeliveryDateAndSevenDayZerosAgainstIndependentExpectations()throws Exception {

            for(String which:List.of("D","T")) {
                var response=read("/admin/dashboard"+(which.equals("D")?"?date="+fixture.date():""),actor);assertEquals(200,response.getStatus());ContractAssertions.matches("Dashboard",responseBody(response));var actual=(ObjectNode)json.readTree(responseBody(response));assertEquals(TEST_CLOCK.instant().toString(),actual.remove("generatedAt").asString());assertTrue(actual.remove("countingPolicy").asString().contains("Completed Order Amount"));assertEquals(expected(fixture,which),actual);
            }
        }
        @Test void fourStatusesTenTwentyThirtyFortyCountOnlyThirtyCompletedAndExcludeNextDayDelivery()throws Exception {
            var menu=menu();var operations=admin();TEST_CLOCK.set(menu.date().atTime(8,0).atZone(com.webox.shared.BusinessClock.ZONE).toInstant());var catalog=new CatalogFixtures(jdbc,media,MEDIA_ROOT,sessions,auth,manager);
            for(int i=1;i<=4;i++) {
                var buyer=browser();String dish=catalog.dish(menu.date(),"Amount dish "+i,"Plain rice with vegetables.",i*1000,"Chinese","Rice",menu.mediaId(),true,true,20);
                var quote=postJson("/checkout/quotes",buyer,Map.of("deliveryDate",menu.date().toString(),"meal",i%2==1?"Lunch":"Dinner","items",List.of(line(dish,1,1))),null);assertEquals(201,quote.getStatus());var order=postJson("/orders",buyer,Map.of("quoteId",field(quote,"quoteId"),"addressText","Reporting fixture office"),UUID.randomUUID().toString());assertEquals(201,order.getStatus());String id=field(order,"orderId");
                if(i==2 || i==3){assertEquals(200,write("PATCH","/admin/orders/"+id+"/status",operations,Map.of("status","Confirmed","expectedVersion",0)).getStatus());if(i==3)assertEquals(200,write("PATCH","/admin/orders/"+id+"/status",operations,Map.of("status","Completed","expectedVersion",1)).getStatus());}
                if(i==4)assertEquals(200,postJson("/orders/"+id+"/cancel",buyer,null,null).getStatus());
            }
            LocalDate next=menu.date().plusDays(1);jdbc.update("INSERT INTO daily_menus VALUES (?,?,?,?)",next,1,menu.adminId(),java.sql.Timestamp.from(TEST_CLOCK.instant()));jdbc.update("INSERT INTO daily_supply SELECT ?,dish_id,scheduled,total_quantity,0,0,updated_at FROM daily_supply WHERE delivery_date=?",next,menu.date());var buyer=browser();var quote=postJson("/checkout/quotes",buyer,Map.of("deliveryDate",next.toString(),"meal","Lunch","items",List.of(line(menu.chinese(),1,1))),null);assertEquals(201,quote.getStatus());assertEquals(201,postJson("/orders",buyer,Map.of("quoteId",field(quote,"quoteId"),"addressText","Next-day fixture office"),UUID.randomUUID().toString()).getStatus());
            var response=read("/admin/dashboard?date="+menu.date(),operations);assertEquals(200,response.getStatus());var value=json.readTree(responseBody(response));assertEquals(4,value.path("totalOrders").asLong());assertEquals(3000,value.path("revenueCents").asLong());assertEquals(1,value.path("completedOrders").asLong());assertEquals(2,value.path("pendingOrders").asLong());assertEquals(1,value.path("cancelledOrders").asLong());assertEquals(1,value.path("topDishes").size());assertEquals("Amount dish 3",value.path("topDishes").get(0).path("name").asString());
        }
    }

    package com.webox.shared;
    import java.time.*;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
    import com.webox.shared.DomainTypes.Meal;
    @Component
    public final class BusinessClock {
        public static final ZoneId ZONE = ZoneId.of("Asia/Shanghai");
        private final Clock clock;
        public BusinessClock(Clock clock) { this.clock = clock; }
        public Instant now() { return clock.instant(); }
        public LocalDate today() { return now().atZone(ZONE).toLocalDate(); }
        public Instant cutoff(LocalDate date, Meal meal) {
            return date.atTime(meal == Meal.Lunch ? 10 : 15, 0).atZone(ZONE).toInstant();
        }
    }

    @RestController
    @RequestMapping("/api/v1/admin/dishes")
    public class AdminDishController {
        private final AdminDishService dishes;
        public AdminDishController(AdminDishService dishes){this.dishes=dishes;}
        @GetMapping public AdminDishPage page(@RequestParam(defaultValue="") List<String> categories,@RequestParam(defaultValue="") String search,@RequestParam(required=false) String published,@RequestParam(defaultValue="0") int page,@RequestParam(defaultValue="24") int size) {
            if(page<0 || size<1 || size>100 || categories.size()>6 || new HashSet<>(categories).size()!=categories.size() || ValueRules.codePoints(search)>50 || published!=null && !Set.of("true","false").contains(published))throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid dish query.");return dishes.page(categories.stream().map(Category::parse).toList(),search.strip(),published==null?null:Boolean.valueOf(published),page,size);
        }
        @GetMapping("/{dishId}") public AdminDish get(@PathVariable String dishId){return dishes.get(ValueRules.uuid(dishId));}

        @PutMapping("/{dishId}") public AdminDish update(@AuthenticationPrincipal UserIdentity actor,@PathVariable String dishId,@RequestBody DishUpdate body){return dishes.update(actor,ValueRules.uuid(dishId),body);}
        @PatchMapping("/{dishId}/publication") public AdminDish publish(@AuthenticationPrincipal UserIdentity actor,@PathVariable String dishId,@RequestBody Publication body){return dishes.publish(actor,ValueRules.uuid(dishId),body);}
    }
    package com.webox.shared;
    
    import java.util.Locale;
    import java.util.regex.Pattern;
    
    /** Shared scalar rules. No floating point is used for money. */
    public final class ValueRules {
        public static final long MAX_SAFE_INTEGER = 9007199254740991L;
        private static final Pattern EDGE_SPACE = Pattern.compile("^[\\x09-\\x0D\\x20\\u00A0\\u1680\\u2000-\\u200A\\u2028\\u2029\\u202F\\u205F\\u3000\\uFEFF]+|[\\x09-\\x0D\\x20\\u00A0\\u1680\\u2000-\\u200A\\u2028\\u2029\\u202F\\u205F\\u3000\\uFEFF]+$");
        private ValueRules() {}
        public static String uuid(String value) {
            if(value==null || !value.matches("[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid identifier.");
            return java.util.UUID.fromString(value).toString();
        }
        public static java.time.LocalDate date(String value) {
            if(value==null || !value.matches("[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid date.");
            try { return java.time.LocalDate.parse(value); }
            catch(java.time.format.DateTimeParseException e) { throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid date."); }
        }
        public static long safeInteger(long value) {
            if (value < 0 || value > MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Value must be a non-negative safe integer.");
            return value;
        }
        public static long add(long a, long b) {
            safeInteger(a); safeInteger(b);
            if (a > MAX_SAFE_INTEGER - b) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Total exceeds the supported amount.");
            return a + b;
        }
        public static long multiply(long a, long b) {
            safeInteger(a); safeInteger(b);
            if (b != 0 && a > MAX_SAFE_INTEGER / b) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Total exceeds the supported amount.");
            return a * b;
        }
        public static long nextVersion(long value) { return add(value, 1); }
        public static String money(long cents) {
            safeInteger(cents);
            return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%d.%02d", cents / 100, cents % 100);
        }
        public static String requiredText(String text, int max) {
            if (text == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("This field is required.");
            String normalized = EDGE_SPACE.matcher(text).replaceAll("");
            int length = codePoints(normalized);
            if (length == 0 || length > max) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Text must contain 1 to " + max + " characters.");
            return normalized;
        }
        public static String password(String text) {
            int length = codePoints(text);
            if (length < 8 || length > 128 || !Pattern.compile("[A-Za-z]").matcher(text).find() || !Pattern.compile("[0-9]").matcher(text).find())
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Password must contain 8 to 128 characters, including a letter and a number.");
            return text;
        }
        public static int codePoints(String text) {
            if (text == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("This field is required.");
            for (int i=0; i<text.length(); i++) {
                char c=text.charAt(i);
                if (Character.isHighSurrogate(c)) {
                    if (++i >= text.length() || !Character.isLowSurrogate(text.charAt(i))) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Text contains invalid Unicode.");
                } else if (Character.isLowSurrogate(c)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Text contains invalid Unicode.");
            }
            return text.codePointCount(0,text.length());
        }
    }
    package com.webox.ordering;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
    import com.webox.auth.*;
    import com.webox.inventory.InventoryMutationService;
    import com.webox.shared.*;
    import com.webox.shared.DomainTypes.*;
    import static com.webox.ordering.OrderingModels.*;
    @Service
    public class OrderStatusService {
        private final UserRepository users;private final OrderRepository orders;private final OrderItemRepository items;private final InventoryMutationService inventory;private final OrderTransactionExecutor transactions;private final BusinessClock clock;
        public OrderStatusService(UserRepository users,OrderRepository orders,OrderItemRepository items,InventoryMutationService inventory,OrderTransactionExecutor transactions,BusinessClock clock) {this.users=users;this.orders=orders;this.items=items;this.inventory=inventory;this.transactions=transactions;this.clock=clock;}
        public Order cancel(String user,String id) { return change(user,id,OrderStatus.Cancelled,null,false); }
        public Order administer(UserIdentity actor,String id,OrderStatus target,long expectedVersion) {
            if(actor.role()!=Role.Admin) throw new ApiException(403,"FORBIDDEN","Administrator access is required.");ValueRules.safeInteger(expectedVersion);return change(actor.userId(),id,target,expectedVersion,true);
        }
        private Order change(String actor,String id,OrderStatus target,Long version,boolean administrator) {
            var located=orders.find(id).orElseThrow(OrderRepository::missing);String owner=located.userId();if(!administrator && !owner.equals(actor)) throw OrderRepository.missing();
            return transactions.execute(()->{
                users.lockOwner(owner).orElseThrow(OrderRepository::missing);var order=orders.lock(id,owner);
                if(order.status()==OrderStatus.Cancelled && target==OrderStatus.Cancelled) return orders.view(order);
                if(administrator && order.version()!=version) throw new ApiException(409,"VERSION_CONFLICT","This order has changed. Reload its current status.");
                boolean allowed=order.status()==OrderStatus.Pending && (target==OrderStatus.Confirmed || target==OrderStatus.Cancelled) || order.status()==OrderStatus.Confirmed && target==OrderStatus.Completed;
                if(!allowed) throw new ApiException(409,administrator?"INVALID_ORDER_TRANSITION":"ORDER_NOT_CANCELLABLE",administrator?"This order status change is not allowed.":"Only a pending order can be cancelled.");
                if(target==OrderStatus.Cancelled) inventory.restore(inventory.lock(order.date(),items.list(order.id())));
                orders.transition(order,target,clock.now());return orders.owned(id,owner);
            },null);
        }
    }

    package com.webox.support;
    import com.webox.shared.DomainTypes.Role;
    import java.io.IOException;
    import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
    import java.time.*;
    import java.util.*;
    import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
    import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
    import org.springframework.jdbc.core.namedparam.NamedParameterJdbcTemplate;
    /** Test-only immutable order snapshots and coherent supply rows. Expected totals are handwritten separately. */
    public final class ReportingFixtures {
        private static final AtomicInteger SERIAL=new AtomicInteger();private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;private final CatalogFixtures catalog;private final FixtureFactory identities;
        public ReportingFixtures(JdbcTemplate jdbc,CatalogFixtures catalog,FixtureFactory identities){this.jdbc=jdbc;this.catalog=catalog;this.identities=identities;}
        public record Fixture(LocalDate date,LocalDate today,Map<String,String> dishes,Map<String,String> orders){}
        public Fixture create() {
            var base=catalog.create();LocalDate date=LocalDate.of(2051,3,8).plusYears(10L*SERIAL.getAndIncrement()),today=date.plusDays(7);var pair=new ArrayList<>(List.of(base.burger(),base.pasta()));Collections.sort(pair);var dishes=Map.of("A",pair.get(0),"B",pair.get(1),"C",base.chinese(),"J",base.japanese());
            var params=new HashMap<String,Object>();params.putAll(dishes);params.put("D",date);params.put("option",UUID.randomUUID().toString());params.put("groupId",UUID.randomUUID().toString());var orders=new LinkedHashMap<String,String>();
            for(int i=1;i<=18;i++){String id=UUID.randomUUID().toString();orders.put("o"+i,id);params.put("o"+i,id);}for(int i=1;i<=3;i++)params.put("u"+i,identities.identity(Role.Employee).user().userId());
            for(LocalDate day=date.minusDays(6);!day.isAfter(today);day=day.plusDays(1)){
                jdbc.update("INSERT INTO daily_menus VALUES (?,?,?,?)",day,1,base.adminId(),java.sql.Timestamp.from(MySqlTestSupport.INITIAL_TIME));
                jdbc.update("INSERT INTO daily_supply SELECT ?,dish_id,scheduled,20,0,0,updated_at FROM daily_supply WHERE delivery_date=?",day,base.date());
            }
            try(var input=ReportingFixtures.class.getResourceAsStream("/reporting/seven-day-orders.sql")){if(input==null)throw new IllegalStateException("Missing reporting fixture.");String sql=new String(input.readAllBytes(),StandardCharsets.UTF_8);var named=new NamedParameterJdbcTemplate(jdbc);for(String statement:sql.split(";"))if(!statement.isBlank())named.update(statement,params);}catch(IOException failure){throw new IllegalStateException(failure);}
            jdbc.update("UPDATE daily_supply s JOIN (SELECT o.delivery_date,i.dish_id,SUM(i.quantity) allocated FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.id WHERE o.delivery_date BETWEEN ? AND ? AND o.status<>'Cancelled' GROUP BY o.delivery_date,i.dish_id) used ON used.delivery_date=s.delivery_date AND used.dish_id=s.dish_id SET s.allocated_quantity=used.allocated",date.minusDays(6),today);
            for(String key:List.of("A","B","C"))jdbc.update("UPDATE dishes SET name=?,version=version+1 WHERE id=?","Current menu "+key,dishes.get(key));
            for(var day:List.of(date,today)) {
                var remaining=day.equals(date)?Map.of("A",3,"B",0,"C",4,"J",5):Map.of("A",0,"B",2,"C",1,"J",20);
                remaining.forEach((key,quantity)->jdbc.update("UPDATE daily_supply SET total_quantity=allocated_quantity+? WHERE delivery_date=? AND dish_id=?",quantity,day,dishes.get(key)));
                jdbc.update("UPDATE daily_supply SET total_quantity=8 WHERE delivery_date=? AND dish_id=?",day,base.salad());jdbc.update("UPDATE daily_supply SET total_quantity=1 WHERE delivery_date=? AND dish_id=?",day,base.hidden());jdbc.update("UPDATE daily_supply SET total_quantity=0 WHERE delivery_date=? AND dish_id=?",day,base.unscheduled());
            }
            return new Fixture(date,today,Map.copyOf(dishes),Map.copyOf(orders));

        cat > backend/src/main/java/com/webox/reporting/DashboardRepository.java <<'EOF'
        package com.webox.reporting;
        import java.sql.*;
        import java.time.LocalDate;
        import java.util.List;
        import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
        import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;
        import com.webox.shared.ValueRules;
        import static com.webox.reporting.DashboardModels.*;
        @Repository
        public class DashboardRepository {
            private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
            public DashboardRepository(JdbcTemplate jdbc){this.jdbc=jdbc;}
            // MySQL SUM(BIGINT) is DECIMAL. Check before serializing to JavaScript-safe integer cents/counts.
            private static long total(ResultSet row,String field)throws SQLException {
                try {var value=row.getBigDecimal(field);long exact=value==null?0:value.longValueExact();if(exact<0 || exact>ValueRules.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)throw new ArithmeticException();return exact;}
                catch(ArithmeticException failure){throw new IllegalStateException("Dashboard aggregate exceeds the supported range.");}
            }
            public Summary summary(LocalDate date) {
                return jdbc.queryForObject("""
                    SELECT COUNT(*) total_orders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='Completed' THEN total_cents ELSE 0 END),0) revenue,
                      COALESCE(SUM(status='Completed'),0) completed, COALESCE(SUM(status IN ('Pending','Confirmed')),0) pending,
                      COALESCE(SUM(status='Cancelled'),0) cancelled, COALESCE(SUM(meal='Lunch'),0) lunch, COALESCE(SUM(meal='Dinner'),0) dinner
                    FROM orders WHERE delivery_date=?
                    """,(row,n)->new Summary(total(row,"total_orders"),total(row,"revenue"),total(row,"completed"),total(row,"pending"),total(row,"cancelled"),total(row,"lunch"),total(row,"dinner")),date);
            }
            public List<TopDish> topDishes(LocalDate date) {
                return jdbc.query("""
                    WITH counted AS (
                      SELECT i.dish_id,i.dish_name_snapshot,i.quantity,
                        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY i.dish_id ORDER BY o.created_at DESC,o.id DESC,i.id DESC) latest
                      FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.id WHERE o.delivery_date=? AND o.status='Completed'
                    )
                    SELECT dish_id,MAX(CASE WHEN latest=1 THEN dish_name_snapshot END) name,SUM(quantity) quantity
                    FROM counted GROUP BY dish_id ORDER BY quantity DESC,dish_id ASC LIMIT 10
                    """,(row,n)->new TopDish(row.getString("dish_id"),row.getString("name"),total(row,"quantity")),date);
            }
            public List<Day> trend(LocalDate date) {
                return jdbc.query("""
                    SELECT delivery_date,COUNT(*) orders,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='Completed' THEN total_cents ELSE 0 END),0) revenue
                    FROM orders WHERE delivery_date BETWEEN ? AND ? GROUP BY delivery_date ORDER BY delivery_date
                    """,(row,n)->new Day(row.getObject("delivery_date",LocalDate.class),total(row,"orders"),total(row,"revenue")),date.minusDays(6),date);
            }
            public List<InventoryAlert> inventory(LocalDate date) {
                return jdbc.query("""
                    SELECT d.id,d.name,s.total_quantity-s.allocated_quantity remaining FROM daily_supply s JOIN dishes d ON d.id=s.dish_id
                    WHERE s.delivery_date=? AND s.scheduled=TRUE AND d.is_listed=TRUE AND s.total_quantity-s.allocated_quantity BETWEEN 0 AND 3
                    ORDER BY remaining ASC,d.id ASC
                    """,(row,n)->new InventoryAlert(row.getString("id"),row.getString("name"),total(row,"remaining"),row.getLong("remaining")==0?"SoldOut":"LowStock"),date);
            }
        }
        EOF
        cat > backend/src/main/java/com/webox/reporting/DashboardService.java <<'EOF'
        package com.webox.reporting;
        import java.time.LocalDate;
        import java.util.*;
        import java.util.function.Function;
        import java.util.stream.Collectors;
        import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
        import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.*;
        import com.webox.auth.UserIdentity;
        import com.webox.catalog.AdminDishService;
        import com.webox.shared.BusinessClock;
        import com.webox.shared.DomainTypes.Meal;
        import static com.webox.reporting.DashboardModels.*;
        @Service
        public class DashboardService {
            private final DashboardRepository repository;private final BusinessClock clock;
            public DashboardService(DashboardRepository repository,BusinessClock clock){this.repository=repository;this.clock=clock;}
            @Transactional(readOnly=true,isolation=Isolation.REPEATABLE_READ)
            public Dashboard get(UserIdentity actor,LocalDate requestedDate) {
                AdminDishService.admin(actor);LocalDate date=requestedDate==null?clock.today():requestedDate;
                var summary=repository.summary(date);var top=repository.topDishes(date);
                var indexed=repository.trend(date).stream().collect(Collectors.toMap(Day::date,Function.identity()));var trend=new ArrayList<Day>(7);
                for(int offset=6;offset>=0;offset--){LocalDate day=date.minusDays(offset);trend.add(indexed.getOrDefault(day,new Day(day,0,0)));}
                var alerts=repository.inventory(date);
                return new Dashboard(date,clock.now(),summary.totalOrders(),summary.revenueCents(),summary.completedOrders(),summary.pendingOrders(),summary.cancelledOrders(),top,List.of(new MealCount(Meal.Lunch,summary.lunch()),new MealCount(Meal.Dinner,summary.dinner())),List.copyOf(trend),alerts,
                    "All figures use delivery dates in Asia/Shanghai. Order and meal counts include all statuses; pending means Pending + Confirmed. Completed Order Amount includes add-ons from Completed orders; it is not payment received. Top dishes count completed portions, merging configurations and using names at purchase. The trend covers the selected date and its six preceding days. Inventory alerts show the current remaining stock for scheduled, published dishes on the selected date, not historical stock.");
            }
        }

    /** A disposable real database; never connects to the development Compose volume. */
    @ActiveProfiles("test")
    @Import(MySqlTestSupport.TimeConfiguration.class)
    public abstract class MySqlTestSupport {
        // Digest identifies MySQL 8.4.11. Testcontainers expects repository@digest without a tag.
        public static final String MYSQL_IMAGE = "mysql@sha256:24989179f58856db763f418010c1169fecc944e3ec1ea7e921572d83eb070f70";
        public static final Instant INITIAL_TIME = Instant.parse("2026-10-16T01:00:00Z");
        protected static final MutableClock TEST_CLOCK = new MutableClock(INITIAL_TIME, ZoneOffset.UTC);
        protected static final Path MEDIA_ROOT = temporaryMedia();
        protected static final MySQLContainer MYSQL = database();
    
        static {
            Runtime.getRuntime().addShutdownHook(new Thread(() -> {
                MYSQL.stop();
                try (var paths = Files.walk(MEDIA_ROOT)) {
                    paths.sorted(Comparator.reverseOrder()).forEach(path -> {
                        try { Files.deleteIfExists(path); } catch (IOException ignored) { /* Temporary files only. */ }
                    });
                } catch (IOException ignored) { /* The OS may already have removed the temporary directory. */ }
            }, "webox-test-cleanup"));
        }
    
        @org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach
        void restoreTestClock() { TEST_CLOCK.set(INITIAL_TIME); }
    
        private static Path temporaryMedia() {
            try { return Files.createTempDirectory("webox-test-media-"); }
            catch (IOException e) { throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot create isolated test media directory", e); }
        }
    
        private static MySQLContainer database() {
            if (!DockerClientFactory.instance().isDockerAvailable()) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("Docker is required for core MySQL integration tests; tests cannot be skipped.");
            }
            var mysql = new MySQLContainer(MYSQL_IMAGE)
                    .withDatabaseName("webox_test")
                    .withUsername("webox_test")
                    .withPassword(UUID.randomUUID().toString())
                    .withCommand("--character-set-server=utf8mb4", "--collation-server=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci", "--default-time-zone=+00:00");
            mysql.start();
            return mysql;
        }
    
        protected static String jdbcUrl() {
            String base = MYSQL.getJdbcUrl();
            return base + (base.contains("?") ? "&" : "?") + "connectionTimeZone=UTC&forceConnectionTimeZoneToSession=true";
        }
    
        @DynamicPropertySource
        static void databaseProperties(DynamicPropertyRegistry properties) {
            properties.add("spring.datasource.url", MySqlTestSupport::jdbcUrl);
            properties.add("spring.datasource.username", MYSQL::getUsername);
            properties.add("spring.datasource.password", MYSQL::getPassword);
            properties.add("webox.media-root", () -> MEDIA_ROOT.toString());
        }
    
        @TestConfiguration(proxyBeanMethods = false)
        public static class TimeConfiguration {
            @Bean @Primary Clock testClock() { return TEST_CLOCK; }
        }
    
        public static final class MutableClock extends Clock {
            private final AtomicReference<Instant> current;
            private final ZoneId zone;
            private final ThreadLocal<Instant> requestTime;
            public MutableClock(Instant instant, ZoneId zone) { this(new AtomicReference<>(instant), zone, new ThreadLocal<>()); }
            private MutableClock(AtomicReference<Instant> current, ZoneId zone, ThreadLocal<Instant> requestTime) { this.current = current; this.zone = zone;this.requestTime=requestTime; }
            public void set(Instant instant) { current.set(instant); }
            public void requestTime(Instant instant) { if(instant==null) requestTime.remove();else requestTime.set(instant); }
            @Override public ZoneId getZone() { return zone; }
            @Override public Clock withZone(ZoneId zone) { return new MutableClock(current, zone, requestTime); }
            @Override public Instant instant() { return requestTime.get()==null?current.get():requestTime.get(); }
        }
    }

    import type { BrowserContext } from '@playwright/test';
    import type { Role, User } from '../../src/shared/api/types';
    export async function identitySession(context: BrowserContext, role: Role = 'Employee'): Promise<User> {
      const origin = process.env.WEBOX_E2E_API_ORIGIN ?? 'http://127.0.0.1:18081';
      const key = process.env.WEBOX_E2E_FIXTURE_KEY;
      if (!key) throw new Error('E2E fixture key is missing. Start the isolated test server through Playwright.');
      const response = await context.request.post(`${origin}/__test/sessions`, { headers: { 'X-WeBox-Fixture-Key': key }, data: { role } });
      if (!response.ok()) throw new Error(`Cannot create isolated test identity (${response.status()}).`);
      const result = await response.json() as { user: User; sessionId: string };
      await context.addCookies([{ name: 'WEBOXSESSION', value: result.sessionId, domain: '127.0.0.1', path: '/', httpOnly: true, secure: false, sameSite: 'Lax' }]);
      return result.user;
    }

    # US8：真实模型推荐
    
    2026-10-16，执行者：Codex。已接通 OpenRouter 两阶段调用、POST SSE、推荐面板和既有配置/购物车。T104–T117完成；真实模型功能24/24、独立浏览器性能20/20、真实下单与最新版本全量回归均通过。本阶段AC-US08-01–05与AC-REV-03已更新为通过；SC-010仍保留真人相关性待验收。
    
    ## 已验证的实现
    
    - 严格请求结构、Unicode 码点上限、日期/餐次、认证和 CSRF；流前返回 JSON 错误，流后只返回有界英文错误。
    - 从真实 MySQL 取目标日期已安排、上架且有库存的菜品。已保存及明确新增的过敏原按基础标签与全部选项标签的并集排除；明确菜系、辣度、预算、蛋白质或菜名进一步过滤。
    - 默认近七天非取消订单仅影响排序；明确排重日期由 Asia/Shanghai 运营日期归一化，查询完整范围。不能用模型截取的短证据把三十天缩成七天；含混区间要求澄清。
    - 发出每张卡之前使用新的一致性快照，重读偏好版本、菜单成员、资料版本、库存和所需历史。菜品资料来自数据库，理由必须通过 ID、重复、英文纯文本、长度及事实校验。
    - 外层 SSE 与内层 JSON 分别解析；完整 item 才可能发卡。必须同时具备完整 JSON、正常 stop 与 `[DONE]` 才能完成；中途失败保留明确 partial 状态。
    - 默认并发 1、队列 8，总 deadline 20 秒包含排队和两阶段；取消关闭上游。下游使用非阻塞有界队列，15 秒心跳与 1 秒连接探测，避免短请求等到下一次心跳才发现浏览器已断开。探测不计有效内容、不延长会话空闲期限。
    - 浏览器逐卡渲染，换诉求/日期/餐次/离开/退出取消旧请求；推荐卡复用 DishDialog 和购物车的配置、过敏原提醒及五份上限。推荐餐次带入结算。
    - 只在有界内存诊断中保留请求 UUID、模型/provider/generation ID、可用 usage/fingerprint 和阶段耗时；不存提示词、用户 ID、邮箱、地址、会话或密钥。原始模型结果的额外诊断仅存在于 llm-live 测试类，输入都是登记的合成夹具。
    
    ## 自动化证据
    
    - `.local/logs/us8-contract-red.log`：接口实施前的真实 404 行为失败。
    - `.local/logs/us8-facts-green.log`：17 项真实 MySQL/HTTP 集成测试通过，覆盖完整与 partial、缺配置、库存/偏好/历史变化、满队列、总时限、浏览器取消和会话撤销；同次单元检查也通过。
    - `.local/logs/us8-front-stream-red.log` → `.local/logs/us8-front-cutoff-fixed.log`：POST 流和取消接通后，52 项前端单元测试通过。测试还发现旧结算组件在自动切换餐次时存在短暂 ready 状态；现同时检查当前餐次是否合法，切换前立即撤销 ready。
    - `.local/logs/us8-e2e-first.log`：Chromium/Firefox/WebKit × 375/768/1440，推荐故障恢复、订餐和规则回归共 **90 项通过**。其中 27 项为推荐场景；partial 明确标为故障注入，不作为真实推荐质量证据。
    - `.local/logs/us8-front-minimum-build.log`：类型检查与生产构建通过。
    
    ## 固定真实模型用例及历史失败
    
    登记文件：`backend/src/test/resources/recommendation/live-cases.json`，SHA-256 `7e17a65d10f3fe36e5d16cde74caa579b74b9bf056b739b0ecc3332146a193ec`。包含 24 组功能输入和独立的 20 次正常性能请求；固定并发 1、一次暖机、默认 `openai/gpt-4.1-mini`、temperature 0、max_tokens 512。业务今天为 2026-10-16，配送日期为隔离夹具中的合法未来日期；全部尝试保留，重跑使用新文件名。
    
    此前轮次均保留在 `backend/target/failsafe-live-reports/recommendation-functional-*.json`，已复制到本目录：
    
    - `initial`：15/24 通过。普通诉求误澄清、相对日期计算不稳定、理由包含未证实健康/过敏原断言等失败均保留。
    - `retest1`：17/24 通过。保存了结构化意图和原始理由，定位到“healthy”“gluten-free”等违规断言，以及明确要意面却返回其他菜的情况。
    - `retest2`：20/24 通过。继续定位“light meal”被误认成菜系、真实菜系比较语句被误拒绝，以及一项无依据的 dairy-free 断言。
    - `retest3`：对理由增加负向正则约束的兼容性实验失败；上游输出空内容并以 length/max_output_tokens 终止。该限制已移除，不能用增加输出上限或接受截断输出绕过校验。能力探测见 `us8-schema-capability-raw.txt`；Python 客户端连接失败和 curl 探测也分别保留。
    - `retest4`：22/24 通过，发现模型虚构过敏原及重述 without dairy 的断言。
    - `retest5`：**24/24 通过**。只允许提取诉求实际提及的过敏原；第二阶段只接收规范化意图和过滤后的候选，不再传原始诉求或过敏原列表。每个有候选的成功结果均有两阶段真实 generation ID。

    import org.springframework.http.HttpMethod;
    import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity;
    import org.springframework.security.web.SecurityFilterChain;
    import org.springframework.security.web.csrf.HttpSessionCsrfTokenRepository;
    import org.springframework.security.web.csrf.CsrfException;
    import org.springframework.security.web.context.HttpSessionSecurityContextRepository;
    import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetailsService;
    import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UsernameNotFoundException;
    import org.springframework.session.web.http.DefaultCookieSerializer;
    import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;
    @org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.condition.ConditionalOnWebApplication
    @Configuration(proxyBeanMethods=false)
    public class SecurityConfiguration {
        @Bean HttpSessionCsrfTokenRepository csrfRepository() {
            var repo=new HttpSessionCsrfTokenRepository(); repo.setHeaderName("X-XSRF-TOKEN"); return repo;
        }
        @Bean HttpSessionSecurityContextRepository securityContextRepository() { return new HttpSessionSecurityContextRepository(); }
        @Bean UserDetailsService disabledDefaultUser() { return name -> { throw new UsernameNotFoundException("Use the application login endpoint."); }; }
        @Bean DefaultCookieSerializer cookieSerializer(@Value("${server.servlet.session.cookie.secure}") boolean secure) {
            var cookie=new DefaultCookieSerializer();cookie.setCookieName("WEBOXSESSION");cookie.setCookiePath("/");
            cookie.setUseHttpOnlyCookie(true);cookie.setUseSecureCookie(secure);cookie.setSameSite("Lax");cookie.setUseBase64Encoding(false);return cookie;
        }
        @Bean SecurityFilterChain security(HttpSecurity http,JsonMapper mapper,HttpSessionCsrfTokenRepository csrf,HttpSessionSecurityContextRepository contexts) throws Exception {
            http.formLogin(c->c.disable()).httpBasic(c->c.disable()).logout(c->c.disable()).requestCache(c->c.disable());
            http.securityContext(c->c.securityContextRepository(contexts).requireExplicitSave(true));
            http.csrf(c->c.csrfTokenRepository(csrf));
            http.authorizeHttpRequests(c->c
                // Only the container's internal error endpoint; normal /error and all API requests keep their rules.
                .requestMatchers(request->request.getDispatcherType()==jakarta.servlet.DispatcherType.ERROR && request.getRequestURI().equals(request.getContextPath()+"/error")).permitAll()
                .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET,"/api/v1/health","/api/v1/auth/csrf","/media/*").permitAll()
                .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.POST,"/api/v1/auth/register","/api/v1/auth/login").permitAll()
                .requestMatchers("/api/v1/admin/**").hasRole("Admin")
                .requestMatchers("/api/v1/**").authenticated().anyRequest().denyAll());
            http.exceptionHandling(c->c
                .authenticationEntryPoint((req,res,e)->ApiErrors.write(mapper,req,res,new ApiException(401,"UNAUTHENTICATED","Please sign in to continue.")))
                .accessDeniedHandler((req,res,e)->ApiErrors.write(mapper,req,res,e instanceof CsrfException
                    ? new ApiException(403,"CSRF_INVALID","Your security token is invalid. Please refresh and try again.")
                    : new ApiException(403,"FORBIDDEN","You do not have permission to perform this action."))));
            return http.build();
        }
    }

    package com.webox.auth;
    import com.webox.support.MySqlTestSupport;
    import com.webox.support.ContractAssertions;
    import jakarta.servlet.http.Cookie;
    import java.util.Map;
    import java.util.UUID;
    import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
    import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
    import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
    import org.springframework.boot.webmvc.test.autoconfigure.AutoConfigureMockMvc;
    import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
    import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.MockMvc;
    import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;
    import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
    import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders.*;
    import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.result.MockMvcResultMatchers.*;
    @SpringBootTest
    @AutoConfigureMockMvc(print=org.springframework.boot.webmvc.test.autoconfigure.MockMvcPrint.NONE)
    class AuthContractIT extends MySqlTestSupport {
        @Autowired com.webox.shared.AdminInitializer admins; @Autowired MockMvc mvc; @Autowired JsonMapper json; @Autowired JdbcTemplate jdbc;
        record Browser(Cookie cookie,String token) {}
        Browser csrf(Cookie cookie) throws Exception {
            var req=get("/api/v1/auth/csrf");if(cookie!=null) req.cookie(cookie);
            var result=mvc.perform(req).andExpect(status().isOk()).andReturn().getResponse();
            ContractAssertions.matches("Csrf",result.getContentAsString());
            return new Browser(cookie==null?result.getCookie("WEBOXSESSION"):cookie,json.readTree(result.getContentAsString()).path("token").asText());
        }
        org.springframework.mock.web.MockHttpServletResponse postJson(String path,Browser browser,Object body,int expected) throws Exception {
            var response=mvc.perform(post("/api/v1"+path).cookie(browser.cookie()).header("X-XSRF-TOKEN",browser.token()).contentType("application/json").content(json.writeValueAsString(body)))
                .andExpect(status().is(expected)).andReturn().getResponse();
            if(expected!=204) ContractAssertions.response(path,"post",expected,response.getContentAsString());return response;
        }
        @Test void registrationDoesNotLoginAndLoginRotatesSessionAndCsrf() throws Exception {
            var anonymous=csrf(null);String email="  USER"+UUID.randomUUID()+"@Example.org  ";String password="  Ab1234🍜  ";
            var registration=postJson("/auth/register",anonymous,Map.of("email",email,"password",password),201);
            assertEquals("Employee",json.readTree(registration.getContentAsString()).path("role").asText());
            mvc.perform(get("/api/v1/auth/me").cookie(anonymous.cookie())).andExpect(status().isUnauthorized());
            var login=postJson("/auth/login",anonymous,Map.of("email",email.trim().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT),"password",password),200);
            var authenticated=login.getCookie("WEBOXSESSION");assertNotNull(authenticated);assertNotEquals(anonymous.cookie().getValue(),authenticated.getValue());
            mvc.perform(get("/api/v1/auth/me").cookie(anonymous.cookie())).andExpect(status().isUnauthorized());
            var me=mvc.perform(get("/api/v1/auth/me").cookie(authenticated)).andExpect(status().isOk()).andReturn().getResponse();
            ContractAssertions.matches("User",me.getContentAsString());assertEquals(json.readTree(registration.getContentAsString()),json.readTree(me.getContentAsString()));
            postJson("/auth/logout",new Browser(authenticated,anonymous.token()),Map.of(),403);
            var fresh=csrf(authenticated);postJson("/auth/logout",fresh,Map.of(),204);
            mvc.perform(get("/api/v1/auth/me").cookie(authenticated)).andExpect(status().isUnauthorized());
            String hash=jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT password_hash FROM users WHERE id=?",String.class,json.readTree(me.getContentAsString()).path("userId").asText());
            assertTrue(hash.startsWith("$argon2id$"));assertFalse(hash.contains(password));
        }
        @Test void duplicatesInvalidCredentialsAndRoleInjectionNeverCreatePrivilege() throws Exception {

    package com.webox.media;
    import java.nio.file.*;
    import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
    import com.webox.shared.ApiException;
    import com.webox.shared.ValueRules;
    import org.springframework.core.io.FileSystemResource;
    import org.springframework.core.io.Resource;
    import org.springframework.http.*;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
    @RestController
    public class PublicMediaController {
        private final MediaRepository media;private final Path root;
        public PublicMediaController(MediaRepository media,Path mediaRoot) { this.media=media;this.root=mediaRoot; }
        @GetMapping("/media/{mediaId}") public ResponseEntity<Resource> image(@PathVariable String mediaId) {
            var asset=media.find(ValueRules.uuid(mediaId)).orElseThrow(PublicMediaController::missing);
            try {
                Path path=root.resolve(asset.storageKey()).normalize();
                if(!path.startsWith(root) || !Files.isRegularFile(path,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) throw missing();
                Path real=path.toRealPath();if(!real.startsWith(root.toRealPath()) || Files.size(real)!=asset.bytes()) throw missing();
                return ResponseEntity.ok().contentType(MediaType.parseMediaType(asset.mime())).contentLength(asset.bytes())
                    .cacheControl(CacheControl.maxAge(365,TimeUnit.DAYS).cachePublic().immutable()).header("X-Content-Type-Options","nosniff")
                    .eTag("\""+asset.sha256()+"\"").body(new FileSystemResource(real));
            } catch(java.io.IOException e) { throw missing(); }
        }
        private static ApiException missing() { return new ApiException(404,"NOT_FOUND","This image is not available."); }
    }

    package com.webox.auth;
    import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
    import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
    import java.util.List;
    import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
    import org.springframework.security.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken;
    import org.springframework.security.core.annotation.AuthenticationPrincipal;
    import org.springframework.security.core.authority.SimpleGrantedAuthority;
    import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
    import org.springframework.security.web.authentication.logout.SecurityContextLogoutHandler;
    import org.springframework.security.web.authentication.session.ChangeSessionIdAuthenticationStrategy;
    import org.springframework.security.web.context.HttpSessionSecurityContextRepository;
    import org.springframework.security.web.csrf.CsrfAuthenticationStrategy;
    import org.springframework.security.web.csrf.HttpSessionCsrfTokenRepository;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
    @org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.condition.ConditionalOnWebApplication
    @RestController
    @RequestMapping("/api/v1/auth")
    public class AuthController {
        private final AuthService service;private final HttpSessionSecurityContextRepository contexts;private final HttpSessionCsrfTokenRepository csrf;
        public AuthController(AuthService service,HttpSessionSecurityContextRepository contexts,HttpSessionCsrfTokenRepository csrf) { this.service=service;this.contexts=contexts;this.csrf=csrf; }
        public record Credentials(String email,String password) { @Override public String toString() { return "Credentials[redacted]"; } }
        @PostMapping("/register") @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
        public UserIdentity register(@RequestBody Credentials body) { return service.register(body.email(),body.password()); }
        @PostMapping("/login")
        public UserIdentity login(@RequestBody Credentials body,HttpServletRequest request,HttpServletResponse response) {
            var user=service.login(body.email(),body.password());
            var authentication=UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken.authenticated(user,null,List.of(new SimpleGrantedAuthority("ROLE_"+user.role().name())));
            new ChangeSessionIdAuthenticationStrategy().onAuthentication(authentication,request,response);
            new CsrfAuthenticationStrategy(csrf).onAuthentication(authentication,request,response);
            var context=SecurityContextHolder.createEmptyContext();context.setAuthentication(authentication);
            SecurityContextHolder.setContext(context);contexts.saveContext(context,request,response);
            return user;
        }
        @GetMapping("/me") public UserIdentity me(@AuthenticationPrincipal UserIdentity user) { return user; }
        @PostMapping("/logout") @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
        public void logout(HttpServletRequest request,HttpServletResponse response) {
            var authentication=SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication();
            csrf.saveToken(null,request,response);
            new SecurityContextLogoutHandler().logout(request,response,authentication);
        }
    }

    import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter;
    import tools.jackson.core.StreamReadConstraints;
    import tools.jackson.core.StreamReadFeature;
    import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;
    @Configuration(proxyBeanMethods=false)
    public class WebConfiguration {
        public static final int MAX_JSON_BYTES=1_048_576;
        @Bean org.springframework.boot.jackson.autoconfigure.JsonMapperBuilderCustomizer strictEnums() {
            return builder -> builder.enable(tools.jackson.databind.cfg.EnumFeature.FAIL_ON_NUMBERS_FOR_ENUMS)
                .withCoercionConfig(tools.jackson.databind.type.LogicalType.Textual, config -> {
                    for (var shape : new tools.jackson.databind.cfg.CoercionInputShape[]{tools.jackson.databind.cfg.CoercionInputShape.Integer, tools.jackson.databind.cfg.CoercionInputShape.Float, tools.jackson.databind.cfg.CoercionInputShape.Boolean})
                        config.setCoercion(shape, tools.jackson.databind.cfg.CoercionAction.Fail);
                });
        }
        @Bean java.nio.file.Path mediaRoot(@org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value("${webox.media-root}") String configured) throws IOException {
            var directory = java.nio.file.Path.of(configured).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
            java.nio.file.Files.createDirectories(directory);
            if (!java.nio.file.Files.isWritable(directory)) throw new IllegalStateException("The media directory is not writable.");
            return directory;
        }
        @Bean Clock applicationClock() { return Clock.systemUTC(); }
        @Bean JsonFactoryBuilderCustomizer jsonLimits() {
            return builder -> builder.streamReadConstraints(StreamReadConstraints.builder().maxNestingDepth(40).maxStringLength(MAX_JSON_BYTES).maxNumberLength(32).build())
                    .enable(StreamReadFeature.STRICT_DUPLICATE_DETECTION);
        }
        @Bean FilterRegistrationBean<OncePerRequestFilter> requestBoundary(JsonMapper mapper) {
            var filter=new OncePerRequestFilter() {
                @Override protected void doFilterInternal(HttpServletRequest request,HttpServletResponse response,FilterChain chain) throws IOException,ServletException {
                    response.setHeader("X-Request-Id",ApiErrors.requestId(request));
                    if(request.getRequestURI().startsWith("/api/")) response.setHeader("Cache-Control","no-store");
                    if(request.getContentType()!=null && (request.getContentType().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT).startsWith("application/json") || request.getContentType().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT).split(";",2)[0].endsWith("+json"))) {
                        if(request.getContentLengthLong()>MAX_JSON_BYTES) { tooLarge(mapper,request,response); return; }
                        byte[] bytes=request.getInputStream().readNBytes(MAX_JSON_BYTES+1);
                        if(bytes.length>MAX_JSON_BYTES) { tooLarge(mapper,request,response); return; }
                        var wrapped=new HttpServletRequestWrapper(request) {
                            @Override public ServletInputStream getInputStream() {
                                var input=new ByteArrayInputStream(bytes);
                                return new ServletInputStream() {
                                    @Override public int read() { return input.read(); }
                                    @Override public int read(byte[] b,int o,int l) { return input.read(b,o,l); }
                                    @Override public boolean isFinished() { return input.available()==0; }
                                    @Override public boolean isReady() { return true; }
                                    @Override public void setReadListener(ReadListener listener) {
                                        try { if(!isFinished()) listener.onDataAvailable(); if(isFinished()) listener.onAllDataRead(); }
                                        catch(IOException e) { listener.onError(e); }
                                    }
                                };
                            }
                            @Override public BufferedReader getReader() { return new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(getInputStream(),java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8)); }
                        };
                        chain.doFilter(wrapped,response); return;
                    }
                    chain.doFilter(request,response);
                }
            };
            var bean=new FilterRegistrationBean<OncePerRequestFilter>(filter);
            bean.setOrder(Ordered.HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE+20); bean.setAsyncSupported(true); return bean;
        }
        private static void tooLarge(JsonMapper mapper,HttpServletRequest req,HttpServletResponse res) throws IOException {
            ApiErrors.write(mapper,req,res,new ApiException(400,"VALIDATION_ERROR","The JSON request is too large."));
        }
    }
    package com.webox.support;
    import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
    import java.util.Map;
    import org.yaml.snakeyaml.Yaml;
    import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;
    import com.networknt.schema.SchemaRegistry;
    import com.networknt.schema.SpecificationVersion;
    import com.networknt.schema.InputFormat;
    import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
    /** Reads the authoritative OpenAPI document, including nested $refs and format constraints. */
    public final class ContractAssertions {
        private static final JsonMapper JSON=JsonMapper.builder().build();
        private static final Map<String,Object> API=readContract();
        private static final SchemaRegistry REGISTRY=SchemaRegistry.withDefaultDialect(SpecificationVersion.DRAFT_2020_12);
        private ContractAssertions() {}
        private static Map<String,Object> readContract() {
            try(var in=ContractAssertions.class.getResourceAsStream("/contracts/openapi.yaml")) {
                if(in==null) throw new IllegalStateException("OpenAPI contract is missing.");
                return new Yaml().load(in);
            } catch(java.io.IOException e) { throw new IllegalStateException(e); }
        }
        public static void matches(String schemaName,String body) {
            var wrapper=new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();wrapper.put("$ref","#/components/schemas/"+schemaName);wrapper.put("components",API.get("components"));
            assertSchema(wrapper,body);
        }
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        public static void response(String path,String method,int status,String body) {
            Map<String,Object> paths=(Map<String,Object>)API.get("paths");
            Map<String,Object> item=(Map<String,Object>)paths.get(path);
            Map<String,Object> operation=(Map<String,Object>)item.get(method);
            Map<String,Object> responses=(Map<String,Object>)operation.get("responses");
            Map<String,Object> response=(Map<String,Object>)responses.get(String.valueOf(status));
            assertNotNull(response,"Response status must be declared in OpenAPI");
            Map<String,Object> content=(Map<String,Object>)response.get("content");
            Map<String,Object> media=(Map<String,Object>)content.get("application/json");
            var wrapper=new LinkedHashMap<>((Map<String,Object>)media.get("schema"));wrapper.put("components",API.get("components"));
            assertSchema(wrapper,body);
        }
        private static void assertSchema(Map<String,Object> schema,String body) {
            var compiled=REGISTRY.getSchema(JSON.writeValueAsString(schema),InputFormat.JSON);
            var errors=compiled.validate(body,InputFormat.JSON,ctx->ctx.executionConfig(config->config.formatAssertionsEnabled(true)));
            assertTrue(errors.isEmpty(),()->"Response violates the declared schema: "+errors);
        }
    }

    **日期**：2026-10-16。**状态**：T001–T117（工程、基础能力、US1–US8）已完成，进入US9经营看板。后端122项、前端52项单元、受影响90项浏览器回归通过；真实OpenRouter功能24/24、独立浏览器性能20/20，首卡/完成p95为3.075/3.666秒。验收台账57项通过、24项未执行，历史失败均保留。证据见 [US8记录](../../docs/validation/us8.md)。
    
    **范围**：Tier 1–3 全部必交付，无开发时限；MVP 仅为实施检查点，不缩减最终 47 条 FR、11 条 SC、10 条 DC。原始 PRD 与既有决策优先，不能把参考项目未采用的规则带入实现。
    
    **Tests**：规格 A-014 引入的交付约束 DC-009 明确要求可运行并通过的核心业务测试，计划与 quickstart 已规定验证入口，因此包含测试任务。每阶段先编写有意义的契约/业务测试，确认因目标行为缺失而失败，再实施并运行至通过；缺依赖、编译错误或跳过不算有效红灯/通过。真实 MySQL、真实 LLM、浏览器负载和真人验收各自留证，测试替身仅限隔离故障注入。
    
    **Organization**：按 US1–US9 和 P1→P2→P3 分阶段；共享模型归属首次使用的故事，库存事务在 US3 即完成，US7 补实时投递与恢复。US4 补全规则交互和边界证明，不推迟 US2/US3 已需的数量与截单强校验。

    import java.time.*;
    import java.util.*;
    import com.webox.shared.DomainTypes.*;
    public final class OrderingModels {
        private OrderingModels() {}
        public record CartItem(String dishId,Long dishVersion,List<String> optionIds,Integer quantity) {}
        public record QuoteRequest(String deliveryDate,Meal meal,List<CartItem> items) {}
        public record OrderCreate(String quoteId,String addressId,String addressText) { @Override public String toString() { return "OrderCreate[redacted]"; } }
        public record OptionSnapshot(String optionId,String groupId,String groupName,String optionName,long extraCents,List<Allergen> allergens) { public OptionSnapshot { allergens=List.copyOf(allergens); } }
        public record PricedLine(String dishId,String dishName,long dishVersion,List<OptionSnapshot> selectedOptions,int quantity,long basePriceCents,long unitPriceCents,long subtotalCents,List<Allergen> effectiveAllergens) {
            public PricedLine { selectedOptions=List.copyOf(selectedOptions);effectiveAllergens=List.copyOf(effectiveAllergens); }
            public String configurationKey() { return IdempotencyRequest.digest(String.join(",",selectedOptions.stream().map(OptionSnapshot::optionId).sorted().toList())); }
        }
        public record Quote(String quoteId,LocalDate deliveryDate,Meal meal,List<PricedLine> items,int totalQuantity,long totalCents,Instant expiresAt,Instant serverTime,List<Map<String,Object>> warnings) { public Quote { items=List.copyOf(items);warnings=List.copyOf(warnings); } }
        public record Order(String orderId,String orderNumber,LocalDate deliveryDate,Meal meal,String addressText,OrderStatus status,List<PricedLine> items,int totalQuantity,long totalCents,long version,Instant createdAt,Instant updatedAt) { public Order { items=List.copyOf(items); } }
        public record OrderPage(List<Order> items,int page,int size,long totalElements) {}
    }

      return <p role="status" aria-live="polite">{children}</p>;

    import { Navigate, Outlet } from 'react-router';
    import { homeFor, useSession } from '../features/auth/session';
    import { ErrorNotice, Loading } from '../shared/ui/Status';
    export function SessionBoundary({ admin = false }: { admin?: boolean }) {
      const session = useSession();
      if (session.loading) return <Loading>Checking your session…</Loading>;
      if (!session.user) return session.error ? <ErrorNotice message={session.error} retry={() => { void session.refresh(); }} /> : <Navigate to="/login" replace />;
      if (admin && session.user.role !== 'Admin') return <section className="panel"><h1>Access denied</h1><p>Administrator access is required.</p></section>;
      // A transient session check failure must not discard an in-flight order's frozen key.
      return <>{session.error && <ErrorNotice message={session.error} retry={() => { void session.refresh(); }} />}<div hidden={Boolean(session.error)}><Outlet /></div></>;
    }
    export function GuestBoundary() {
      const session = useSession();
      if (session.loading) return <Loading>Checking your session…</Loading>;
      if (session.user) return <Navigate to={homeFor(session.user)} replace />;
      return <Outlet />;
    }

    package com.webox.ordering;
    import java.util.Map;
    import java.util.function.Supplier;
    import org.springframework.dao.*;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
    import org.springframework.transaction.*;
    import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionTemplate;
    import com.webox.shared.ApiException;
    @Component
    public class OrderTransactionExecutor {
        private final TransactionTemplate transaction;
        public OrderTransactionExecutor(PlatformTransactionManager manager) {
            transaction=new TransactionTemplate(manager);transaction.setIsolationLevel(TransactionDefinition.ISOLATION_READ_COMMITTED);transaction.setPropagationBehavior(TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW);
        }
        public <T> T execute(Supplier<T> operation,Supplier<T> uniqueConflict) {
            for(int attempt=0;attempt<3;attempt++) {
                try { return transaction.execute(status->operation.get()); }
                catch(DuplicateKeyException conflict) {
                    // TransactionTemplate has fully rolled back before conflict resolution starts.
                    if(uniqueConflict==null) throw conflict;return transaction.execute(status->uniqueConflict.get());
                } catch(PessimisticLockingFailureException conflict) {
                    if(attempt==2) throw unavailable();java.util.concurrent.locks.LockSupport.parkNanos((attempt+1)*10_000_000L);
                }
            }
            throw unavailable();
        }
        public static ApiException unavailable() { return new ApiException(503,"TEMPORARY_UNAVAILABLE","The order could not be completed yet. Retry with the same request.",true,Map.of()); }
    }

    import com.webox.shared.BusinessClock;
    import jakarta.annotation.*;
    import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
    import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.condition.ConditionalOnWebApplication;
    import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
    import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;
    @Component @ConditionalOnWebApplication
    public class OutboxDispatcher {
        private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;private final JsonMapper json;private final InventorySubscriptions subscriptions;private final BusinessClock clock;private final boolean enabled;private final long interval;
        private final ScheduledExecutorService worker=Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor(r->{var t=new Thread(r,"inventory-outbox");t.setDaemon(true);return t;});
        public OutboxDispatcher(JdbcTemplate jdbc,JsonMapper json,InventorySubscriptions subscriptions,BusinessClock clock,@Value("${webox.inventory.dispatch-enabled:true}") boolean enabled,@Value("${INVENTORY_POLL_INTERVAL_MS:250}") long interval){if(interval<10)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid inventory polling interval.");this.jdbc=jdbc;this.json=json;this.subscriptions=subscriptions;this.clock=clock;this.enabled=enabled;this.interval=interval;}
        private record Pending(String id,String type,String payload,int attempts) {}
        @PostConstruct void start(){if(enabled)worker.scheduleWithFixedDelay(()->{try{dispatch();}catch(RuntimeException ignored){/* Durable rows remain pending for the next poll. */}},interval,interval,TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);}
        @PreDestroy void stop(){worker.shutdownNow();}
        public synchronized void dispatch() {
            var rows=jdbc.query("SELECT id,event_type,payload,attempt_count FROM outbox_events WHERE published_at IS NULL AND next_attempt_at<=? ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 100",(rs,n)->new Pending(rs.getString(1),rs.getString(2),rs.getString(3),rs.getInt(4)),Timestamp.from(clock.now()));
            for(var row:rows) {
                try {
                    LocalDate date;
                    if(row.type().equals("inventory.updated"))date=json.readValue(row.payload(),InventoryModels.Updated.class).deliveryDate();
                    else if(row.type().equals("menu.changed"))date=json.readValue(row.payload(),InventoryModels.Changed.class).deliveryDate();
                    else throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported outbox event.");
                    subscriptions.publish(date,row.type(),row.payload());markPublished(row.id());
                }catch(RuntimeException failure) {
                    long delay=Math.min(30_000,250L*(1L<<Math.min(row.attempts(),7)));int attempts=row.attempts()==Integer.MAX_VALUE?Integer.MAX_VALUE:row.attempts()+1;
                    jdbc.update("UPDATE outbox_events SET attempt_count=?,next_attempt_at=?,last_error_code='DISPATCH_FAILED' WHERE id=? AND published_at IS NULL",attempts,Timestamp.from(clock.now().plusMillis(delay)),row.id());
                }
            }
        }
        void markPublished(String id){jdbc.update("UPDATE outbox_events SET published_at=?,last_error_code=NULL WHERE id=? AND published_at IS NULL",Timestamp.from(clock.now()),id);}
    }

    /** Single-instance fan-out. Business writers only append outbox; socket writes never run on their threads. */
    @Component @ConditionalOnWebApplication
    public class InventorySubscriptions {
        private final SessionValidity sessions;private final JsonMapper json;private final int perSession,maxConnections,capacity;
        private final long heartbeatNanos,lifetimeNanos,writeTimeoutNanos;
        private final Map<String,Connection> connections=new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
        private final ExecutorService writers;private final ScheduledExecutorService maintenance;
        private volatile boolean stopped;
        public InventorySubscriptions(SessionValidity sessions,JsonMapper json,
            @Value("${webox.inventory.heartbeat-ms:${SSE_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS:15000}}") long heartbeat,
            @Value("${webox.inventory.max-duration-ms:${SSE_MAX_DURATION_MS:1800000}}") long lifetime,
            @Value("${webox.inventory.max-per-session:${SSE_MAX_PER_SESSION:3}}") int perSession,
            @Value("${webox.inventory.max-connections:${SSE_MAX_CONNECTIONS:600}}") int maxConnections,
            @Value("${webox.inventory.queue-capacity:${SSE_QUEUE_CAPACITY:256}}") int capacity,
            @Value("${webox.inventory.write-timeout-ms:${SSE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_MS:5000}}") long timeout) {
            if(heartbeat<50 || lifetime<100 || perSession<1 || maxConnections<1 || capacity<2 || timeout<50)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid inventory stream limits.");
            this.sessions=sessions;this.json=json;this.perSession=perSession;this.maxConnections=maxConnections;this.capacity=capacity;
            heartbeatNanos=TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.toNanos(heartbeat);lifetimeNanos=TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.toNanos(lifetime);writeTimeoutNanos=TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.toNanos(timeout);
            writers=new ThreadPoolExecutor(8,8,0,TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS,new ArrayBlockingQueue<>(maxConnections),r->{var t=new Thread(r,"inventory-writer");t.setDaemon(true);return t;},new ThreadPoolExecutor.AbortPolicy());
            maintenance=Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor(r->{var t=new Thread(r,"inventory-maintenance");t.setDaemon(true);return t;});
        }
        @PostConstruct void start(){maintenance.scheduleWithFixedDelay(this::maintain,100,100,TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);}
        public synchronized Connection register(LocalDate date,String sessionId) {
            var owned=connections.values().stream().filter(c->c.sessionId.equals(sessionId)).toList();
            if(stopped || connections.size()>=maxConnections || owned.size()>=perSession) {

                // bounded set now so reconnect need not wait for the regular 15-second heartbeat.
                if(!stopped)for(var existing:owned)existing.offer(": connection-check\n\n".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));

            byte[] bytes=frame(event,data);for(var connection:connections.values())if(connection.date.equals(date))connection.offer(bytes);

        static byte[] frame(String event,String data){return ("event: "+event+"\ndata: "+data+"\n\n").getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);}

            }
        }

    import java.time.Instant;

    import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
    /** Bounded diagnostic evidence. Never stores user IDs, prompts, sessions, secrets or upstream messages. */
    @Component
    public final class RecommendationObservations {
        private final LinkedHashMap<String,Trace> traces=new LinkedHashMap<>();
        public synchronized Trace begin(String requestId,String configuredModel,RequestDeadline deadline){var trace=new Trace(requestId,configuredModel,deadline);traces.put(requestId,trace);while(traces.size()>128)traces.remove(traces.keySet().iterator().next());return trace;}
        public synchronized Optional<Snapshot> find(String requestId){var trace=traces.get(requestId);return trace==null?Optional.empty():Optional.of(trace.snapshot());}
        public record Snapshot(String requestId,String configuredModel,Instant beganAt,OpenRouterProvider.Metadata intent,OpenRouterProvider.Metadata recommendation,Long firstCardMillis,Long finishedMillis,int cards,String outcome){}
        public static final class Trace {
            private final String id,model;private final Instant began;private final long start;private OpenRouterProvider.Metadata intent,recommendation;private Long first,finished;private int cards;private String outcome="IN_PROGRESS";
            Trace(String id,String model,RequestDeadline deadline){this.id=id;this.model=model;this.began=deadline.beganAt();this.start=deadline.startedNanos();}
            public synchronized void intent(OpenRouterProvider.Metadata metadata){intent=metadata;}
            public synchronized void recommendation(OpenRouterProvider.Metadata metadata){recommendation=metadata;}
            public synchronized void card(){if(first==null)first=(System.nanoTime()-start)/1_000_000;cards++;}
            public synchronized void finish(String result){if(finished==null){finished=(System.nanoTime()-start)/1_000_000;outcome=result;}}
            synchronized Snapshot snapshot(){return new Snapshot(id,model,began,intent,recommendation,first,finished,cards,outcome);}
        }
    }
    package com.webox.shared;
    import java.io.IOException;
    import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
    import java.util.Map;
    import java.util.UUID;
    import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
    import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
    import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;
    public final class ApiErrors {
        public static final String REQUEST_ID = ApiErrors.class.getName()+".requestId";
        private ApiErrors() {}
        public static String requestId(HttpServletRequest request) {
            var value=request.getAttribute(REQUEST_ID);
            if (value instanceof String s) return s;
            String id=UUID.randomUUID().toString(); request.setAttribute(REQUEST_ID,id); return id;
        }
        public static Map<String,Object> body(HttpServletRequest request, ApiException error) {
            var result=new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();
            result.put("code",error.code()); result.put("message",error.getMessage());
            result.put("requestId",requestId(request)); result.put("retryable",error.retryable()); result.putAll(error.context());
            return result;
        }
        public static void write(JsonMapper mapper,HttpServletRequest request,HttpServletResponse response,ApiException error) throws IOException {
            response.setStatus(error.status()); response.setContentType("application/json"); response.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");
            response.setHeader("Cache-Control","no-store");response.setHeader("X-Request-Id",requestId(request));
            response.getWriter().write(mapper.writeValueAsString(body(request,error)));

    package com.webox.shared;
    import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
    import org.slf4j.Logger;
    import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
    import org.springframework.dao.DataAccessException;
    import org.springframework.dao.TransientDataAccessException;
    import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
    import org.springframework.http.converter.HttpMessageNotReadableException;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.MethodArgumentNotValidException;
    import org.springframework.web.method.annotation.MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException;
    import org.springframework.web.servlet.resource.NoResourceFoundException;
    import org.springframework.web.multipart.MaxUploadSizeExceededException;
    import org.springframework.web.HttpRequestMethodNotSupportedException;
    import org.springframework.web.HttpMediaTypeNotSupportedException;
    import java.util.Map;
    @RestControllerAdvice
    public class ApiExceptionHandler {
        private static final Logger LOG=LoggerFactory.getLogger(ApiExceptionHandler.class);
        @ExceptionHandler(ApiException.class)
        public ResponseEntity<Map<String,Object>> business(ApiException e,HttpServletRequest request) {
            return ResponseEntity.status(e.status()).contentType(org.springframework.http.MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).header("Cache-Control","no-store").body(ApiErrors.body(request,e));
        }
        @ExceptionHandler({HttpMessageNotReadableException.class,MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException.class,IllegalArgumentException.class,HttpRequestMethodNotSupportedException.class,HttpMediaTypeNotSupportedException.class,org.springframework.web.bind.ServletRequestBindingException.class,org.springframework.web.method.annotation.HandlerMethodValidationException.class,jakarta.validation.ConstraintViolationException.class})
        public ResponseEntity<Map<String,Object>> invalid(Exception e,HttpServletRequest request) {
            return business(new ApiException(400,"VALIDATION_ERROR","The request contains invalid or unsupported fields."),request);
        }
        @ExceptionHandler(MethodArgumentNotValidException.class)
        public ResponseEntity<Map<String,Object>> fields(MethodArgumentNotValidException e,HttpServletRequest request) {
            var errors=e.getBindingResult().getFieldErrors().stream().map(error->Map.of("field",error.getField(),"message","This field is invalid or required.")).toList();
            return business(new ApiException(400,"VALIDATION_ERROR","Please check the highlighted fields.",false,Map.of("fieldErrors",errors)),request);
        }
        @ExceptionHandler(NoResourceFoundException.class)
        public ResponseEntity<Map<String,Object>> missing(Exception e,HttpServletRequest request) {
            return business(new ApiException(404,"NOT_FOUND","The requested resource was not found."),request);
        }
        @ExceptionHandler(MaxUploadSizeExceededException.class)
        public ResponseEntity<Map<String,Object>> upload(Exception e,HttpServletRequest request) {
            return business(new ApiException(413,"IMAGE_TOO_LARGE","The image exceeds the 5 MiB limit."),request);
        }
        @ExceptionHandler(TransientDataAccessException.class)
        public ResponseEntity<Map<String,Object>> temporary(Exception e,HttpServletRequest request) {
            LOG.warn("requestId={} code=TEMPORARY_UNAVAILABLE type={}",ApiErrors.requestId(request),e.getClass().getSimpleName());
            return business(new ApiException(503,"TEMPORARY_UNAVAILABLE","The service is temporarily unavailable. Please retry.",true,Map.of()),request);
        }
        @ExceptionHandler({DataAccessException.class,Exception.class})
        public ResponseEntity<Map<String,Object>> unexpected(Exception e,HttpServletRequest request) {
            // Exception messages and stacks can contain SQL parameters or private request content.
            LOG.error("requestId={} code=INTERNAL_ERROR type={}",ApiErrors.requestId(request),e.getClass().getSimpleName());
            return business(new ApiException(500,"INTERNAL_ERROR","Something went wrong. Please try again."),request);
        }
    }
