    @Service
    public class PlaceOrderService {
        private final UserRepository users;private final QuoteRepository quotes;private final OrderRepository orders;private final OrderItemRepository items;private final AddressRepository addresses;private final OrderPolicy policy;private final InventoryMutationService inventory;private final OrderTransactionExecutor transactions;private final BusinessClock clock;
        public PlaceOrderService(UserRepository users,QuoteRepository quotes,OrderRepository orders,OrderItemRepository items,AddressRepository addresses,OrderPolicy policy,InventoryMutationService inventory,OrderTransactionExecutor transactions,BusinessClock clock) { this.users=users;this.quotes=quotes;this.orders=orders;this.items=items;this.addresses=addresses;this.policy=policy;this.inventory=inventory;this.transactions=transactions;this.clock=clock; }
        public record Result(Order order,boolean replayed) {}
        public Result create(String user,String key,OrderCreate body) {
            var request=IdempotencyRequest.normalize(key,body);var existing=orders.byKey(user,request.key());if(existing.isPresent()) return replay(existing.get(),request);
            return transactions.execute(()->createLocked(user,request),()->resolveConflict(user,request));
        }
        private Result replay(OrderRepository.Row row,IdempotencyRequest request) {
            if(!row.hash().equals(request.hash())) throw new ApiException(409,"IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED","This request key belongs to a different order request.");return new Result(orders.view(row),true);
        }
        private Result createLocked(String user,IdempotencyRequest request) {
            users.lockOwner(user).orElseThrow(OrderRepository::missing);
            var existing=orders.byKey(user,request.key());if(existing.isPresent()) return replay(existing.get(),request);
            // Also catches a consumed quote whose expired quote row has since been cleaned up.
            if(orders.byQuote(user,request.quoteId()).isPresent()) throw consumed();
            var quote=quotes.lockOwned(request.quoteId(),user).orElseThrow(()->new ApiException(404,"NOT_FOUND","This quote was not found."));
            if(quote.consumedOrderId()!=null) throw consumed();policy.notExpired(quote.expiresAt());policy.quantity(quote.quantity());policy.active(user,quote.date(),quote.meal());
            var lines=quotes.items(quote.id());long total=0;int quantity=0;for(var line:lines) {total=ValueRules.add(total,line.subtotalCents());quantity+=line.quantity();}
            if(lines.isEmpty() || total!=quote.total() || quantity!=quote.quantity()) throw new IllegalStateException("Quote totals are inconsistent.");
            var locked=inventory.lock(quote.date(),lines);inventory.validateForPurchase(locked,lines);
            // Both checks happen after all potentially blocking row locks.
            policy.notExpired(quote.expiresAt());policy.slot(quote.date(),quote.meal());
            String address=request.addressId()==null?request.addressText():addresses.resolve(user,request.addressId());
            inventory.allocate(locked);var now=clock.now().truncatedTo(java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit.MICROS);var row=orders.insert(user,request,quote,address,now);
            items.insert(row.id(),lines);addresses.use(user,address,now);quotes.consume(quote.id(),row.id());return new Result(orders.view(row),false);
        }
        private Result resolveConflict(String user,IdempotencyRequest request) {
            var existing=orders.byKey(user,request.key());if(existing.isPresent()) return replay(existing.get(),request);
            if(orders.byQuote(user,request.quoteId()).isPresent()) throw consumed();
            var quote=quotes.findOwned(request.quoteId(),user);if(quote.isPresent()) {if(quote.get().consumedOrderId()!=null) throw consumed();policy.active(user,quote.get().date(),quote.get().meal());}
            throw OrderTransactionExecutor.unavailable();
        }
        private static ApiException consumed() { return new ApiException(409,"QUOTE_CONSUMED","This quote has already been used. Review your existing order or request a new quote."); }
    }

    import java.time.Duration;
    import java.util.Set;
    import java.util.function.Supplier;
    import com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.*;
    import com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.stats.CacheStats;
    import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
    import io.micrometer.core.instrument.binder.cache.CaffeineCacheMetrics;
    import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
    import org.springframework.transaction.support.*;
    @Component
    public class MenuDetailsCache {
        private record Key(String id,long version) {}
        private final Cache<Key,MenuModels.Details> cache;
        @Autowired public MenuDetailsCache(MeterRegistry metrics) {
            this(Duration.ofMinutes(5),10000,Ticker.systemTicker());CaffeineCacheMetrics.monitor(metrics,cache,"menuDishDetails");
        }
        public MenuDetailsCache(Duration expiration,int capacity,Ticker ticker) {
            cache=Caffeine.newBuilder().maximumSize(capacity).expireAfterWrite(expiration).ticker(ticker).recordStats().build();
        }
        public MenuModels.Details get(String id,long version,Supplier<MenuModels.Details> loader) {
            return cache.get(new Key(id,version),key->{var loaded=loader.get();if(!key.id().equals(loaded.dishId()) || key.version()!=loaded.dishVersion()) throw new IllegalStateException("Mismatched menu cache version.");return loaded;});
        }
        public void invalidateAfterCommit(Set<String> ids) {
            Set<String> snapshot=Set.copyOf(ids);
            if(!TransactionSynchronizationManager.isActualTransactionActive()) throw new IllegalStateException("Cache invalidation requires a business transaction.");
            TransactionSynchronizationManager.registerSynchronization(new TransactionSynchronization() {
                @Override public void afterCommit() { cache.asMap().keySet().removeIf(key->snapshot.contains(key.id())); }
            });
        }
        public long size() { return cache.estimatedSize(); }
        public void cleanUp() { cache.cleanUp(); }
        public CacheStats stats() { return cache.stats(); }
    }

        package com.webox.shared;
        import com.webox.inventory.InventorySubscriptions;
        import com.webox.recommendation.RecommendationStreams;
        import io.micrometer.core.instrument.*;
        import java.time.Duration;
        import java.util.Set;
        import org.springframework.beans.factory.*;
        import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
        import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
        /** Aggregate operational metrics only: no account, session, address, prompt or generation-ID labels. */
        @Component
        public class OperationalMetrics implements SmartInitializingSingleton {
            private final MeterRegistry registry;private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;private final ObjectProvider<InventorySubscriptions> inventory;private final ObjectProvider<RecommendationStreams> recommendations;
            public OperationalMetrics(MeterRegistry registry,JdbcTemplate jdbc,ObjectProvider<InventorySubscriptions> inventory,ObjectProvider<RecommendationStreams> recommendations){this.registry=registry;this.jdbc=jdbc;this.inventory=inventory;this.recommendations=recommendations;}
            @Override public void afterSingletonsInstantiated(){
                var stock=inventory.getIfAvailable();if(stock!=null)Gauge.builder("webox.inventory.active",stock,InventorySubscriptions::size).register(registry);
                var ai=recommendations.getIfAvailable();if(ai!=null)Gauge.builder("webox.ai.active",ai,RecommendationStreams::size).register(registry);
                Gauge.builder("webox.outbox.pending",jdbc,db->{try{return db.queryForObject("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outbox_events WHERE published_at IS NULL",Long.class);}catch(RuntimeException unavailable){return -1;}}).register(registry);
                for(String outcome:Set.of("created","replayed"))registry.counter("webox.orders", "outcome",outcome);
                registry.counter("webox.order.lock.retries");
            }
            public void order(boolean replay){registry.counter("webox.orders","outcome",replay?"replayed":"created").increment();}
            public void lockRetry(){registry.counter("webox.order.lock.retries").increment();}
            public void failure(String code){
                if(Set.of("INSUFFICIENT_STOCK","DISH_UNAVAILABLE","DISH_CHANGED","ACTIVE_ORDER_EXISTS","VERSION_CONFLICT","IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED","QUOTE_CONSUMED","INVALID_ORDER_TRANSITION").contains(code))registry.counter("webox.conflicts","code",code).increment();
            }
            public void limited(String scope){registry.counter("webox.rate_limited","scope",scope).increment();}
            public void firstCard(long nanos){Timer.builder("webox.ai.first_card").publishPercentileHistogram().register(registry).record(Duration.ofNanos(nanos));}
            public void aiFinished(String outcome,long nanos){String label=Set.of("COMPLETE","NO_MATCH","CANCELLED","AI_INVALID_RESPONSE","AI_TIMEOUT","AI_UNAVAILABLE","AI_BUSY","INTENT_CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED","SESSION_EXPIRED").contains(outcome)?outcome:"OTHER";Timer.builder("webox.ai.finished").tag("outcome",label).publishPercentileHistogram().register(registry).record(Duration.ofNanos(nanos));}
        }

        /** Single-instance token buckets, after authentication/CSRF. Monotonic time; bounded identity storage. */
        @Component @ConditionalOnWebApplication
        public class RateLimitFilter extends OncePerRequestFilter {
            private record Policy(int capacity,int perMinute){Policy{if(capacity<1||perMinute<1||capacity>1000000||perMinute>1000000)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid rate limit.");}}
            private static final class Bucket {
                private double tokens;private long updated=System.nanoTime();private final Policy policy;
                Bucket(Policy policy){this.policy=policy;tokens=policy.capacity();}
                synchronized int take(){long now=System.nanoTime();tokens=Math.min(policy.capacity(),tokens+(now-updated)*policy.perMinute()/60_000_000_000.0);updated=now;if(tokens>=1){tokens--;return 0;}return Math.max(1,(int)Math.ceil((1-tokens)*60/policy.perMinute()));}
            }
            private final Cache<String,Bucket> buckets=Caffeine.newBuilder().maximumSize(10000).expireAfterAccess(Duration.ofMinutes(30)).build();
            private final JsonMapper json;private final OperationalMetrics metrics;private final boolean enabled;private final Policy auth,write,ai;private final Bucket globalAuth;
            public RateLimitFilter(JsonMapper json,OperationalMetrics metrics,
                @Value("${webox.rate-limit.enabled:true}") boolean enabled,
                @Value("${webox.rate-limit.auth-capacity:60}") int authCapacity,@Value("${webox.rate-limit.auth-per-minute:120}") int authRate,
                @Value("${webox.rate-limit.write-capacity:120}") int writeCapacity,@Value("${webox.rate-limit.write-per-minute:300}") int writeRate,
                @Value("${webox.rate-limit.ai-capacity:10}") int aiCapacity,@Value("${webox.rate-limit.ai-per-minute:30}") int aiRate,
                @Value("${webox.rate-limit.global-auth-capacity:600}") int globalCapacity,@Value("${webox.rate-limit.global-auth-per-minute:1200}") int globalRate) {
                this.json=json;this.metrics=metrics;this.enabled=enabled;auth=new Policy(authCapacity,authRate);write=new Policy(writeCapacity,writeRate);ai=new Policy(aiCapacity,aiRate);globalAuth=new Bucket(new Policy(globalCapacity,globalRate));
            }
            @Override protected void doFilterInternal(HttpServletRequest request,HttpServletResponse response,FilterChain chain)throws ServletException,IOException {
                if(!enabled){chain.doFilter(request,response);return;}String path=request.getRequestURI().substring(request.getContextPath().length()),scope=null,key=null;Policy policy=null;
                if(Set.of("/api/v1/auth/csrf","/api/v1/auth/login","/api/v1/auth/register").contains(path)){scope="authentication";key="auth:"+request.getRemoteAddr();policy=auth;}
                else if(!Set.of("GET","HEAD","OPTIONS").contains(request.getMethod()) && path.startsWith("/api/v1/") && !path.equals("/api/v1/auth/logout")) {
                    var authentication=SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication();if(authentication!=null && authentication.getPrincipal() instanceof UserIdentity user){boolean recommendation=path.equals("/api/v1/recommendations/stream");scope=recommendation?"recommendation":"write";key=scope+":"+user.userId();policy=recommendation?ai:write;}
                }
                if(key!=null){Policy selected=policy;int retry=buckets.get(key,ignored->new Bucket(selected)).take();if(retry==0&&scope.equals("authentication"))retry=globalAuth.take();if(retry>0){metrics.limited(scope);response.setHeader("Retry-After",String.valueOf(retry));ApiErrors.write(json,request,response,new ApiException(429,"RATE_LIMITED","Too many requests. Please try again shortly.",true,Map.of()));return;}}
                chain.doFilter(request,response);
            }
        }

        # Install as /etc/nginx/conf.d/webox.conf. App and database remain private.
        upstream webox_api {
            server 127.0.0.1:8080;
            keepalive 32;
        }
        server {
            listen 80;
            server_name _;
            return 308 https://$host$request_uri;
        }
        server {
            listen 443 ssl;
            http2 on;
            server_name _;
            ssl_certificate /etc/nginx/tls/fullchain.pem;
            ssl_certificate_key /etc/nginx/tls/privkey.pem;
            ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
            ssl_session_cache shared:WeBoxTLS:10m;
            ssl_session_timeout 1d;
            server_tokens off;
            client_max_body_size 6m;
            client_body_timeout 15s;
            send_timeout 10s;
            root /srv/webox/frontend;
            index index.html;
            # Queries may contain personal search text; do not write access URLs or credentials to logs.
            access_log off;
            error_log /var/log/nginx/webox-error.log crit;
            add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000" always;
            add_header X-Content-Type-Options nosniff always;
            add_header Referrer-Policy same-origin always;
            add_header X-Frame-Options DENY always;
            add_header Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'" always;
            proxy_set_header Host $host;
            proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
            proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $remote_addr;
            proxy_set_header Connection "";
            proxy_http_version 1.1;
            proxy_connect_timeout 3s;
            proxy_send_timeout 30s;
            proxy_read_timeout 65s;
            proxy_next_upstream off;
            location /api/ {
                proxy_pass http://webox_api;
                proxy_cache off;
                proxy_buffering off;
                gzip off;
            }
            location /actuator/ {
                # Spring Security additionally requires an authenticated Admin session.
                proxy_pass http://webox_api;
                proxy_cache off;
                proxy_buffering off;
            }
            location /media/ {
                proxy_pass http://webox_api;
            }
            location /assets/ {
                try_files $uri =404;
                expires 1y;
            }
            location = /index.html {
                expires -1;
            }
            location / {
                try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;
            }
        }

    package com.webox.media;
    import java.time.Instant;
    import java.time.LocalDateTime;
    import java.time.ZoneOffset;
    import java.util.Optional;
    import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;
    @Repository
    public class MediaRepository {
        private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
        public MediaRepository(JdbcTemplate jdbc) { this.jdbc=jdbc; }
        public Optional<Asset> find(String id) {
            return jdbc.query("SELECT id,storage_key,served_mime,served_bytes,content_sha256,width,height FROM media_assets WHERE id=?",
                (rs,n)->new Asset(rs.getString(1),rs.getString(2),rs.getString(3),rs.getLong(4),rs.getString(5),rs.getInt(6),rs.getInt(7)),id).stream().findFirst();
        }
        public void insert(Asset asset,String uploader,String originalName,String sourceMime,long sourceBytes,String attribution,Instant now) {
            if(!"Admin".equals(jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT role FROM users WHERE id=?",String.class,uploader))) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Only administrators can create media.");
            jdbc.update("INSERT INTO media_assets(id,uploaded_by,original_filename,source_mime,source_bytes,content_sha256,width,height,storage_key,served_mime,served_bytes,source_attribution,created_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                asset.id(),uploader,originalName,sourceMime,sourceBytes,asset.sha256(),asset.width(),asset.height(),asset.storageKey(),asset.mime(),asset.bytes(),attribution,LocalDateTime.ofInstant(now,ZoneOffset.UTC));
        }
        public record Asset(String id,String storageKey,String mime,long bytes,String sha256,int width,int height) {}
    }

        @Component @ConditionalOnWebApplication
        public class MaintenanceJobs {
            private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;private final BusinessClock clock;private final Path media;private final TransactionTemplate writes;private final boolean enabled;private final long delay,interval;private final int batch;private final Duration quotes,events,files;
            private final ScheduledExecutorService worker=Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor(r->{var thread=new Thread(r,"webox-maintenance");thread.setDaemon(true);return thread;});private String fileCursor="";
            public MaintenanceJobs(JdbcTemplate jdbc,BusinessClock clock,Path mediaRoot,PlatformTransactionManager manager,
                @Value("${webox.maintenance.enabled:true}") boolean enabled,@Value("${webox.maintenance.initial-delay-ms:60000}") long delay,@Value("${webox.maintenance.interval-ms:3600000}") long interval,
                @Value("${webox.maintenance.batch-size:100}") int batch,@Value("${webox.maintenance.quote-retention-hours:24}") int quoteHours,@Value("${webox.maintenance.outbox-retention-days:7}") int eventDays,@Value("${webox.maintenance.media-retention-hours:24}") int fileHours) {
                if(delay<0||interval<100||batch<1||batch>1000||quoteHours<1||eventDays<1||fileHours<1)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid maintenance settings.");
                this.jdbc=jdbc;this.clock=clock;media=mediaRoot;this.enabled=enabled;this.delay=delay;this.interval=interval;this.batch=batch;quotes=Duration.ofHours(quoteHours);events=Duration.ofDays(eventDays);files=Duration.ofHours(fileHours);writes=new TransactionTemplate(manager);writes.setIsolationLevel(TransactionDefinition.ISOLATION_READ_COMMITTED);writes.setTimeout(5);
            }
            @PostConstruct void start(){if(enabled)worker.scheduleWithFixedDelay(()->{try{run();}catch(RuntimeException failure){LoggerFactory.getLogger(MaintenanceJobs.class).warn("Maintenance deferred: type={}",failure.getClass().getSimpleName());}},delay,interval,TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);}
            @PreDestroy void stop(){worker.shutdownNow();}
            public synchronized void run() {
                var now=clock.now();writes.executeWithoutResult(status->{
                    // Lock parents before children, matching checkout. Skip in-flight work; never touch consumed quotes.
                    var ids=jdbc.queryForList("SELECT id FROM checkout_quotes WHERE expires_at<? AND consumed_order_id IS NULL ORDER BY expires_at,id LIMIT "+batch+" FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED",String.class,Timestamp.from(now.minus(quotes)));
                    for(String id:ids){jdbc.update("DELETE FROM checkout_quote_items WHERE quote_id=?",id);jdbc.update("DELETE FROM checkout_quotes WHERE id=? AND consumed_order_id IS NULL",id);}
                    jdbc.update("DELETE FROM outbox_events WHERE published_at IS NOT NULL AND published_at<? ORDER BY published_at,id LIMIT "+batch,Timestamp.from(now.minus(events)));
                });
                // Keep all registered assets, including replaced images. Only old unregistered crash remnants are removed.
                // A bounded sorted window advances across runs, avoiding starvation without retaining a whole directory listing.
                var window=new TreeSet<Path>(Comparator.comparing(p->p.getFileName().toString()));
                try(var directory=Files.newDirectoryStream(media)) {
                    for(Path path:directory){String name=path.getFileName().toString();if(name.compareTo(fileCursor)<=0 || !name.matches("(?:upload-[A-Za-z0-9-]+\\.tmp|[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}\\.(?:png|jpeg))"))continue;window.add(path);if(window.size()>1000)window.pollLast();}
                    if(window.isEmpty()){fileCursor="";return;}
                    for(Path path:window){String name=path.getFileName().toString();if(!Files.isRegularFile(path,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS) || !Files.getLastModifiedTime(path,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS).toInstant().isBefore(now.minus(files)))continue;
                        if(jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_assets WHERE storage_key=?",Integer.class,name)==0)Files.deleteIfExists(path);
                    }fileCursor=window.last().getFileName().toString();
                }catch(IOException failure){throw new IllegalStateException("Media maintenance could not complete.");}
            }
        }

        #!/usr/bin/env python3
        """Online single-schema backup; restore only to a labelled, empty isolated MySQL container.
        Credentials stay inside the container environment. Backups contain private application data.
        """
        import argparse
        import datetime as dt
        import gzip
        import hashlib
        import json
        import os
        from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
        import re
        import shutil
        import subprocess
        import sys
        import tarfile
        import tempfile
        
        DB_COMMAND = '''set -eu
        : "${MYSQL_USER:?A dedicated MYSQL_USER is required}"
        : "${MYSQL_PASSWORD:?MYSQL_PASSWORD is required}"
        : "${MYSQL_DATABASE:?MYSQL_DATABASE is required}"
        [ "$MYSQL_USER" != root ] && [ "$MYSQL_DATABASE" = "$1" ] || exit 65
        export MYSQL_PWD="$MYSQL_PASSWORD"
        '''
        DUMP = DB_COMMAND + '''exec mysqldump --user="$MYSQL_USER" --single-transaction --quick --no-tablespaces --skip-add-locks --hex-blob --set-gtid-purged=OFF --column-statistics=0 "$1"'''
        IMPORT = DB_COMMAND + '''exec mysql --user="$MYSQL_USER" --binary-mode=1 --database="$1"'''
        COUNT = DB_COMMAND + '''exec mysql --user="$MYSQL_USER" --batch --skip-column-names --database="$1" -e 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema=DATABASE()' '''
        
        def command(container, db, script):
            return ['docker', 'exec', '-i', container, 'sh', '-c', script, 'webox-storage', db]
        
        def digest(path):
            with path.open('rb') as stream:
                return hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest() if hasattr(hashlib, 'file_digest') else legacy_digest(stream)
        
        def legacy_digest(stream):
            value = hashlib.sha256()
            for data in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
                value.update(data)
            return value.hexdigest()
        
        def backup(args):
            media = args.media_root.resolve(strict=True)
            if not media.is_dir() or media == Path('/'):
                raise ValueError('MEDIA_ROOT must be a dedicated directory.')
            target = args.output.resolve()
            if target == media or media in target.parents:
                raise ValueError('The backup directory must be outside MEDIA_ROOT.')
            target.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=False)
            database = target / 'database.sql.gz'
            process = subprocess.Popen(command(args.container, args.database, DUMP), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
            try:
                with gzip.open(database, 'wb', compresslevel=6) as output:
                    shutil.copyfileobj(process.stdout, output)
                if process.wait() != 0:
                    raise RuntimeError('MySQL export failed. Check the container, schema and dedicated account privileges.')
            finally:
                process.stdout.close()
                if process.poll() is None:
                    process.kill()
                    process.wait()
            count = 0
            archive = target / 'media.tar.gz'
            with tarfile.open(archive, 'w:gz', dereference=False) as bundle:
                for directory, subdirectories, names in os.walk(media, followlinks=False):
                    subdirectories[:] = [name for name in subdirectories if not (Path(directory) / name).is_symlink()]
                    for name in sorted(names):
                        path = Path(directory) / name
                        if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
                            continue
                        try:
                            bundle.add(path, arcname=str(path.relative_to(media)), recursive=False)
                            count += 1
                        except FileNotFoundError:
                            # Maintenance may remove an unregistered remnant; registered immutable media is retained.
                            continue
            manifest = {'format': 1, 'createdAt': dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'database': args.database, 'mediaFiles': count,
                        'files': {path.name: {'sha256': digest(path), 'bytes': path.stat().st_size} for path in [database, archive]}}
            (target / 'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n')
            print(json.dumps({'backup': str(target), 'mediaFiles': count, 'complete': True}))
        
        def restore(args):
            if not args.database.startswith('webox_restore_'):
                raise ValueError('Restore requires a database named webox_restore_*.')
            label = subprocess.run(['docker', 'inspect', '--format', '{{ index .Config.Labels "webox.restore-target" }}', args.container], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
            if label != 'true':
                raise ValueError('Restore requires the container label webox.restore-target=true.')
            source = args.source.resolve(strict=True)
            manifest = json.loads((source / 'manifest.json').read_text())
            if manifest.get('format') != 1:
                raise ValueError('Unsupported backup format.')
            for name in ['database.sql.gz', 'media.tar.gz']:
                file = source / name
                if file.is_symlink() or not file.is_file() or digest(file) != manifest['files'][name]['sha256'] or file.stat().st_size != manifest['files'][name]['bytes']:
                    raise ValueError('Backup checksum verification failed.')
            media = args.media_root.resolve()
            if media == Path('/') or media == source or media in source.parents or source in media.parents:
                raise ValueError('Restore media must use a separate empty directory.')
            media.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            if any(media.iterdir()):
                raise ValueError('Restore media directory must be empty.')
            check = subprocess.run(command(args.container, args.database, COUNT), capture_output=True, text=True)
            if check.returncode or check.stdout.strip() != '0':
                raise ValueError('Restore database must exist, match MYSQL_DATABASE, use a non-root account and contain no tables.')
            stage = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='.webox-restore-', dir=media.parent))
            try:
                total = 0
                with tarfile.open(source / 'media.tar.gz', 'r|gz') as bundle:
                    for member in bundle:
                        relative = PurePosixPath(member.name)
                        if relative.is_absolute() or '..' in relative.parts or not relative.parts or not (member.isfile() or member.isdir()):
                            raise ValueError('Unsafe media archive entry.')
                        if member.size < 0 or member.size > 5_242_880:
                            raise ValueError('Media archive file exceeds the application size limit.')
                        total += member.size
                        if total > 10 * 1024 ** 3:
                            raise ValueError('Media archive exceeds the 10 GiB restore limit.')
                        destination = stage.joinpath(*relative.parts)
                        if member.isdir():
                            destination.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                        else:
                            destination.parent.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                            with bundle.extractfile(member) as data, destination.open('xb') as output:
                                shutil.copyfileobj(data, output)
                process = subprocess.Popen(command(args.container, args.database, IMPORT), stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
                try:
                    with gzip.open(source / 'database.sql.gz', 'rb') as data:
                        shutil.copyfileobj(data, process.stdin)
                    process.stdin.close()
                    if process.wait() != 0:
                        raise RuntimeError('MySQL restore failed. Keep this target isolated and inspect it before another attempt.')
                finally:
                    if process.poll() is None:
                        process.kill()
                        process.wait()
                media.rmdir()
                stage.rename(media)
                print(json.dumps({'restoredDatabase': args.database, 'mediaRoot': str(media), 'isolated': True, 'complete': True}))
            finally:
                if stage.exists():
                    shutil.rmtree(stage)
        
        def main():
            os.umask(0o077)
            parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
            parser.add_argument('mode', choices=['backup', 'restore'])
            parser.add_argument('--container', required=True)
            parser.add_argument('--database', required=True)
            parser.add_argument('--media-root', type=Path, required=True)
            parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path)
            parser.add_argument('--from-backup', dest='source', type=Path)
            args = parser.parse_args()
            if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,127}', args.container) or not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,63}', args.database):
                parser.error('Invalid container or database name.')
            if args.mode == 'backup' and args.output is None or args.mode == 'restore' and args.source is None:
                parser.error('Backup requires --output; restore requires --from-backup.')
            try:
                (backup if args.mode == 'backup' else restore)(args)
            except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError, subprocess.SubprocessError, tarfile.TarError, KeyError) as error:
                # Never emit SQL, environment values, credentials or archive contents.
                print(f'Storage operation failed: {type(error).__name__}. Check the supplied paths, schema, isolation label and container access. Incomplete outputs are not valid backups.', file=sys.stderr)
                return 1
            return 0
        
        if __name__ == '__main__':
            sys.exit(main())
        EOF

    /** Launched twice as separate JVMs; credentials are inherited through environment variables. */
    public final class CacheRestartProbe {
        public static void main(String[] args) {
            try(var context=new SpringApplicationBuilder(WeBoxApplication.class).web(WebApplicationType.NONE).profiles("test").run()) {
                var cache=context.getBean(MenuDetailsCache.class);var service=context.getBean(MenuService.class);
                if(cache.size()!=0 || cache.stats().missCount()!=0) throw new AssertionError("Process must start with a cold cache");
                var first=service.dish(java.time.LocalDate.parse(args[0]),args[1]);var second=service.dish(java.time.LocalDate.parse(args[0]),args[1]);
                if(!first.equals(second) || cache.stats().missCount()!=1 || cache.stats().hitCount()!=1) throw new AssertionError("Cold/warm reads must agree");
                System.out.println("CACHE_PROBE="+first.dishId()+":"+first.dishVersion()+":"+first.basePriceCents()+":"+first.remaining()+":"+first.inventoryVersion());
            }
        }
    }

        cat > docs/operations.md <<'EOF'
        # 运行与维护
        
        当前目标为单实例Spring Boot + 独立MySQL + 同源Nginx HTTPS，生产配置不代表已经对外部署。生产域名、真实证书和主机由部署方提供。完整验证状态见`docs/validation/`及验收台账。
        
        ## 构建与部署
        
        1. 使用JDK17、Node24/npm11，执行`./scripts/frontend.sh ci`、`./scripts/frontend.sh run build`、`./scripts/backend.sh verify`。发布构建产物为`frontend/dist/`和`backend/target/webox-api-0.1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar`。真实模型另按README的live入口验证。
        2. 创建操作系统专用用户webox，将静态文件安装到`/srv/webox/frontend/`、JAR安装到`/srv/webox/webox-api.jar`，创建该用户拥有的`/srv/webox/media/`与`/srv/webox/runtime/`。媒体必须持久化，不能随发布目录删除。
        3. MySQL8.4使用独立进程和持久卷。创建生产专用schema和非root账号，授权仅限该schema。应用需SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE；启动时Flyway还需CREATE/ALTER/INDEX/REFERENCES/DROP等迁移权限，禁止全局授权。开发、测试、恢复目标各自独立，不能共用生产schema。
        4. 以0600权限保存`/etc/webox/application.env`，配置DB_URL（含UTC连接参数）、DB_USERNAME、DB_PASSWORD、MEDIA_ROOT、OPENROUTER_API_KEY、OPENROUTER_MODEL。不要把凭据写入命令行、前端、版本库、日志或报告。该环境文件采用systemd EnvironmentFile格式；不要直接把含任意shell语法的文件当脚本执行。
        5. 安装`infra/webox.service`，确认`/usr/bin/java`为JDK17，运行prod profile。默认仅监听127.0.0.1:8080，Cookie强制Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite=Lax。容器化时只能在私有网络监听0.0.0.0，并把TRUSTED_PROXY_REGEX限定为实际代理地址；不公开应用和MySQL端口。
        6. Nginx验证版本为1.30.6，容器镜像固定`nginx:1.30.6-alpine@sha256:970364228b1e4f932abc22d321932816782cca8a20b85a77552a7cfe9acfb3b5`。安装`infra/nginx.conf`为conf.d配置，把server_name改为真实域名，提供`/etc/nginx/tls/fullchain.pem`和`privkey.pem`，执行`nginx -t`后启动或reload。HTTP重定向HTTPS；静态SPA回退、带hash资源一年缓存、index重新验证、API不缓存；TLS1.2/1.3、HSTS、CSP和点击劫持保护已配置。
        7. `/api/`关闭响应缓冲和压缩，读超时65秒大于15秒心跳，保留同源Cookie和CSRF；代理不自动重放写请求。覆盖客户端X-Forwarded-For，只有可信代理可决定真实地址。依据[Nginx代理文档](https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_proxy_module.html)及[HTTPS文档](https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/configuring_https_servers.html)。
        
        采用单实例是当前库存SSE广播和内存限流的明确边界。业务库存、报价、订单幂等、会话和偏好均在MySQL；Caffeine只缓存菜品版本化静态资料。扩展多个应用节点前必须引入跨节点事件广播和共享限流，不能直接增加副本。
        
        ## 健康、指标与故障
        
        公开`GET /api/v1/health`仅给UP状态；生产`/actuator/health`及`/actuator/metrics/**`由Admin会话保护，未公开env/configprops等端点。完整接口仍要求登录、角色及写请求CSRF。根据[Spring Boot端点文档](https://docs.spring.io/spring-boot/reference/actuator/endpoints.html)显式控制暴露和权限。
        
        聚合指标包括`webox.orders`的created/replayed、`webox.conflicts`固定错误码、`webox.order.lock.retries`、`webox.outbox.pending`、`webox.inventory.active`、`webox.ai.active`、`webox.ai.first_card`和`webox.ai.finished`；Caffeine的cache.*命中/未命中已接入，Spring提供HTTP/JVM/连接池指标。没有用户ID、session、地址、提示词或generation ID标签。outbox积压读取失败时为-1，不能当0处理。请求返回X-Request-Id；业务日志仅记录请求ID、错误码、异常类型。Nginx关闭包含URL查询的access log。
        
        建议监控5xx、连接池等待、内存、磁盘、持续outbox积压、库存/AI活跃连接和延迟，并结合本部署基线设置告警。AI不可用时返回明确错误，普通菜单/报价/订单不依赖AI。不得以清理未发布事件或订单来消除积压。锁冲突最多三次尝试，客户端网络不确定时继续使用原幂等key。
        
        ## 有界限流
        
        限流在认证与CSRF校验之后执行，采用单调时钟令牌桶，最多10000个身份桶，空闲30分钟清除。限流返回429/RATE_LIMITED、Retry-After及X-Request-Id。服务器不直接信任客户端X-Forwarded-For。
        
        | Spring属性前缀webox.rate-limit | 默认突发容量 | 每分钟补充 | 范围 |
        | --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
        | auth-capacity / auth-per-minute | 60 | 120 | 同一真实IP的CSRF获取、注册、登录 |
        | global-auth-capacity / global-auth-per-minute | 600 | 1200 | 实例认证总入口，保护新身份桶大量创建 |
        | write-capacity / write-per-minute | 120 | 300 | 同一账号的普通写入 |
        | ai-capacity / ai-per-minute | 10 | 30 | 同一账号的推荐请求；另有并发1/等待8/总20秒限制 |
        
        注销不受频率桶阻止，仍需合法会话和CSRF。读菜单/库存快照不占写入桶，SSE另有每session3/实例600连接、队列和写超时约束。可通过同名Spring环境变量（如WEBOX_RATE_LIMIT_AUTH_CAPACITY）调整。普通隔离集成测试profile关闭限流以测试业务并发；RateLimitIT显式启用，真实浏览器E2E服务和生产启用。最终200人负载也必须启用，按实测校准并记录。
        
        ## 清理
        
        MaintenanceJobs单线程，每小时运行一批，启动默认延迟60秒；每批默认100行（上限1000），数据库事务5秒超时、READ COMMITTED，过期报价父行先锁定并跳过正在锁定的行。
        
        - 只删除已过期超过24小时且**未消费**的报价和其明细；已消费报价、订单、订单明细及成功幂等key永久保留。
        - 只删除发布超过7天的outbox记录；未发布记录永不清理，无论重试次数或年龄。
        - 媒体按有界1000文件窗口轮转；只删除超过24小时、文件名符合应用生成规则且无media_assets记录的临时/崩溃残留。保留全部注册资产（包括已替换图片）、新文件、符号链接与无关文件。
        
        属性在`webox.maintenance`下：enabled、initial-delay-ms、interval-ms、batch-size、quote-retention-hours、outbox-retention-days、media-retention-hours。测试单独验证这些保留边界；不要把业务日期直接当清理保留期。
        
        ## 备份与隔离恢复
        
        备份包含密码哈希、会话和私人业务数据，目录创建为0700、文件0600，放在`.local/backups/`或专门受控磁盘；不得上传到公开仓库。按业务要求至少每日一次并保留滚动副本，将加密副本存到独立存储，定期验证恢复。脚本不擅自删除历史备份或声明未验证RPO/RTO。
        
        `infra/backup.sh`需要显式指定拥有MYSQL_USER/MYSQL_PASSWORD/MYSQL_DATABASE环境的MySQL容器，凭据仅在容器内使用。使用非root专用schema账号；`mysqldump --single-transaction`一致性导出，不进行DDL变更期间执行备份。先导出DB，再归档不可变媒体；维护不删除注册媒体，因此导出时引用的资产仍可拷贝。额外新媒体可以存在于归档，不改变数据库快照。
        
        ```bash
        ./infra/backup.sh --container YOUR_MYSQL_CONTAINER --database webox_prod \
          --media-root /srv/webox/media --output /secure/backups/webox-YYYYMMDD-HHMM
        ```
        
        成功目录包括database.sql.gz、media.tar.gz、manifest.json（SHA-256、字节数、时间、文件数）。没有完整manifest或校验失败的目录不能恢复。备份脚本绝不把SQL写到终端。
        
        恢复脚本仅接受容器标签`webox.restore-target=true`、名称以`webox_restore_`开头且匹配该容器MYSQL_DATABASE的**空schema**、非root账号及**空媒体目录**。恢复前验证SHA-256，拒绝目录穿越、符号链接、特殊文件、单文件超过5MiB和总媒体超过10GiB的归档。超大部署须另行评估并调整明确上限。不会DROP或覆盖已有schema/媒体。
        
        ```bash
        ./infra/restore.sh --container YOUR_LABELLED_RESTORE_CONTAINER \
          --database webox_restore_drill --media-root /isolated/webox-media \
          --from-backup /secure/backups/webox-YYYYMMDD-HHMM
        ```
        
        恢复失败保留目标隔离；不要把部分恢复目标切换到生产。成功后用独立端口启动同版本应用，核对账号、偏好、地址、订单/状态/金额、库存、图片和未过期会话；确认注销会话仍无效。正常应用/MySQL重启与备份恢复是两项不同验证，证据由T130单独保存。
        
        ## 本地生产代理验证
        
        先构建前端，再运行`./scripts/backend.sh -Pproxy verify`。该测试只使用隔离MySQL、临时测试证书及固定Nginx镜像，检查真实构建SPA、TLS、安全Cookie、API/指标权限、库存SSE即时快照和推荐POST SSE。测试证书不用于外部部署。

            var admin=admins.initialize(environment.getProperty("ADMIN_EMAIL"),environment.getProperty("ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD"));

            context.close();
        }

    import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

    @Component
    public class CheckoutWarnings {
        private final PreferencesRepository preferences;
        public CheckoutWarnings(PreferencesRepository preferences) {this.preferences=preferences;}
        public List<Map<String,Object>> forItems(String user,List<PricedLine> items) {
            var personal=preferences.get(user);var warnings=new ArrayList<Map<String,Object>>();long total=0;
            for(int index=0;index<items.size();index++) {
                var item=items.get(index);total=ValueRules.add(total,item.subtotalCents());var matches=item.effectiveAllergens().stream().filter(personal.allergens()::contains).map(Enum::name).sorted().toList();
                if(!matches.isEmpty()) warnings.add(Map.of("code","FLAGGED_ALLERGEN","message","This selection contains your flagged allergens: "+String.join(", ",matches)+". You may continue if you choose.","dishId",item.dishId(),"itemIndex",index,"allergens",matches));
            }
            if(personal.budgetMaxCents()!=null && total>personal.budgetMaxCents()) warnings.add(Map.of("code","BUDGET_EXCEEDED","message","This order exceeds your maximum meal budget. You can still place the order."));
            return List.copyOf(warnings);
        }
    }

    package com.webox.ordering;
    import java.time.*;
    import java.util.Map;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
    import com.webox.shared.*;
    import com.webox.shared.DomainTypes.Meal;
    @Component
    public class OrderPolicy {
        private final BusinessClock clock;private final OrderRepository orders;
        public OrderPolicy(BusinessClock clock,OrderRepository orders) { this.clock=clock;this.orders=orders; }
        public void quantity(long total) { if(total<1 || total>5) throw new ApiException(422,"ORDER_LIMIT_EXCEEDED","An order must contain 1 to 5 portions."); }
        public void slot(LocalDate date,Meal meal) {
            if(date==null || meal==null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Select a delivery date and meal.");
            Instant now=clock.now();LocalDate today=now.atZone(BusinessClock.ZONE).toLocalDate();
            if(date.isBefore(today)) throw new ApiException(422,"INVALID_DELIVERY_DATE","Choose today or a future delivery date.");
            if(!now.isBefore(clock.cutoff(date,meal))) {
                boolean dinner=now.isBefore(clock.cutoff(today,Meal.Dinner));
                throw new ApiException(409,"SLOT_EXPIRED","This meal has closed. Confirm the suggested delivery date and meal before continuing.",false,Map.of("suggestedDeliveryDate",dinner?today:today.plusDays(1),"suggestedMeal",dinner?Meal.Dinner:Meal.Lunch));
            }
        }
        public void active(String user,LocalDate date,Meal meal) { orders.active(user,date,meal).ifPresent(id->{throw new ApiException(409,"ACTIVE_ORDER_EXISTS","You already have an active order for this meal.",false,Map.of("existingOrderId",id));}); }
        public void notExpired(Instant expires) { if(!clock.now().isBefore(expires)) throw new ApiException(409,"QUOTE_EXPIRED","This quote has expired. Review your cart and request a new quote."); }
    }

    package com.webox.shared;
    import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonCreator;
    import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonValue;
    public final class DomainTypes {
        private DomainTypes() {}
        public enum Role { Employee, Admin }
        public enum Category {
            Chinese("Chinese"), Western("Western"), Japanese("Japanese"), LightMeal("Light Meal"), Korean("Korean"), SoutheastAsian("Southeast Asian");
            private final String value;
            Category(String value) { this.value = value; }
            @JsonValue public String value() { return value; }
            @JsonCreator public static Category parse(String value) {
                for (var category : values()) if (category.value.equals(value)) return category;
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid category.");
            }
        }
        public enum SpiceLevel { None, Mild, Medium, Hot }
        public enum Allergen { Peanuts, Dairy, Egg, Gluten, Soy, Fish, Shellfish }
        public enum Flavor { Light, Moderate, Strong }
        public enum Meal { Lunch, Dinner }
        public enum OrderStatus { Pending, Confirmed, Completed, Cancelled }
        public enum SelectionType { Single, Multiple }
    }

    @ActiveProfiles("test")

        protected static final Path MEDIA_ROOT = temporaryMedia();
        protected static final MySQLContainer MYSQL = database();
    
        static {
            Runtime.getRuntime().addShutdownHook(new Thread(() -> {
                MYSQL.stop();
                try (var paths = Files.walk(MEDIA_ROOT)) {
                    paths.sorted(Comparator.reverseOrder()).forEach(path -> {
                        try { Files.deleteIfExists(path); } catch (IOException ignored) { /* Temporary files only. */ }
                    });
                } catch (IOException ignored) { /* The OS may already have removed the temporary directory. */ }
            }, "webox-test-cleanup"));
        }
    
        @org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach
        void restoreTestClock() { TEST_CLOCK.set(INITIAL_TIME); }

            try { return Files.createTempDirectory("webox-test-media-"); }
            catch (IOException e) { throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot create isolated test media directory", e); }
        }
    
        private static MySQLContainer database() {
            if (!DockerClientFactory.instance().isDockerAvailable()) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("Docker is required for core MySQL integration tests; tests cannot be skipped.");
            }
            var mysql = new MySQLContainer(MYSQL_IMAGE)
                    .withDatabaseName("webox_test")
                    .withUsername("webox_test")
                    .withPassword(UUID.randomUUID().toString())
                    .withCommand("--character-set-server=utf8mb4", "--collation-server=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci", "--default-time-zone=+00:00");
            mysql.start();
            return mysql;
        }
    
        protected static String jdbcUrl() {
            String base = MYSQL.getJdbcUrl();
            return base + (base.contains("?") ? "&" : "?") + "connectionTimeZone=UTC&forceConnectionTimeZoneToSession=true";
        }

        public static class TimeConfiguration {
            @Bean @Primary Clock testClock() { return TEST_CLOCK; }

        public static final class MutableClock extends Clock {
            private final AtomicReference<Instant> current;
            private final ZoneId zone;
            private final ThreadLocal<Instant> requestTime;
            public MutableClock(Instant instant, ZoneId zone) { this(new AtomicReference<>(instant), zone, new ThreadLocal<>()); }
            private MutableClock(AtomicReference<Instant> current, ZoneId zone, ThreadLocal<Instant> requestTime) { this.current = current; this.zone = zone;this.requestTime=requestTime; }
            public void set(Instant instant) { current.set(instant); }
            public void requestTime(Instant instant) { if(instant==null) requestTime.remove();else requestTime.set(instant); }
            @Override public ZoneId getZone() { return zone; }
            @Override public Clock withZone(ZoneId zone) { return new MutableClock(current, zone, requestTime); }
            @Override public Instant instant() { return requestTime.get()==null?current.get():requestTime.get(); }
        }
    }

        private record Policy(int capacity,int perMinute){Policy{if(capacity<1||perMinute<1||capacity>1000000||perMinute>1000000)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid rate limit.");}}
        private static final class Bucket {
            private double tokens;private long updated=System.nanoTime();private final Policy policy;
            Bucket(Policy policy){this.policy=policy;tokens=policy.capacity();}
            synchronized int take(){long now=System.nanoTime();tokens=Math.min(policy.capacity(),tokens+(now-updated)*policy.perMinute()/60_000_000_000.0);updated=now;if(tokens>=1){tokens--;return 0;}return Math.max(1,(int)Math.ceil((1-tokens)*60/policy.perMinute()));}
        }
        private final Cache<String,Bucket> buckets=Caffeine.newBuilder().maximumSize(10000).expireAfterAccess(Duration.ofMinutes(30)).build();
        private final JsonMapper json;private final OperationalMetrics metrics;private final boolean enabled;private final Policy auth,write,ai;private final Bucket globalAuth;
        public RateLimitFilter(JsonMapper json,OperationalMetrics metrics,
            @Value("${webox.rate-limit.enabled:true}") boolean enabled,
            @Value("${webox.rate-limit.auth-capacity:60}") int authCapacity,@Value("${webox.rate-limit.auth-per-minute:120}") int authRate,
            @Value("${webox.rate-limit.write-capacity:120}") int writeCapacity,@Value("${webox.rate-limit.write-per-minute:300}") int writeRate,
            @Value("${webox.rate-limit.ai-capacity:10}") int aiCapacity,@Value("${webox.rate-limit.ai-per-minute:30}") int aiRate,
            @Value("${webox.rate-limit.global-auth-capacity:600}") int globalCapacity,@Value("${webox.rate-limit.global-auth-per-minute:1200}") int globalRate) {
            this.json=json;this.metrics=metrics;this.enabled=enabled;auth=new Policy(authCapacity,authRate);write=new Policy(writeCapacity,writeRate);ai=new Policy(aiCapacity,aiRate);globalAuth=new Bucket(new Policy(globalCapacity,globalRate));
        }
        @Override protected void doFilterInternal(HttpServletRequest request,HttpServletResponse response,FilterChain chain)throws ServletException,IOException {
            if(!enabled){chain.doFilter(request,response);return;}String path=request.getRequestURI().substring(request.getContextPath().length()),scope=null,key=null;Policy policy=null;
            if(Set.of("/api/v1/auth/csrf","/api/v1/auth/login","/api/v1/auth/register").contains(path)){scope="authentication";key="auth:"+request.getRemoteAddr();policy=auth;}
            else if(!Set.of("GET","HEAD","OPTIONS").contains(request.getMethod()) && path.startsWith("/api/v1/") && !path.equals("/api/v1/auth/logout")) {
                var authentication=SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication();if(authentication!=null && authentication.getPrincipal() instanceof UserIdentity user){boolean recommendation=path.equals("/api/v1/recommendations/stream");scope=recommendation?"recommendation":"write";key=scope+":"+user.userId();policy=recommendation?ai:write;}
            }
            if(key!=null){Policy selected=policy;int retry=buckets.get(key,ignored->new Bucket(selected)).take();if(retry==0&&scope.equals("authentication"))retry=globalAuth.take();if(retry>0){metrics.limited(scope);response.setHeader("Retry-After",String.valueOf(retry));ApiErrors.write(json,request,response,new ApiException(429,"RATE_LIMITED","Too many requests. Please try again shortly.",true,Map.of()));return;}}
            chain.doFilter(request,response);
        }
    }

    package com.webox.shared;
    import com.webox.inventory.InventorySubscriptions;
    import com.webox.recommendation.RecommendationStreams;
    import io.micrometer.core.instrument.*;
    import java.time.Duration;
    import java.util.Set;
    import org.springframework.beans.factory.*;
    import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
    /** Aggregate operational metrics only: no account, session, address, prompt or generation-ID labels. */
    @Component
    public class OperationalMetrics implements SmartInitializingSingleton {
        private final MeterRegistry registry;private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;private final ObjectProvider<InventorySubscriptions> inventory;private final ObjectProvider<RecommendationStreams> recommendations;
        public OperationalMetrics(MeterRegistry registry,JdbcTemplate jdbc,ObjectProvider<InventorySubscriptions> inventory,ObjectProvider<RecommendationStreams> recommendations){this.registry=registry;this.jdbc=jdbc;this.inventory=inventory;this.recommendations=recommendations;}
        @Override public void afterSingletonsInstantiated(){
            var stock=inventory.getIfAvailable();if(stock!=null)Gauge.builder("webox.inventory.active",stock,InventorySubscriptions::size).register(registry);
            var ai=recommendations.getIfAvailable();if(ai!=null)Gauge.builder("webox.ai.active",ai,RecommendationStreams::size).register(registry);
            Gauge.builder("webox.outbox.pending",jdbc,db->{try{return db.queryForObject("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outbox_events WHERE published_at IS NULL",Long.class);}catch(RuntimeException unavailable){return -1;}}).register(registry);
            for(String outcome:Set.of("created","replayed"))registry.counter("webox.orders", "outcome",outcome);
            registry.counter("webox.order.lock.retries");
        }
        public void order(boolean replay){registry.counter("webox.orders","outcome",replay?"replayed":"created").increment();}
        public void lockRetry(){registry.counter("webox.order.lock.retries").increment();}
        public void failure(String code){
            if(Set.of("INSUFFICIENT_STOCK","DISH_UNAVAILABLE","DISH_CHANGED","ACTIVE_ORDER_EXISTS","VERSION_CONFLICT","IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED","QUOTE_CONSUMED","INVALID_ORDER_TRANSITION").contains(code))registry.counter("webox.conflicts","code",code).increment();
        }
        public void limited(String scope){registry.counter("webox.rate_limited","scope",scope).increment();}
        public void firstCard(long nanos){Timer.builder("webox.ai.first_card").publishPercentileHistogram().register(registry).record(Duration.ofNanos(nanos));}
        public void aiFinished(String outcome,long nanos){String label=Set.of("COMPLETE","NO_MATCH","CANCELLED","AI_INVALID_RESPONSE","AI_TIMEOUT","AI_UNAVAILABLE","AI_BUSY","INTENT_CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED","SESSION_EXPIRED").contains(outcome)?outcome:"OTHER";Timer.builder("webox.ai.finished").tag("outcome",label).publishPercentileHistogram().register(registry).record(Duration.ofNanos(nanos));}
    }

        }

    import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.condition.ConditionalOnWebApplication;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
    @RestController @ConditionalOnWebApplication
    @RequestMapping("/api/v1/menus/{date}")
    public class InventoryController {
        private final InventoryQuery inventory;private final InventorySubscriptions subscriptions;
        public InventoryController(InventoryQuery inventory,InventorySubscriptions subscriptions){this.inventory=inventory;this.subscriptions=subscriptions;}
        @GetMapping("/inventory") public InventoryModels.Snapshot snapshot(@PathVariable String date){return inventory.snapshot(ValueRules.date(date));}
        @GetMapping(value="/events",produces="text/event-stream") public void events(@PathVariable String date,HttpServletRequest request,HttpServletResponse response) throws IOException {
            var day=ValueRules.date(date);var connection=subscriptions.register(day,request.getSession(false).getId());
            try {
                var snapshot=inventory.snapshot(day);response.setContentType("text/event-stream");response.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");response.setHeader("Cache-Control","no-store");response.setHeader("X-Accel-Buffering","no");
                connection.begin(snapshot,request.startAsync(),response);
            }catch(IOException | RuntimeException failure){connection.close();throw failure;}
        }
    }

    test('lost create response retries the frozen key and preserves additions made before resolving it', async ({ page, context }) => {
      await identitySession(context);const fixture = await catalog(context);await checkout(page, fixture);await page.getByLabel('New address').fill('Office B');await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Review order' }).click();
      const requests: { key: string | null; body: string | null }[] = [];
      await page.route('**/api/v1/orders', async route => {
        if (route.request().method() !== 'POST') return route.continue();
        requests.push({ key: await route.request().headerValue('idempotency-key'), body: route.request().postData() });
        if (requests.length === 1) { const persisted = await route.fetch();expect(persisted.status()).toBe(201);await route.abort('failed'); }
        else { const replay = await route.fetch();expect(replay.status()).toBe(200);expect(replay.headers()['idempotency-replayed']).toBe('true');await route.fulfill({ response: replay }); }
      });
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Place Order' }).click();await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Retry same order request' })).toBeVisible();await expect(page.getByLabel('New address')).toBeDisabled();
      await page.route('**/api/v1/auth/me', route => route.fulfill({ status: 503, contentType: 'application/json', body: JSON.stringify({ code: 'TEMPORARY_UNAVAILABLE', message: 'Temporary test outage.', requestId: crypto.randomUUID(), retryable: true }) }));
      await page.evaluate(() => window.dispatchEvent(new Event('focus')));await expect(page.getByRole('alert')).toContainText('Could not check your session');
      await page.unroute('**/api/v1/auth/me');await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Try again' }).click();await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Retry same order request' })).toBeVisible();

    export function CartPage() {
      const [editing, setEditing] = useState<CartLine | null>(null), opener = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
      const cart = useCart(), count = totalQuantity(cart.state), blocked = cart.busy || !count || cart.state.lines.some(line => line.issue || !line.dish.remaining);
      return <section><div className="page-heading"><div><p className="eyebrow">MADE JUST FOR YOU</p><h1>Your cart</h1><p>Delivery date: {cart.date} · Up to 5 portions per order</p></div><Link to="/menu">Keep browsing</Link></div>
        {cart.busy && <Loading>Checking current prices and availability…</Loading>}{cart.notice && <ErrorNotice message={cart.notice} retry={cart.refresh} />}{cart.state.error && <ErrorNotice message={cart.state.error} />}{count > 0 && <button type="button" className="secondary recheck-cart" disabled={cart.busy} onClick={cart.refresh}>Check current availability</button>}
        {!count && !cart.busy ? <div className="panel empty-state"><h2>Your next good meal starts here</h2><p>Your cart is empty.           const names = line.original?.snapshot.optionNames ?? line.dish.optionGroups.flatMap(group => group.options.filter(option => line.optionIds.includes(option.optionId)).map(option => option.name));
          const availability = purchaseAvailability(cart.state, line.dish);
          return <article className="cart-line panel" key={line.key} aria-label={`${line.dish.name}, ${names.join(', ')}`}><DishImage src={line.dish.imageUrl} name={line.dish.name} /><div className="cart-line-body"><h2>{line.dish.name}</h2><p>{names.join(' · ') || 'Standard preparation'}</p><p>¥{money(line.unitPriceCents)} each</p>
            {line.issue === 'changed' && <div className="notice"><p>This dish has changed. Current unit price: ¥{money(configuration(line.dish, line.optionIds).unitPriceCents)}. Review and confirm to continue.</p><button type="button" disabled={cart.busy} onClick={() => cart.dispatch({ type: 'confirm', key: line.key })}>Confirm updated item</button></div>}
            {line.issue === 'unavailable' && <p className="notice error" role="alert">This configuration or quantity is unavailable on the selected date. Reduce the quantity, remove it, or choose another dish.</p>}
            <button type="button" className="text-button" disabled={cart.busy} onClick={event => { opener.current = event.currentTarget;setEditing(line); }}>Edit options</button><div className="quantity-controls"><button type="button" className="secondary" aria-label={`Decrease ${line.dish.name}`} disabled={cart.busy} onClick={() => cart.dispatch({ type: 'decrease', key: line.key })}>−</button><span aria-label="Quantity">{line.quantity}</span><button type="button" className="secondary" aria-label={`Increase ${line.dish.name}`} disabled={cart.busy || !availability.canAdd} onClick={() => cart.dispatch({ type: 'add', dish: line.dish, optionIds: line.optionIds })}>+</button><button type="button" className="text-button" disabled={cart.busy} onClick={() => cart.dispatch({ type: 'remove', key: line.key })}>Remove</button></div><strong>Subtotal: ¥{money(line.unitPriceCents * line.quantity)}</strong></div></article>;
        })}</div><aside className="panel cart-summary"><h2>Your meal</h2><p>{count} {count === 1 ? 'portion' : 'portions'}</p><p className="cart-total">Total <strong>¥{money(totalCents(cart.state))}</strong></p>{count >= 5 && <p className="form-hint">You can add up to 5 portions per order.</p>}{blocked ? <><button disabled>Continue to checkout</button><p className="form-hint">Resolve unavailable or changed items before checkout.</p></> : <Link className="button" to="/checkout">Continue to checkout</Link>}<p className="form-hint">Items in your cart do not reserve stock. Availability is confirmed when you place your order.</p></aside></div>}
        {editing && <DishDialog key={editing.key} dish={editing.dish} editing={editing} restoreFocus={opener.current} close={() => setEditing(null)} />}
      </section>;
    }

    /** 60-second ramp, then 600 seconds with all 200 authenticated users and their SSE streams alive. */
    public class MealOrderingSimulation extends Simulation {
        private final boolean smoke=Boolean.getBoolean("webox.load.smoke");
        private final int users=smoke?10:200,seconds=smoke?30:600;
        private final JsonMapper json=new JsonMapper();
        private final AtomicInteger ready=new AtomicInteger(),created=new AtomicInteger(),conflicts=new AtomicInteger();
        private final AtomicLong steady=new AtomicLong();
        private final List<Map<String,Object>> samples=new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
        private final ScheduledExecutorService monitor=Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor();
        private final Path report,state;
        private final Process application;
        private volatile Process browser;
        private final Map<String,Object> fixture;
        private volatile String monitorFailure;
        public MealOrderingSimulation() throws Exception {
            String name=System.getProperty("webox.load.run",(smoke?"smoke-":"full-")+Instant.now().toString().replace(':','-'));
            if(!name.matches("[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+"))throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid run label.");
            report=Path.of("target/load",name).toAbsolutePath();Files.createDirectories(report.getParent());Files.createDirectory(report);
            state=Files.createTempFile("webox-load-",".json");Files.setPosixFilePermissions(state,PosixFilePermissions.fromString("rw-------"));
            var builder=new ProcessBuilder(Path.of(System.getProperty("java.home"),"bin/java").toString(),"-Xms256m","-Xmx1g","-Duser.timezone=UTC","-cp",System.getProperty("java.class.path"),"com.webox.load.LoadFixture",state.toString());
            builder.environment().remove("OPENROUTER_API_KEY");builder.environment().remove("SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE");
            application=builder.redirectErrorStream(true).redirectOutput(report.resolve("application.log").toFile()).start();
            Runtime.getRuntime().addShutdownHook(new Thread(this::cleanup));
            long timeout=System.nanoTime()+Duration.ofSeconds(120).toNanos();
            while(application.isAlive()&&Files.size(state)==0&&System.nanoTime()<timeout)Thread.sleep(100);
            if(Files.size(state)==0){cleanup();throw new IllegalStateException("Isolated load fixture did not start; inspect its application log.");}
            fixture=json.readValue(Files.readString(state),Map.class);
            if(((Number)fixture.get("dishCount")).intValue()!=500)throw new IllegalStateException("Load fixture must contain 500 dishes.");
            var browserState=new LinkedHashMap<>(fixture);browserState.remove("employees");browserState.put("output",report.resolve("browser").toString());browserState.put("smoke",smoke);browserState.put("expectedActive",users);
            Path browserFile=report.resolve("browser-state.json");Files.writeString(browserFile,json.writeValueAsString(browserState));Files.setPosixFilePermissions(browserFile,PosixFilePermissions.fromString("rw-------"));
            var rows=(List<Map<String,Object>>)fixture.get("employees");var feeder=rows.subList(0,users).iterator();String date=(String)fixture.get("date"),origin=(String)fixture.get("apiOrigin");
            var protocol=http.baseUrl(origin).acceptHeader("application/json").contentTypeHeader("application/json").disableCaching().disableWarmUp();
            var scenario=scenario("Authenticated employee with one inventory stream")
                .feed(feeder).exec(addCookie(Cookie("WEBOXSESSION","#{cookie}")))
                .exec(http("Session and CSRF").get("/api/v1/auth/csrf").check(status().is(200),jsonPath("$.token").saveAs("csrf"))).exitHereIfFailed()
                .exec(sse("Inventory connection").get("/api/v1/menus/"+date+"/events").await(10).on(sse.checkMessage("Initial inventory snapshot").check(jsonPath("$.event").is("inventory.snapshot")))).exitHereIfFailed()
                .exec(session->{if(ready.incrementAndGet()==users)steady.set(System.nanoTime());return session;})
                .asLongAs(session->steady.get()==0).on(pause(1))
                .pause(1,5)
                .exec(http("Valid quote").post("/api/v1/checkout/quotes").header("X-XSRF-TOKEN","#{csrf}")
                    .body(StringBody("{\"deliveryDate\":\""+date+"\",\"meal\":\"Lunch\",\"items\":[{\"dishId\":\"#{dishId}\",\"dishVersion\":1,\"quantity\":1,\"optionIds\":[]}]}"))
                    .check(status().is(201),jsonPath("$.quoteId").saveAs("quoteId"))).exitHereIfFailed()
                .exec(session->session.set("key",UUID.randomUUID().toString()))
                .exec(http("Valid order").post("/api/v1/orders").header("X-XSRF-TOKEN","#{csrf}").header("Idempotency-Key","#{key}")
                    .body(StringBody("{\"quoteId\":\"#{quoteId}\",\"addressText\":\"Load fixture office\"}"))
                    .check(status().saveAs("orderStatus"),status().is(201),jsonPath("$.orderId").saveAs("orderId")))
                .exec(session->{if(session.contains("orderStatus")){int code=session.getInt("orderStatus");if(code==201)created.incrementAndGet();if(code==409)conflicts.incrementAndGet();}return session;}).exitHereIfFailed()
                .pause(1,5)
                .exec(http("Cancel pending order").post("/api/v1/orders/#{orderId}/cancel").header("X-XSRF-TOKEN","#{csrf}").body(StringBody("{}")).check(status().is(200))).exitHereIfFailed()
                .asLongAs(session->System.nanoTime()-steady.get()<Duration.ofSeconds(seconds+2).toNanos()).on(
                    pause(1,5),exec(http("Menu page").get("/api/v1/menus/"+date).queryParam("page",session->(session.userId()%20)).check(status().is(200))),
                    pause(1,5),exec(http("Search dishes").get("/api/v1/menus/"+date).queryParam("q","#{search}").check(status().is(200),jsonPath("$.totalElements").ofInt().is(1))),
                    pause(1,5),exec(http("Dish details").get("/api/v1/menus/"+date+"/dishes/#{dishId}").check(status().is(200))))
                .exec(sse("Close inventory connection").close());
            setUp(scenario.injectOpen(rampUsers(users).during(smoke?5:60))).protocols(protocol).maxDuration(Duration.ofSeconds(seconds+(smoke?90:150)))
                .assertions(global().failedRequests().count().is(0L),details("Valid order").successfulRequests().count().is((long)users));
            before(()->monitor.scheduleAtFixedRate(()->sample(origin,browserFile),0,1,TimeUnit.SECONDS));
            after(()->{
                monitor.shutdownNow();boolean browserPassed=false;
                try{
                    if(browser!=null&&browser.waitFor(10,TimeUnit.SECONDS))browserPassed=browser.exitValue()==0;
                    var proof=new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();proof.put("smokeOnly",smoke);proof.put("users",users);proof.put("dishes",500);proof.put("rampSeconds",smoke?5:60);proof.put("steadySeconds",seconds);proof.put("ready",ready.get());proof.put("validOrders",created.get());proof.put("businessConflicts",conflicts.get());proof.put("samples",samples);proof.put("browserPassed",browserPassed);proof.put("monitorFailure",monitorFailure);proof.put("separateApplicationJvm",true);proof.put("applicationHeap","256m–1g");proof.put("hikariPool",16);proof.put("sharedIpAuthenticationBurst",240);proof.put("sharedIpAuthenticationPerMinute",300);
                    boolean active=samples.size()>=seconds&&samples.stream().allMatch(row->((Number)row.get("activeInventoryStreams")).doubleValue()>=users);
                    proof.put("passed",ready.get()==users&&created.get()==users&&active&&browserPassed&&monitorFailure==null);
                    Files.writeString(report.resolve("result.json"),json.writerWithDefaultPrettyPrinter().writeValueAsString(proof));
                    if(!(Boolean)proof.get("passed"))throw new AssertionError("Load validation failed; inspect result.json and browser.log.");
                }catch(Exception error){throw new IllegalStateException("Load proof could not be completed.",error);}finally{try{Files.deleteIfExists(browserFile);}catch(Exception ignored){}cleanup();}
            });
        }
        private void sample(String origin,Path browserFile){
            if(steady.get()==0)return;long elapsed=System.nanoTime()-steady.get();if(elapsed>Duration.ofSeconds(seconds).toNanos())return;
            try{
                var response=HttpClientHolder.CLIENT.send(HttpRequest.newBuilder(URI.create(origin+"/actuator/metrics/webox.inventory.active")).header("Cookie","WEBOXSESSION="+fixture.get("adminCookie")).timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(3)).GET().build(),HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString());
                if(response.statusCode()!=200)throw new IllegalStateException();double active=json.readTree(response.body()).path("measurements").get(0).path("value").asDouble();
                samples.add(Map.of("elapsedMs",elapsed/1_000_000,"activeInventoryStreams",active));
                if(browser==null){var process=new ProcessBuilder(Path.of("../scripts/frontend.sh").toAbsolutePath().normalize().toString(),"exec","--","playwright","test","--config=playwright.performance.config.ts").redirectErrorStream(true).redirectOutput(report.resolve("browser.log").toFile());process.environment().put("WEBOX_LOAD_STATE",browserFile.toString());browser=process.start();}
            }catch(Exception failure){monitorFailure=failure.getClass().getSimpleName();}
        }
        private static class HttpClientHolder {static final HttpClient CLIENT=HttpClient.newBuilder().connectTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(2)).build();}
        private void cleanup(){
            monitor.shutdownNow();if(browser!=null&&browser.isAlive()){browser.descendants().forEach(ProcessHandle::destroy);browser.destroy();}
            if(application!=null&&application.isAlive()){application.destroy();try{if(!application.waitFor(40,TimeUnit.SECONDS))application.destroyForcibly();}catch(InterruptedException e){Thread.currentThread().interrupt();}}
            try{Files.deleteIfExists(state);}catch(Exception ignored){}
        }
    }

    # 运行与维护
    
    当前目标为单实例Spring Boot + 独立MySQL + 同源Nginx HTTPS，生产配置不代表已经对外部署。生产域名、真实证书和主机由部署方提供。完整验证状态见`docs/validation/`及验收台账。
    
    ## 构建与部署
    
    1. 使用JDK17、Node24/npm11，执行`./scripts/frontend.sh ci`、`./scripts/frontend.sh run build`、`./scripts/backend.sh verify`。发布构建产物为`frontend/dist/`和`backend/target/webox-api-0.1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar`。真实模型另按README的live入口验证。
    2. 创建操作系统专用用户webox，将静态文件安装到`/srv/webox/frontend/`、JAR安装到`/srv/webox/webox-api.jar`，创建该用户拥有的`/srv/webox/media/`与`/srv/webox/runtime/`。媒体必须持久化，不能随发布目录删除。
    3. MySQL8.4使用独立进程和持久卷。创建生产专用schema和非root账号，授权仅限该schema。应用需SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE；启动时Flyway还需CREATE/ALTER/INDEX/REFERENCES/DROP等迁移权限，禁止全局授权。开发、测试、恢复目标各自独立，不能共用生产schema。
    4. 以0600权限保存`/etc/webox/application.env`，配置DB_URL（含UTC连接参数）、DB_USERNAME、DB_PASSWORD、MEDIA_ROOT、OPENROUTER_API_KEY、OPENROUTER_MODEL。不要把凭据写入命令行、前端、版本库、日志或报告。该环境文件采用systemd EnvironmentFile格式；不要直接把含任意shell语法的文件当脚本执行。
    5. 安装`infra/webox.service`，确认`/usr/bin/java`为JDK17，运行prod profile。默认仅监听127.0.0.1:8080，Cookie强制Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite=Lax。容器化时只能在私有网络监听0.0.0.0，并把TRUSTED_PROXY_REGEX限定为实际代理地址；不公开应用和MySQL端口。
    6. Nginx验证版本为1.30.6，容器镜像固定`nginx:1.30.6-alpine@sha256:970364228b1e4f932abc22d321932816782cca8a20b85a77552a7cfe9acfb3b5`。安装`infra/nginx.conf`为conf.d配置，把server_name改为真实域名，提供`/etc/nginx/tls/fullchain.pem`和`privkey.pem`，执行`nginx -t`后启动或reload。HTTP重定向HTTPS；静态SPA回退、带hash资源一年缓存、index重新验证、API不缓存；TLS1.2/1.3、HSTS、CSP和点击劫持保护已配置。
    7. `/api/`关闭响应缓冲和压缩，读超时65秒大于15秒心跳，保留同源Cookie和CSRF；代理不自动重放写请求。覆盖客户端X-Forwarded-For，只有可信代理可决定真实地址。依据[Nginx代理文档](https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_proxy_module.html)及[HTTPS文档](https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/configuring_https_servers.html)。
    
    采用单实例是当前库存SSE广播和内存限流的明确边界。业务库存、报价、订单幂等、会话和偏好均在MySQL；Caffeine只缓存菜品版本化静态资料。扩展多个应用节点前必须引入跨节点事件广播和共享限流，不能直接增加副本。
    
    ## 健康、指标与故障
    
    公开`GET /api/v1/health`仅给UP状态；生产`/actuator/health`及`/actuator/metrics/**`由Admin会话保护，未公开env/configprops等端点。完整接口仍要求登录、角色及写请求CSRF。根据[Spring Boot端点文档](https://docs.spring.io/spring-boot/reference/actuator/endpoints.html)显式控制暴露和权限。
    
    聚合指标包括`webox.orders`的created/replayed、`webox.conflicts`固定错误码、`webox.order.lock.retries`、`webox.outbox.pending`、`webox.inventory.active`、`webox.ai.active`、`webox.ai.first_card`和`webox.ai.finished`；Caffeine的cache.*命中/未命中已接入，Spring提供HTTP/JVM/连接池指标。没有用户ID、session、地址、提示词或generation ID标签。outbox积压读取失败时为-1，不能当0处理。请求返回X-Request-Id；业务日志仅记录请求ID、错误码、异常类型。Nginx关闭包含URL查询的access log。
    
    建议监控5xx、连接池等待、内存、磁盘、持续outbox积压、库存/AI活跃连接和延迟，并结合本部署基线设置告警。AI不可用时返回明确错误，普通菜单/报价/订单不依赖AI。不得以清理未发布事件或订单来消除积压。锁冲突最多三次尝试，客户端网络不确定时继续使用原幂等key。
    
    ## 有界限流
    
    限流在认证与CSRF校验之后执行，采用单调时钟令牌桶，最多10000个身份桶，空闲30分钟清除。限流返回429/RATE_LIMITED、Retry-After及X-Request-Id。服务器不直接信任客户端X-Forwarded-For。
    
    | Spring属性前缀webox.rate-limit | 默认突发容量 | 每分钟补充 | 范围 |
    | --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
    | auth-capacity / auth-per-minute | 60 | 120 | 同一真实IP的CSRF获取、注册、登录 |
    | global-auth-capacity / global-auth-per-minute | 600 | 1200 | 实例认证总入口，保护新身份桶大量创建 |
    | write-capacity / write-per-minute | 120 | 300 | 同一账号的普通写入 |
    | ai-capacity / ai-per-minute | 10 | 30 | 同一账号的推荐请求；另有并发1/等待8/总20秒限制 |
    
    注销不受频率桶阻止，仍需合法会话和CSRF。读菜单/库存快照不占写入桶，SSE另有每session3/实例600连接、队列和写超时约束。可通过同名Spring环境变量（如WEBOX_RATE_LIMIT_AUTH_CAPACITY）调整。普通隔离集成测试profile关闭限流以测试业务并发；RateLimitIT显式启用，真实浏览器E2E服务和生产启用。最终200人负载也必须启用，按实测校准并记录。
    
    ## 清理
    
    MaintenanceJobs单线程，每小时运行一批，启动默认延迟60秒；每批默认100行（上限1000），数据库事务5秒超时、READ COMMITTED，过期报价父行先锁定并跳过正在锁定的行。
    
    - 只删除已过期超过24小时且**未消费**的报价和其明细；已消费报价、订单、订单明细及成功幂等key永久保留。
    - 只删除发布超过7天的outbox记录；未发布记录永不清理，无论重试次数或年龄。
    - 媒体按有界1000文件窗口轮转；只删除超过24小时、文件名符合应用生成规则且无media_assets记录的临时/崩溃残留。保留全部注册资产（包括已替换图片）、新文件、符号链接与无关文件。
    
    属性在`webox.maintenance`下：enabled、initial-delay-ms、interval-ms、batch-size、quote-retention-hours、outbox-retention-days、media-retention-hours。测试单独验证这些保留边界；不要把业务日期直接当清理保留期。
    
    ## 备份与隔离恢复
    
    备份包含密码哈希、会话和私人业务数据，目录创建为0700、文件0600，放在`.local/backups/`或专门受控磁盘；不得上传到公开仓库。按业务要求至少每日一次并保留滚动副本，将加密副本存到独立存储，定期验证恢复。脚本不擅自删除历史备份或声明未验证RPO/RTO。
    
    `infra/backup.sh`需要显式指定拥有MYSQL_USER/MYSQL_PASSWORD/MYSQL_DATABASE环境的MySQL容器，凭据仅在容器内使用。使用非root专用schema账号；`mysqldump --single-transaction`一致性导出，不进行DDL变更期间执行备份。先导出DB，再归档不可变媒体；维护不删除注册媒体，因此导出时引用的资产仍可拷贝。额外新媒体可以存在于归档，不改变数据库快照。
    
    ```bash
    ./infra/backup.sh --container YOUR_MYSQL_CONTAINER --database webox_prod \
      --media-root /srv/webox/media --output /secure/backups/webox-YYYYMMDD-HHMM
    ```
    
    成功目录包括database.sql.gz、media.tar.gz、manifest.json（SHA-256、字节数、时间、文件数）。没有完整manifest或校验失败的目录不能恢复。备份脚本绝不把SQL写到终端。
    
    恢复脚本仅接受容器标签`webox.restore-target=true`、名称以`webox_restore_`开头且匹配该容器MYSQL_DATABASE的**空schema**、非root账号及**空媒体目录**。恢复前验证SHA-256，拒绝目录穿越、符号链接、特殊文件、单文件超过5MiB和总媒体超过10GiB的归档。超大部署须另行评估并调整明确上限。不会DROP或覆盖已有schema/媒体。
    
    ```bash
    ./infra/restore.sh --container YOUR_LABELLED_RESTORE_CONTAINER \
      --database webox_restore_drill --media-root /isolated/webox-media \
      --from-backup /secure/backups/webox-YYYYMMDD-HHMM
    ```
    
    恢复失败保留目标隔离；不要把部分恢复目标切换到生产。成功后用独立端口启动同版本应用，核对账号、偏好、地址、订单/状态/金额、库存、图片和未过期会话；确认注销会话仍无效。正常应用/MySQL重启与备份恢复是两项不同验证，证据由T130单独保存。
    
    ## 本地生产代理验证
    
    先构建前端，再运行`./scripts/backend.sh -Pproxy verify`。该测试只使用隔离MySQL、临时测试证书及固定Nginx镜像，检查真实构建SPA、TLS、安全Cookie、API/指标权限、库存SSE即时快照和推荐POST SSE。测试证书不用于外部部署。

    # 真人首次使用验收
    
    状态：**未执行，等待10名此前未使用本系统的真人参与**。自动浏览器、模型自评及开发者操作不计入此分母。T133保持未完成；工程实现和其余验证继续进行。
    
    参与者使用P01–P10匿名编号，记录经其同意的计时和回答，不记录姓名、真实配送地址或密码。每人独立完成、使用新的Employee账号；主持人只宣读任务，不指路或代操作。使用隔离验收数据库和虚构办公地址，确认页面连接真实OpenRouter模型，先记录应用版本、浏览器、日期、主持人及设备。
    
    ## 主持流程
    
    1. 从未登录首页开始计时，要求参与者注册、选菜、完成一次合法订餐；允许自行查看界面。出现Pending订单详情时停止计时。请其口头说明配送日期、午餐/晚餐、配送地址与订单状态。记录四项原始回答、计时及是否得到帮助。SC-001要求至少9/10在300秒内完成且正确理解配送信息；超时、放弃、得到代操作都保留在10人分母中。
    2. 让参与者在设置中选择一种过敏原和一个预算范围，尝试包含该过敏原的配置及超过预算的组合。分别问“这个提示意味着什么？继续操作会怎样？”。记录原话；理解过敏原风险与预算提醒、知道仍须自己决定才算通过。SC-008要求至少9/10同时理解两类警告，不以点击确认本身判定理解。
    3. 让参与者输入自己的餐食偏好，获取一次真实AI推荐，查看卡片理由并可选择菜品。记录提示词的非敏感摘要、实际推荐菜名、原样理由及请求ID，询问“这些理由是否与刚才的需求相关？为什么？”。保留不相关、无卡和错误结果；不得反复请求直到满意再挑选记录。SC-010要求至少8/10认为理由相关。若确有预期澄清，记录澄清和后续输入，不能隐去首次结果。
    4. 另给一位具备Admin账号的实际运营参与者任务：“新增一款英文菜品，上传本地图片，安排指定日期供应，将它下架，再上架”。从任务宣读完毕到员工菜单可看到上架菜品计时，要求300秒以内。记录操作完成情况、员工页面验证与帮助情况，对应SC-007。
